t: So do not let one avert you from it who does not believe in it and follows his desire, for you [then] would perish.

r: Ta-Ha 20:17
t: And what is that in your right hand, O Moses?"

r: Ta-Ha 20:18
t: He said, "It is my staff; I lean upon it, and I bring down leaves for my sheep and I have therein other uses."

r: Ta-Ha 20:19
t: [Allāh] said, "Throw it down, O Moses."

r: Ta-Ha 20:20
t: So he threw it down, and thereupon it was a snake, moving swiftly.

r: Ta-Ha 20:21
t: [Allāh] said, "Seize it and fear not; We will return it to its former condition.

r: Ta-Ha 20:22
t: And draw in your hand to your side; it will come out white without disease - another sign,

r: Ta-Ha 20:23
t: That We may show you [some] of Our greater signs.

r: Ta-Ha 20:24
t: Go to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed [i.e., tyrannized]."

r: Ta-Ha 20:25
t: [Moses] said, "My Lord, expand [i.e., relax] for me my breast [with assurance]

r: Ta-Ha 20:26
t: And ease for me my task

r: Ta-Ha 20:27
t: And untie the knot from my tongue

r: Ta-Ha 20:28
t: That they may understand my speech.

r: Ta-Ha 20:29
t: And appoint for me a minister [i.e., assistant] from my family -

r: Ta-Ha 20:30
t: Aaron, my brother.

r: Ta-Ha 20:31
t: Increase through him my strength

r: Ta-Ha 20:32
t: And let him share my task

r: Ta-Ha 20:33
t: That we may exalt You much

r: Ta-Ha 20:34
t: And remember You much.

r: Ta-Ha 20:35
t: Indeed, You are of us ever Seeing."

r: Ta-Ha 20:36
t: [Allāh] said, "You have been granted your request, O Moses.

r: Ta-Ha 20:37
t: And We had already conferred favor upon you another time,

r: Ta-Ha 20:38
t: When We inspired to your mother what We inspired,

r: Ta-Ha 20:39
t: [Saying], 'Cast him into the chest and cast it into the river, and the river will throw it onto the bank; there will take him an enemy to Me and an enemy to him.' And I bestowed upon you love from Me that you would be brought up under My eye [i.e., observation and care].

r: Ta-Ha 20:40
t: [And We favored you] when your sister went and said, 'Shall I direct you to someone who will be responsible for him?' So We restored you to your mother that she might be content and not grieve. And you killed someone, but We saved you from retaliation and tried you with a [severe] trial. And you remained [some] years among the people of Madyan. Then you came [here] at the decreed time, O Moses.

r: Ta-Ha 20:41
t: And I produced you for Myself.

r: Ta-Ha 20:42
t: Go, you and your brother, with My signs and do not slacken in My remembrance.

r: Ta-Ha 20:43
t: Go, both of you, to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed.

r: Ta-Ha 20:44
t: And speak to him with gentle speech that perhaps he may be reminded or fear [Allāh]."

r: Ta-Ha 20:45
t: They said, "Our Lord, indeed we are afraid that he will hasten [punishment] against us or that he will transgress."

r: Ta-Ha 20:46
t: [Allāh] said, "Fear not. Indeed, I am with you both; I hear and I see.

r: Ta-Ha 20:47
t: So go to him and say, 'Indeed, we are messengers of your Lord, so send with us the Children of Israel and do not torment them. We have come to you with a sign from your Lord. And peace will be upon he who follows the guidance.

r: Ta-Ha 20:48
t: Indeed, it has been revealed to us that the punishment will be upon whoever denies and turns away.'"

r: Ta-Ha 20:49
t: [Pharaoh] said, "So who is the Lord of you two, O Moses?"

r: Ta-Ha 20:50
t: He said, "Our Lord is He who gave each thing its form and then guided [it]."

r: Ta-Ha 20:51
t: [Pharaoh] said, "Then what is the case of the former generations?"

r: Ta-Ha 20:52
t: [Moses] said, "The knowledge thereof is with my Lord in a record. My Lord neither errs nor forgets."

r: Ta-Ha 20:53
t: [It is He] who has made for you the earth as a bed [spread out] and inserted therein for you roadways and sent down from the sky, rain and produced thereby categories of various plants.

r: Ta-Ha 20:54
t: Eat [therefrom] and pasture your livestock. Indeed in that are signs for those of intelligence.

r: Ta-Ha 20:55
t: From it [i.e., the earth] We created you, and into it We will return you, and from it We will extract you another time.

r: Ta-Ha 20:56
t: And We certainly showed him [i.e., Pharaoh] Our signs - all of them - but he denied and refused.

r: Ta-Ha 20:57
t: He said, "Have you come to us to drive us out of our land with your magic, O Moses?

r: Ta-Ha 20:58
t: Then we will surely bring you magic like it, so make between us and you an appointment, which we will not fail to keep and neither will you, in a place assigned."

r: Ta-Ha 20:59
t: [Moses] said, "Your appointment is on the day of the festival when the people assemble at mid-morning."

r: Ta-Ha 20:60
t: So Pharaoh went away, put together his plan, and then came [to Moses].

r: Ta-Ha 20:61
t: Moses said to them [i.e., the magicians summoned by Pharaoh], "Woe to you! Do not invent a lie against Allāh or He will exterminate you with a punishment; and he has failed who invents [such falsehood]."

r: Ta-Ha 20:62
t: So they disputed over their affair among themselves and concealed their private conversation.

r: Ta-Ha 20:63
t: They said, "Indeed, these are two magicians who want to drive you out of your land with their magic and do away with your most exemplary way [i.e., religion or tradition].

r: Ta-Ha 20:64
t: So resolve upon your plan and then come [forward] in line. And he has succeeded today who overcomes."

r: Ta-Ha 20:65
t: They said, "O Moses, either you throw or we will be the first to throw."

r: Ta-Ha 20:66
t: He said, "Rather, you throw." And suddenly their ropes and staffs seemed to him from their magic that they were moving [like snakes].

r: Ta-Ha 20:67
t: And he sensed within himself apprehension, did Moses.

r: Ta-Ha 20:68
t: We [i.e., Allāh] said, "Fear not. Indeed, it is you who are superior.

r: Ta-Ha 20:69
t: And throw what is in your right hand; it will swallow up what they have crafted. What they have crafted is but the trick of a magician, and the magician will not succeed wherever he is."

r: Ta-Ha 20:70
t: So the magicians fell down in prostration. They said, "We have believed in the Lord of Aaron and Moses."

r: Ta-Ha 20:71
t: [Pharaoh] said, "You believed him [i.e., Moses] before I gave you permission. Indeed, he is your leader who has taught you magic. So I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will crucify you on the trunks of palm trees, and you will surely know which of us is more severe in [giving] punishment and more enduring."

r: Ta-Ha 20:72
t: They said, "Never will we prefer you over what has come to us of clear proofs and [over] He who created us. So decree whatever you are to decree. You can only decree for this worldly life.

r: Ta-Ha 20:73
t: Indeed, we have believed in our Lord that He may forgive us our sins and what you compelled us [to do] of magic. And Allāh is better and more enduring."

r: Ta-Ha 20:74
t: Indeed, whoever comes to his Lord as a criminal - indeed, for him is Hell; he will neither die therein nor live.

r: Ta-Ha 20:75
t: But whoever comes to Him as a believer having done righteous deeds - for those will be the highest degrees [in position]:

r: Ta-Ha 20:76
t: Gardens of perpetual residence beneath which rivers flow, wherein they abide eternally. And that is the reward of one who purifies himself.

r: Ta-Ha 20:77
t: And We had inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants and strike for them a dry path through the sea; you will not fear being overtaken [by Pharaoh] nor be afraid [of drowning]."

r: Ta-Ha 20:78
t: So Pharaoh pursued them with his soldiers, and there covered them from the sea that which covered them,

r: Ta-Ha 20:79
t: And Pharaoh led his people astray and did not guide [them].

r: Ta-Ha 20:80
t: O Children of Israel, We delivered you from your enemy, and We made an appointment with you at the right side of the mount, and We sent down to you manna and quails,

r: Ta-Ha 20:81
t: [Saying], "Eat from the good things with which We have provided you and do not transgress [or oppress others] therein, lest My anger should descend upon you. And he upon whom My anger descends has certainly fallen [i.e., perished]."

r: Ta-Ha 20:82
t: But indeed, I am the Perpetual Forgiver of whoever repents and believes and does righteousness and then continues in guidance.

r: Ta-Ha 20:83
t: [Allāh said], "And what made you hasten from your people, O Moses?"

r: Ta-Ha 20:84
t: He said, "They are close upon my tracks, and I hastened to You, my Lord, that You be pleased."

r: Ta-Ha 20:85
t: [Allāh] said, "But indeed, We have tried your people after you [departed], and the Sāmirī has led them astray."

r: Ta-Ha 20:86
t: So Moses returned to his people, angry and grieved. He said, "O my people, did your Lord not make you a good promise? Then, was the time [of its fulfillment] too long for you, or did you wish that wrath from your Lord descend upon you, so you broke your promise [of obedience] to me?"

r: Ta-Ha 20:87
t: They said, "We did not break our promise to you by our will, but we were made to carry burdens from the ornaments of the people [of Pharaoh], so we threw them [into the fire], and thus did the Sāmirī throw."

r: Ta-Ha 20:88
t: And he extracted for them [the statue of] a calf which had a lowing sound, and they said, "This is your god and the god of Moses, but he forgot."

r: Ta-Ha 20:89
t: Did they not see that it could not return to them any speech [i.e., response] and that it did not possess for them any harm or benefit?

r: Ta-Ha 20:90
t: And Aaron had already told them before [the return of Moses], "O my people, you are only being tested by it, and indeed, your Lord is the Most Merciful, so follow me and obey my order."

r: Ta-Ha 20:91
t: They said, "We will never cease being devoted to it [i.e., the calf] until Moses returns to us."

r: Ta-Ha 20:92
t: [Moses] said, "O Aaron, what prevented you, when you saw them going astray,

r: Ta-Ha 20:93
t: From following me? Then have you disobeyed my order?"

r: Ta-Ha 20:94
t: [Aaron] said, "O son of my mother, do not seize [me] by my beard or by my head. Indeed, I feared that you would say, 'You caused division among the Children of Israel, and you did not observe [or await] my word.'"

r: Ta-Ha 20:95
t: [Moses] said, "And what is your case, O Sāmirī?"

r: Ta-Ha 20:96
t: He said, "I saw what they did not see, so I took a handful [of dust] from the track of the messenger and threw it, and thus did my soul entice me."

r: Ta-Ha 20:97
t: [Moses] said, "Then go. And indeed, it is [decreed] for you in [this] life to say, 'No contact.' And indeed, you have an appointment [in the Hereafter] you will not fail to keep. And look at your 'god' to which you remained devoted. We will surely burn it and blow it [i.e., its ashes] into the sea with a blast.

r: Ta-Ha 20:98
t: Your god is only Allāh, except for whom there is no deity. He has encompassed all things in knowledge."

r: Ta-Ha 20:99
t: Thus, [O Muḥammad], We relate to you from the news of what has preceded. And We have certainly given you from Us a message [i.e., the Qur’ān].
Whoever turns away from it - then indeed, he will bear on the Day of Resurrection a burden [i.e., great sin],
[Abiding] eternally therein, and evil it is for them on the Day of Resurrection as a load -
The Day the Horn will be blown. And We will gather the criminals, that Day, blue-eyed.
They will murmur among themselves, "You remained not but ten [days in the world]."
We are most knowing of what they say when the best of them in manner [i.e., wisdom or speech] will say, "You remained not but one day."
And they ask you about the mountains, so say, "My Lord will blow them away with a blast.
And He will leave it [i.e., the earth] a level plain;
You will not see therein a depression or an elevation."

That Day, they [i.e., everyone] will follow [the call of] the Caller [with] no deviation therefrom, and [all] voices will be stilled before the Most Merciful, so you will not hear except a whisper [of footsteps].
That Day, no intercession will benefit except [that of] one to whom the Most Merciful has given permission and has accepted his word.
He [i.e., Allāh] knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, but they do not encompass it [i.e., what He knows] in knowledge.
And [all] faces will be humbled before the Ever-Living, the Self-Sustaining. And he will have failed who carries injustice.
But he who does of righteous deeds while he is a believer - he will neither fear injustice nor deprivation.
And thus We have sent it down as an Arabic Qur’ān and have diversified therein the warnings that perhaps they will avoid [sin] or it would cause them remembrance.

So high [above all] is Allāh, the Sovereign, the Truth. And, [O Muḥammad], do not hasten with [recitation of] the Qur’ān before its revelation is completed to you, and say, "My Lord, increase me in knowledge."
And We had already taken a promise from Adam before, but he forgot; and We found not in him determination.
And [mention] when We said to the angels, "Prostrate to Adam," and they prostrated, except Iblees; he refused.
So We said, "O Adam, indeed this is an enemy to you and to your wife. Then let him not remove you from Paradise so you would suffer.
Indeed, it is [promised] for you not to be hungry therein or be unclothed.
And indeed, you will not be thirsty therein or be hot from the sun."
Then Satan whispered to him; he said, "O Adam, shall I direct you to the tree of eternity and possession that will not deteriorate?"

And they [i.e., Adam and his wife] ate of it, and their private parts became apparent to them, and they began to fasten over themselves from the leaves of Paradise. And Adam disobeyed his Lord and erred.
Then his Lord chose him and turned to him in forgiveness and guided [him].

[Allāh] said, "Descend from it [i.e., Paradise] - all, [your descendants] being enemies to one another. And if there should come to you guidance from Me - then whoever follows My guidance will neither go astray [in the world] nor suffer [in the Hereafter].
And whoever turns away from My remembrance - indeed, he will have a depressed [i.e., difficult] life, and We will gather [i.e., raise] him on the Day of Resurrection blind."
He will say, "My Lord, why have you raised me blind while I was [once] seeing?"
[Allāh] will say, "Thus did Our signs come to you, and you forgot [i.e., disregarded] them; and thus will you this Day be forgotten."
And thus do We recompense he who transgressed and did not believe in the signs of his Lord. And the punishment of the Hereafter is more severe and more enduring.
Then, has it not become clear to them how many generations We destroyed before them as they walk among their dwellings? Indeed in that are signs for those of intelligence.
And if not for a word that preceded from your Lord, it [i.e., punishment] would have been an obligation [due immediately], and [if not for] a specified term [decreed].

So be patient over what they say and exalt [Allāh] with praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting; and during periods of the night [exalt Him] and at the ends of the day, that you may be satisfied.

And do not extend your eyes toward that by which We have given enjoyment to [some] categories of them, [its being but] the splendor of worldly life by which We test them. And the provision of your Lord is better and more enduring.
And enjoin prayer upon your family [and people] and be steadfast therein. We ask you not for provision; We provide for you, and the [best] outcome is for [those of] righteousness.
And they say, "Why does he not bring us a sign from his Lord?" Has there not come to them evidence of what was in the former scriptures?

And if We had destroyed them with a punishment before him, they would have said, "Our Lord, why did You not send to us a messenger so we could have followed Your verses [i.e., teachings] before we were humiliated and disgraced?"
Say, "Each [of us] is waiting; so wait. For you will know who are the companions of the sound path and who is guided."

r: The Prophets 21:1
t: [The time of] their account has approached for the people, while they are in heedlessness turning away.

r: The Prophets 21:2
t: No mention [i.e., revelation] comes to them anew from their Lord except that they listen to it while they are at play

r: The Prophets 21:3
t: With their hearts distracted. And those who do wrong conceal their private conversation, [saying], "Is this [Prophet] except a human being like you? So would you approach magic while you are aware [of it]?"

r: The Prophets 21:4
t: He [the Prophet (ﷺ)] said, "My Lord knows whatever is said throughout the heaven and earth, and He is the Hearing, the Knowing."

r: The Prophets 21:5
t: But they say, "[The revelation is but] a mixture of false dreams; rather, he has invented it; rather, he is a poet. So let him bring us a sign just as the previous [messengers] were sent [with miracles]."

r: The Prophets 21:6
t: Not a [single] city which We destroyed believed before them, so will they believe?

r: The Prophets 21:7
t: And We sent not before you, [O Muḥammad], except men to whom We revealed [the message], so ask the people of the message [i.e., former scriptures] if you do not know.

r: The Prophets 21:8
t: And We did not make them [i.e., the prophets] forms not eating food, nor were they immortal [on earth].

r: The Prophets 21:9
t: Then We fulfilled for them the promise, and We saved them and whom We willed and destroyed the transgressors.

r: The Prophets 21:10
t: We have certainly sent down to you a Book [i.e., the Qur’ān] in which is your mention. Then will you not reason?

r: The Prophets 21:11
t: And how many a city which was unjust have We shattered and produced after it another people.

r: The Prophets 21:12
t: And when they [i.e., its inhabitants] perceived Our punishment, at once they fled from it.

r: The Prophets 21:13
t: [Some angels said], "Do not flee but return to where you were given luxury and to your homes - perhaps you will be questioned."

r: The Prophets 21:14
t: They said, "O woe to us! Indeed, we were wrongdoers."

r: The Prophets 21:15
t: And that declaration of theirs did not cease until We made them [as] a harvest [mowed down], extinguished [like a fire].

r: The Prophets 21:16
t: And We did not create the heaven and earth and that between them in play.

r: The Prophets 21:17
t: Had We intended to take a diversion, We could have taken it from [what is] with Us - if [indeed] We were to do so.

r: The Prophets 21:18
t: Rather, We dash the truth upon falsehood, and it destroys it, and thereupon it departs. And for you is destruction from that which you describe.

r: The Prophets 21:19
t: To Him belongs whoever is in the heavens and the earth. And those near Him [i.e., the angels] are not prevented by arrogance from His worship, nor do they tire.

r: The Prophets 21:20
t: They exalt [Him] night and day [and] do not slacken.

r: The Prophets 21:21
t: Or have they [i.e., men] taken for themselves gods from the earth who resurrect [the dead]?

r: The Prophets 21:22
t: Had there been within them [i.e., the heavens and earth] gods besides Allāh, they both would have been ruined. So exalted is Allāh, Lord of the Throne, above what they describe.

r: The Prophets 21:23
t: He is not questioned about what He does, but they will be questioned.

r: The Prophets 21:24
t: Or have they taken gods besides Him? Say, [O Muḥammad], "Produce your proof. This [Qur’ān] is the message for those with me and the message of those before me." But most of them do not know the truth, so they are turning away.

r: The Prophets 21:25
t: And We sent not before you any messenger except We revealed to him that, "There is no deity except Me, so worship Me."

r: The Prophets 21:26
t: And they say, "The Most Merciful has taken a son." Exalted is He! Rather, they are [but] honored servants.

r: The Prophets 21:27
t: They cannot precede Him in word, and they act by His command.

r: The Prophets 21:28
t: He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they cannot intercede except on behalf of one whom He approves. And they, from fear of Him, are apprehensive.

r: The Prophets 21:29
t: And whoever of them should say, "Indeed, I am a god besides Him" - that one We would recompense with Hell. Thus do We recompense the wrongdoers.

r: The Prophets 21:30
t: Have those who disbelieved not considered that the heavens and the earth were a joined entity, and then We separated them and made from water every living thing? Then will they not believe?

r: The Prophets 21:31
t: And We placed within the earth firmly set mountains, lest it should shift with them, and We made therein [mountain] passes [as] roads that they might be guided.

r: The Prophets 21:32
t: And We made the sky a protected ceiling, but they, from its signs, are turning away.

r: The Prophets 21:33
t: And it is He who created the night and the day and the sun and the moon; all [heavenly bodies] in an orbit are swimming.

r: The Prophets 21:34
t: And We did not grant to any man before you eternity [on earth]; so if you die - would they be eternal?

r: The Prophets 21:35
t: Every soul will taste death. And We test you with evil and with good as trial; and to Us you will be returned.

r: The Prophets 21:36
t: And when those who disbelieve see you, [O Muḥammad], they take you not except in ridicule, [saying], "Is this the one who mentions [i.e., insults] your gods?" And they are, at the mention of the Most Merciful, disbelievers.

r: The Prophets 21:37
t: Man was created of haste [i.e., impatience]. I will show you My signs [i.e., vengeance], so do not impatiently urge Me.

r: The Prophets 21:38
t: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"

r: The Prophets 21:39
t: If those who disbelieved but knew the time when they will not avert the Fire from their faces or from their backs and they will not be aided...

r: The Prophets 21:40
t: Rather, it will come to them unexpectedly and bewilder them, and they will not be able to repel it, nor will they be reprieved.

r: The Prophets 21:41
t: And already were messengers ridiculed before you, but those who mocked them were enveloped by what they used to ridicule.

r: The Prophets 21:42
t: Say, "Who can protect you at night or by day from the Most Merciful?" But they are, from the remembrance of their Lord, turning away.

r: The Prophets 21:43
t: Or do they have gods to defend them other than Us? They are unable [even] to help themselves, nor can they be protected from Us.

r: The Prophets 21:44
t: But, [on the contrary], We have provided good things for these [disbelievers] and their fathers until life was prolonged for them. Then do they not see that We set upon the land, reducing it from its borders? Is it they who will overcome?

r: The Prophets 21:45
t: Say, "I only warn you by revelation." But the deaf do not hear the call when they are warned.

r: The Prophets 21:46
t: And if [as much as] a whiff of the punishment of your Lord should touch them, they would surely say, "O woe to us! Indeed, we have been wrongdoers."

r: The Prophets 21:47
t: And We place the scales of justice for the Day of Resurrection, so no soul will be treated unjustly at all. And if there is [even] the weight of a mustard seed, We will bring it forth. And sufficient are We as accountant.

r: The Prophets 21:48
t: And We had already given Moses and Aaron the criterion and a light and a reminder for the righteous

r: The Prophets 21:49
t: Who fear their Lord unseen, while they are of the Hour apprehensive.

r: The Prophets 21:50
t: And this [Qur’ān] is a blessed message which We have sent down. Then are you with it unacquainted?

r: The Prophets 21:51
t: And We had certainly given Abraham his sound judgement before, and We were of him well-Knowing

r: The Prophets 21:52
t: When he said to his father and his people, "What are these statues to which you are devoted?"

r: The Prophets 21:53
t: They said, "We found our fathers worshippers of them."

r: The Prophets 21:54
t: He said, "You were certainly, you and your fathers, in manifest error."

r: The Prophets 21:55
t: They said, "Have you come to us with truth, or are you of those who jest?"

r: The Prophets 21:56
t: He said, "[No], rather, your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth who created them, and I, to that, am of those who testify.

r: The Prophets 21:57
t: And [I swear] by Allāh, I will surely plan against your idols after you have turned and gone away."

r: The Prophets 21:58
t: So he made them into fragments, except a large one among them, that they might return to it [and question].

r: The Prophets 21:59
t: They said, "Who has done this to our gods? Indeed, he is of the wrongdoers."

r: The Prophets 21:60
t: They said, "We heard a young man mention them who is called Abraham."

r: The Prophets 21:61
t: They said, "Then bring him before the eyes of the people that they may testify."

r: The Prophets 21:62
t: They said, "Have you done this to our gods, O Abraham?"

r: The Prophets 21:63
t: He said, "Rather, this - the largest of them - did it, so ask them, if they should [be able to] speak."

r: The Prophets 21:64
t: So they returned to [blaming] themselves and said [to each other], "Indeed, you are the wrongdoers."

r: The Prophets 21:65
t: Then they reversed themselves, [saying], "You have already known that these do not speak!"

r: The Prophets 21:66
t: He said, "Then do you worship instead of Allāh that which does not benefit you at all or harm you?

r: The Prophets 21:67
t: Uff to you and to what you worship instead of Allāh. Then will you not use reason?"

r: The Prophets 21:68
t: They said, "Burn him and support your gods - if you are to act."

r: The Prophets 21:69
t: We [i.e., Allāh] said, "O fire, be coolness and safety upon Abraham."

r: The Prophets 21:70
t: And they intended for him a plan [i.e., harm], but We made them the greatest losers.

r: The Prophets 21:71
t: And We delivered him and Lot to the land which We had blessed for the worlds [i.e., peoples].

r: The Prophets 21:72
t: And We gave him Isaac and Jacob in addition, and all [of them] We made righteous.

r: The Prophets 21:73
t: And We made them leaders guiding by Our command. And We inspired to them the doing of good deeds, establishment of prayer, and giving of zakāh; and they were worshippers of Us.

r: The Prophets 21:74
t: And to Lot We gave judgement and knowledge, and We saved him from the city that was committing wicked deeds. Indeed, they were a people of evil, defiantly disobedient.

r: The Prophets 21:75
t: And We admitted him into Our mercy. Indeed, he was of the righteous.

r: The Prophets 21:76
t: And [mention] Noah, when he called [to Allāh] before [that time], so We responded to him and saved him and his family from the great affliction [i.e., the flood].

r: The Prophets 21:77
t: And We aided [i.e., saved] him from the people who denied Our signs. Indeed, they were a people of evil, so We drowned them, all together.

r: The Prophets 21:78
t: And [mention] David and Solomon, when they judged concerning the field - when the sheep of a people overran it [at night], and We were witness to their judgement.

r: The Prophets 21:79
t: And We gave understanding of it [i.e., the case] to Solomon, and to each [of them] We gave judgement and knowledge. And We subjected the mountains to exalt [Us], along with David and [also] the birds. And We were doing [that].

r: The Prophets 21:80
t: And We taught him the fashioning of coats of armor to protect you from your [enemy in] battle. So will you then be grateful?

r: The Prophets 21:81
t: And to Solomon [We subjected] the wind, blowing forcefully, proceeding by his command toward the land which We had blessed. And We are ever, of all things, Knowing.

r: The Prophets 21:82
t: And of the devils [i.e., jinn] were those who dived for him and did work other than that. And We were of them a guardian.

r: The Prophets 21:83
t: And [mention] Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, adversity has touched me, and You are the most merciful of the merciful."

r: The Prophets 21:84
t: So We responded to him and removed what afflicted him of adversity. And We gave him [back] his family and the like thereof with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for the worshippers [of Allāh].

r: The Prophets 21:85
t: And [mention] Ishmael and Idrees and Dhul-Kifl; all were of the patient.

r: The Prophets 21:86
t: And We admitted them into Our mercy. Indeed, they were of the righteous.

r: The Prophets 21:87
t: And [mention] the man of the fish [i.e., Jonah], when he went off in anger and thought that We would not decree [anything] upon him. And he called out within the darknesses, "There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers."

r: The Prophets 21:88
t: So We responded to him and saved him from the distress. And thus do We save the believers.

r: The Prophets 21:89
t: And [mention] Zechariah, when he called to his Lord, "My Lord, do not leave me alone [with no heir], while You are the best of inheritors."

r: The Prophets 21:90
t: So We responded to him, and We gave to him John, and amended for him his wife. Indeed, they used to hasten to good deeds and supplicate Us in hope and fear, and they were to Us humbly submissive.

r: The Prophets 21:91
t: And [mention] the one who guarded her chastity [i.e., Mary], so We blew into her [garment] through Our angel [i.e., Gabriel], and We made her and her son a sign for the worlds.

r: The Prophets 21:92
t: Indeed this, your religion, is one religion, and I am your Lord, so worship Me.

r: The Prophets 21:93
t: And [yet] they divided their affair [i.e., that of their religion] among themselves, [but] all to Us will return.

r: The Prophets 21:94
t: So whoever does righteous deeds while he is a believer - no denial will there be for his effort, and indeed We [i.e., Our angels], of it, are recorders.

r: The Prophets 21:95
t: And it is prohibited to [the people of] a city which We have destroyed that they will [ever] return

r: The Prophets 21:96
t: Until when [the dam of] Gog and Magog has been opened and they, from every elevation, descend

r: The Prophets 21:97
t: And [when] the true promise [i.e., the resurrection] has approached; then suddenly the eyes of those who disbelieved will be staring [in horror, while they say], "O woe to us; we had been unmindful of this; rather, we were wrongdoers."

r: The Prophets 21:98
t: Indeed, you [disbelievers] and what you worship other than Allāh are the firewood of Hell. You will be coming to [enter] it.

r: The Prophets 21:99
t: Had these [false deities] been [actual] gods, they would not have come to it, but all are eternal therein.

r: The Prophets 21:100
t: For them therein is heavy sighing, and they therein will not hear.

r: The Prophets 21:101
t: Indeed, those for whom the best [reward] has preceded from Us - they are from it far removed.

r: The Prophets 21:102
t: They will not hear its sound, while they are, in that which their souls desire, abiding eternally.

r: The Prophets 21:103
t: They will not be grieved by the greatest terror, and the angels will meet them, [saying], "This is your Day which you have been promised" -

r: The Prophets 21:104
t: The Day when We will fold the heaven like the folding of a [written] sheet for the records. As We began the first creation, We will repeat it. [That is] a promise binding upon Us. Indeed, We will do it.

r: The Prophets 21:105
t: And We have already written in the book [of Psalms] after the [previous] mention that the land [of Paradise] is inherited by My righteous servants.

r: The Prophets 21:106
t: Indeed, in this [Qur’ān] is notification for a worshipping people.

r: The Prophets 21:107
t: And We have not sent you, [O Muḥammad], except as a mercy to the worlds.

r: The Prophets 21:108
t: Say, "It is only revealed to me that your god is but one God; so will you be Muslims [in submission to Him]?"

r: The Prophets 21:109
t: But if they turn away, then say, "I have announced to [all of] you equally. And I know not whether near or far is that which you are promised.

r: The Prophets 21:110
t: Indeed, He knows what is declared of speech, and He knows what you conceal.

r: The Prophets 21:111
t: And I know not; perhaps it is a trial for you and enjoyment for a time."

r: The Prophets 21:112
t: [The Prophet (ﷺ)] has said, "My Lord, judge [between us] in truth. And our Lord is the Most Merciful, the one whose help is sought against that which you describe."

r: The Pilgrimage 22:1
t: O mankind, fear your Lord. Indeed, the convulsion of the [final] Hour is a terrible thing.

r: The Pilgrimage 22:2
t: On the Day you see it every nursing mother will be distracted from that [child] she was nursing, and every pregnant woman will abort her pregnancy, and you will see the people [appearing] intoxicated while they are not intoxicated; but the punishment of Allāh is severe.

r: The Pilgrimage 22:3
t: And of the people is he who disputes about Allāh without knowledge and follows every rebellious devil.

r: The Pilgrimage 22:4
t: It has been decreed for him [i.e., every devil] that whoever turns to him - he will misguide him and will lead him to the punishment of the Blaze.

r: The Pilgrimage 22:5
t: O people, if you should be in doubt about the Resurrection, then [consider that] indeed, We created you from dust, then from a sperm-drop, then from a clinging clot, and then from a lump of flesh, formed and unformed - that We may show you. And We settle in the wombs whom We will for a specified term, then We bring you out as a child, and then [We develop you] that you may reach your [time of] maturity. And among you is he who is taken in [early] death, and among you is he who is returned to the most decrepit [old] age so that he knows, after [once having] knowledge, nothing. And you see the earth barren, but when We send down upon it rain, it quivers and swells and grows [something] of every beautiful kind.

r: The Pilgrimage 22:6
t: That is because Allāh is the True Reality and because He gives life to the dead and because He is over all things competent

r: The Pilgrimage 22:7
t: And [that they may know] that the Hour is coming - no doubt about it - and that Allāh will resurrect those in the graves.

r: The Pilgrimage 22:8
t: And of the people is he who disputes about Allāh without knowledge or guidance or an enlightening book [from Him],

r: The Pilgrimage 22:9
t: Twisting his neck [in arrogance] to mislead [people] from the way of Allāh. For him in the world is disgrace, and We will make him taste on the Day of Resurrection the punishment of the Burning Fire [while it is said],

r: The Pilgrimage 22:10
t: "That is for what your hands have put forth and because Allāh is not ever unjust to [His] servants."

r: The Pilgrimage 22:11
t: And of the people is he who worships Allāh on an edge. If he is touched by good, he is reassured by it; but if he is struck by trial, he turns on his face [to unbelief]. He has lost [this] world and the Hereafter. That is what is the manifest loss.

r: The Pilgrimage 22:12
t: He invokes instead of Allāh that which neither harms him nor benefits him. That is what is the extreme error.

r: The Pilgrimage 22:13
t: He invokes one whose harm is closer than his benefit - how wretched the protector and how wretched the associate.

r: The Pilgrimage 22:14
t: Indeed, Allāh will admit those who believe and do righteous deeds to gardens beneath which rivers flow. Indeed, Allāh does what He intends.

r: The Pilgrimage 22:15
t: Whoever should think that Allāh will not support him [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)] in this world and the Hereafter - let him extend a rope to the ceiling, then cut off [his breath], and let him see: will his effort remove that which enrages [him]?

r: The Pilgrimage 22:16
t: And thus have We sent it [i.e., the Qur’ān] down as verses of clear evidence and because Allāh guides whom He intends.

r: The Pilgrimage 22:17
t: Indeed, those who have believed and those who were Jews and the Sabeans and the Christians and the Magians and those who associated with Allāh - Allāh will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed Allāh is, over all things, Witness.

r: The Pilgrimage 22:18
t: Do you not see [i.e., know] that to Allāh prostrates whoever is in the heavens and whoever is on the earth and the sun, the moon, the stars, the mountains, the trees, the moving creatures and many of the people? But upon many the punishment has been justified. And he whom Allāh humiliates - for him there is no bestower of honor. Indeed, Allāh does what He wills.

r: The Pilgrimage 22:19
t: These are two adversaries who have disputed over their Lord. But those who disbelieved will have cut out for them garments of fire. Poured upon their heads will be scalding water

r: The Pilgrimage 22:20
t: By which is melted that within their bellies and [their] skins.

r: The Pilgrimage 22:21
t: And for [striking] them are maces of iron.

r: The Pilgrimage 22:22
t: Every time they want to get out of it [i.e., Hellfire] from anguish, they will be returned to it, and [it will be said], "Taste the punishment of the Burning Fire!"

r: The Pilgrimage 22:23
t: Indeed, Allāh will admit those who believe and do righteous deeds to gardens beneath which rivers flow. They will be adorned therein with bracelets of gold and pearl, and their garments therein will be silk.

r: The Pilgrimage 22:24
t: And they had been guided [in worldly life] to good speech, and they were guided to the path of the Praiseworthy.

r: The Pilgrimage 22:25
t: Indeed, those who have disbelieved and avert [people] from the way of Allāh and [from] al-Masjid al-Ḥarām, which We made for the people - equal are the resident therein and one from outside - and [also] whoever intends [a deed] therein of deviation [in religion] by wrongdoing - We will make him taste of a painful punishment.

r: The Pilgrimage 22:26
t: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when We designated for Abraham the site of the House, [saying], "Do not associate anything with Me and purify My House for those who perform ṭawāf and those who stand [in prayer] and those who bow and prostrate.

r: The Pilgrimage 22:27
t: And proclaim to the people the ḥajj [pilgrimage]; they will come to you on foot and on every lean camel; they will come from every distant pass -

r: The Pilgrimage 22:28
t: That they may witness [i.e., attend] benefits for themselves and mention the name of Allāh on known [i.e., specific] days over what He has provided for them of [sacrificial] animals. So eat of them and feed the miserable and poor.

r: The Pilgrimage 22:29
t: Then let them end their untidiness and fulfill their vows and perform ṭawāf around the ancient House."

r: The Pilgrimage 22:30
t: That [has been commanded], and whoever honors the sacred ordinances of Allāh - it is best for him in the sight of his Lord. And permitted to you are the grazing livestock, except what is recited to you. So avoid the uncleanliness of idols and avoid false statement,

r: The Pilgrimage 22:31
t: Inclining [only] to Allāh, not associating [anything] with Him. And he who associates with Allāh - it is as though he had fallen from the sky and was snatched by the birds or the wind carried him down into a remote place.

r: The Pilgrimage 22:32
t: That [is so]. And whoever honors the symbols [i.e., rites] of Allāh - indeed, it is from the piety of hearts.

r: The Pilgrimage 22:33
t: For you therein [i.e., the animals marked for sacrifice] are benefits for a specified term; then their place of sacrifice is at the ancient House.

r: The Pilgrimage 22:34
t: And for every [religious] community We have appointed a rite [of sacrifice] that they may mention the name of Allāh over what He has provided for them of [sacrificial] animals. For your god is one God, so to Him submit. And, [O Muḥammad], give good tidings to the humble [before their Lord]

r: The Pilgrimage 22:35
t: Who, when Allāh is mentioned, their hearts are fearful, and [to] the patient over what has afflicted them, and the establishers of prayer and those who spend from what We have provided them.

r: The Pilgrimage 22:36
t: And the camels and cattle We have appointed for you as among the symbols [i.e., rites] of Allāh; for you therein is good. So mention the name of Allāh upon them when lined up [for sacrifice]; and when they are [lifeless] on their sides, then eat from them and feed the needy [who does not seek aid] and the beggar. Thus have We subjected them to you that you may be grateful.

r: The Pilgrimage 22:37
t: Their meat will not reach Allāh, nor will their blood, but what reaches Him is piety from you. Thus have We subjected them to you that you may glorify Allāh for that [to] which He has guided you; and give good tidings to the doers of good.

r: The Pilgrimage 22:38
t: Indeed, Allāh defends those who have believed. Indeed, Allāh does not like everyone treacherous and ungrateful.

r: The Pilgrimage 22:39
t: Permission [to fight] has been given to those who are being fought, because they were wronged. And indeed, Allāh is competent to give them victory.

r: The Pilgrimage 22:40
t: [They are] those who have been evicted from their homes without right - only because they say, "Our Lord is Allāh." And were it not that Allāh checks the people, some by means of others, there would have been demolished monasteries, churches, synagogues, and mosques in which the name of Allāh is much mentioned [i.e., praised]. And Allāh will surely support those who support Him [i.e., His cause]. Indeed, Allāh is Powerful and Exalted in Might.

r: The Pilgrimage 22:41
t: [And they are] those who, if We give them authority in the land, establish prayer and give zakāh and enjoin what is right and forbid what is wrong. And to Allāh belongs the outcome of [all] matters.

r: The Pilgrimage 22:42
t: And if they deny you, [O Muḥammad] - so, before them, did the people of Noah and ʿAad and Thamūd deny [their prophets],

r: The Pilgrimage 22:43
t: And the people of Abraham and the people of Lot.

r: The Pilgrimage 22:44
t: And the inhabitants of Madyan. And Moses was denied, so I prolonged enjoyment for the disbelievers; then I seized them, and how [terrible] was My reproach.

r: The Pilgrimage 22:45
t: And how many a city did We destroy while it was committing wrong - so it is [now] fallen into ruin - and [how many] an abandoned well and [how many] a lofty palace.

r: The Pilgrimage 22:46
t: So have they not traveled through the earth and have hearts by which to reason and ears by which to hear? For indeed, it is not eyes that are blinded, but blinded are the hearts which are within the breasts.

r: The Pilgrimage 22:47
t: And they urge you to hasten the punishment. But Allāh will never fail in His promise. And indeed, a day with your Lord is like a thousand years of those which you count.

r: The Pilgrimage 22:48
t: And for how many a city did I prolong enjoyment while it was committing wrong. Then I seized it, and to Me is the [final] destination.

r: The Pilgrimage 22:49
t: Say, "O people, I am only to you a clear warner."

r: The Pilgrimage 22:50
t: And those who have believed and done righteous deeds - for them is forgiveness and noble provision.

r: The Pilgrimage 22:51
t: But the ones who strove against Our verses, [seeking] to cause failure - those are the companions of Hellfire.

r: The Pilgrimage 22:52
t: And We did not send before you any messenger or prophet except that when he spoke [or recited], Satan threw into it [some misunderstanding]. But Allāh abolishes that which Satan throws in; then Allāh makes precise His verses. And Allāh is Knowing and Wise.

r: The Pilgrimage 22:53
t: [That is] so He may make what Satan throws in [i.e., asserts] a trial for those within whose hearts is disease and those hard of heart. And indeed, the wrongdoers are in extreme dissension.

r: The Pilgrimage 22:54
t: And so those who were given knowledge may know that it is the truth from your Lord and [therefore] believe in it, and their hearts humbly submit to it. And indeed is Allāh the Guide of those who have believed to a straight path.

r: The Pilgrimage 22:55
t: But those who disbelieve will not cease to be in doubt of it until the Hour comes upon them unexpectedly or there comes to them the punishment of a barren Day.

r: The Pilgrimage 22:56
t: [All] sovereignty that Day is for Allāh; He will judge between them. So they who believed and did righteous deeds will be in the Gardens of Pleasure.

r: The Pilgrimage 22:57
t: And they who disbelieved and denied Our signs - for those there will be a humiliating punishment.

r: The Pilgrimage 22:58
t: And those who emigrated for the cause of Allāh and then were killed or died - Allāh will surely provide for them a good provision. And indeed, it is Allāh who is the best of providers.

r: The Pilgrimage 22:59
t: He will surely cause them to enter an entrance with which they will be pleased, and indeed, Allāh is Knowing and Forbearing.

r: The Pilgrimage 22:60
t: That [is so]. And whoever responds [to injustice] with the equivalent of that with which he was harmed and then is tyrannized - Allāh will surely aid him. Indeed, Allāh is Pardoning and Forgiving.

r: The Pilgrimage 22:61
t: That is because Allāh causes the night to enter the day and causes the day to enter the night and because Allāh is Hearing and Seeing.

r: The Pilgrimage 22:62
t: That is because Allāh is the True Reality, and that which they call upon other than Him is falsehood, and because Allāh is the Most High, the Grand.

r: The Pilgrimage 22:63
t: Do you not see that Allāh has sent down rain from the sky and the earth becomes green? Indeed, Allāh is Subtle and Aware.

r: The Pilgrimage 22:64
t: To Him belongs what is in the heavens and what is on the earth. And indeed, Allāh is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy.

r: The Pilgrimage 22:65
t: Do you not see that Allāh has subjected to you whatever is on the earth and the ships which run through the sea by His command? And He restrains the sky from falling upon the earth, unless by His permission. Indeed Allāh, to the people, is Kind and Merciful.

r: The Pilgrimage 22:66
t: And He is the one who gave you life; then He causes you to die and then will [again] give you life. Indeed, mankind is ungrateful.

r: The Pilgrimage 22:67
t: For every [religious] community We have appointed rites which they perform. So, [O Muḥammad], let them [i.e., the disbelievers] not contend with you over the matter but invite [them] to your Lord. Indeed, you are upon straight guidance.

r: The Pilgrimage 22:68
t: And if they dispute with you, then say, "Allāh is most knowing of what you do.

r: The Pilgrimage 22:69
t: Allāh will judge between you on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which you used to differ."

r: The Pilgrimage 22:70
t: Do you not know that Allāh knows what is in the heaven and earth? Indeed, that is in a Record. Indeed that, for Allāh, is easy.

r: The Pilgrimage 22:71
t: And they worship besides Allāh that for which He has not sent down authority and that of which they have no knowledge. And there will not be for the wrongdoers any helper.

r: The Pilgrimage 22:72
t: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, you recognize in the faces of those who disbelieve disapproval. They are almost on the verge of assaulting those who recite to them Our verses. Say, "Then shall I inform you of [what is] worse than that? [It is] the Fire which Allāh has promised those who disbelieve, and wretched is the destination."

r: The Pilgrimage 22:73
t: O people, an example is presented, so listen to it. Indeed, those you invoke besides Allāh will never create [as much as] a fly, even if they gathered together for it [i.e., that purpose]. And if the fly should steal from them a [tiny] thing, they could not recover it from him. Weak are the pursuer and pursued.

r: The Pilgrimage 22:74
t: They have not appraised Allāh with true appraisal. Indeed, Allāh is Powerful and Exalted in Might.

r: The Pilgrimage 22:75
t: Allāh chooses from the angels messengers and from the people. Indeed, Allāh is Hearing and Seeing.

r: The Pilgrimage 22:76
t: He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them. And to Allāh will be returned [all] matters.

r: The Pilgrimage 22:77
t: O you who have believed, bow and prostrate and worship your Lord and do good - that you may succeed.

r: The Pilgrimage 22:78
t: And strive for Allāh with the striving due to Him. He has chosen you and has not placed upon you in the religion any difficulty. [It is] the religion of your father, Abraham. He [i.e., Allāh] named you "Muslims" before [in former scriptures] and in this [revelation] that the Messenger may be a witness over you and you may be witnesses over the people. So establish prayer and give zakāh and hold fast to Allāh. He is your protector; and excellent is the protector, and excellent is the helper.

r: The Believers 23:1
t: Certainly will the believers have succeeded:

r: The Believers 23:2
t: They who are during their prayer humbly intent

r: The Believers 23:3
t: And they who turn away from ill speech

r: The Believers 23:4
t: And they who are observant of zakāh

r: The Believers 23:5
t: And they who guard their private parts

r: The Believers 23:6
t: Except from their wives or those their right hands possess, for indeed, they will not be blamed -

r: The Believers 23:7
t: But whoever seeks beyond that, then those are the transgressors -

r: The Believers 23:8
t: And they who are to their trusts and their promises attentive

r: The Believers 23:9
t: And they who carefully maintain their prayers -

r: The Believers 23:10
t: Those are the inheritors

r: The Believers 23:11
t: Who will inherit al-Firdaus. They will abide therein eternally.

r: The Believers 23:12
t: And certainly did We create man from an extract of clay.

r: The Believers 23:13
t: Then We placed him as a sperm-drop in a firm lodging [i.e., the womb].

r: The Believers 23:14
t: Then We made the sperm-drop into a clinging clot, and We made the clot into a lump [of flesh], and We made [from] the lump, bones, and We covered the bones with flesh; then We developed him into another creation. So blessed is Allāh, the best of creators.

r: The Believers 23:15
t: Then indeed, after that you are to die.

r: The Believers 23:16
t: Then indeed you, on the Day of Resurrection, will be resurrected.

r: The Believers 23:17
t: And We have created above you seven layered heavens, and never have We been of [Our] creation unaware.

r: The Believers 23:18
t: And We have sent down rain from the sky in a measured amount and settled it in the earth. And indeed, We are Able to take it away.

r: The Believers 23:19
t: And We brought forth for you thereby gardens of palm trees and grapevines in which for you are abundant fruits and from which you eat.

r: The Believers 23:20
t: And [We brought forth] a tree issuing from Mount Sinai which produces oil and food [i.e., olives] for those who eat.

r: The Believers 23:21
t: And indeed, for you in livestock is a lesson. We give you drink from that which is in their bellies, and for you in them are numerous benefits, and from them you eat.

r: The Believers 23:22
t: And upon them and on ships you are carried.

r: The Believers 23:23
t: And We had certainly sent Noah to his people, and he said, "O my people, worship Allāh; you have no deity other than Him; then will you not fear Him?"

r: The Believers 23:24
t: But the eminent among those who disbelieved from his people said, "This is not but a man like yourselves who wishes to take precedence over you; and if Allāh had willed [to send a messenger], He would have sent down angels. We have not heard of this among our forefathers.

r: The Believers 23:25
t: He is not but a man possessed with madness, so wait concerning him for a time."

r: The Believers 23:26
t: [Noah] said, "My Lord, support me because they have denied me."

r: The Believers 23:27
t: So We inspired to him, "Construct the ship under Our observation and Our inspiration, and when Our command comes and the oven overflows, put into it [i.e., the ship] from each [creature] two mates and your family, except him for whom the decree [of destruction] has proceeded. And do not address Me concerning those who have wronged; indeed, they are to be drowned.

r: The Believers 23:28
t: And when you have boarded the ship, you and those with you, then say, 'Praise to Allāh who has saved us from the wrongdoing people.'

r: The Believers 23:29
t: And say, 'My Lord, let me land at a blessed landing place, and You are the best to accommodate [us].'"

r: The Believers 23:30
t: Indeed in that are signs, and indeed, We are ever testing [Our servants].

r: The Believers 23:31
t: Then We produced after them a generation of others.

r: The Believers 23:32
t: And We sent among them a messenger from themselves, [saying], "Worship Allāh; you have no deity other than Him; then will you not fear Him?"

r: The Believers 23:33
t: And the eminent among his people who disbelieved and denied the meeting of the Hereafter while We had given them luxury in the worldly life said, "This is not but a man like yourselves. He eats of that from which you eat and drinks of what you drink.

r: The Believers 23:34
t: And if you should obey a man like yourselves, indeed, you would then be losers.

r: The Believers 23:35
t: Does he promise you that when you have died and become dust and bones that you will be brought forth [once more]?

r: The Believers 23:36
t: How far, how far, is that which you are promised.

r: The Believers 23:37
t: It [i.e., life] is not but our worldly life - we die and live, but we will not be resurrected.

r: The Believers 23:38
t: He is not but a man who has invented a lie about Allāh, and we will not believe him."

r: The Believers 23:39
t: He said, "My Lord, support me because they have denied me."

r: The Believers 23:40
t: [Allāh] said, "After a little, they will surely become regretful."

r: The Believers 23:41
t: So the shriek seized them in truth, and We made them as [plant] stubble. Then away with the wrongdoing people.

r: The Believers 23:42
t: Then We produced after them other generations.

r: The Believers 23:43
t: No nation will precede its time [of termination], nor will they remain [thereafter].

r: The Believers 23:44
t: Then We sent Our messengers in succession. Every time there came to a nation its messenger, they denied him, so We made them follow one another [to destruction], and We made them narrations. So away with a people who do not believe.

r: The Believers 23:45
t: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our signs and a clear authority

r: The Believers 23:46
t: To Pharaoh and his establishment, but they were arrogant and were a haughty people.

r: The Believers 23:47
t: They said, "Should we believe two men like ourselves while their people are for us in servitude?"

r: The Believers 23:48
t: So they denied them and were of those destroyed.

r: The Believers 23:49
t: And We certainly gave Moses the Scripture that perhaps they would be guided.

r: The Believers 23:50
t: And We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign and sheltered them within a high ground having level [areas] and flowing water.

r: The Believers 23:51
t: [Allāh said], "O messengers, eat from the good foods and work righteousness. Indeed I, of what you do, am Knowing.

r: The Believers 23:52
t: And indeed this, your religion, is one religion, and I am your Lord, so fear Me."

r: The Believers 23:53
t: But they [i.e., the people] divided their religion among them into portions [i.e., sects] - each faction, in what it has, rejoicing.

r: The Believers 23:54
t: So leave them in their confusion for a time.

r: The Believers 23:55
t: Do they think that what We extend to them of wealth and children

r: The Believers 23:56
t: Is [because] We hasten for them good things? Rather, they do not perceive.

r: The Believers 23:57
t: Indeed, they who are apprehensive from fear of their Lord

r: The Believers 23:58
t: And they who believe in the signs of their Lord

r: The Believers 23:59
t: And they who do not associate anything with their Lord

r: The Believers 23:60
t: And they who give what they give while their hearts are fearful because they will be returning to their Lord -

r: The Believers 23:61
t: It is those who hasten to good deeds, and they outstrip [others] therein.

r: The Believers 23:62
t: And We charge no soul except [with that within] its capacity, and with Us is a record which speaks with truth; and they will not be wronged.

r: The Believers 23:63
t: But their hearts are covered with confusion over this, and they have [evil] deeds besides that [i.e., disbelief] which they are doing,

r: The Believers 23:64
t: Until when We seize their affluent ones with punishment, at once they are crying [to Allāh] for help.

r: The Believers 23:65
t: Do not cry out today. Indeed, by Us you will not be helped.

r: The Believers 23:66
t: My verses had already been recited to you, but you were turning back on your heels.

r: The Believers 23:67
t: In arrogance regarding it, conversing by night, speaking evil.

r: The Believers 23:68
t: Then have they not reflected over the word [i.e., the Qur’ān], or has there come to them that which had not come to their forefathers?

r: The Believers 23:69
t: Or did they not know their Messenger, so they are toward him disacknowledging?

r: The Believers 23:70
t: Or do they say, "In him is madness"? Rather, he brought them the truth, but most of them, to the truth, are averse.

r: The Believers 23:71
t: But if the Truth [i.e., Allāh] had followed their inclinations, the heavens and the earth and whoever is in them would have been ruined. Rather, We have brought them their message, but they, from their message, are turning away.

r: The Believers 23:72
t: Or do you, [O Muḥammad], ask them for payment? But the reward of your Lord is best, and He is the best of providers.

r: The Believers 23:73
t: And indeed, you invite them to a straight path.

r: The Believers 23:74
t: But indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter are deviating from the path.

r: The Believers 23:75
t: And even if We gave them mercy and removed what was upon them of affliction, they would persist in their transgression, wandering blindly.

r: The Believers 23:76
t: And We had gripped them with suffering [as a warning], but they did not yield to their Lord, nor did they humbly supplicate, [and will continue thus]

r: The Believers 23:77
t: Until when We have opened before them a door of severe punishment, immediately they will be therein in despair.

r: The Believers 23:78
t: And it is He who produced for you hearing and vision and hearts [i.e., intellect]; little are you grateful.

r: The Believers 23:79
t: And it is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered.

r: The Believers 23:80
t: And it is He who gives life and causes death, and His is the alternation of the night and the day. Then will you not reason?

r: The Believers 23:81
t: Rather, they say like what the former peoples said.

r: The Believers 23:82
t: They said, "When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?

r: The Believers 23:83
t: We have been promised this, we and our forefathers, before; this is not but legends of the former peoples."

r: The Believers 23:84
t: Say, [O Muḥammad], "To whom belongs the earth and whoever is in it, if you should know?"

r: The Believers 23:85
t: They will say, "To Allāh." Say, "Then will you not remember?"

r: The Believers 23:86
t: Say, "Who is Lord of the seven heavens and Lord of the Great Throne?"

r: The Believers 23:87
t: They will say, "[They belong] to Allāh." Say, "Then will you not fear Him?"

r: The Believers 23:88
t: Say, "In whose hand is the realm of all things - and He protects while none can protect against Him - if you should know?"

r: The Believers 23:89
t: They will say, "[All belongs] to Allāh." Say, "Then how are you deluded?"

r: The Believers 23:90
t: Rather, We have brought them the truth, and indeed they are liars.

r: The Believers 23:91
t: Allāh has not taken any son, nor has there ever been with Him any deity. [If there had been], then each deity would have taken what it created, and some of them would have [sought to] overcome others. Exalted is Allāh above what they describe [concerning Him].

r: The Believers 23:92
t: [He is] Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, so high is He above what they associate [with Him].

r: The Believers 23:93
t: Say, [O Muḥammad], "My Lord, if You should show me that which they are promised,

r: The Believers 23:94
t: My Lord, then do not place me among the wrongdoing people."

r: The Believers 23:95
t: And indeed, We are Able to show you what We have promised them.

r: The Believers 23:96
t: Repel, by [means of] what is best, [their] evil. We are most knowing of what they describe.

r: The Believers 23:97
t: And say, "My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the incitements of the devils,

r: The Believers 23:98
t: And I seek refuge in You, my Lord, lest they be present with me."

r: The Believers 23:99
t: [For such is the state of the disbelievers] until, when death comes to one of them, he says, "My Lord, send me back

r: The Believers 23:100
t: That I might do righteousness in that which I left behind." No! It is only a word he is saying; and behind them is a barrier until the Day they are resurrected.

r: The Believers 23:101
t: So when the Horn is blown, no relationship will there be among them that Day, nor will they ask about one another.

r: The Believers 23:102
t: And those whose scales are heavy [with good deeds] - it is they who are the successful.

r: The Believers 23:103
t: But those whose scales are light - those are the ones who have lost their souls, [being] in Hell, abiding eternally.

r: The Believers 23:104
t: The Fire will sear their faces, and they therein will have taut smiles.

r: The Believers 23:105
t: [It will be said], "Were not My verses recited to you and you used to deny them?"

r: The Believers 23:106
t: They will say, "Our Lord, our wretchedness overcame us, and we were a people astray.

r: The Believers 23:107
t: Our Lord, remove us from it, and if we were to return [to evil], we would indeed be wrongdoers."

r: The Believers 23:108
t: He will say, "Remain despised therein and do not speak to Me.

r: The Believers 23:109
t: Indeed, there was a party of My servants who said, 'Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us and have mercy upon us, and You are the best of the merciful.'

r: The Believers 23:110
t: But you took them in mockery to the point that they made you forget My remembrance, and you used to laugh at them.

r: The Believers 23:111
t: Indeed, I have rewarded them this Day for their patient endurance - that they are the attainers [of success]."

r: The Believers 23:112
t: [Allāh] will say, "How long did you remain on earth in number of years?"

r: The Believers 23:113
t: They will say, "We remained a day or part of a day; ask those who enumerate."

r: The Believers 23:114
t: He will say, "You stayed not but a little - if only you had known.

r: The Believers 23:115
t: Then did you think that We created you uselessly and that to Us you would not be returned?"

r: The Believers 23:116
t: So exalted is Allāh, the Sovereign, the Truth; there is no deity except Him, Lord of the Noble Throne.

r: The Believers 23:117
t: And whoever invokes besides Allāh another deity for which he has no proof - then his account is only with his Lord. Indeed, the disbelievers will not succeed.

r: The Believers 23:118
t: And, [O Muḥammad], say, "My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of the merciful."

r: The Light 24:1
t: [This is] a sūrah which We have sent down and made [that within it] obligatory and revealed therein verses of clear evidence that you might remember.

r: The Light 24:2
t: The [unmarried] woman or [unmarried] man found guilty of sexual intercourse - lash each one of them with a hundred lashes, and do not be taken by pity for them in the religion [i.e., law] of Allāh, if you should believe in Allāh and the Last Day. And let a group of the believers witness their punishment.

r: The Light 24:3
t: The fornicator does not marry except a [female] fornicator or polytheist, and none marries her except a fornicator or a polytheist, and that [i.e., marriage to such persons] has been made unlawful to the believers.

r: The Light 24:4
t: And those who accuse chaste women and then do not produce four witnesses - lash them with eighty lashes and do not accept from them testimony ever after. And those are the defiantly disobedient,

r: The Light 24:5
t: Except for those who repent thereafter and reform, for indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

r: The Light 24:6
t: And those who accuse their wives [of adultery] and have no witnesses except themselves - then the witness of one of them [shall be] four testimonies [swearing] by Allāh that indeed, he is of the truthful.

r: The Light 24:7
t: And the fifth [oath will be] that the curse of Allāh be upon him if he should be of the liars.

r: The Light 24:8
t: But it will prevent punishment from her if she gives four testimonies [swearing] by Allāh that indeed, he is of the liars.

r: The Light 24:9
t: And the fifth [oath will be] that the wrath of Allāh be upon her if he was of the truthful.

r: The Light 24:10
t: And if not for the favor of Allāh upon you and His mercy... and because Allāh is Accepting of Repentance and Wise.

r: The Light 24:11
t: Indeed, those who came with falsehood are a group among you. Do not think it bad for you; rather, it is good for you. For every person among them is what [punishment] he has earned from the sin, and he who took upon himself the greater portion thereof - for him is a great punishment [i.e., Hellfire].

r: The Light 24:12
t: Why, when you heard it, did not the believing men and believing women think good of themselves [i.e., one another] and say, "This is an obvious falsehood"?

r: The Light 24:13
t: Why did they [who slandered] not produce for it four witnesses? And when they do not produce the witnesses, then it is they, in the sight of Allāh, who are the liars.

r: The Light 24:14
t: And if it had not been for the favor of Allāh upon you and His mercy in this world and the Hereafter, you would have been touched for that [lie] in which you were involved by a great punishment

r: The Light 24:15
t: When you received it with your tongues and said with your mouths that of which you had no knowledge and thought it was insignificant while it was, in the sight of Allāh, tremendous.

r: The Light 24:16
t: And why, when you heard it, did you not say, "It is not for us to speak of this. Exalted are You, [O Allāh]; this is a great slander"?

r: The Light 24:17
t: Allāh warns you against returning to the likes of this [conduct], ever, if you should be believers.

r: The Light 24:18
t: And Allāh makes clear to you the verses [i.e., His rulings], and Allāh is Knowing and Wise.

r: The Light 24:19
t: Indeed, those who like that immorality should be spread [or publicized] among those who have believed will have a painful punishment in this world and the Hereafter. And Allāh knows and you do not know.

r: The Light 24:20
t: And if it had not been for the favor of Allāh upon you and His mercy... and because Allāh is Kind and Merciful.

r: The Light 24:21
t: O you who have believed, do not follow the footsteps of Satan. And whoever follows the footsteps of Satan - indeed, he enjoins immorality and wrongdoing. And if not for the favor of Allāh upon you and His mercy, not one of you would have been pure, ever, but Allāh purifies whom He wills, and Allāh is Hearing and Knowing.

r: The Light 24:22
t: And let not those of virtue among you and wealth swear not to give [aid] to their relatives and the needy and the emigrants for the cause of Allāh, and let them pardon and overlook. Would you not like that Allāh should forgive you? And Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

r: The Light 24:23
t: Indeed, those who [falsely] accuse chaste, unaware and believing women are cursed in this world and the Hereafter; and they will have a great punishment

r: The Light 24:24
t: On a Day when their tongues, their hands and their feet will bear witness against them as to what they used to do.

r: The Light 24:25
t: That Day, Allāh will pay them in full their true [i.e., deserved] recompense, and they will know that it is Allāh who is the manifest Truth [i.e., perfect in justice].

r: The Light 24:26
t: Evil words are for evil men, and evil men are [subjected] to evil words. And good words are for good men, and good men are [an object] of good words. Those [good people] are declared innocent of what they [i.e., slanderers] say. For them is forgiveness and noble provision.

r: The Light 24:27
t: O you who have believed, do not enter houses other than your own houses until you ascertain welcome and greet their inhabitants. That is best for you; perhaps you will be reminded [i.e., advised].

r: The Light 24:28
t: And if you do not find anyone therein, do not enter them until permission has been given you. And if it is said to you, "Go back," then go back; it is purer for you. And Allāh is Knowing of what you do.

r: The Light 24:29
t: There is no blame upon you for entering houses not inhabited in which there is convenience for you. And Allāh knows what you reveal and what you conceal.

r: The Light 24:30
t: Tell the believing men to reduce [some] of their vision and guard their private parts. That is purer for them. Indeed, Allāh is [fully] Aware of what they do.

r: The Light 24:31
t: And tell the believing women to reduce [some] of their vision and guard their private parts and not expose their adornment except that which [necessarily] appears thereof and to wrap [a portion of] their headcovers over their chests and not expose their adornment [i.e., beauty] except to their husbands, their fathers, their husbands' fathers, their sons, their husbands' sons, their brothers, their brothers' sons, their sisters' sons, their women, that which their right hands possess [i.e., slaves], or those male attendants having no physical desire, or children who are not yet aware of the private aspects of women. And let them not stamp their feet to make known what they conceal of their adornment. And turn to Allāh in repentance, all of you, O believers, that you might succeed.

r: The Light 24:32
t: And marry the unmarried among you and the righteous among your male slaves and female slaves. If they should be poor, Allāh will enrich them from His bounty, and Allāh is all-Encompassing and Knowing.

r: The Light 24:33
t: But let them who find not [the means for] marriage abstain [from sexual relations] until Allāh enriches them from His bounty. And those who seek a contract [for eventual emancipation] from among whom your right hands possess - then make a contract with them if you know there is within them goodness and give them from the wealth of Allāh which He has given you. And do not compel your slave girls to prostitution, if they desire chastity, to seek [thereby] the temporary interests of worldly life. And if someone should compel them, then indeed, Allāh is [to them], after their compulsion, Forgiving and Merciful.

r: The Light 24:34
t: And We have certainly sent down to you distinct verses and examples from those who passed on before you and an admonition for those who fear Allāh.

r: The Light 24:35
t: Allāh is the Light of the heavens and the earth. The example of His light is like a niche within which is a lamp; the lamp is within glass, the glass as if it were a pearly [white] star lit from [the oil of] a blessed olive tree, neither of the east nor of the west, whose oil would almost glow even if untouched by fire. Light upon light. Allāh guides to His light whom He wills. And Allāh presents examples for the people, and Allāh is Knowing of all things.

r: The Light 24:36
t: [Such niches are] in houses [i.e., mosques] which Allāh has ordered to be raised and that His name be mentioned [i.e., praised] therein; exalting Him within them in the morning and the evenings

r: The Light 24:37
t: [Are] men whom neither commerce nor sale distracts from the remembrance of Allāh and performance of prayer and giving of zakāh. They fear a Day in which the hearts and eyes will [fearfully] turn about -

r: The Light 24:38
t: That Allāh may reward them [according to] the best of what they did and increase them from His bounty. And Allāh gives provision to whom He wills without account [i.e., limit].

r: The Light 24:39
t: But those who disbelieved - their deeds are like a mirage in a lowland which a thirsty one thinks is water until, when he comes to it, he finds it is nothing but finds Allāh before him, and He will pay him in full his due; and Allāh is swift in account.

r: The Light 24:40
t: Or [they are] like darknesses within an unfathomable sea which is covered by waves, upon which are waves, over which are clouds - darknesses, some of them upon others. When one puts out his hand [therein], he can hardly see it. And he to whom Allāh has not granted light - for him there is no light.

r: The Light 24:41
t: Do you not see that Allāh is exalted by whomever is within the heavens and the earth and [by] the birds with wings spread [in flight]? Each [of them] has known his [means of] prayer and exalting [Him], and Allāh is Knowing of what they do.

r: The Light 24:42
t: And to Allāh belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth, and to Allāh is the destination.

r: The Light 24:43
t: Do you not see that Allāh drives clouds? Then He brings them together; then He makes them into a mass, and you see the rain emerge from within it. And He sends down from the sky, mountains [of clouds] within which is hail, and He strikes with it whom He wills and averts it from whom He wills. The flash of its lightning almost takes away the eyesight.

r: The Light 24:44
t: Allāh alternates the night and the day. Indeed in that is a lesson for those who have vision.

r: The Light 24:45
t: Allāh has created every [living] creature from water. And of them are those that move on their bellies, and of them are those that walk on two legs, and of them are those that walk on four. Allāh creates what He wills. Indeed, Allāh is over all things competent.

r: The Light 24:46
t: We have certainly sent down distinct verses. And Allāh guides whom He wills to a straight path.

r: The Light 24:47
t: But they [i.e., the hypocrites] say, "We have believed in Allāh and in the Messenger, and we obey"; then a party of them turns away after that. And those are not believers.

r: The Light 24:48
t: And when they are called to [the words of] Allāh and His Messenger to judge between them, at once a party of them turns aside [in refusal].

r: The Light 24:49
t: But if the right is theirs, they come to him in prompt obedience.

r: The Light 24:50
t: Is there disease in their hearts? Or have they doubted? Or do they fear that Allāh will be unjust to them, or His Messenger? Rather, it is they who are the wrongdoers [i.e., the unjust].

r: The Light 24:51
t: The only statement of the [true] believers when they are called to Allāh and His Messenger to judge between them is that they say, "We hear and we obey." And those are the successful.

r: The Light 24:52
t: And whoever obeys Allāh and His Messenger and fears Allāh and is conscious of Him - it is those who are the attainers.

r: The Light 24:53
t: And they swear by Allāh their strongest oaths that if you ordered them, they would go forth [in Allāh's cause]. Say, "Do not swear. [Such] obedience is known. Indeed, Allāh is [fully] Aware of that which you do."

r: The Light 24:54
t: Say, "Obey Allāh and obey the Messenger; but if you turn away - then upon him is only that [duty] with which he has been charged, and upon you is that with which you have been charged. And if you obey him, you will be [rightly] guided. And there is not upon the Messenger except the [responsibility for] clear notification."

r: The Light 24:55
t: Allāh has promised those who have believed among you and done righteous deeds that He will surely grant them succession [to authority] upon the earth just as He granted it to those before them and that He will surely establish for them [therein] their religion which He has preferred for them and that He will surely substitute for them, after their fear, security, [for] they worship Me, not associating anything with Me. But whoever disbelieves after that - then those are the defiantly disobedient.

r: The Light 24:56
t: And establish prayer and give zakāh and obey the Messenger - that you may receive mercy.

r: The Light 24:57
t: Never think that the disbelievers are causing failure [to Allāh] upon the earth. Their refuge will be the Fire - and how wretched the destination.

r: The Light 24:58
t: O you who have believed, let those whom your right hands possess and those who have not [yet] reached puberty among you ask permission of you [before entering] at three times: before the dawn prayer and when you put aside your clothing [for rest] at noon and after the night prayer. [These are] three times of privacy for you. There is no blame upon you nor upon them beyond these [periods], for they continually circulate among you - some of you, among others. Thus does Allāh make clear to you the verses [i.e., His ordinances]; and Allāh is Knowing and Wise.

r: The Light 24:59
t: And when the children among you reach puberty, let them ask permission [at all times] as those before them have done. Thus does Allāh make clear to you His verses; and Allāh is Knowing and Wise.

r: The Light 24:60
t: And women of post-menstrual age who have no desire for marriage - there is no blame upon them for putting aside their outer garments [but] not displaying adornment. But to modestly refrain [from that] is better for them. And Allāh is Hearing and Knowing.

r: The Light 24:61
t: There is not upon the blind [any] constraint nor upon the lame constraint nor upon the ill constraint nor upon yourselves when you eat from your [own] houses or the houses of your fathers or the houses of your mothers or the houses of your brothers or the houses of your sisters or the houses of your father's brothers or the houses of your father's sisters or the houses of your mother's brothers or the houses of your mother's sisters or [from houses] whose keys you possess or [from the house] of your friend. There is no blame upon you whether you eat together or separately. But when you enter houses, give greetings of peace upon each other - a greeting from Allāh, blessed and good. Thus does Allāh make clear to you the verses [of ordinance] that you may understand.

r: The Light 24:62
t: The believers are only those who believe in Allāh and His Messenger and, when they are [meeting] with him for a matter of common interest, do not depart until they have asked his permission. Indeed, those who ask your permission, [O Muḥammad] - those are the ones who believe in Allāh and His Messenger. So when they ask your permission due to something of their affairs, then give permission to whom you will among them and ask forgiveness for them of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

r: The Light 24:63
t: Do not make [your] calling of the Messenger among yourselves as the call of one of you to another. Already Allāh knows those of you who slip away, concealed by others. So let those beware who dissent from his [i.e., the Prophet's] order, lest fitnah strike them or a painful punishment.

r: The Light 24:64
t: Unquestionably, to Allāh belongs whatever is in the heavens and earth. Already He knows that upon which you [stand] and [knows] the Day when they will be returned to Him and He will inform them of what they have done. And Allāh is Knowing of all things.

r: The Criterion 25:1
