r: The Romans 30:21
t: And of His signs is that He created for you from yourselves mates that you may find tranquility in them; and He placed between you affection and mercy. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought.

r: The Romans 30:22
t: And of His signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth and the diversity of your languages and your colors. Indeed in that are signs for those of knowledge.

r: The Romans 30:23
t: And of His signs is your sleep by night and day and your seeking of His bounty. Indeed in that are signs for a people who listen.

r: The Romans 30:24
t: And of His signs is [that] He shows you the lightning [causing] fear and aspiration, and He sends down rain from the sky by which He brings to life the earth after its lifelessness. Indeed in that are signs for a people who use reason.

r: The Romans 30:25
t: And of His signs is that the heaven and earth stand [i.e., remain] by His command. Then when He calls you with a [single] call from the earth, immediately you will come forth.

r: The Romans 30:26
t: And to Him belongs whoever is in the heavens and earth. All are to Him devoutly obedient.

r: The Romans 30:27
t: And it is He who begins creation; then He repeats it, and that is [even] easier for Him. To Him belongs the highest description [i.e., attribute] in the heavens and earth. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

r: The Romans 30:28
t: He presents to you an example from yourselves. Do you have among those whom your right hands possess [i.e., slaves] any partners in what We have provided for you so that you are equal therein [and] would fear them as your fear of one another [within a partnership]? Thus do We detail the verses for a people who use reason.

r: The Romans 30:29
t: But those who wrong follow their [own] desires without knowledge. Then who can guide one whom Allāh has sent astray? And for them there are no helpers.

r: The Romans 30:30
t: So direct your face [i.e., self] toward the religion, inclining to truth. [Adhere to] the fiṭrah of Allāh upon which He has created [all] people. No change should there be in the creation of Allāh. That is the correct religion, but most of the people do not know.

r: The Romans 30:31
t: [Adhere to it], turning in repentance to Him, and fear Him and establish prayer and do not be of those who associate others with Allāh

r: The Romans 30:32
t: [Or] of those who have divided their religion and become sects, every faction rejoicing in what it has.

r: The Romans 30:33
t: And when adversity touches the people, they call upon their Lord, turning in repentance to Him. Then when He lets them taste mercy from Him, at once a party of them associate others with their Lord,

r: The Romans 30:34
t: So that they will deny what We have granted them. Then enjoy yourselves, for you are going to know.

r: The Romans 30:35
t: Or have We sent down to them an authority [i.e., a proof or scripture], and it speaks of what they have been associating with Him?

r: The Romans 30:36
t: And when We let the people taste mercy, they rejoice therein, but if evil afflicts them for what their hands have put forth, immediately they despair.

r: The Romans 30:37
t: Do they not see that Allāh extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it]? Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe.

r: The Romans 30:38
t: So give the relative his right, as well as the needy and the traveler. That is best for those who desire the face [i.e., approval] of Allāh, and it is they who will be the successful.

r: The Romans 30:39
t: And whatever you give for interest [i.e., advantage] to increase within the wealth of people will not increase with Allāh. But what you give in zakāh, desiring the face [i.e., approval] of Allāh - those are the multipliers.

r: The Romans 30:40
t: Allāh is the one who created you, then provided for you, then will cause you to die, and then will give you life. Are there any of your "partners" who does anything of that? Exalted is He and high above what they associate with Him.

r: The Romans 30:41
t: Corruption has appeared throughout the land and sea by [reason of] what the hands of people have earned so He [i.e., Allāh] may let them taste part of [the consequence of] what they have done that perhaps they will return [to righteousness].

r: The Romans 30:42
t: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Travel through the land and observe how was the end of those before. Most of them were associators [of others with Allāh].

r: The Romans 30:43
t: So direct your face [i.e., self] toward the correct religion before a Day comes from Allāh of which there is no repelling. That Day, they will be divided.

r: The Romans 30:44
t: Whoever disbelieves - upon him is [the consequence of] his disbelief. And whoever does righteousness - they are for themselves preparing,

r: The Romans 30:45
t: That He may reward those who have believed and done righteous deeds out of His bounty. Indeed, He does not like the disbelievers.

r: The Romans 30:46
t: And of His signs is that He sends the winds as bringers of good tidings and to let you taste His mercy [i.e., rain] and so the ships may sail at His command and so you may seek of His bounty, and perhaps you will be grateful.

r: The Romans 30:47
t: And We have already sent messengers before you to their peoples, and they came to them with clear evidences; then We took retribution from those who committed crimes, and incumbent upon Us was support of the believers.

r: The Romans 30:48
t: It is Allāh who sends the winds, and they stir the clouds and spread them in the sky however He wills, and He makes them fragments so you see the rain emerge from within them. And when He causes it to fall upon whom He wills of His servants, immediately they rejoice

r: The Romans 30:49
t: Although they were, before it was sent down upon them - before that, in despair.

r: The Romans 30:50
t: So observe the effects of the mercy of Allāh - how He gives life to the earth after its lifelessness. Indeed, that [same one] will give life to the dead, and He is over all things competent.

r: The Romans 30:51
t: But if We should send a [bad] wind and they saw [their crops] turned yellow, they would remain thereafter disbelievers.

r: The Romans 30:52
t: So indeed, you will not make the dead hear, nor will you make the deaf hear the call when they turn their backs, retreating.

r: The Romans 30:53
t: And you cannot guide the blind away from their error. You will only make hear those who believe in Our verses so they are Muslims [in submission to Allāh].

r: The Romans 30:54
t: Allāh is the one who created you from weakness, then made after weakness strength, then made after strength weakness and white hair. He creates what He wills, and He is the Knowing, the Competent.

r: The Romans 30:55
t: And the Day the Hour appears the criminals will swear they had remained but an hour. Thus they were deluded.

r: The Romans 30:56
t: But those who were given knowledge and faith will say, "You remained the extent of Allāh's decree until the Day of Resurrection, and this is the Day of Resurrection, but you did not used to know."

r: The Romans 30:57
t: So that Day, their excuse will not benefit those who wronged, nor will they be asked to appease [Allāh].

r: The Romans 30:58
t: And We have certainly presented to the people in this Qur’ān from every [kind of] example. But, [O Muḥammad], if you should bring them a sign, the disbelievers will surely say, "You [believers] are but falsifiers."

r: The Romans 30:59
t: Thus does Allāh seal the hearts of those who do not know.

r: The Romans 30:60
t: So be patient. Indeed, the promise of Allāh is truth. And let them not disquiet you who are not certain [in faith].

r: Luqman 31:1
t: Alif, Lām, Meem.

r: Luqman 31:2
t: These are verses of the wise Book,

r: Luqman 31:3
t: As guidance and mercy for the doers of good

r: Luqman 31:4
t: Who establish prayer and give zakāh, and they, of the Hereafter, are certain [in faith].

r: Luqman 31:5
t: Those are on [right] guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful.

r: Luqman 31:6
t: And of the people is he who buys the amusement of speech to mislead [others] from the way of Allāh without knowledge and who takes it [i.e., His way] in ridicule. Those will have a humiliating punishment.

r: Luqman 31:7
t: And when Our verses are recited to him, he turns away arrogantly as if he had not heard them, as if there was in his ears deafness. So give him tidings of a painful punishment.

r: Luqman 31:8
t: Indeed, those who believe and do righteous deeds - for them are the Gardens of Pleasure,

r: Luqman 31:9
t: Wherein they abide eternally; [it is] the promise of Allāh [which is] truth. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

r: Luqman 31:10
t: He created the heavens without pillars that you see and has cast into the earth firmly set mountains, lest it should shift with you, and dispersed therein from every creature. And We sent down rain from the sky and made grow therein [plants] of every noble kind.

r: Luqman 31:11
t: This is the creation of Allāh. So show Me what those other than Him have created. Rather, the wrongdoers are in clear error.

r: Luqman 31:12
t: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy.

r: Luqman 31:13
t: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when Luqmān said to his son while he was instructing him, "O my son, do not associate [anything] with Allāh. Indeed, association [with Him] is great injustice."

r: Luqman 31:14
t: And We have enjoined upon man [care] for his parents. His mother carried him, [increasing her] in weakness upon weakness, and his weaning is in two years. Be grateful to Me and to your parents; to Me is the [final] destination.

r: Luqman 31:15
t: But if they endeavor to make you associate with Me that of which you have no knowledge, do not obey them but accompany them in [this] world with appropriate kindness and follow the way of those who turn back to Me [in repentance]. Then to Me will be your return, and I will inform you about what you used to do.

r: Luqman 31:16
t: [And Luqmān said], "O my son, indeed if it [i.e., a wrong] should be the weight of a mustard seed and should be within a rock or [anywhere] in the heavens or in the earth, Allāh will bring it forth. Indeed, Allāh is Subtle and Aware.

r: Luqman 31:17
t: O my son, establish prayer, enjoin what is right, forbid what is wrong, and be patient over what befalls you. Indeed, [all] that is of the matters [requiring] resolve.

r: Luqman 31:18
t: And do not turn your cheek [in contempt] toward people and do not walk through the earth exultantly. Indeed, Allāh does not like everyone self-deluded and boastful.

r: Luqman 31:19
t: And be moderate in your pace and lower your voice; indeed, the most disagreeable of sounds is the voice of donkeys."

r: Luqman 31:20
t: Do you not see that Allāh has made subject to you whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth and amply bestowed upon you His favors, [both] apparent and unapparent? But of the people is he who disputes about Allāh without knowledge or guidance or an enlightening Book [from Him].

r: Luqman 31:21
t: And when it is said to them, "Follow what Allāh has revealed," they say, "Rather, we will follow that upon which we found our fathers." Even if Satan was inviting them to the punishment of the Blaze?

r: Luqman 31:22
t: And whoever submits his face [i.e., self] to Allāh while he is a doer of good - then he has grasped the most trustworthy handhold. And to Allāh will be the outcome of [all] matters.

r: Luqman 31:23
t: And whoever has disbelieved - let not his disbelief grieve you. To Us is their return, and We will inform them of what they did. Indeed, Allāh is Knowing of that within the breasts.

r: Luqman 31:24
t: We grant them enjoyment for a little; then We will force them to a massive punishment.

r: Luqman 31:25
t: And if you asked them, "Who created the heavens and earth?" they would surely say, "Allāh." Say, "[All] praise is [due] to Allāh"; but most of them do not know.

r: Luqman 31:26
t: To Allāh belongs whatever is in the heavens and earth. Indeed, Allāh is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy.

r: Luqman 31:27
t: And if whatever trees upon the earth were pens and the sea [was ink], replenished thereafter by seven [more] seas, the words of Allāh would not be exhausted. Indeed, Allāh is Exalted in Might and Wise.

r: Luqman 31:28
t: Your creation and your resurrection will not be but as that of a single soul. Indeed, Allāh is Hearing and Seeing.

r: Luqman 31:29
t: Do you not see [i.e., know] that Allāh causes the night to enter the day and causes the day to enter the night and has subjected the sun and the moon, each running [its course] for a specified term, and that Allāh, of whatever you do, is Aware?

r: Luqman 31:30
t: That is because Allāh is the True Reality, and that what they call upon other than Him is falsehood, and because Allāh is the Most High, the Grand.

r: Luqman 31:31
t: Do you not see that ships sail through the sea by the favor of Allāh that He may show you of His signs? Indeed in that are signs for everyone patient and grateful.

r: Luqman 31:32
t: And when waves come over them like canopies, they supplicate Allāh, sincere to Him in religion [i.e., faith]. But when He delivers them to the land, there are [some] of them who are moderate [in faith]. And none rejects Our signs except everyone treacherous and ungrateful.

r: Luqman 31:33
t: O mankind, fear your Lord and fear a Day when no father will avail his son, nor will a son avail his father at all. Indeed, the promise of Allāh is truth, so let not the worldly life delude you and be not deceived about Allāh by the Deceiver [i.e., Satan].

r: Luqman 31:34
t: Indeed, Allāh [alone] has knowledge of the Hour and sends down the rain and knows what is in the wombs. And no soul perceives what it will earn tomorrow, and no soul perceives in what land it will die. Indeed, Allāh is Knowing and Aware.

r: The Prostration 32:1
t: Alif, Lām, Meem.

r: The Prostration 32:2
t: [This is] the revelation of the Book about which there is no doubt from the Lord of the worlds.

r: The Prostration 32:3
t: Or do they say, "He invented it"? Rather, it is the truth from your Lord, [O Muḥammad], that you may warn a people to whom no warner has come before you [so] perhaps they will be guided.

r: The Prostration 32:4
t: It is Allāh who created the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them in six days; then He established Himself above the Throne. You have not besides Him any protector or any intercessor; so will you not be reminded?

r: The Prostration 32:5
t: He arranges [each] matter from the heaven to the earth; then it will ascend to Him in a Day, the extent of which is a thousand years of those which you count.

r: The Prostration 32:6
t: That is the Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,

r: The Prostration 32:7
t: Who perfected everything which He created and began the creation of man from clay.

r: The Prostration 32:8
t: Then He made his posterity out of the extract of a liquid disdained.

r: The Prostration 32:9
t: Then He proportioned him and breathed into him from His [created] soul and made for you hearing and vision and hearts [i.e., intellect]; little are you grateful.

r: The Prostration 32:10
t: And they say, "When we are lost [i.e., disintegrated] within the earth, will we indeed be [recreated] in a new creation?" Rather, they are, in the meeting with their Lord, disbelievers.

r: The Prostration 32:11
t: Say, "The angel of death who has been entrusted with you will take you. Then to your Lord you will be returned."

r: The Prostration 32:12
t: If you could but see when the criminals are hanging their heads before their Lord, [saying], "Our Lord, we have seen and heard, so return us [to the world]; we will work righteousness. Indeed, we are [now] certain."

r: The Prostration 32:13
t: And if We had willed, We could have given every soul its guidance, but the word from Me will come into effect [that] "I will surely fill Hell with jinn and people all together.

r: The Prostration 32:14
t: So taste [punishment] because you forgot the meeting of this, your Day; indeed, We have [accordingly] forgotten you. And taste the punishment of eternity for what you used to do."

r: The Prostration 32:15
t: Only those believe in Our verses who, when they are reminded by them, fall down in prostration and exalt [Allāh] with praise of their Lord, and they are not arrogant.

r: The Prostration 32:16
t: Their sides part [i.e., they arise] from [their] beds; they supplicate their Lord in fear and aspiration, and from what We have provided them, they spend.

r: The Prostration 32:17
t: And no soul knows what has been hidden for them of comfort for eyes [i.e., satisfaction] as reward for what they used to do.

r: The Prostration 32:18
t: Then is one who was a believer like one who was defiantly disobedient? They are not equal.

r: The Prostration 32:19
t: As for those who believed and did righteous deeds, for them will be the Gardens of Refuge as accommodation for what they used to do.

r: The Prostration 32:20
t: But as for those who defiantly disobeyed, their refuge is the Fire. Every time they wish to emerge from it, they will be returned to it while it is said to them, "Taste the punishment of the Fire which you used to deny."

r: The Prostration 32:21
t: And We will surely let them taste the nearer punishment short of the greater punishment that perhaps they will return [i.e., repent].

r: The Prostration 32:22
t: And who is more unjust than one who is reminded of the verses of his Lord; then he turns away from them? Indeed We, from the criminals, will take retribution.

r: The Prostration 32:23
t: And We certainly gave Moses the Scripture, so do not be in doubt over his meeting. And We made it [i.e., the Torah] guidance for the Children of Israel.

r: The Prostration 32:24
t: And We made from among them leaders guiding by Our command when they were patient and [when] they were certain of Our signs.

r: The Prostration 32:25
t: Indeed, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ.

r: The Prostration 32:26
t: Has it not become clear to them how many generations We destroyed before them, [as] they walk among their dwellings? Indeed in that are signs; then do they not hear?

r: The Prostration 32:27
t: Have they not seen that We drive water [in clouds] to barren land and bring forth thereby crops from which their livestock eat and [they] themselves? Then do they not see?

r: The Prostration 32:28
t: And they say, "When will be this conquest, if you should be truthful?"

r: The Prostration 32:29
t: Say, [O Muḥammad], "On the Day of Conquest the belief of those who had disbelieved will not benefit them, nor will they be reprieved."

r: The Prostration 32:30
t: So turn away from them and wait. Indeed, they are waiting.

r: The Combined Forces 33:1
t: O Prophet, fear Allāh and do not obey the disbelievers and the hypocrites. Indeed, Allāh is ever Knowing and Wise.

r: The Combined Forces 33:2
t: And follow that which is revealed to you from your Lord. Indeed Allāh is ever, of what you do, Aware.

r: The Combined Forces 33:3
t: And rely upon Allāh; and sufficient is Allāh as Disposer of affairs.

r: The Combined Forces 33:4
t: Allāh has not made for a man two hearts in his interior. And He has not made your wives whom you declare unlawful your mothers. And He has not made your claimed [i.e., adopted] sons your [true] sons. That is [merely] your saying by your mouths, but Allāh says the truth, and He guides to the [right] way.

r: The Combined Forces 33:5
t: Call them by [the names of] their fathers; it is more just in the sight of Allāh. But if you do not know their fathers - then they are [still] your brothers in religion and those entrusted to you. And there is no blame upon you for that in which you have erred but [only for] what your hearts intended. And ever is Allāh Forgiving and Merciful.

r: The Combined Forces 33:6
t: The Prophet is more worthy of the believers than themselves, and his wives are [in the position of] their mothers. And those of [blood] relationship are more entitled [to inheritance] in the decree of Allāh than the [other] believers and the emigrants, except that you may do to your close associates a kindness [through bequest]. That was in the Book inscribed.

r: The Combined Forces 33:7
t: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when We took from the prophets their covenant and from you and from Noah and Abraham and Moses and Jesus, the son of Mary; and We took from them a solemn covenant

r: The Combined Forces 33:8
t: That He may question the truthful about their truth. And He has prepared for the disbelievers a painful punishment.

r: The Combined Forces 33:9
t: O you who have believed, remember the favor of Allāh upon you when armies came to [attack] you and We sent upon them a wind and armies [of angels] you did not see. And ever is Allāh, of what you do, Seeing.

r: The Combined Forces 33:10
t: [Remember] when they came at you from above you and from below you, and when eyes shifted [in fear], and hearts reached the throats, and you assumed about Allāh [various] assumptions.

r: The Combined Forces 33:11
t: There the believers were tested and shaken with a severe shaking.

r: The Combined Forces 33:12
t: And [remember] when the hypocrites and those in whose hearts is disease said, "Allāh and His Messenger did not promise us except delusion,"

r: The Combined Forces 33:13
t: And when a faction of them said, "O people of Yathrib, there is no stability for you [here], so return [home]." And a party of them asked permission of the Prophet, saying, "Indeed, our houses are exposed [i.e., unprotected]," while they were not exposed. They did not intend except to flee.

r: The Combined Forces 33:14
t: And if they had been entered upon from all its [surrounding] regions and fitnah [i.e., disbelief] had been demanded of them, they would have done it and not hesitated over it except briefly.

r: The Combined Forces 33:15
t: And they had already promised Allāh before not to turn their backs [i.e., flee]. And ever is the promise to Allāh [that about which one will be] questioned.

r: The Combined Forces 33:16
t: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Never will fleeing benefit you if you should flee from death or killing; and then [if you did], you would not be given enjoyment [of life] except for a little."

r: The Combined Forces 33:17
t: Say, "Who is it that can protect you from Allāh if He intends for you an ill or intends for you a mercy?" And they will not find for themselves besides Allāh any protector or any helper.

r: The Combined Forces 33:18
t: Already Allāh knows the hinderers among you and those [hypocrites] who say to their brothers, "Come to us," and do not go to battle, except for a few,

r: The Combined Forces 33:19
t: Indisposed toward you. And when fear comes, you see them looking at you, their eyes revolving like one being overcome by death. But when fear departs, they lash you with sharp tongues, indisposed toward [any] good. Those have not believed, so Allāh has rendered their deeds worthless, and ever is that, for Allāh, easy.

r: The Combined Forces 33:20
t: They think the companies have not [yet] withdrawn. And if the companies should come [again], they would wish they were in the desert among the bedouins, inquiring [from afar] about your news. And if they should be among you, they would not fight except for a little.

r: The Combined Forces 33:21
t: There has certainly been for you in the Messenger of Allāh an excellent pattern for anyone whose hope is in Allāh and the Last Day and [who] remembers Allāh often.

r: The Combined Forces 33:22
t: And when the believers saw the companies, they said, "This is what Allāh and His Messenger had promised us, and Allāh and His Messenger spoke the truth." And it increased them only in faith and acceptance.

r: The Combined Forces 33:23
t: Among the believers are men true to what they promised Allāh. Among them is he who has fulfilled his vow [to the death], and among them is he who awaits [his chance]. And they did not alter [the terms of their commitment] by any alteration -

r: The Combined Forces 33:24
t: That Allāh may reward the truthful for their truth and punish the hypocrites if He wills or accept their repentance. Indeed, Allāh is ever Forgiving and Merciful.

r: The Combined Forces 33:25
t: And Allāh repelled those who disbelieved, in their rage, not having obtained any good. And sufficient was Allāh for the believers in battle, and ever is Allāh Powerful and Exalted in Might.

r: The Combined Forces 33:26
t: And He brought down those who supported them among the People of the Scripture from their fortresses and cast terror into their hearts [so that] a party [i.e., their men] you killed, and you took captive a party [i.e., the women and children].

r: The Combined Forces 33:27
t: And He caused you to inherit their land and their homes and their properties and a land which you have not trodden. And ever is Allāh, over all things, competent.

r: The Combined Forces 33:28
t: O Prophet, say to your wives, "If you should desire the worldly life and its adornment, then come, I will provide for you and give you a gracious release.

r: The Combined Forces 33:29
t: But if you should desire Allāh and His Messenger and the home of the Hereafter - then indeed, Allāh has prepared for the doers of good among you a great reward."

r: The Combined Forces 33:30
t: O wives of the Prophet, whoever of you should commit a clear immorality - for her the punishment would be doubled two fold, and ever is that, for Allāh, easy.

r: The Combined Forces 33:31
t: And whoever of you devoutly obeys Allāh and His Messenger and does righteousness - We will give her her reward twice; and We have prepared for her a noble provision.

r: The Combined Forces 33:32
t: O wives of the Prophet, you are not like anyone among women. If you fear Allāh, then do not be soft in speech [to men], lest he in whose heart is disease should covet, but speak with appropriate speech.

r: The Combined Forces 33:33
t: And abide in your houses and do not display yourselves as [was] the display of the former times of ignorance. And establish prayer and give zakāh and obey Allāh and His Messenger. Allāh intends only to remove from you the impurity [of sin], O people of the [Prophet's] household, and to purify you with [extensive] purification.

r: The Combined Forces 33:34
t: And remember what is recited in your houses of the verses of Allāh and wisdom. Indeed, Allāh is ever Subtle and Aware.

r: The Combined Forces 33:35
t: Indeed, the Muslim men and Muslim women, the believing men and believing women, the obedient men and obedient women, the truthful men and truthful women, the patient men and patient women, the humble men and humble women, the charitable men and charitable women, the fasting men and fasting women, the men who guard their private parts and the women who do so, and the men who remember Allāh often and the women who do so - for them Allāh has prepared forgiveness and a great reward.

r: The Combined Forces 33:36
t: It is not for a believing man or a believing woman, when Allāh and His Messenger have decided a matter, that they should [thereafter] have any choice about their affair. And whoever disobeys Allāh and His Messenger has certainly strayed into clear error.

r: The Combined Forces 33:37
t: And [remember, O Muḥammad], when you said to the one on whom Allāh bestowed favor and you bestowed favor, "Keep your wife and fear Allāh," while you concealed within yourself that which Allāh is to disclose. And you feared the people, while Allāh has more right that you fear Him. So when Zayd had no longer any need for her, We married her to you in order that there not be upon the believers any discomfort [i.e., guilt] concerning the wives of their claimed [i.e., adopted] sons when they no longer have need of them. And ever is the command [i.e., decree] of Allāh accomplished.

r: The Combined Forces 33:38
t: There is not to be upon the Prophet any discomfort concerning that which Allāh has imposed upon him. [This is] the established way of Allāh with those [prophets] who have passed on before. And ever is the command of Allāh a destiny decreed.

r: The Combined Forces 33:39
t: [Allāh praises] those who convey the messages of Allāh and fear Him and do not fear anyone but Allāh. And sufficient is Allāh as Accountant.

r: The Combined Forces 33:40
t: Muḥammad is not the father of [any] one of your men, but [he is] the Messenger of Allāh and seal [i.e., last] of the prophets. And ever is Allāh, of all things, Knowing.

r: The Combined Forces 33:41
t: O you who have believed, remember Allāh with much remembrance

r: The Combined Forces 33:42
t: And exalt Him morning and afternoon.

r: The Combined Forces 33:43
t: It is He who confers blessing upon you, and His angels [ask Him to do so] that He may bring you out from darknesses into the light. And ever is He, to the believers, Merciful.

r: The Combined Forces 33:44
t: Their greeting the Day they meet Him will be, "Peace." And He has prepared for them a noble reward.

r: The Combined Forces 33:45
t: O Prophet, indeed We have sent you as a witness and a bringer of good tidings and a warner

r: The Combined Forces 33:46
t: And one who invites to Allāh, by His permission, and an illuminating lamp.

r: The Combined Forces 33:47
t: And give good tidings to the believers that they will have from Allāh great bounty.

r: The Combined Forces 33:48
t: And do not obey the disbelievers and the hypocrites and disregard their annoyance, and rely upon Allāh. And sufficient is Allāh as Disposer of affairs.

r: The Combined Forces 33:49
t: O you who have believed, when you marry believing women and then divorce them before you have touched them [i.e., consummated the marriage], then there is not for you any waiting period to count concerning them. So provide for them and give them a gracious release.

r: The Combined Forces 33:50
t: O Prophet, indeed We have made lawful to you your wives to whom you have given their due compensation and those your right hand possesses from what Allāh has returned to you [of captives] and the daughters of your paternal uncles and the daughters of your paternal aunts and the daughters of your maternal uncles and the daughters of your maternal aunts who emigrated with you and a believing woman if she gives herself to the Prophet [and] if the Prophet wishes to marry her; [this is] only for you, excluding the [other] believers. We certainly know what We have made obligatory upon them concerning their wives and those their right hands possess, [but this is for you] in order that there will be upon you no discomfort [i.e., difficulty]. And ever is Allāh Forgiving and Merciful.

r: The Combined Forces 33:51
t: You, [O Muḥammad], may put aside whom you will of them or take to yourself whom you will. And any that you desire of those [wives] from whom you had [temporarily] separated - there is no blame upon you [in returning her]. That is more suitable that they should be content and not grieve and that they should be satisfied with what you have given them - all of them. And Allāh knows what is in your hearts. And ever is Allāh Knowing and Forbearing.

r: The Combined Forces 33:52
t: Not lawful to you, [O Muḥammad], are [any additional] women after [this], nor [is it] for you to exchange them for [other] wives, even if their beauty were to please you, except what your right hand possesses. And ever is Allāh, over all things, an Observer.

r: The Combined Forces 33:53
t: O you who have believed, do not enter the houses of the Prophet except when you are permitted for a meal, without awaiting its readiness. But when you are invited, then enter; and when you have eaten, disperse without seeking to remain for conversation. Indeed, that [behavior] was troubling the Prophet, and he is shy of [dismissing] you. But Allāh is not shy of the truth. And when you ask [his wives] for something, ask them from behind a partition. That is purer for your hearts and their hearts. And it is not [conceivable or lawful] for you to harm the Messenger of Allāh or to marry his wives after him, ever. Indeed, that would be in the sight of Allāh an enormity.

r: The Combined Forces 33:54
t: Whether you reveal a thing or conceal it, indeed Allāh is ever, of all things, Knowing.

r: The Combined Forces 33:55
t: There is no blame upon them [i.e., women] concerning their fathers or their sons or their brothers or their brothers' sons or their sisters' sons or their women or those their right hands possess [i.e., slaves]. And fear Allāh. Indeed Allāh is ever, over all things, Witness.

r: The Combined Forces 33:56
t: Indeed, Allāh confers blessing upon the Prophet, and His angels [ask Him to do so]. O you who have believed, ask [Allāh to confer] blessing upon him and ask [Allāh to grant him] peace.

r: The Combined Forces 33:57
t: Indeed, those who abuse Allāh and His Messenger - Allāh has cursed them in this world and the Hereafter and prepared for them a humiliating punishment.

r: The Combined Forces 33:58
t: And those who harm believing men and believing women for [something] other than what they have earned [i.e., deserved] have certainly borne upon themselves a slander and manifest sin.

r: The Combined Forces 33:59
t: O Prophet, tell your wives and your daughters and the women of the believers to bring down over themselves [part] of their outer garments. That is more suitable that they will be known and not be abused. And ever is Allāh Forgiving and Merciful.

r: The Combined Forces 33:60
t: If the hypocrites and those in whose hearts is disease and those who spread rumors in al-Madīnah do not cease, We will surely incite you against them; then they will not remain your neighbors therein except for a little,

r: The Combined Forces 33:61
t: Accursed wherever they are found, [being] seized and massacred completely.

r: The Combined Forces 33:62
t: [This is] the established way of Allāh with those who passed on before; and you will not find in the way of Allāh any change.

r: The Combined Forces 33:63
t: People ask you concerning the Hour. Say, "Knowledge of it is only with Allāh. And what may make you perceive? Perhaps the Hour is near."

r: The Combined Forces 33:64
t: Indeed, Allāh has cursed the disbelievers and prepared for them a Blaze.

r: The Combined Forces 33:65
t: Abiding therein forever, they will not find a protector or a helper.

r: The Combined Forces 33:66
t: The Day their faces will be turned about in the Fire, they will say, "How we wish we had obeyed Allāh and obeyed the Messenger."

r: The Combined Forces 33:67
t: And they will say, "Our Lord, indeed we obeyed our masters and our dignitaries, and they led us astray from the [right] way.

r: The Combined Forces 33:68
t: Our Lord, give them double the punishment and curse them with a great curse."

r: The Combined Forces 33:69
t: O you who have believed, be not like those who abused Moses; then Allāh cleared him of what they said. And he, in the sight of Allāh, was distinguished.

r: The Combined Forces 33:70
t: O you who have believed, fear Allāh and speak words of appropriate justice.

r: The Combined Forces 33:71
t: He will [then] amend for you your deeds and forgive you your sins. And whoever obeys Allāh and His Messenger has certainly attained a great attainment.

r: The Combined Forces 33:72
t: Indeed, We offered the Trust to the heavens and the earth and the mountains, and they declined to bear it and feared it; but man [undertook to] bear it. Indeed, he was unjust and ignorant.

r: The Combined Forces 33:73
t: [It was] so that Allāh may punish the hypocrite men and hypocrite women and the men and women who associate others with Him and that Allāh may accept repentance from the believing men and believing women. And ever is Allāh Forgiving and Merciful.

r: Sheba 34:1
t: [All] praise is [due] to Allāh, to whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth, and to Him belongs [all] praise in the Hereafter. And He is the Wise, the Aware.

r: Sheba 34:2
t: He knows what penetrates into the earth and what emerges from it and what descends from the heaven and what ascends therein. And He is the Merciful, the Forgiving.

r: Sheba 34:3
t: But those who disbelieve say, "The Hour will not come to us." Say, "Yes, by my Lord, it will surely come to you. [Allāh is] the Knower of the unseen." Not absent from Him is an atom's weight within the heavens or within the earth or [what is] smaller than that or greater, except that it is in a clear register -

r: Sheba 34:4
t: That He may reward those who believe and do righteous deeds. Those will have forgiveness and noble provision.

r: Sheba 34:5
t: But those who strive against Our verses [seeking] to cause failure - for them will be a painful punishment of foul nature.

r: Sheba 34:6
t: And those who have been given knowledge see that what is revealed to you from your Lord is the truth, and it guides to the path of the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy.

r: Sheba 34:7
t: But those who disbelieve say, "Shall we direct you to a man who will inform you [that] when you have disintegrated in complete disintegration, you will [then] be [recreated] in a new creation?

r: Sheba 34:8
t: Has he invented about Allāh a lie or is there in him madness?" Rather, they who do not believe in the Hereafter will be in the punishment and [are in] extreme error.

r: Sheba 34:9
t: Then, do they not look at what is before them and what is behind them of the heaven and earth? If We should will, We could cause the earth to swallow them or [could] let fall upon them fragments from the sky. Indeed in that is a sign for every servant turning back [to Allāh].

r: Sheba 34:10
t: And We certainly gave David from Us bounty. [We said], "O mountains, repeat [Our] praises with him, and the birds [as well]." And We made pliable for him iron,

r: Sheba 34:11
t: [Commanding him], "Make full coats of mail and calculate [precisely] the links, and work [all of you] righteousness. Indeed I, of what you do, am Seeing."

r: Sheba 34:12
t: And to Solomon [We subjected] the wind - its morning [journey was that of] a month - and its afternoon [journey was that of] a month, and We made flow for him a spring of [liquid] copper. And among the jinn were those who worked for him by the permission of his Lord. And whoever deviated among them from Our command - We will make him taste of the punishment of the Blaze.

r: Sheba 34:13
t: They made for him what he willed of elevated chambers, statues, bowls like reservoirs, and stationary kettles. [We said], "Work, O family of David, in gratitude." And few of My servants are grateful.

r: Sheba 34:14
t: And when We decreed for him [i.e., Solomon] death, nothing indicated to them [i.e., the jinn] his death except a creature of the earth eating his staff. But when he fell, it became clear to the jinn that if they had known the unseen, they would not have remained in humiliating punishment.

r: Sheba 34:15
t: There was for [the tribe of] Saba’ in their dwelling place a sign: two [fields of] gardens on the right and on the left. [They were told], "Eat from the provisions of your Lord and be grateful to Him. A good land [have you], and a forgiving Lord."

r: Sheba 34:16
t: But they turned away [refusing], so We sent upon them the flood of the dam, and We replaced their two [fields of] gardens with gardens of bitter fruit, tamarisks and something of sparse lote trees.

r: Sheba 34:17
t: [By] that We repaid them because they disbelieved. And do We [thus] repay except the ungrateful?

r: Sheba 34:18
t: And We placed between them and the cities which We had blessed [many] visible cities. And We determined between them the [distances of] journey, [saying], "Travel between them by night or by day in safety."

r: Sheba 34:19
t: But [insolently] they said, "Our Lord, lengthen the distance between our journeys," and wronged themselves, so We made them narrations and dispersed them in total dispersion. Indeed in that are signs for everyone patient and grateful.

r: Sheba 34:20
t: And Iblees had already confirmed through them his assumption, so they followed him, except for a party of believers.

r: Sheba 34:21
t: And he had over them no authority except [it was decreed] that We might make evident who believes in the Hereafter from who is thereof in doubt. And your Lord, over all things, is Guardian.

r: Sheba 34:22
t: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Invoke those you claim [as deities] besides Allāh." They do not possess an atom's weight [of ability] in the heavens or on the earth, and they do not have therein any partnership [with Him], nor is there for Him from among them any assistant.

r: Sheba 34:23
t: And intercession does not benefit with Him except for one whom He permits. [And those wait] until, when terror is removed from their hearts, they will say [to one another], "What has your Lord said?" They will say, "The truth." And He is the Most High, the Grand.

r: Sheba 34:24
t: Say, "Who provides for you from the heavens and the earth?" Say, "Allāh. And indeed, we or you are either upon guidance or in clear error."

r: Sheba 34:25
t: Say, "You will not be asked about what we committed, and we will not be asked about what you do."

r: Sheba 34:26
t: Say, "Our Lord will bring us together; then He will judge between us in truth. And He is the Knowing Judge."

r: Sheba 34:27
t: Say, "Show me those whom you have attached to Him as partners. No! Rather, He [alone] is Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Wise."

r: Sheba 34:28
t: And We have not sent you except comprehensively to mankind as a bringer of good tidings and a warner. But most of the people do not know.

r: Sheba 34:29
t: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"

r: Sheba 34:30
t: Say, "For you is the appointment of a Day [when] you will not remain thereafter an hour, nor will you precede [it]."

r: Sheba 34:31
t: And those who disbelieve say, "We will never believe in this Qur’ān nor in that before it." But if you could see when the wrongdoers are made to stand before their Lord, refuting each others' words... Those who were oppressed will say to those who were arrogant, "If not for you, we would have been believers."

r: Sheba 34:32
t: Those who were arrogant will say to those who were oppressed, "Did we avert you from guidance after it had come to you? Rather, you were criminals."

r: Sheba 34:33
t: Those who were oppressed will say to those who were arrogant, "Rather, [it was your] conspiracy of night and day when you were ordering us to disbelieve in Allāh and attribute to Him equals." But they will [all] confide regret when they see the punishment; and We will put shackles on the necks of those who disbelieved. Will they be recompensed except for what they used to do?

r: Sheba 34:34
t: And We did not send into a city any warner except that its affluent said, "Indeed we, in that with which you were sent, are disbelievers."

r: Sheba 34:35
t: And they said, "We are more [than the believers] in wealth and children, and we are not to be punished."

r: Sheba 34:36
t: Say, "Indeed, my Lord extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it], but most of the people do not know."

r: Sheba 34:37
t: And it is not your wealth or your children that bring you nearer to Us in position, but it is [by being] one who has believed and done righteousness. For them there will be the double reward for what they did, and they will be in the upper chambers [of Paradise], safe [and secure].

r: Sheba 34:38
t: And the ones who strive against Our verses to cause [them] failure - those will be brought into the punishment [to remain].

r: Sheba 34:39
t: Say, "Indeed, my Lord extends provision for whom He wills of His servants and restricts [it] for him. But whatever thing you spend [in His cause] - He will compensate it; and He is the best of providers."

r: Sheba 34:40
t: And [mention] the Day when He will gather them all and then say to the angels, "Did these [people] used to worship you?"

r: Sheba 34:41
t: They will say, "Exalted are You! You, [O Allāh], are our benefactor excluding [i.e., not] them. Rather, they used to worship the jinn; most of them were believers in them."

r: Sheba 34:42
t: But today [i.e., the Day of Judgement] you do not hold for one another [the power of] benefit or harm, and We will say to those who wronged, "Taste the punishment of the Fire, which you used to deny."

r: Sheba 34:43
t: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, they say, "This is not but a man who wishes to avert you from that which your fathers were worshipping." And they say, "This is not except a lie invented." And those who disbelieve say of the truth when it has come to them, "This is not but obvious magic."

r: Sheba 34:44
t: And We had not given them any scriptures which they could study, and We had not sent to them before you, [O Muḥammad], any warner.

r: Sheba 34:45
t: And those before them denied, and they [i.e., the people of Makkah] have not attained a tenth of what We had given them. But they [i.e., the former peoples] denied My messengers, so how [terrible] was My reproach.

r: Sheba 34:46
t: Say, "I only advise you of one [thing] - that you stand for Allāh, [seeking truth] in pairs and individually, and then give thought." There is not in your companion any madness. He is only a warner to you before a severe punishment.

r: Sheba 34:47
t: Say, "Whatever payment I might have asked of you - it is yours. My payment is only from Allāh, and He is, over all things, Witness."

r: Sheba 34:48
t: Say, "Indeed, my Lord projects the truth, Knower of the unseen."

r: Sheba 34:49
t: Say, "The truth has come, and falsehood can neither begin [anything] nor repeat [it]."

r: Sheba 34:50
t: Say, "If I should err, I would only err against myself. But if I am guided, it is by what my Lord reveals to me. Indeed, He is Hearing and near."

r: Sheba 34:51
t: And if you could see when they are terrified but there is no escape, and they will be seized from a place nearby.

r: Sheba 34:52
t: And they will [then] say, "We believe in it!" But how for them will be the taking [of faith] from a place far away?

r: Sheba 34:53
t: And they had already disbelieved in it before and would assault the unseen from a place far away.

r: Sheba 34:54
t: And prevention will be placed between them and what they desire, as was done with their kind before. Indeed, they were in disquieting doubt [i.e., denial].

r: The Originator 35:1
t: [All] praise is [due] to Allāh, Creator of the heavens and the earth, [who] made the angels messengers having wings, two or three or four. He increases in creation what He wills. Indeed, Allāh is over all things competent.

r: The Originator 35:2
t: Whatever Allāh grants to people of mercy - none can withhold it; and whatever He withholds - none can release it thereafter. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

r: The Originator 35:3
t: O mankind, remember the favor of Allāh upon you. Is there any creator other than Allāh who provides for you from the heaven and earth? There is no deity except Him, so how are you deluded?

r: The Originator 35:4
t: And if they deny you, [O Muḥammad] - already were messengers denied before you. And to Allāh are returned [all] matters.

r: The Originator 35:5
t: O mankind, indeed the promise of Allāh is truth, so let not the worldly life delude you and be not deceived about Allāh by the Deceiver [i.e., Satan].

r: The Originator 35:6
t: Indeed, Satan is an enemy to you; so take him as an enemy. He only invites his party to be among the companions of the Blaze.

r: The Originator 35:7
t: Those who disbelieve will have a severe punishment, and those who believe and do righteous deeds will have forgiveness and great reward.

r: The Originator 35:8
t: Then is one to whom the evil of his deed has been made attractive so he considers it good [like one rightly guided]? For indeed, Allāh sends astray whom He wills and guides whom He wills. So do not let yourself perish over them in regret. Indeed, Allāh is Knowing of what they do.

r: The Originator 35:9
t: And it is Allāh who sends the winds, and they stir the clouds, and We drive them to a dead land and give life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness. Thus is the resurrection.

r: The Originator 35:10
t: Whoever desires honor [through power] - then to Allāh belongs all honor. To Him ascends good speech, and righteous work raises it. But they who plot evil deeds will have a severe punishment, and the plotting of those - it will perish.

r: The Originator 35:11
t: And Allāh created you from dust, then from a sperm-drop; then He made you mates. And no female conceives nor does she give birth except with His knowledge. And no aged person is granted [additional] life nor is his lifespan lessened but that it is in a register. Indeed, that for Allāh is easy.

r: The Originator 35:12
t: And not alike are the two seas [i.e., bodies of water]. One is fresh and sweet, palatable for drinking, and one is salty and bitter. And from each you eat tender meat and extract ornaments which you wear, and you see the ships plowing through [them] that you might seek of His bounty; and perhaps you will be grateful.

r: The Originator 35:13
t: He causes the night to enter the day, and He causes the day to enter the night and has subjected the sun and the moon - each running [its course] for a specified term. That is Allāh, your Lord; to Him belongs sovereignty. And those whom you invoke other than Him do not possess [as much as] the membrane of a date seed.

r: The Originator 35:14
t: If you invoke them, they do not hear your supplication; and if they heard, they would not respond to you. And on the Day of Resurrection they will deny your association. And none can inform you like [one] Aware [of all matters].

r: The Originator 35:15
t: O mankind, you are those in need of Allāh, while Allāh is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy.

r: The Originator 35:16
t: If He wills, He can do away with you and bring forth a new creation.

r: The Originator 35:17
t: And that is for Allāh not difficult.

r: The Originator 35:18
t: And no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another. And if a heavily laden soul calls [another] to [carry some of] its load, nothing of it will be carried, even if he should be a close relative. You can only warn those who fear their Lord unseen and have established prayer. And whoever purifies himself only purifies himself for [the benefit of] his soul. And to Allāh is the [final] destination.

r: The Originator 35:19
t: Not equal are the blind and the seeing,

r: The Originator 35:20
t: Nor are the darknesses and the light,

r: The Originator 35:21
t: Nor are the shade and the heat,

r: The Originator 35:22
t: And not equal are the living and the dead. Indeed, Allāh causes to hear whom He wills, but you cannot make hear those in the graves.

r: The Originator 35:23
t: You, [O Muḥammad], are not but a warner.

r: The Originator 35:24
t: Indeed, We have sent you with the truth as a bringer of good tidings and a warner. And there was no nation but that there had passed within it a warner.

r: The Originator 35:25
t: And if they deny you - then already have those before them denied. Their messengers came to them with clear proofs and written ordinances and with the enlightening Scripture.

r: The Originator 35:26
t: Then I seized the ones who disbelieved, and how [terrible] was My reproach.

r: The Originator 35:27
t: Do you not see that Allāh sends down rain from the sky, and We produce thereby fruits of varying colors? And in the mountains are tracts, white and red of varying shades and [some] extremely black.

r: The Originator 35:28
t: And among people and moving creatures and grazing livestock are various colors similarly. Only those fear Allāh, from among His servants, who have knowledge. Indeed, Allāh is Exalted in Might and Forgiving.

r: The Originator 35:29
t: Indeed, those who recite the Book of Allāh and establish prayer and spend [in His cause] out of what We have provided them, secretly and publicly, [can] expect a transaction [i.e., profit] that will never perish -

r: The Originator 35:30
t: That He may give them in full their rewards and increase for them of His bounty. Indeed, He is Forgiving and Appreciative.

r: The Originator 35:31
t: And that which We have revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], of the Book is the truth, confirming what was before it. Indeed Allāh, of His servants, is Aware and Seeing.

r: The Originator 35:32
t: Then We caused to inherit the Book those We have chosen of Our servants; and among them is he who wrongs himself [i.e., sins], and among them is he who is moderate, and among them is he who is foremost in good deeds by permission of Allāh. That [inheritance] is what is the great bounty.

r: The Originator 35:33
t: [For them are] gardens of perpetual residence which they will enter. They will be adorned therein with bracelets of gold and pearls, and their garments therein will be silk.

r: The Originator 35:34
t: And they will say, "Praise to Allāh, who has removed from us [all] sorrow. Indeed, our Lord is Forgiving and Appreciative -

r: The Originator 35:35
t: He who has settled us in the home of duration [i.e., Paradise] out of His bounty. There touches us not in it any fatigue, and there touches us not in it weariness [of mind]."

r: The Originator 35:36
t: And for those who disbelieve will be the fire of Hell. [Death] is not decreed for them so they may die, nor will its torment be lightened for them. Thus do We recompense every ungrateful one.

r: The Originator 35:37
t: And they will cry out therein, "Our Lord, remove us; we will do righteousness - other than what we were doing!" But did We not grant you life enough for whoever would remember therein to remember, and the warner had come to you? So taste [the punishment], for there is not for the wrongdoers any helper.

r: The Originator 35:38
t: Indeed, Allāh is Knower of the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and earth. Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.

r: The Originator 35:39
t: It is He who has made you successors upon the earth. And whoever disbelieves - upon him will be [the consequence of] his disbelief. And the disbelief of the disbelievers does not increase them in the sight of their Lord except in hatred; and the disbelief of the disbelievers does not increase them except in loss.

r: The Originator 35:40
t: Say, "Have you considered your 'partners' whom you invoke besides Allāh? Show me what they have created from the earth, or have they partnership [with Him] in the heavens? Or have We given them a book so they are [standing] on evidence therefrom? [No], rather, the wrongdoers do not promise each other except delusion."

r: The Originator 35:41
t: Indeed, Allāh holds the heavens and the earth, lest they cease. And if they should cease, no one could hold them [in place] after Him. Indeed, He is Forbearing and Forgiving.

r: The Originator 35:42
t: And they swore by Allāh their strongest oaths that if a warner came to them, they would be more guided than [any] one of the [previous] nations. But when a warner came to them, it did not increase them except in aversion

r: The Originator 35:43
t: [Due to] arrogance in the land and plotting of evil; but the evil plot does not encompass except its own people. Then do they await except the way [i.e., fate] of the former peoples? But you will never find in the way [i.e., established method] of Allāh any change, and you will never find in the way of Allāh any alteration.

r: The Originator 35:44
t: Have they not traveled through the land and observed how was the end of those before them? And they were greater than them in power. But Allāh is not to be caused failure [i.e., prevented] by anything in the heavens or on the earth. Indeed, He is ever Knowing and Competent.

r: The Originator 35:45
t: And if Allāh were to impose blame on the people for what they have earned, He would not leave upon it [i.e., the earth] any creature. But He defers them for a specified term. And when their time comes, then indeed Allāh has ever been, of His servants, Seeing.

r: Ya Sin 36:1
t: Yā, Seen.

r: Ya Sin 36:2
t: By the wise Qur’ān,

r: Ya Sin 36:3
t: Indeed you, [O Muḥammad], are from among the messengers,

r: Ya Sin 36:4
t: On a straight path.

r: Ya Sin 36:5
t: [This is] a revelation of the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,

r: Ya Sin 36:6
t: That you may warn a people whose forefathers were not warned, so they are unaware.

r: Ya Sin 36:7
t: Already the word [i.e., decree] has come into effect upon most of them, so they do not believe.

r: Ya Sin 36:8
t: Indeed, We have put shackles on their necks, and they are to their chins, so they are with heads [kept] aloft.

r: Ya Sin 36:9
t: And We have put before them a barrier and behind them a barrier and covered them, so they do not see.

r: Ya Sin 36:10
t: And it is all the same for them whether you warn them or do not warn them - they will not believe.

r: Ya Sin 36:11
t: You can only warn one who follows the message and fears the Most Merciful unseen. So give him good tidings of forgiveness and noble reward.

r: Ya Sin 36:12
t: Indeed, it is We who bring the dead to life and record what they have put forth and what they left behind, and all things We have enumerated in a clear register.

r: Ya Sin 36:13
t: And present to them an example: the people of the city, when the messengers came to it -

r: Ya Sin 36:14
t: When We sent to them two but they denied them, so We strengthened [them] with a third, and they said, "Indeed, we are messengers to you."

r: Ya Sin 36:15
t: They said, "You are not but human beings like us, and the Most Merciful has not revealed a thing. You are only telling lies."

r: Ya Sin 36:16
t: They said, "Our Lord knows that we are messengers to you,

r: Ya Sin 36:17
t: And we are not responsible except for clear notification."

r: Ya Sin 36:18
t: They said, "Indeed, we consider you a bad omen. If you do not desist, we will surely stone you, and there will surely touch you, from us, a painful punishment."

r: Ya Sin 36:19
t: They said, "Your omen [i.e., fate] is with yourselves. Is it because you were reminded? Rather, you are a transgressing people."

r: Ya Sin 36:20
t: And there came from the farthest end of the city a man, running. He said, "O my people, follow the messengers.

r: Ya Sin 36:21
t: Follow those who do not ask of you [any] payment, and they are [rightly] guided.

r: Ya Sin 36:22
t: And why should I not worship He who created me and to whom you will be returned?

r: Ya Sin 36:23
t: Should I take other than Him [false] deities [while], if the Most Merciful intends for me some adversity, their intercession will not avail me at all, nor can they save me?

r: Ya Sin 36:24
t: Indeed, I would then be in manifest error.

r: Ya Sin 36:25
t: Indeed, I have believed in your Lord, so listen to me."

r: Ya Sin 36:26
t: It was said, "Enter Paradise." He said, "I wish my people could know

r: Ya Sin 36:27
t: Of how my Lord has forgiven me and placed me among the honored."

r: Ya Sin 36:28
t: And We did not send down upon his people after him any soldiers from the heaven, nor would We have done so.

r: Ya Sin 36:29
t: It was not but one shout, and immediately they were extinguished.

r: Ya Sin 36:30
t: How regretful for the servants. There did not come to them any messenger except that they used to ridicule him.

r: Ya Sin 36:31
t: Have they not considered how many generations We destroyed before them - that they to them will not return?

r: Ya Sin 36:32
t: And indeed, all of them will yet be brought present before Us.

r: Ya Sin 36:33
t: And a sign for them is the dead earth. We have brought it to life and brought forth from it grain, and from it they eat.

r: Ya Sin 36:34
t: And We placed therein gardens of palm trees and grapevines and caused to burst forth therefrom some springs -

r: Ya Sin 36:35
t: That they may eat of His fruit. And their hands have not produced it, so will they not be grateful?

r: Ya Sin 36:36
t: Exalted is He who created all pairs - from what the earth grows and from themselves and from that which they do not know.

r: Ya Sin 36:37
t: And a sign for them is the night. We remove from it the [light of] day, so they are [left] in darkness.

r: Ya Sin 36:38
t: And the sun runs [on course] toward its stopping point. That is the determination of the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.

r: Ya Sin 36:39
t: And the moon - We have determined for it phases, until it returns [appearing] like the old date stalk.

r: Ya Sin 36:40
t: It is not allowable [i.e., possible] for the sun to reach the moon, nor does the night overtake the day, but each, in an orbit, is swimming.

r: Ya Sin 36:41
t: And a sign for them is that We carried their forefathers in a laden ship.

r: Ya Sin 36:42
t: And We created for them from the likes of it that which they ride.

r: Ya Sin 36:43
t: And if We should will, We could drown them; then no one responding to a cry would there be for them, nor would they be saved

r: Ya Sin 36:44
t: Except as a mercy from Us and provision for a time.

r: Ya Sin 36:45
t: But when it is said to them, "Beware of what is before you and what is behind you; perhaps you will receive mercy..."

r: Ya Sin 36:46
t: And no sign comes to them from the signs of their Lord except that they are from it turning away.

r: Ya Sin 36:47
t: And when it is said to them, "Spend from that which Allāh has provided for you," those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Should we feed one whom, if Allāh had willed, He would have fed? You are not but in clear error."

r: Ya Sin 36:48
t: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"

r: Ya Sin 36:49
t: They do not await except one blast which will seize them while they are disputing.

r: Ya Sin 36:50
t: And they will not be able [to give] any instruction, nor to their people can they return.

r: Ya Sin 36:51
t: And the Horn will be blown; and at once from the graves to their Lord they will hasten.

r: Ya Sin 36:52
t: They will say, "O woe to us! Who has raised us up from our sleeping place?" [The reply will be], "This is what the Most Merciful had promised, and the messengers told the truth."

r: Ya Sin 36:53
t: It will not be but one blast, and at once they are all brought present before Us.

r: Ya Sin 36:54
t: So today [i.e., the Day of Judgement] no soul will be wronged at all, and you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do.

r: Ya Sin 36:55
t: Indeed the companions of Paradise, that Day, will be amused in [joyful] occupation -

r: Ya Sin 36:56
t: They and their spouses - in shade, reclining on adorned couches.

r: Ya Sin 36:57
t: For them therein is fruit, and for them is whatever they request [or wish]

r: Ya Sin 36:58
t: [And] "Peace," a word from a Merciful Lord.

r: Ya Sin 36:59
t: [Then He will say], "But stand apart today, you criminals.

r: Ya Sin 36:60
t: Did I not enjoin upon you, O children of Adam, that you not worship Satan - [for] indeed, he is to you a clear enemy -

r: Ya Sin 36:61
t: And that you worship [only] Me? This is a straight path.

r: Ya Sin 36:62
t: And he had already led astray from among you much of creation, so did you not use reason?

r: Ya Sin 36:63
t: This is the Hellfire which you were promised.

r: Ya Sin 36:64
t: [Enter to] burn therein today for what you used to deny."

r: Ya Sin 36:65
t: That Day, We will seal over their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us, and their feet will testify about what they used to earn.

r: Ya Sin 36:66
t: And if We willed, We could have obliterated their eyes, and they would race to [find] the path, and how could they see?

r: Ya Sin 36:67
t: And if We willed, We could have deformed them, [paralyzing them] in their places so they would not be able to proceed, nor could they return.

r: Ya Sin 36:68
t: And he to whom We grant long life We reverse in creation; so will they not understand?

r: Ya Sin 36:69
t: And We did not give him [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)] knowledge of poetry, nor is it befitting for him. It is not but a message and a clear Qur’ān

r: Ya Sin 36:70
t: To warn whoever is alive and justify the word [i.e., decree] against the disbelievers.

r: Ya Sin 36:71
t: Do they not see that We have created for them from what Our hands have made, grazing livestock, and [then] they are their owners?

r: Ya Sin 36:72
t: And We have tamed them for them, so some of them they ride, and some of them they eat.

r: Ya Sin 36:73
t: And for them therein are [other] benefits and drinks, so will they not be grateful?

r: Ya Sin 36:74
t: But they have taken besides Allāh [false] deities that perhaps they would be helped.

r: Ya Sin 36:75
t: They are not able to help them, and they [themselves] are for them soldiers in attendance.

r: Ya Sin 36:76
t: So let not their speech grieve you. Indeed, We know what they conceal and what they declare.

r: Ya Sin 36:77
t: Does man not consider that We created him from a [mere] sperm-drop - then at once he is a clear adversary?

r: Ya Sin 36:78
t: And he presents for Us an example and forgets his [own] creation. He says, "Who will give life to bones while they are disintegrated?"

r: Ya Sin 36:79
t: Say, "He will give them life who produced them the first time; and He is, of all creation, Knowing."

r: Ya Sin 36:80
t: [It is] He who made for you from the green tree, fire, and then from it you ignite.

r: Ya Sin 36:81
t: Is not He who created the heavens and the earth Able to create the likes of them? Yes, [it is so]; and He is the Knowing Creator.

r: Ya Sin 36:82
t: His command is only when He intends a thing that He says to it, "Be," and it is.

r: Ya Sin 36:83
t: So exalted is He in whose hand is the realm of all things, and to Him you will be returned.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:1
t: By those [angels] lined up in rows

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:2
t: And those who drive [the clouds]

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:3
t: And those who recite the message,

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:4
t: Indeed, your God is One,

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:5
t: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them and Lord of the sunrises.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:6
t: Indeed, We have adorned the nearest heaven with an adornment of stars

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:7
t: And as protection against every rebellious devil

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:8
t: [So] they may not listen to the exalted assembly [of angels] and are pelted from every side,

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:9
t: Repelled; and for them is a constant punishment,

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:10
t: Except one who snatches [some words] by theft, but they are pursued by a burning flame, piercing [in brightness].

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:11
t: Then inquire of them, [O Muḥammad], "Are they a stronger [or more difficult] creation or those [others] We have created?" Indeed, We created them [i.e., men] from sticky clay.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:12
t: But you wonder, while they mock,

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:13
t: And when they are reminded, they remember not.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:14
t: And when they see a sign, they ridicule.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:15
t: And say, "This is not but obvious magic.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:16
t: When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:17
t: And our forefathers [as well]?"

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:18
t: Say, "Yes, and you will be [rendered] contemptible."

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:19
t: It will be only one shout, and at once they will be observing.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:20
t: They will say, "O woe to us! This is the Day of Recompense."

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:21
t: [They will be told], "This is the Day of Judgement which you used to deny."

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:22
t: [The angels will be ordered], "Gather those who committed wrong, their kinds, and what they used to worship

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:23
t: Other than Allāh, and guide them to the path of Hellfire

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:24
t: And stop them; indeed, they are to be questioned."

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:25
t: [They will be asked], "What is [wrong] with you? Why do you not help each other?"

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:26
t: But they, that Day, are in surrender.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:27
t: And they will approach one another asking [i.e., blaming] each other.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:28
t: They will say, "Indeed, you used to come at us from the right."

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:29
t: They [i.e., the oppressors] will say, "Rather, you [yourselves] were not believers,

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:30
t: And we had over you no authority, but you were a transgressing people.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:31
t: So the word [i.e., decree] of our Lord has come into effect upon us; indeed, we will taste [punishment].

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:32
t: And we led you to deviation; indeed, we were deviators."

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:33
t: So indeed they, that Day, will be sharing in the punishment.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:34
t: Indeed, that is how We deal with the criminals.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:35
t: Indeed they, when it was said to them, "There is no deity but Allāh," were arrogant

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:36
t: And were saying, "Are we to leave our gods for a mad poet?"

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:37
t: Rather, he [i.e., the Prophet (ﷺ)] has come with the truth and confirmed the [previous] messengers.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:38
t: Indeed, you [disbelievers] will be tasters of the painful punishment,

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:39
t: And you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do -

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:40
t: But not the chosen servants of Allāh.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:41
t: Those will have a provision determined -

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:42
t: Fruits; and they will be honored

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:43
t: In gardens of pleasure

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:44
t: On thrones facing one another.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:45
t: There will be circulated among them a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring,

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:46
t: White and delicious to the drinkers;

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:47
t: No bad effect is there in it, nor from it will they be intoxicated.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:48
t: And with them will be women limiting [their] glances, with large, [beautiful] eyes,

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:49
t: As if they were [delicate] eggs, well-protected.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:50
t: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:51
t: A speaker among them will say, "Indeed, I had a companion [on earth].

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:52
t: Who would say, 'Are you indeed of those who believe

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:53
t: That when we have died and become dust and bones, we will indeed be recompensed?'"

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:54
t: He will say, "Would you [care to] look?"

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:55
t: And he will look and see him in the midst of the Hellfire.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:56
t: He will say, "By Allāh, you almost ruined me.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:57
t: If not for the favor of my Lord, I would have been of those brought in [to Hell].

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:58
t: Then, are we not to die

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:59
t: Except for our first death, and we will not be punished?"

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:60
t: Indeed, this is the great attainment.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:61
t: For the like of this let the workers [on earth] work.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:62
t: Is that [i.e., Paradise] a better accommodation or the tree of zaqqūm?

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:63
t: Indeed, We have made it a torment for the wrongdoers.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:64
t: Indeed, it is a tree issuing from the bottom of the Hellfire,

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:65
t: Its emerging fruit as if it was heads of the devils.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:66
t: And indeed, they will eat from it and fill with it their bellies.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:67
t: Then indeed, they will have after it a mixture of scalding water.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:68
t: Then indeed, their return will be to the Hellfire.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:69
t: Indeed they found their fathers astray.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:70
t: So they hastened [to follow] in their footsteps.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:71
t: And there had already strayed before them most of the former peoples,

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:72
t: And We had already sent among them warners.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:73
t: Then look how was the end of those who were warned -

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:74
t: But not the chosen servants of Allāh.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:75
t: And Noah had certainly called Us, and [We are] the best of responders.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:76
t: And We saved him and his family from the great affliction.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:77
t: And We made his descendants those remaining [on the earth]

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:78
t: And left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:79
t: "Peace upon Noah among the worlds."

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:80
t: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:81
t: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:82
t: Then We drowned the others [i.e., disbelievers].

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:83
t: And indeed, among his kind was Abraham,

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:84
t: When he came to his Lord with a sound heart

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:85
t: [And] when he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship?

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:86
t: Is it falsehood [as] gods other than Allāh you desire?

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:87
t: Then what is your thought about the Lord of the worlds?"

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:88
t: And he cast a look at the stars.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:89
t: And said, "Indeed, I am [about to be] ill."

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:90
t: So they turned away from him, departing.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:91
t: Then he turned to their gods and said, "Do you not eat?

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:92
t: What is [wrong] with you that you do not speak?".

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:93
t: And he turned upon them a blow with [his] right hand.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:94
t: Then they [i.e., the people] came toward him, hastening.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:95
t: He said, "Do you worship that which you [yourselves] carve,

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:96
t: While Allāh created you and that which you do?"

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:97
t: They said, "Construct for him a structure [i.e., furnace] and throw him into the burning fire."

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:98
t: And they intended for him a plan [i.e., harm], but We made them the most debased.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:99
t: And [then] he said, "Indeed, I will go to [where I am ordered by] my Lord; He will guide me.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:100
t: My Lord, grant me [a child] from among the righteous."

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:101
t: So We gave him good tidings of a forbearing boy.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:102
t: And when he reached with him [the age of] exertion, he said, "O my son, indeed I have seen in a dream that I [must] sacrifice you, so see what you think." He said, "O my father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if Allāh wills, of the steadfast."

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:103
t: And when they had both submitted and he put him down upon his forehead,

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:104
t: We called to him, "O Abraham,

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:105
t: You have fulfilled the vision." Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:106
t: Indeed, this was the clear trial.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:107
t: And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice,

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:108
t: And We left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:109
t: "Peace upon Abraham."

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:110
t: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:111
t: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:112
t: And We gave him good tidings of Isaac, a prophet from among the righteous.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:113
t: And We blessed him and Isaac. But among their descendants is the doer of good and the clearly unjust to himself [i.e., sinner].

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:114
t: And We did certainly confer favor upon Moses and Aaron.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:115
t: And We saved them and their people from the great affliction,

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:116
t: And We supported them so it was they who overcame.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:117
t: And We gave them the explicit Scripture [i.e., the Torah],

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:118
t: And We guided them on the straight path.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:119
t: And We left for them [favorable mention] among later generations:

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:120
t: "Peace upon Moses and Aaron."

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:121
t: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:122
t: Indeed, they were of Our believing servants.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:123
t: And indeed, Elias was from among the messengers,

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:124
t: When he said to his people, "Will you not fear Allāh?

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:125
t: Do you call upon Baʿl and leave the best of creators -

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:126
t: Allāh, your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers?"

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:127
t: And they denied him, so indeed, they will be brought [for punishment],

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:128
t: Except the chosen servants of Allāh.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:129
t: And We left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:130
t: "Peace upon Elias."

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:131
t: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:132
t: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:133
t: And indeed, Lot was among the messengers.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:134
t: [So mention] when We saved him and his family, all,

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:135
t: Except an old woman [i.e., his wife] among those who remained [with the evildoers].

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:136
t: Then We destroyed the others.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:137
t: And indeed, you pass by them in the morning

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:138
t: And at night. Then will you not use reason?

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:139
t: And indeed, Jonah was among the messengers.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:140
t: [Mention] when he ran away to the laden ship.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:141
t: And he drew lots and was among the losers.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:142
t: Then the fish swallowed him, while he was blameworthy.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:143
t: And had he not been of those who exalt Allāh,

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:144
t: He would have remained inside its belly until the Day they are resurrected.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:145
t: But We threw him onto the open shore while he was ill.
