r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:146
t: And We caused to grow over him a gourd vine.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:147
t: And We sent him to [his people of] a hundred thousand or more.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:148
t: And they believed, so We gave them enjoyment [of life] for a time.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:149
t: So inquire of them, [O Muḥammad], "Does your Lord have daughters while they have sons?

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:150
t: Or did We create the angels as females while they were witnesses?"

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:151
t: Unquestionably, it is out of their [invented] falsehood that they say,

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:152
t: "Allāh has begotten," and indeed, they are liars.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:153
t: Has He chosen daughters over sons?

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:154
t: What is [wrong] with you? How do you make judgement?

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:155
t: Then will you not be reminded?

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:156
t: Or do you have a clear authority?

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:157
t: Then produce your scripture, if you should be truthful.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:158
t: And they have made [i.e., claimed] between Him and the jinn a lineage, but the jinn have already known that they [who made such claims] will be brought [to punishment].

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:159
t: Exalted is Allāh above what they describe,

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:160
t: Except the chosen servants of Allāh [who do not share in that sin].

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:161
t: So indeed, you [disbelievers] and whatever you worship,

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:162
t: You cannot tempt [anyone] away from Him

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:163
t: Except he who is to [enter and] burn in the Hellfire.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:164
t: [The angels say], "There is not among us any except that he has a known position.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:165
t: And indeed, we are those who line up [for prayer].

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:166
t: And indeed, we are those who exalt Allāh."

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:167
t: And indeed, they [i.e., the disbelievers] used to say,

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:168
t: "If we had a message from [those of] the former peoples,

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:169
t: We would have been the chosen servants of Allāh."

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:170
t: But they disbelieved in it, so they are going to know.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:171
t: And Our word [i.e., decree] has already preceded for Our servants, the messengers,

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:172
t: [That] indeed, they would be those given victory

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:173
t: And [that] indeed, Our soldiers [i.e., the believers] will be those who overcome.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:174
t: So, [O Muḥammad], leave them for a time.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:175
t: And see [what will befall] them, for they are going to see.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:176
t: Then for Our punishment are they impatient?

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:177
t: But when it descends in their territory, then evil is the morning of those who were warned.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:178
t: And leave them for a time.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:179
t: And see, for they are going to see.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:180
t: Exalted is your Lord, the Lord of might, above what they describe.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:181
t: And peace upon the messengers.

r: Those Who Set The Ranks 37:182
t: And praise to Allāh, Lord of the worlds.

r: Sad 38:1
t: Ṣād. By the Qur’ān containing reminder...

r: Sad 38:2
t: But those who disbelieve are in pride and dissension.

r: Sad 38:3
t: How many a generation have We destroyed before them, and they [then] called out; but it was not a time for escape.

r: Sad 38:4
t: And they wonder that there has come to them a warner [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)] from among themselves. And the disbelievers say, "This is a magician and a liar.

r: Sad 38:5
t: Has he made the gods [only] one God? Indeed, this is a curious thing."

r: Sad 38:6
t: And the eminent among them went forth, [saying], "Continue, and be patient over [the defense of] your gods. Indeed, this is a thing intended.

r: Sad 38:7
t: We have not heard of this in the latest religion. This is not but a fabrication.

r: Sad 38:8
t: Has the message been revealed to him out of [all of] us?" Rather, they are in doubt about My message. Rather, they have not yet tasted My punishment.

r: Sad 38:9
t: Or do they have the depositories of the mercy of your Lord, the Exalted in Might, the Bestower?
Or is theirs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and what is between them? Then let them ascend through [any] ways of access.
[They are but] soldiers [who will be] defeated there among the companies [of disbelievers].
The people of Noah denied before them, and [the tribe of] ʿAad and Pharaoh, the owner of stakes,
And [the tribe of] Thamūd and the people of Lot and the companions of the thicket [i.e., people of Madyan]. Those are the companies.
Each of them denied the messengers, so My penalty was justified.
And these [disbelievers] await not but one blast [of the Horn]; for it there will be no delay.
And they say, "Our Lord, hasten for us our share [of the punishment] before the Day of Account."
Be patient over what they say and remember Our servant, David, the possessor of strength; indeed, he was one who repeatedly turned back [to Allāh].
Indeed, We subjected the mountains [to praise] with him, exalting [Allāh] in the [late] afternoon and [after] sunrise.
And the birds were assembled, all with him repeating [praises].
And We strengthened his kingdom and gave him wisdom and discernment in speech.
And has there come to you the news of the adversaries, when they climbed over the wall of [his] prayer chamber -

When they entered upon David and he was alarmed by them? They said, "Fear not. [We are] two adversaries, one of whom has wronged the other, so judge between us with truth and do not exceed [it] and guide us to the sound path.
Indeed this, my brother, has ninety-nine ewes, and I have one ewe; so he said, 'Entrust her to me,' and he overpowered me in speech."

[David] said, "He has certainly wronged you in demanding your ewe [in addition] to his ewes. And indeed, many associates oppress one another, except for those who believe and do righteous deeds - and few are they." And David became certain that We had tried him, and he asked forgiveness of his Lord and fell down bowing [in prostration] and turned in repentance [to Allāh].
So We forgave him that; and indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return.

[We said], "O David, indeed We have made you a successor upon the earth, so judge between the people in truth and do not follow [your own] desire, as it will lead you astray from the way of Allāh." Indeed, those who go astray from the way of Allāh will have a severe punishment for having forgotten the Day of Account.
And We did not create the heaven and the earth and that between them aimlessly. That is the assumption of those who disbelieve, so woe to those who disbelieve from the Fire.
Or should We treat those who believe and do righteous deeds like corrupters in the land? Or should We treat those who fear Allāh like the wicked?
[This is] a blessed Book which We have revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], that they might reflect upon its verses and that those of understanding would be reminded.
And to David We gave Solomon. An excellent servant, indeed he was one repeatedly turning back [to Allāh].
[Mention] when there were exhibited before him in the afternoon the poised [standing] racehorses.
And he said, "Indeed, I gave preference to the love of good [things] over the remembrance of my Lord until it [i.e., the sun] disappeared into the curtain [of darkness]."
[He said], "Return them to me," and set about striking [their] legs and necks.
And We certainly tried Solomon and placed on his throne a body; then he returned.
He said, "My Lord, forgive me and grant me a kingdom such as will not belong to anyone after me. Indeed, You are the Bestower."
So We subjected to him the wind blowing by his command, gently, wherever he directed,
And [also] the devils [of jinn] - every builder and diver.
And others bound together in irons.
[We said], "This is Our gift, so grant or withhold without account."
And indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return.
And remember Our servant Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, Satan has touched me with hardship and torment."
[So he was told], "Strike [the ground] with your foot; this is a [spring for a] cool bath and drink."
And We granted him his family and a like [number] with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for those of understanding.

[We said], "And take in your hand a bunch [of grass] and strike with it and do not break your oath." Indeed, We found him patient, an excellent servant. Indeed, he was one repeatedly turning back [to Allāh].
And remember Our servants, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob - those of strength and [religious] vision.
Indeed, We chose them for an exclusive quality: remembrance of the home [of the Hereafter].
And indeed they are, to Us, among the chosen and outstanding.
And remember Ishmael, Elisha and Dhul-Kifl, and all are among the outstanding.
This is a reminder. And indeed, for the righteous is a good place of return -
Gardens of perpetual residence, whose doors will be opened to them.
Reclining within them, they will call therein for abundant fruit and drink.
And with them will be women limiting [their] glances and of equal age.
This is what you, [the righteous], are promised for the Day of Account.
Indeed, this is Our provision; for it there is no depletion.
This [is so]. But indeed, for the transgressors is an evil place of return -
Hell, which they will [enter to] burn, and wretched is the resting place.
This - so let them taste it - is scalding water and [foul] purulence.
And other [punishments] of its type [in various] kinds.
[Its inhabitants will say], "This is a company bursting in with you. No welcome for them. Indeed, they will burn in the Fire."
They will say, "Nor you! No welcome for you. You, [our leaders], brought this upon us, and wretched is the settlement."
They will say, "Our Lord, whoever brought this upon us - increase for him double punishment in the Fire."
And they will say, "Why do we not see men whom we used to count among the worst?
Is it [because] we took them in ridicule, or has [our] vision turned away from them?"
Indeed, that is truth [i.e., reality] - the quarreling of the people of the Fire.
Say, [O Muḥammad], "I am only a warner, and there is not any deity except Allāh, the One, the Prevailing,
Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver."
Say, "It is great news
From which you turn away.
I had no knowledge of the exalted assembly [of angels] when they were disputing [the creation of Adam].
It has not been revealed to me except that I am a clear warner."
[So mention] when your Lord said to the angels, "Indeed, I am going to create a human being from clay.
So when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul, then fall down to him in prostration."
So the angels prostrated - all of them entirely,
Except Iblees; he was arrogant and became among the disbelievers.
[Allāh] said, "O Iblees, what prevented you from prostrating to that which I created with My hands? Were you arrogant [then], or were you [already] among the haughty?"
He said, "I am better than him. You created me from fire and created him from clay."
[Allāh] said, "Then get out of it [i.e., Paradise], for indeed, you are expelled.
And indeed, upon you is My curse until the Day of Recompense."
He said, "My Lord, then reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected."
[Allāh] said, "So indeed, you are of those reprieved
Until the Day of the time well-known."
[Iblees] said, "By Your might, I will surely mislead them all.
Except, among them, Your chosen servants."
[Allāh] said, "The truth [is My oath], and the truth I say -
[That] I will surely fill Hell with you and those of them that follow you all together."
Say, [O Muḥammad], "I do not ask you for it [i.e., the Qur’ān] any payment, and I am not of the pretentious.
It is but a reminder to the worlds.
And you will surely know [the truth of] its information after a time."

r: The Troops 39:1
t: The revelation of the Book [i.e., the Qur’ān] is from Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

r: The Troops 39:2
t: Indeed, We have sent down to you the Book, [O Muḥammad], in truth. So worship Allāh, [being] sincere to Him in religion.

r: The Troops 39:3
t: Unquestionably, for Allāh is the pure religion. And those who take protectors besides Him [say], "We only worship them that they may bring us nearer to Allāh in position." Indeed, Allāh will judge between them concerning that over which they differ. Indeed, Allāh does not guide he who is a liar and [confirmed] disbeliever.

r: The Troops 39:4
t: If Allāh had intended to take a son, He could have chosen from what He creates whatever He willed. Exalted is He; He is Allāh, the One, the Prevailing.

r: The Troops 39:5
t: He created the heavens and earth in truth. He wraps the night over the day and wraps the day over the night and has subjected the sun and the moon, each running [its course] for a specified term. Unquestionably, He is the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver.

r: The Troops 39:6
t: He created you from one soul. Then He made from it its mate, and He produced for you from the grazing livestock eight mates. He creates you in the wombs of your mothers, creation after creation, within three darknesses. That is Allāh, your Lord; to Him belongs dominion. There is no deity except Him, so how are you averted?

r: The Troops 39:7
t: If you disbelieve - indeed, Allāh is Free from need of you. And He does not approve for His servants disbelief. And if you are grateful, He approves [i.e., likes] it for you; and no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another. Then to your Lord is your return, and He will inform you about what you used to do. Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.

r: The Troops 39:8
t: And when adversity touches man, he calls upon his Lord, turning to Him [alone]; then when He bestows on him a favor from Himself, he forgets Him whom he called upon before, and he attributes to Allāh equals to mislead [people] from His way. Say, "Enjoy your disbelief for a little; indeed, you are of the companions of the Fire."

r: The Troops 39:9
t: Is one who is devoutly obedient during periods of the night, prostrating and standing [in prayer], fearing the Hereafter and hoping for the mercy of his Lord, [like one who does not]? Say, "Are those who know equal to those who do not know?" Only they will remember [who are] people of understanding.

r: The Troops 39:10
t: Say, "O My servants who have believed, fear your Lord. For those who do good in this world is good, and the earth of Allāh is spacious. Indeed, the patient will be given their reward without account [i.e., limit]."

r: The Troops 39:11
t: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Indeed, I have been commanded to worship Allāh, [being] sincere to Him in religion.

r: The Troops 39:12
t: And I have been commanded to be the first [among you] of the Muslims."

r: The Troops 39:13
t: Say, "Indeed I fear, if I should disobey my Lord, the punishment of a tremendous Day."

r: The Troops 39:14
t: Say, "Allāh [alone] do I worship, sincere to Him in my religion,

r: The Troops 39:15
t: So worship what you will besides Him." Say, "Indeed, the losers are the ones who will lose themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection. Unquestionably, that is the manifest loss."

r: The Troops 39:16
t: They will have canopies [i.e., layers] of fire above them and below them, canopies. By that Allāh threatens [i.e., warns] His servants. O My servants, then fear Me.

r: The Troops 39:17
t: But those who have avoided ṭāghūt, lest they worship it, and turned back to Allāh - for them are good tidings. So give good tidings to My servants

r: The Troops 39:18
t: Who listen to speech and follow the best of it. Those are the ones Allāh has guided, and those are people of understanding.

r: The Troops 39:19
t: Then, is one who has deserved the decree of punishment [to be guided]? Then, can you save one who is in the Fire?

r: The Troops 39:20
t: But those who have feared their Lord - for them are chambers, above them chambers built high, beneath which rivers flow. [This is] the promise of Allāh. Allāh does not fail in [His] promise.

r: The Troops 39:21
t: Do you not see that Allāh sends down rain from the sky and makes it flow as springs [and rivers] in the earth; then He produces thereby crops of varying colors; then they dry and you see them turned yellow; then He makes them [scattered] debris. Indeed in that is a reminder for those of understanding.

r: The Troops 39:22
t: So is one whose breast Allāh has expanded to [accept] Islām and he is upon [i.e., guided by] a light from his Lord [like one whose heart rejects it]? Then woe to those whose hearts are hardened against the remembrance of Allāh. Those are in manifest error.

r: The Troops 39:23
t: Allāh has sent down the best statement: a consistent Book wherein is reiteration. The skins shiver therefrom of those who fear their Lord; then their skins and their hearts relax at the remembrance [i.e., mention] of Allāh. That is the guidance of Allāh by which He guides whom He wills. And one whom Allāh sends astray - for him there is no guide.

r: The Troops 39:24
t: Then is he who will shield with his face the worst of the punishment on the Day of Resurrection [like one secure from it]? And it will be said to the wrongdoers, "Taste what you used to earn."

r: The Troops 39:25
t: Those before them denied, and punishment came upon them from where they did not perceive.

r: The Troops 39:26
t: So Allāh made them taste disgrace in worldly life. But the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew.

r: The Troops 39:27
t: And We have certainly presented for the people in this Qur’ān from every [kind of] example - that they might remember.

r: The Troops 39:28
t: [It is] an Arabic Qur’ān, without any deviance that they might become righteous.

r: The Troops 39:29
t: Allāh presents an example: a man [i.e., slave] owned by quarreling partners and another belonging exclusively to one man - are they equal in comparison? Praise be to Allāh! But most of them do not know.

r: The Troops 39:30
t: Indeed, you are to die, and indeed, they are to die.

r: The Troops 39:31
t: Then indeed you, on the Day of Resurrection, before your Lord, will dispute.

r: The Troops 39:32
t: So who is more unjust than one who lies about Allāh and denies the truth when it has come to him? Is there not in Hell a residence for the disbelievers?

r: The Troops 39:33
t: And the one who has brought the truth [i.e., the Prophet (ﷺ)] and [they who] believed in it - those are the righteous.

r: The Troops 39:34
t: They will have whatever they desire with their Lord. That is the reward of the doers of good -

r: The Troops 39:35
t: That Allāh may remove from them the worst of what they did and reward them their due for the best of what they used to do.

r: The Troops 39:36
t: Is not Allāh sufficient for His Servant [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)]? And [yet], they threaten you with those [they worship] other than Him. And whoever Allāh leaves astray - for him there is no guide.

r: The Troops 39:37
t: And whoever Allāh guides - for him there is no misleader. Is not Allāh Exalted in Might and Owner of Retribution?

r: The Troops 39:38
t: And if you asked them, "Who created the heavens and the earth?" they would surely say, "Allāh." Say, "Then have you considered what you invoke besides Allāh? If Allāh intended me harm, are they removers of His harm; or if He intended me mercy, are they withholders of His mercy?" Say, "Sufficient for me is Allāh; upon Him [alone] rely the [wise] reliers."

r: The Troops 39:39
t: Say, "O my people, work according to your position, [for] indeed, I am working; and you are going to know

r: The Troops 39:40
t: To whom will come a torment disgracing him and on whom will descend an enduring punishment."

r: The Troops 39:41
t: Indeed, We sent down to you the Book for the people in truth. So whoever is guided - it is for [the benefit of] his soul; and whoever goes astray only goes astray to its detriment. And you are not a manager [i.e., authority] over them.

r: The Troops 39:42
t: Allāh takes the souls at the time of their death, and those that do not die [He takes] during their sleep. Then He keeps those for which He has decreed death and releases the others for a specified term. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought.

r: The Troops 39:43
t: Or have they taken other than Allāh as intercessors? Say, "Even though they do not possess [power over] anything, nor do they reason?"

r: The Troops 39:44
t: Say, "To Allāh belongs [the right to allow] intercession entirely. To Him belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. Then to Him you will be returned."

r: The Troops 39:45
t: And when Allāh is mentioned alone, the hearts of those who do not believe in the Hereafter shrink with aversion, but when those [worshipped] other than Him are mentioned, immediately they rejoice.

r: The Troops 39:46
t: Say, "O Allāh, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, You will judge between your servants concerning that over which they used to differ."

r: The Troops 39:47
t: And if those who did wrong had all that is in the earth entirely and the like of it with it, they would [attempt to] ransom themselves thereby from the worst of the punishment on the Day of Resurrection. And there will appear to them from Allāh that which they had not taken into account.

r: The Troops 39:48
t: And there will appear to them the evils they had earned, and they will be enveloped by what they used to ridicule.

r: The Troops 39:49
t: And when adversity touches man, he calls upon Us; then when We bestow on him a favor from Us, he says, "I have only been given it because of [my] knowledge." Rather, it is a trial, but most of them do not know.

r: The Troops 39:50
t: Those before them had already said it, but they were not availed by what they used to earn.

r: The Troops 39:51
t: And the evil consequences of what they earned struck them. And those who have wronged of these [people] will be struck [i.e., afflicted] by the evil consequences of what they earned; and they will not cause failure.

r: The Troops 39:52
t: Do they not know that Allāh extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it]? Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe.

r: The Troops 39:53
t: Say, "O My servants who have transgressed against themselves [by sinning], do not despair of the mercy of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh forgives all sins. Indeed, it is He who is the Forgiving, the Merciful."

r: The Troops 39:54
t: And return [in repentance] to your Lord and submit to Him before the punishment comes upon you; then you will not be helped.

r: The Troops 39:55
t: And follow the best of what was revealed to you from your Lord [i.e., the Qur’ān] before the punishment comes upon you suddenly while you do not perceive,

r: The Troops 39:56
t: Lest a soul should say, "Oh, [how great is] my regret over what I neglected in regard to Allāh and that I was among the mockers."

r: The Troops 39:57
t: Or [lest] it say, "If only Allāh had guided me, I would have been among the righteous."

r: The Troops 39:58
t: Or [lest] it say when it sees the punishment, "If only I had another turn so I could be among the doers of good."

r: The Troops 39:59
t: But yes, there had come to you My verses, but you denied them and were arrogant, and you were among the disbelievers.

r: The Troops 39:60
t: And on the Day of Resurrection you will see those who lied about Allāh [with] their faces blackened. Is there not in Hell a residence for the arrogant?

r: The Troops 39:61
t: And Allāh will save those who feared Him by their attainment; no evil will touch them, nor will they grieve.

r: The Troops 39:62
t: Allāh is the Creator of all things, and He is, over all things, Disposer of affairs.

r: The Troops 39:63
t: To Him belong the keys of the heavens and the earth. And they who disbelieve in the verses of Allāh - it is those who are the losers.

r: The Troops 39:64
t: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Is it other than Allāh that you order me to worship, O ignorant ones?"

r: The Troops 39:65
t: And it was already revealed to you and to those before you that if you should associate [anything] with Allāh, your work would surely become worthless, and you would surely be among the losers.

r: The Troops 39:66
t: Rather, worship [only] Allāh and be among the grateful.

r: The Troops 39:67
t: They have not appraised Allāh with true appraisal, while the earth entirely will be [within] His grip on the Day of Resurrection, and the heavens will be folded in His right hand. Exalted is He and high above what they associate with Him.

r: The Troops 39:68
t: And the Horn will be blown, and whoever is in the heavens and whoever is on the earth will fall dead except whom Allāh wills. Then it will be blown again, and at once they will be standing, looking on.

r: The Troops 39:69
t: And the earth will shine with the light of its Lord, and the record [of deeds] will be placed, and the prophets and the witnesses will be brought, and it will be judged between them in truth, and they will not be wronged.

r: The Troops 39:70
t: And every soul will be fully compensated [for] what it did; and He is most knowing of what they do.

r: The Troops 39:71
t: And those who disbelieved will be driven to Hell in groups until, when they reach it, its gates are opened and its keepers will say, "Did there not come to you messengers from yourselves, reciting to you the verses of your Lord and warning you of the meeting of this Day of yours?" They will say, "Yes, but the word [i.e., decree] of punishment has come into effect upon the disbelievers."

r: The Troops 39:72
t: [To them] it will be said, "Enter the gates of Hell to abide eternally therein, and wretched is the residence of the arrogant."

r: The Troops 39:73
t: But those who feared their Lord will be driven to Paradise in groups until, when they reach it while its gates have been opened and its keepers say, "Peace be upon you; you have become pure; so enter it to abide eternally therein," [they will enter].

r: The Troops 39:74
t: And they will say, "Praise to Allāh, who has fulfilled for us His promise and made us inherit the earth [so] we may settle in Paradise wherever we will. And excellent is the reward of [righteous] workers."

r: The Troops 39:75
t: And you will see the angels surrounding the Throne, exalting [Allāh] with praise of their Lord. And it will be judged between them in truth, and it will be said, "[All] praise to Allāh, Lord of the worlds."

r: The Forgiver 40:1
t: Ḥā, Meem.

r: The Forgiver 40:2
t: The revelation of the Book [i.e., the Qur’ān] is from Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Knowing,

r: The Forgiver 40:3
t: The forgiver of sin, acceptor of repentance, severe in punishment, owner of abundance. There is no deity except Him; to Him is the destination.

r: The Forgiver 40:4
t: No one disputes concerning the signs of Allāh except those who disbelieve, so be not deceived by their [uninhibited] movement throughout the land.

r: The Forgiver 40:5
t: The people of Noah denied before them and the [disbelieving] factions after them, and every nation intended [a plot] for their messenger to seize him, and they disputed by [using] falsehood to [attempt to] invalidate thereby the truth. So I seized them, and how [terrible] was My penalty.

r: The Forgiver 40:6
t: And thus has the word [i.e., decree] of your Lord come into effect upon those who disbelieved that they are companions of the Fire.

r: The Forgiver 40:7
t: Those [angels] who carry the Throne and those around it exalt [Allāh] with praise of their Lord and believe in Him and ask forgiveness for those who have believed, [saying], "Our Lord, You have encompassed all things in mercy and knowledge, so forgive those who have repented and followed Your way and protect them from the punishment of Hellfire.

r: The Forgiver 40:8
t: Our Lord, and admit them to gardens of perpetual residence which You have promised them and whoever was righteous among their forefathers, their spouses and their offspring. Indeed, it is You who is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

r: The Forgiver 40:9
t: And protect them from the evil consequences [of their deeds]. And he whom You protect from evil consequences that Day - You will have given him mercy. And that is the great attainment."

r: The Forgiver 40:10
t: Indeed, those who disbelieve will be addressed, "The hatred of Allāh for you was [even] greater than your hatred of yourselves [this Day in Hell] when you were invited to faith, but you disbelieved [i.e., refused]."

r: The Forgiver 40:11
t: They will say, "Our Lord, You made us lifeless twice and gave us life twice, and we have confessed our sins. So is there to an exit any way?"

r: The Forgiver 40:12
t: [They will be told], "That is because, when Allāh was called upon alone, you disbelieved; but if others were associated with Him, you believed. So the judgement is with Allāh, the Most High, the Grand."

r: The Forgiver 40:13
t: It is He who shows you His signs and sends down to you from the sky, provision. But none will remember except he who turns back [in repentance].

r: The Forgiver 40:14
t: So invoke Allāh, [being] sincere to Him in religion, although the disbelievers dislike it.

r: The Forgiver 40:15
t: [He is] the Exalted above [all] degrees, Owner of the Throne; He places the inspiration of His command [i.e., revelation] upon whom He wills of His servants to warn of the Day of Meeting.

r: The Forgiver 40:16
t: The Day they come forth nothing concerning them will be concealed from Allāh. To whom belongs [all] sovereignty this Day? To Allāh, the One, the Prevailing.

r: The Forgiver 40:17
t: This Day every soul will be recompensed for what it earned. No injustice today! Indeed, Allāh is swift in account.

r: The Forgiver 40:18
t: And warn them, [O Muḥammad], of the Approaching Day, when hearts are at the throats, filled [with distress]. For the wrongdoers there will be no devoted friend and no intercessor [who is] obeyed.

r: The Forgiver 40:19
t: He knows that which deceives the eyes and what the breasts conceal.

r: The Forgiver 40:20
t: And Allāh judges with truth, while those they invoke besides Him judge not with anything. Indeed, Allāh - He is the Hearing, the Seeing.

r: The Forgiver 40:21
t: Have they not traveled through the land and observed how was the end of those who were before them? They were greater than them in strength and in impression on the land, but Allāh seized them for their sins. And they had not from Allāh any protector.

r: The Forgiver 40:22
t: That was because their messengers were coming to them with clear proofs, but they disbelieved, so Allāh seized them. Indeed, He is Powerful and severe in punishment.

r: The Forgiver 40:23
t: And We did certainly send Moses with Our signs and a clear authority

r: The Forgiver 40:24
t: To Pharaoh, Hāmān and Qārūn, but they said, "[He is] a magician and a liar."

r: The Forgiver 40:25
t: And when he brought them the truth from Us, they said, "Kill the sons of those who have believed with him and keep their women alive." But the plan of the disbelievers is not except in error.

r: The Forgiver 40:26
t: And Pharaoh said, "Let me kill Moses and let him call upon his Lord. Indeed, I fear that he will change your religion or that he will cause corruption in the land."

r: The Forgiver 40:27
t: But Moses said, "Indeed, I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord from every arrogant one who does not believe in the Day of Account."

r: The Forgiver 40:28
t: And a believing man from the family of Pharaoh who concealed his faith said, "Do you kill a man [merely] because he says, 'My Lord is Allāh' while he has brought you clear proofs from your Lord? And if he should be lying, then upon him is [the consequence of] his lie; but if he should be truthful, there will strike you some of what he promises you. Indeed, Allāh does not guide one who is a transgressor and a liar.

r: The Forgiver 40:29
t: O my people, sovereignty is yours today, [your being] dominant in the land. But who would protect us from the punishment of Allāh if it came to us?" Pharaoh said, "I do not show you except what I see, and I do not guide you except to the way of right conduct."

r: The Forgiver 40:30
t: And he who believed said, "O my people, indeed I fear for you [a fate] like the day of the companies -

r: The Forgiver 40:31
t: Like the custom of the people of Noah and of ʿAad and Thamūd and those after them. And Allāh wants no injustice for [His] servants.

r: The Forgiver 40:32
t: And O my people, indeed I fear for you the Day of Calling -

r: The Forgiver 40:33
t: The Day you will turn your backs fleeing; there is not for you from Allāh any protector. And whoever Allāh sends astray - there is not for him any guide.

r: The Forgiver 40:34
t: And Joseph had already come to you before with clear proofs, but you remained in doubt of that which he brought to you, until when he died, you said, 'Never will Allāh send a messenger after him.' Thus does Allāh leave astray he who is a transgressor and skeptic."

r: The Forgiver 40:35
t: Those who dispute concerning the signs of Allāh without an authority having come to them - great is hatred [of them] in the sight of Allāh and in the sight of those who have believed. Thus does Allāh seal over every heart [belonging to] an arrogant tyrant.

r: The Forgiver 40:36
t: And Pharaoh said, "O Hāmān, construct for me a tower that I might reach the ways -

r: The Forgiver 40:37
t: The ways into the heavens - so that I may look at the deity of Moses; but indeed, I think he is a liar." And thus was made attractive to Pharaoh the evil of his deed, and he was averted from the [right] way. And the plan of Pharaoh was not except in ruin.

r: The Forgiver 40:38
t: And he who believed said, "O my people, follow me; I will guide you to the way of right conduct.

r: The Forgiver 40:39
t: O my people, this worldly life is only [temporary] enjoyment, and indeed, the Hereafter - that is the home of [permanent] settlement.

r: The Forgiver 40:40
t: Whoever does an evil deed will not be recompensed except by the like thereof; but whoever does righteousness, whether male or female, while he is a believer - those will enter Paradise, being given provision therein without account.

r: The Forgiver 40:41
t: And O my people, how is it that I invite you to salvation while you invite me to the Fire?

r: The Forgiver 40:42
t: You invite me to disbelieve in Allāh and associate with Him that of which I have no knowledge, and I invite you to the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver.

r: The Forgiver 40:43
t: Assuredly, that to which you invite me has no [response to a] supplication in this world or in the Hereafter; and indeed, our return is to Allāh, and indeed, the transgressors will be companions of the Fire.

r: The Forgiver 40:44
t: And you will remember what I [now] say to you, and I entrust my affair to Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Seeing of [His] servants."

r: The Forgiver 40:45
t: So Allāh protected him from the evils they plotted, and the people of Pharaoh were enveloped by the worst of punishment -

r: The Forgiver 40:46
t: The Fire; they are exposed to it morning and evening. And the Day the Hour appears [it will be said], "Make the people of Pharaoh enter the severest punishment."

r: The Forgiver 40:47
t: And [mention] when they will argue within the Fire, and the weak will say to those who had been arrogant, "Indeed, we were [only] your followers, so will you relieve us of a share of the Fire?"

r: The Forgiver 40:48
t: Those who had been arrogant will say, "Indeed, all [of us] are in it. Indeed, Allāh has judged between the servants."

r: The Forgiver 40:49
t: And those in the Fire will say to the keepers of Hell, "Supplicate your Lord to lighten for us a day from the punishment."

r: The Forgiver 40:50
t: They will say, "Did there not come to you your messengers with clear proofs?" They will say, "Yes." They will reply, "Then supplicate [yourselves], but the supplication of the disbelievers is not except in error [i.e., futility]."

r: The Forgiver 40:51
t: Indeed, We will support Our messengers and those who believe during the life of this world and on the Day when the witnesses will stand -

r: The Forgiver 40:52
t: The Day their excuse will not benefit the wrongdoers, and they will have the curse, and they will have the worst home [i.e., Hell].

r: The Forgiver 40:53
t: And We had certainly given Moses guidance, and We caused the Children of Israel to inherit the Scripture

r: The Forgiver 40:54
t: As guidance and a reminder for those of understanding.

r: The Forgiver 40:55
t: So be patient, [O Muḥammad]. Indeed, the promise of Allāh is truth. And ask forgiveness for your sin and exalt [Allāh] with praise of your Lord in the evening and the morning.

r: The Forgiver 40:56
t: Indeed, those who dispute concerning the signs of Allāh without [any] evidence having come to them - there is not within their breasts except pride, [the extent of] which they cannot reach. So seek refuge in Allāh. Indeed, it is He who is the Hearing, the Seeing.

r: The Forgiver 40:57
t: The creation of the heavens and earth is greater than the creation of mankind, but most of the people do not know.

r: The Forgiver 40:58
t: And not equal are the blind and the seeing, nor are those who believe and do righteous deeds and the evildoer. Little do you remember.

r: The Forgiver 40:59
t: Indeed, the Hour is coming - no doubt about it - but most of the people do not believe.

r: The Forgiver 40:60
t: And your Lord says, "Call upon Me; I will respond to you." Indeed, those who disdain My worship will enter Hell [rendered] contemptible.

r: The Forgiver 40:61
t: It is Allāh who made for you the night that you may rest therein and the day giving sight. Indeed, Allāh is the possessor of bounty for the people, but most of them are not grateful.

r: The Forgiver 40:62
t: That is Allāh, your Lord, Creator of all things; there is no deity except Him, so how are you deluded?

r: The Forgiver 40:63
t: Thus were those [before you] deluded who were rejecting the signs of Allāh.

r: The Forgiver 40:64
t: It is Allāh who made for you the earth a place of settlement and the sky a structure [i.e., ceiling] and formed you and perfected your forms and provided you with good things. That is Allāh, your Lord; then blessed is Allāh, Lord of the worlds.

r: The Forgiver 40:65
t: He is the Ever-Living; there is no deity except Him, so call upon Him, [being] sincere to Him in religion. [All] praise is [due] to Allāh, Lord of the worlds.

r: The Forgiver 40:66
t: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Indeed, I have been forbidden to worship those you call upon besides Allāh once the clear proofs have come to me from my Lord, and I have been commanded to submit to the Lord of the worlds."

r: The Forgiver 40:67
t: It is He who created you from dust, then from a sperm-drop, then from a clinging clot; then He brings you out as a child; then [He develops you] that you reach your [time of] maturity, then [further] that you become elders. And among you is he who is taken in death before [that], so that you reach a specified term; and perhaps you will use reason.

r: The Forgiver 40:68
t: He it is who gives life and causes death; and when He decrees a matter, He but says to it, "Be," and it is.

r: The Forgiver 40:69
t: Do you not consider those who dispute concerning the signs of Allāh - how are they averted?

r: The Forgiver 40:70
t: Those who deny the Book [i.e., the Qur’ān] and that with which We sent Our messengers - they are going to know,

r: The Forgiver 40:71
t: When the shackles are around their necks and the chains; they will be dragged

r: The Forgiver 40:72
t: In boiling water; then in the Fire they will be filled [with flame].

r: The Forgiver 40:73
t: Then it will be said to them, "Where is that which you used to associate [with Him in worship]

r: The Forgiver 40:74
t: Other than Allāh?" They will say, "They have departed from us; rather, we did not used to invoke previously anything." Thus does Allāh put astray the disbelievers.

r: The Forgiver 40:75
t: [The angels will say], "That was because you used to exult upon the earth without right and you used to behave insolently.

r: The Forgiver 40:76
t: Enter the gates of Hell to abide eternally therein, and wretched is the residence of the arrogant."

r: The Forgiver 40:77
t: So be patient, [O Muḥammad]; indeed, the promise of Allāh is truth. And whether We show you some of what We have promised them or We take you in death, it is to Us they will be returned.

r: The Forgiver 40:78
t: And We have already sent messengers before you. Among them are those [whose stories] We have related to you, and among them are those [whose stories] We have not related to you. And it was not for any messenger to bring a sign [or verse] except by permission of Allāh. So when the command of Allāh comes, it will be concluded [i.e., judged] in truth, and the falsifiers will thereupon lose [all].

r: The Forgiver 40:79
t: It is Allāh who made for you the grazing animals upon which you ride, and some of them you eat.

r: The Forgiver 40:80
t: And for you therein are [other] benefits and that you may realize upon them a need which is in your breasts; and upon them and upon ships you are carried.

r: The Forgiver 40:81
t: And He shows you His signs. So which of the signs of Allāh do you deny?

r: The Forgiver 40:82
t: Have they not traveled through the land and observed how was the end of those before them? They were more numerous than themselves and greater in strength and in impression on the land, but they were not availed by what they used to earn.

r: The Forgiver 40:83
t: And when their messengers came to them with clear proofs, they [merely] rejoiced in what they had of knowledge, but they were enveloped by what they used to ridicule.

r: The Forgiver 40:84
t: And when they saw Our punishment, they said, "We believe in Allāh alone and disbelieve in that which we used to associate with Him."

r: The Forgiver 40:85
t: But never did their faith benefit them once they saw Our punishment. [It is] the established way of Allāh which has preceded among His servants. And the disbelievers thereupon lost [all].

r: Explained in Detail 41:1
t: Ḥā, Meem.

r: Explained in Detail 41:2
t: [This is] a revelation from the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful -

r: Explained in Detail 41:3
t: A Book whose verses have been detailed, an Arabic Qur’ān for a people who know,

r: Explained in Detail 41:4
t: As a giver of good tidings and a warner; but most of them turn away, so they do not hear.

r: Explained in Detail 41:5
t: And they say, "Our hearts are within coverings [i.e., screened] from that to which you invite us, and in our ears is deafness, and between us and you is a partition, so work; indeed, we are working."

r: Explained in Detail 41:6
t: Say, [O Muḥammad], "I am only a man like you to whom it has been revealed that your god is but one God; so take a straight course to Him and seek His forgiveness." And woe to those who associate others with Allāh

r: Explained in Detail 41:7
t: Those who do not give zakāh, and in the Hereafter they are disbelievers.

r: Explained in Detail 41:8
t: Indeed, those who believe and do righteous deeds - for them is a reward uninterrupted.

r: Explained in Detail 41:9
t: Say, "Do you indeed disbelieve in He who created the earth in two days and attribute to Him equals? That is the Lord of the worlds."

r: Explained in Detail 41:10
t: And He placed on it [i.e., the earth] firmly set mountains over its surface, and He blessed it and determined therein its [creatures'] sustenance in four days without distinction - for [the information of] those who ask.

r: Explained in Detail 41:11
t: Then He directed Himself to the heaven while it was smoke and said to it and to the earth, "Come [into being], willingly or by compulsion." They said, "We have come willingly."

r: Explained in Detail 41:12
t: And He completed them as seven heavens within two days and inspired [i.e., made known] in each heaven its command. And We adorned the nearest heaven with lamps [i.e., stars, for beauty] and as protection. That is the determination of the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.

r: Explained in Detail 41:13
t: But if they turn away, then say, "I have warned you of a thunderbolt like the thunderbolt [that struck] ʿAad and Thamūd.

r: Explained in Detail 41:14
t: [That occurred] when the messengers had come to them before them and after them, [saying], "Worship not except Allāh." They said, "If our Lord had willed, He would have sent down the angels, so indeed we, in that with which you have been sent, are disbelievers."

r: Explained in Detail 41:15
t: As for ʿAad, they were arrogant upon the earth without right and said, "Who is greater than us in strength?" Did they not consider that Allāh who created them was greater than them in strength? But they were rejecting Our signs.

r: Explained in Detail 41:16
t: So We sent upon them a screaming wind during days of misfortune to make them taste the punishment of disgrace in the worldly life; but the punishment of the Hereafter is more disgracing, and they will not be helped.

r: Explained in Detail 41:17
t: And as for Thamūd, We guided them, but they preferred blindness over guidance, so the thunderbolt of humiliating punishment seized them for what they used to earn.

r: Explained in Detail 41:18
t: And We saved those who believed and used to fear Allāh.

r: Explained in Detail 41:19
t: And [mention, O Muḥammad], the Day when the enemies of Allāh will be gathered to the Fire while they are [driven], assembled in rows,

r: Explained in Detail 41:20
t: Until, when they reach it, their hearing and their eyes and their skins will testify against them of what they used to do.

r: Explained in Detail 41:21
t: And they will say to their skins, "Why have you testified against us?" They will say, "We were made to speak by Allāh, who has made everything speak; and He created you the first time, and to Him you are returned.

r: Explained in Detail 41:22
t: And you were not covering [i.e., protecting] yourselves, lest your hearing testify against you or your sight or your skins, but you assumed that Allāh does not know much of what you do.

r: Explained in Detail 41:23
t: And that was your assumption which you assumed about your Lord. It has brought you to ruin, and you have become among the losers."

r: Explained in Detail 41:24
t: So [even] if they are patient, the Fire is a residence for them; and if they ask to appease [Allāh], they will not be of those who are allowed to appease.

r: Explained in Detail 41:25
t: And We appointed for them companions who made attractive to them what was before them and what was behind them [of sin], and the word [i.e., decree] has come into effect upon them among nations which had passed on before them of jinn and men. Indeed, they [all] were losers.

r: Explained in Detail 41:26
t: And those who disbelieve say, "Do not listen to this Qur’ān and speak noisily during [the recitation of] it that perhaps you will overcome."

r: Explained in Detail 41:27
t: But We will surely cause those who disbelieve to taste a severe punishment, and We will surely recompense them for the worst of what they had been doing.

r: Explained in Detail 41:28
t: That is the recompense of the enemies of Allāh - the Fire. For them therein is the home of eternity as recompense for what they, of Our verses, were rejecting.

r: Explained in Detail 41:29
t: And those who disbelieved will [then] say, "Our Lord, show us those who misled us of the jinn and men [so] we may put them under our feet that they will be among the lowest."

r: Explained in Detail 41:30
t: Indeed, those who have said, "Our Lord is Allāh" and then remained on a right course - the angels will descend upon them, [saying], "Do not fear and do not grieve but receive good tidings of Paradise, which you were promised.

r: Explained in Detail 41:31
t: We [angels] were your allies in worldly life and [are so] in the Hereafter. And you will have therein whatever your souls desire, and you will have therein whatever you request [or wish]

r: Explained in Detail 41:32
t: As accommodation from a [Lord who is] Forgiving and Merciful."

r: Explained in Detail 41:33
t: And who is better in speech than one who invites to Allāh and does righteousness and says, "Indeed, I am of the Muslims."

r: Explained in Detail 41:34
t: And not equal are the good deed and the bad. Repel [evil] by that [deed] which is better; and thereupon, the one whom between you and him is enmity [will become] as though he was a devoted friend.

r: Explained in Detail 41:35
t: But none is granted it except those who are patient, and none is granted it except one having a great portion [of good].

r: Explained in Detail 41:36
t: And if there comes to you from Satan an evil suggestion, then seek refuge in Allāh. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.

r: Explained in Detail 41:37
t: And of His signs are the night and day and the sun and moon. Do not prostrate to the sun or to the moon, but prostrate to Allāh, who created them, if it should be Him that you worship.

r: Explained in Detail 41:38
t: But if they are arrogant - then those who are near your Lord [i.e., the angels] exalt Him by night and by day, and they do not become weary.

r: Explained in Detail 41:39
t: And of His signs is that you see the earth stilled, but when We send down upon it rain, it quivers and grows. Indeed, He who has given it life is the Giver of Life to the dead. Indeed, He is over all things competent.

r: Explained in Detail 41:40
t: Indeed, those who inject deviation into Our verses are not concealed from Us. So, is he who is cast into the Fire better or he who comes secure on the Day of Resurrection? Do whatever you will; indeed, He is Seeing of what you do.

r: Explained in Detail 41:41
t: Indeed, those who disbelieve in the message [i.e., the Qur’ān] after it has come to them... And indeed, it is a mighty Book.

r: Explained in Detail 41:42
t: Falsehood cannot approach it from before it or from behind it; [it is] a revelation from a [Lord who is] Wise and Praiseworthy.

r: Explained in Detail 41:43
t: Nothing is said to you, [O Muḥammad], except what was already said to the messengers before you. Indeed, your Lord is a possessor of forgiveness and a possessor of painful penalty.

r: Explained in Detail 41:44
t: And if We had made it a foreign [i.e., non-Arabic] Qur’ān, they would have said, "Why are its verses not explained in detail [in our language]? Is it a foreign [recitation] and an Arab [messenger]?" Say, "It is, for those who believe, a guidance and cure." And those who do not believe - in their ears is deafness, and it is upon them blindness. Those are being called from a distant place.

r: Explained in Detail 41:45
t: And We had already given Moses the Scripture, but it came under disagreement. And if not for a word [i.e., decree] that preceded from your Lord, it would have been concluded between them. And indeed they are, concerning it [i.e., the Qur’ān], in disquieting doubt.

r: Explained in Detail 41:46
t: Whoever does righteousness - it is for his [own] soul; and whoever does evil [does so] against it. And your Lord is not ever unjust to [His] servants.

r: Explained in Detail 41:47
t: To Him [alone] is attributed knowledge of the Hour. And fruits emerge not from their coverings nor does a female conceive or give birth except with His knowledge. And the Day He will call to them, "Where are My 'partners'?" they will say, "We announce to You that there is [no longer] among us any witness [to that]."

r: Explained in Detail 41:48
t: And lost from them will be those they were invoking before, and they will be certain that they have no place of escape.

r: Explained in Detail 41:49
t: Man is not weary of supplication for good [things], but if evil touches him, he is hopeless and despairing.

r: Explained in Detail 41:50
t: And if We let him taste mercy from Us after an adversity which has touched him, he will surely say, "This is [due] to me, and I do not think the Hour will occur; and [even] if I should be returned to my Lord, indeed, for me there will be with Him the best." But We will surely inform those who disbelieved about what they did, and We will surely make them taste a massive punishment.

r: Explained in Detail 41:51
t: And when We bestow favor upon man, he turns away and distances himself; but when evil touches him, then he is full of extensive supplication.

r: Explained in Detail 41:52
t: Say, "Have you considered: if it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is from Allāh and you disbelieved in it, who would be more astray than one who is in extreme dissension?"

r: Explained in Detail 41:53
t: We will show them Our signs in the horizons and within themselves until it becomes clear to them that it is the truth. But is it not sufficient concerning your Lord that He is, over all things, a Witness?

r: Explained in Detail 41:54
t: Unquestionably, they are in doubt about the meeting with their Lord. Unquestionably He is, of all things, encompassing.

r: The Consultation 42:1
t: Ḥā, Meem.

r: The Consultation 42:2
t: ʿAyn, Seen, Qāf.

r: The Consultation 42:3
t: Thus has He revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], and to those before you - Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

r: The Consultation 42:4
t: To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth, and He is the Most High, the Most Great.

r: The Consultation 42:5
t: The heavens almost break from above them, and the angels exalt [Allāh] with praise of their Lord and ask forgiveness for those on earth. Unquestionably, it is Allāh who is the Forgiving, the Merciful.

r: The Consultation 42:6
t: And those who take as allies other than Him - Allāh is [yet] Guardian over them; and you, [O Muḥammad], are not over them a manager.

r: The Consultation 42:7
t: And thus We have revealed to you an Arabic Qur’ān that you may warn the Mother of Cities [i.e., Makkah] and those around it and warn of the Day of Assembly, about which there is no doubt. A party will be in Paradise and a party in the Blaze.

r: The Consultation 42:8
t: And if Allāh willed, He could have made them [of] one religion, but He admits whom He wills into His mercy. And the wrongdoers have not any protector or helper.

r: The Consultation 42:9
t: Or have they taken protectors [or allies] besides Him? But Allāh - He is the Protector, and He gives life to the dead, and He is over all things competent.

r: The Consultation 42:10
t: And in anything over which you disagree - its ruling is [to be referred] to Allāh. [Say], "That is Allāh, my Lord; upon Him I have relied, and to Him I turn back."

r: The Consultation 42:11
t: [He is] Creator of the heavens and the earth. He has made for you from yourselves, mates, and among the cattle, mates; He multiplies you thereby. There is nothing like unto Him, and He is the Hearing, the Seeing.

r: The Consultation 42:12
t: To Him belong the keys of the heavens and the earth. He extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it]. Indeed He is, of all things, Knowing.

r: The Consultation 42:13
t: He has ordained for you of religion what He enjoined upon Noah and that which We have revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], and what We enjoined upon Abraham and Moses and Jesus - to establish the religion and not be divided therein. Difficult for those who associate others with Allāh is that to which you invite them. Allāh chooses for Himself whom He wills and guides to Himself whoever turns back [to Him].

r: The Consultation 42:14
t: And they did not become divided until after knowledge had come to them - out of jealous animosity between themselves. And if not for a word that preceded from your Lord [postponing the penalty] until a specified time, it would have been concluded between them. And indeed, those who were granted inheritance of the Scripture after them are, concerning it, in disquieting doubt.

r: The Consultation 42:15
t: So to that [religion of Allāh] invite, [O Muḥammad], and remain on a right course as you are commanded and do not follow their inclinations but say, "I have believed in what Allāh has revealed of scripture [i.e., the Qur’ān], and I have been commanded to do justice among you. Allāh is our Lord and your Lord. For us are our deeds, and for you your deeds. There is no [need for] argument between us and you. Allāh will bring us together, and to Him is the [final] destination."

r: The Consultation 42:16
t: And those who argue concerning Allāh after He has been responded to - their argument is invalid with their Lord, and upon them is [His] wrath, and for them is a severe punishment.

r: The Consultation 42:17
t: It is Allāh who has sent down the Book in truth and [also] the balance [i.e., justice]. And what will make you perceive? Perhaps the Hour is near.

r: The Consultation 42:18
t: Those who do not believe in it are impatient for it, but those who believe are fearful of it and know that it is the truth. Unquestionably, those who dispute concerning the Hour are in extreme error.

r: The Consultation 42:19
t: Allāh is Subtle with His servants; He gives provision to whom He wills. And He is the Powerful, the Exalted in Might.

r: The Consultation 42:20
t: Whoever desires the harvest of the Hereafter - We increase for him in his harvest [i.e., reward]. And whoever desires the harvest [i.e., benefits] of this world - We give him thereof, but there is not for him in the Hereafter any share.

r: The Consultation 42:21
t: Or have they partners [i.e., other deities] who have ordained for them a religion to which Allāh has not consented? But if not for the decisive word, it would have been concluded between them. And indeed, the wrongdoers will have a painful punishment.

r: The Consultation 42:22
t: You will see the wrongdoers fearful of what they have earned, and it will [certainly] befall them. And those who have believed and done righteous deeds will be in lush regions of the gardens [in Paradise] having whatever they will in the presence of their Lord. That is what is the great bounty.

r: The Consultation 42:23
t: It is that of which Allāh gives good tidings to His servants who believe and do righteous deeds. Say, [O Muḥammad], "I do not ask you for it [i.e., this message] any payment [but] only good will through [i.e., due to] kinship." And whoever commits a good deed - We will increase for him good therein. Indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Appreciative.

r: The Consultation 42:24
t: Or do they say, "He has invented about Allāh a lie"? But if Allāh willed, He could seal over your heart. And Allāh eliminates falsehood and establishes the truth by His words. Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.

r: The Consultation 42:25
t: And it is He who accepts repentance from His servants and pardons misdeeds, and He knows what you do.

r: The Consultation 42:26
t: And He answers [the supplication of] those who have believed and done righteous deeds and increases [for] them from His bounty. But the disbelievers will have a severe punishment.

r: The Consultation 42:27
t: And if Allāh had extended [excessively] provision for His servants, they would have committed tyranny throughout the earth. But He sends [it] down in an amount which He wills. Indeed He is, of His servants, Aware and Seeing.

r: The Consultation 42:28
t: And it is He who sends down the rain after they had despaired and spreads His mercy. And He is the Protector, the Praiseworthy.

r: The Consultation 42:29
t: And of His signs is the creation of the heavens and earth and what He has dispersed throughout them of creatures. And He, for gathering them when He wills, is competent.

r: The Consultation 42:30
t: And whatever strikes you of disaster - it is for what your hands have earned; but He pardons much.

r: The Consultation 42:31
t: And you will not cause failure [to Allāh] upon the earth. And you have not besides Allāh any protector or helper.

r: The Consultation 42:32
t: And of His signs are the ships in the sea, like mountains.

r: The Consultation 42:33
t: If He willed, He could still the wind, and they would remain motionless on its surface. Indeed in that are signs for everyone patient and grateful.

r: The Consultation 42:34
t: Or He could destroy them for what they earned; but He pardons much.

r: The Consultation 42:35
t: And [that is so] those who dispute concerning Our signs may know that for them there is no place of escape.

r: The Consultation 42:36
t: So whatever thing you have been given - it is but [for] enjoyment of the worldly life. But what is with Allāh is better and more lasting for those who have believed and upon their Lord rely

r: The Consultation 42:37
t: And those who avoid the major sins and immoralities, and when they are angry, they forgive,

r: The Consultation 42:38
t: And those who have responded to their Lord and established prayer and whose affair is [determined by] consultation among themselves, and from what We have provided them, they spend,

r: The Consultation 42:39
t: And those who, when tyranny strikes them, they retaliate [in a just manner].

r: The Consultation 42:40
t: And the retribution for an evil act is an evil one like it, but whoever pardons and makes reconciliation - his reward is [due] from Allāh. Indeed, He does not like wrongdoers.

r: The Consultation 42:41
t: And whoever retaliates after having been wronged - those have not upon them any cause [for blame].

r: The Consultation 42:42
t: The cause is only against the ones who wrong the people and tyrannize upon the earth without right. Those will have a painful punishment.

r: The Consultation 42:43
t: And whoever is patient and forgives - indeed, that is of the matters [worthy] of resolve.

r: The Consultation 42:44
t: And he whom Allāh sends astray - for him there is no protector beyond Him. And you will see the wrongdoers, when they see the punishment, saying, "Is there for return [to the former world] any way?"

r: The Consultation 42:45
t: And you will see them being exposed to it [i.e., the Fire], humbled from humiliation, looking from [behind] a covert glance. And those who had believed will say, "Indeed, the [true] losers are the ones who lost themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection. Unquestionably, the wrongdoers are in an enduring punishment."

r: The Consultation 42:46
t: And there will not be for them any allies to aid them other than Allāh. And whoever Allāh sends astray - for him there is no way.

r: The Consultation 42:47
t: Respond to your Lord before a Day comes from Allāh of which there is no repelling. No refuge will you have that Day, nor for you will there be any denial.

r: The Consultation 42:48
t: But if they turn away - then We have not sent you, [O Muḥammad], over them as a guardian; upon you is only [the duty of] notification. And indeed, when We let man taste mercy from Us, he rejoices in it; but if evil afflicts him for what his hands have put forth, then indeed, man is ungrateful.

r: The Consultation 42:49
t: To Allāh belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth; He creates what He wills. He gives to whom He wills female [children], and He gives to whom He wills males.

r: The Consultation 42:50
t: Or He makes them [both] males and females, and He renders whom He wills barren. Indeed, He is Knowing and Competent.

r: The Consultation 42:51
t: And it is not for any human being that Allāh should speak to him except by revelation or from behind a partition or that He sends a messenger [i.e., angel] to reveal, by His permission, what He wills. Indeed, He is Most High and Wise.

r: The Consultation 42:52
t: And thus We have revealed to you an inspiration of Our command [i.e., the Qur’ān]. You did not know what is the Book or [what is] faith, but We have made it a light by which We guide whom We will of Our servants. And indeed, [O Muḥammad], you guide to a straight path -

r: The Consultation 42:53
t: The path of Allāh, to whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Unquestionably, to Allāh do [all] matters evolve [i.e., return].

r: The Gold Adornments 43:1
t: Ḥā, Meem.

r: The Gold Adornments 43:2
t: By the clear Book,

r: The Gold Adornments 43:3
t: Indeed, We have made it an Arabic Qur’ān that you might understand.

r: The Gold Adornments 43:4
t: And indeed it is, in the Mother of the Book with Us, exalted and full of wisdom.

r: The Gold Adornments 43:5
t: Then should We turn the message away, disregarding you, because you are a transgressing people?

r: The Gold Adornments 43:6
t: And how many a prophet We sent among the former peoples,

r: The Gold Adornments 43:7
t: But there would not come to them a prophet except that they used to ridicule him.

r: The Gold Adornments 43:8
t: And We destroyed greater than them in [striking] power, and the example of the former peoples has preceded.

r: The Gold Adornments 43:9
t: And if you should ask them, "Who has created the heavens and the earth?" they would surely say, "They were created by the Exalted in Might, the Knowing,"

r: The Gold Adornments 43:10
t: [The one] who has made for you the earth a bed and made for you upon it roads that you might be guided

r: The Gold Adornments 43:11
t: And who sends down rain from the sky in measured amounts, and We revive thereby a dead land - thus will you be brought forth -

r: The Gold Adornments 43:12
t: And who created the species, all of them, and has made for you of ships and animals those which you mount

r: The Gold Adornments 43:13
t: That you may settle yourselves upon their backs and then remember the favor of your Lord when you have settled upon them and say, "Exalted is He who has subjected this to us, and we could not have [otherwise] subdued it.

r: The Gold Adornments 43:14
t: And indeed we, to our Lord, will [surely] return."

r: The Gold Adornments 43:15
t: But they have attributed to Him from His servants a portion. Indeed, man is clearly ungrateful.

r: The Gold Adornments 43:16
t: Or has He taken, out of what He has created, daughters and chosen you for [having] sons?

r: The Gold Adornments 43:17
t: And when one of them is given good tidings of that which he attributes to the Most Merciful in comparison [i.e., a daughter], his face becomes dark, and he suppresses grief.

r: The Gold Adornments 43:18
t: So is one brought up in ornaments while being during conflict unevident [attributed to Allāh]?

r: The Gold Adornments 43:19
t: And they described the angels, who are servants of the Most Merciful, as females. Did they witness their creation? Their testimony will be recorded, and they will be questioned.

r: The Gold Adornments 43:20
t: And they said, "If the Most Merciful had willed, we would not have worshipped them." They have of that no knowledge. They are not but misjudging.

r: The Gold Adornments 43:21
t: Or have We given them a book before it [i.e., the Qur’ān] to which they are adhering?

r: The Gold Adornments 43:22
t: Rather, they say, "Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are in their footsteps [rightly] guided."

r: The Gold Adornments 43:23
t: And similarly, We did not send before you any warner into a city except that its affluent said, "Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are, in their footsteps, following."

r: The Gold Adornments 43:24
t: [Each warner] said, "Even if I brought you better guidance than that [religion] upon which you found your fathers?" They said, "Indeed we, in that with which you were sent, are disbelievers."

r: The Gold Adornments 43:25
t: So We took retribution from them; then see how was the end of the deniers.

r: The Gold Adornments 43:26
t: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when Abraham said to his father and his people, "Indeed, I am disassociated from that which you worship

r: The Gold Adornments 43:27
t: Except for He who created me; and indeed, He will guide me."

r: The Gold Adornments 43:28
t: And he made it a word remaining among his descendants that they might return [to it].

r: The Gold Adornments 43:29
t: However, I gave enjoyment to these [people of Makkah] and their fathers until there came to them the truth and a clear Messenger.

r: The Gold Adornments 43:30
t: But when the truth came to them, they said, "This is magic, and indeed we are, concerning it, disbelievers."

r: The Gold Adornments 43:31
t: And they said, "Why was this Qur’ān not sent down upon a great man from [one of] the two cities?"

r: The Gold Adornments 43:32
t: Do they distribute the mercy of your Lord? It is We who have apportioned among them their livelihood in the life of this world and have raised some of them above others in degrees [of rank] that they may make use of one another for service. But the mercy of your Lord is better than whatever they accumulate.

r: The Gold Adornments 43:33
t: And if it were not that the people would become one community [of disbelievers], We would have made for those who disbelieve in the Most Merciful - for their houses - ceilings and stairways of silver upon which to mount.

r: The Gold Adornments 43:34
t: And for their houses - doors and couches [of silver] upon which to recline

r: The Gold Adornments 43:35
t: And gold ornament. But all that is not but the enjoyment of worldly life. And the Hereafter with your Lord is for the righteous.

r: The Gold Adornments 43:36
t: And whoever is blinded from remembrance of the Most Merciful - We appoint for him a devil, and he is to him a companion.

r: The Gold Adornments 43:37
t: And indeed, they [i.e., the devils] avert them from the way [of guidance] while they think that they are [rightly] guided

r: The Gold Adornments 43:38
t: Until, when he comes to Us [at Judgement], he says [to his companion], "How I wish there was between me and you the distance between the east and west; and what a wretched companion."

r: The Gold Adornments 43:39
t: And never will it benefit you that Day, when you have wronged, that you are [all] sharing in the punishment.

r: The Gold Adornments 43:40
t: Then will you make the deaf hear, [O Muḥammad], or guide the blind or he who is in clear error?

r: The Gold Adornments 43:41
t: And whether [or not] We take you away [in death], indeed, We will take retribution upon them.

r: The Gold Adornments 43:42
t: Or whether [or not] We show you that which We have promised them, indeed, We are Perfect in Ability.

r: The Gold Adornments 43:43
t: So adhere to that which is revealed to you. Indeed, you are on a straight path.

r: The Gold Adornments 43:44
t: And indeed, it is a remembrance for you and your people, and you [all] are going to be questioned.

r: The Gold Adornments 43:45
t: And ask those We sent before you of Our messengers; have We made besides the Most Merciful deities to be worshipped?

r: The Gold Adornments 43:46
t: And certainly did We send Moses with Our signs to Pharaoh and his establishment, and he said, "Indeed, I am the messenger of the Lord of the worlds."

r: The Gold Adornments 43:47
t: But when he brought them Our signs, at once they laughed at them.

r: The Gold Adornments 43:48
t: And We showed them not a sign except that it was greater than its sister, and We seized them with affliction that perhaps they might return [to faith].

r: The Gold Adornments 43:49
t: And they said [to Moses], "O magician, invoke for us your Lord by what He has promised you. Indeed, we will be guided."

r: The Gold Adornments 43:50
t: But when We removed from them the affliction, at once they broke their word.

r: The Gold Adornments 43:51
t: And Pharaoh called out among his people; he said, "O my people, does not the kingdom of Egypt belong to me, and these rivers flowing beneath me; then do you not see?

r: The Gold Adornments 43:52
t: Or am I [not] better than this one [i.e., Moses] who is insignificant and hardly makes himself clear?

r: The Gold Adornments 43:53
t: Then why have there not been placed upon him bracelets of gold or come with him the angels in conjunction?"

r: The Gold Adornments 43:54
t: So he bluffed his people, and they obeyed him. Indeed, they were [themselves] a people defiantly disobedient [of Allāh].

r: The Gold Adornments 43:55
t: And when they angered Us, We took retribution from them and drowned them all.

r: The Gold Adornments 43:56
t: And We made them a precedent and an example for the later peoples.

r: The Gold Adornments 43:57
t: And when the son of Mary was presented as an example, immediately your people laughed aloud.

r: The Gold Adornments 43:58
t: And they said, "Are our gods better, or is he?" They did not present it [i.e., the comparison] except for [mere] argument. But, [in fact], they are a people prone to dispute.

r: The Gold Adornments 43:59
t: He [i.e., Jesus] was not but a servant upon whom We bestowed favor, and We made him an example for the Children of Israel.

r: The Gold Adornments 43:60
t: And if We willed, We could have made [instead] of you angels succeeding [one another] on the earth.

r: The Gold Adornments 43:61
t: And indeed, he [i.e., Jesus] will be [a sign for] knowledge of the Hour, so be not in doubt of it, and follow Me. This is a straight path.

r: The Gold Adornments 43:62
t: And never let Satan avert you. Indeed, he is to you a clear enemy.

r: The Gold Adornments 43:63
t: And when Jesus brought clear proofs, he said, "I have come to you with wisdom [i.e., prophethood] and to make clear to you some of that over which you differ, so fear Allāh and obey me.

r: The Gold Adornments 43:64
t: Indeed, Allāh is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. This is a straight path."

r: The Gold Adornments 43:65
t: But the denominations from among them differed [and separated], so woe to those who have wronged from the punishment of a painful Day.

r: The Gold Adornments 43:66
t: Are they waiting except for the Hour to come upon them suddenly while they perceive not?

r: The Gold Adornments 43:67
t: Close friends, that Day, will be enemies to each other, except for the righteous

r: The Gold Adornments 43:68
t: [To whom Allāh will say], "O My servants, no fear will there be concerning you this Day, nor will you grieve,

r: The Gold Adornments 43:69
t: [You] who believed in Our verses and were Muslims.

r: The Gold Adornments 43:70
t: Enter Paradise, you and your kinds, delighted."

r: The Gold Adornments 43:71
t: Circulated among them will be plates and vessels of gold. And therein is whatever the souls desire and [what] delights the eyes, and you will abide therein eternally.

r: The Gold Adornments 43:72
t: And that is Paradise which you are made to inherit for what you used to do.

r: The Gold Adornments 43:73
t: For you therein is much fruit from which you will eat.

r: The Gold Adornments 43:74
t: Indeed, the criminals will be in the punishment of Hell, abiding eternally.

r: The Gold Adornments 43:75
t: It will not be allowed to subside for them, and they, therein, are in despair.

r: The Gold Adornments 43:76
t: And We did not wrong them, but it was they who were the wrongdoers.

r: The Gold Adornments 43:77
t: And they will call, "O Mālik, let your Lord put an end to us!" He will say, "Indeed, you will remain."

r: The Gold Adornments 43:78
t: We had certainly brought you the truth, but most of you, to the truth, were averse.

r: The Gold Adornments 43:79
t: Or have they devised [some] affair? But indeed, We are devising [a plan].

r: The Gold Adornments 43:80
t: Or do they think that We hear not their secrets and their private conversations? Yes, [We do], and Our messengers [i.e., angels] are with them recording.

r: The Gold Adornments 43:81
t: Say, [O Muḥammad], "If the Most Merciful had a son, then I would be the first of [his] worshippers."

r: The Gold Adornments 43:82
t: Exalted is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Lord of the Throne, above what they describe.

r: The Gold Adornments 43:83
t: So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised.

r: The Gold Adornments 43:84
t: And it is He [i.e., Allāh] who is [the only] deity in the heaven, and on the earth [the only] deity. And He is the Wise, the Knowing.

r: The Gold Adornments 43:85
t: And blessed is He to whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them and with whom is knowledge of the Hour and to whom you will be returned.

r: The Gold Adornments 43:86
t: And those they invoke besides Him do not possess [power of] intercession; but only those who testify to the truth [can benefit], and they know.

r: The Gold Adornments 43:87
t: And if you asked them who created them, they would surely say, "Allāh." So how are they deluded?

r: The Gold Adornments 43:88
t: And [Allāh acknowledges] his saying, "O my Lord, indeed these are a people who do not believe."

r: The Gold Adornments 43:89
t: So turn aside from them and say, "Peace." But they are going to know.

r: The Smoke 44:1
t: Ḥā, Meem.

r: The Smoke 44:2
t: By the clear Book,

r: The Smoke 44:3
t: Indeed, We sent it down during a blessed night. Indeed, We were to warn [mankind].

r: The Smoke 44:4
t: Therein [i.e., on that night] is made distinct every precise matter -

r: The Smoke 44:5
t: [Every] matter [proceeding] from Us. Indeed, We were to send [a messenger]

r: The Smoke 44:6
t: As mercy from your Lord. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing,

r: The Smoke 44:7
t: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them, if you would be certain.

r: The Smoke 44:8
t: There is no deity except Him; He gives life and causes death. [He is] your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers.

r: The Smoke 44:9
t: But they are in doubt, amusing themselves.

r: The Smoke 44:10
t: Then watch for the Day when the sky will bring a visible smoke

r: The Smoke 44:11
t: Covering the people; this is a painful torment.

r: The Smoke 44:12
t: [They will say], "Our Lord, remove from us the torment; indeed, we are believers."

r: The Smoke 44:13
t: How will there be for them a reminder [at that time]? And there had come to them a clear Messenger.

r: The Smoke 44:14
t: Then they turned away from him and said, "[He was] taught [and is] a madman."

r: The Smoke 44:15
t: Indeed, We will remove the torment for a little. Indeed, you [disbelievers] will return [to disbelief].

r: The Smoke 44:16
t: The Day We will strike with the greatest assault, indeed, We will take retribution.

r: The Smoke 44:17
t: And We had already tried before them the people of Pharaoh, and there came to them a noble messenger [i.e., Moses],

r: The Smoke 44:18
t: [Saying], "Render to me the servants of Allāh. Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger,"

r: The Smoke 44:19
t: And [saying], "Be not haughty with Allāh. Indeed, I have come to you with clear evidence.

r: The Smoke 44:20
t: And indeed, I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord, lest you stone me.

r: The Smoke 44:21
t: But if you do not believe me, then leave me alone."

r: The Smoke 44:22
t: And [finally] he called to his Lord that these were a criminal people.

r: The Smoke 44:23
t: [Allāh said], "Then set out with My servants by night. Indeed, you are to be pursued.

r: The Smoke 44:24
t: And leave the sea in stillness. Indeed, they are an army to be drowned."

r: The Smoke 44:25
t: How much they left behind of gardens and springs

r: The Smoke 44:26
t: And crops and noble sites

r: The Smoke 44:27
