t: And comfort wherein they were amused.

r: The Smoke 44:28
t: Thus. And We caused to inherit it another people.

r: The Smoke 44:29
t: And the heaven and earth wept not for them, nor were they reprieved.

r: The Smoke 44:30
t: And We certainly saved the Children of Israel from the humiliating torment -

r: The Smoke 44:31
t: From Pharaoh. Indeed, he was a haughty one among the transgressors.

r: The Smoke 44:32
t: And We certainly chose them by knowledge over [all] the worlds.

r: The Smoke 44:33
t: And We gave them of signs that in which there was a clear trial.

r: The Smoke 44:34
t: Indeed, these [disbelievers] are saying,

r: The Smoke 44:35
t: "There is not but our first death, and we will not be resurrected.

r: The Smoke 44:36
t: Then bring [back] our forefathers, if you should be truthful."

r: The Smoke 44:37
t: Are they better or the people of Tubbaʿ and those before them? We destroyed them, [for] indeed, they were criminals.

r: The Smoke 44:38
t: And We did not create the heavens and earth and that between them in play.

r: The Smoke 44:39
t: We did not create them except in truth, but most of them do not know.

r: The Smoke 44:40
t: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is the appointed time for them all -

r: The Smoke 44:41
t: The Day when no relation will avail a relation at all, nor will they be helped -

r: The Smoke 44:42
t: Except those [believers] on whom Allāh has mercy. Indeed, He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

r: The Smoke 44:43
t: Indeed, the tree of zaqqūm

r: The Smoke 44:44
t: Is food for the sinful.

r: The Smoke 44:45
t: Like murky oil, it boils within bellies

r: The Smoke 44:46
t: Like the boiling of scalding water.

r: The Smoke 44:47
t: [It will be commanded], "Seize him and drag him into the midst of the Hellfire,

r: The Smoke 44:48
t: Then pour over his head from the torment of scalding water."

r: The Smoke 44:49
t: [It will be said], "Taste! Indeed, you are the honored, the noble!

r: The Smoke 44:50
t: Indeed, this is what you used to dispute."

r: The Smoke 44:51
t: Indeed, the righteous will be in a secure place:

r: The Smoke 44:52
t: Within gardens and springs,

r: The Smoke 44:53
t: Wearing [garments of] fine silk and brocade, facing each other.

r: The Smoke 44:54
t: Thus. And We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.

r: The Smoke 44:55
t: They will call therein for every [kind of] fruit - safe and secure.

r: The Smoke 44:56
t: They will not taste death therein except the first death, and He will have protected them from the punishment of Hellfire

r: The Smoke 44:57
t: As bounty from your Lord. That is what is the great attainment.

r: The Smoke 44:58
t: And indeed, We have eased it [i.e., the Qur’ān] in your tongue that they might be reminded.

r: The Smoke 44:59
t: So watch, [O Muḥammad]; indeed, they are watching [for your end].

r: The Crouching 45:1
t: Ḥā, Meem.

r: The Crouching 45:2
t: The revelation of the Book is from Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

r: The Crouching 45:3
t: Indeed, within the heavens and earth are signs for the believers.

r: The Crouching 45:4
t: And in the creation of yourselves and what He disperses of moving creatures are signs for people who are certain [in faith].

r: The Crouching 45:5
t: And [in] the alternation of night and day and [in] what Allāh sends down from the sky of provision [i.e., rain] and gives life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness and [in His] directing of the winds are signs for a people who reason.

r: The Crouching 45:6
t: These are the verses of Allāh which We recite to you in truth. Then in what statement after Allāh and His verses will they believe?

r: The Crouching 45:7
t: Woe to every sinful liar

r: The Crouching 45:8
t: Who hears the verses of Allāh recited to him, then persists arrogantly as if he had not heard them. So give him tidings of a painful punishment.

r: The Crouching 45:9
t: And when he knows anything of Our verses, he takes them in ridicule. Those will have a humiliating punishment.

r: The Crouching 45:10
t: Before them is Hell, and what they had earned will not avail them at all nor what they had taken besides Allāh as allies. And they will have a great punishment.

r: The Crouching 45:11
t: This [Qur’ān] is guidance. And those who have disbelieved in the verses of their Lord will have a painful punishment of foul nature.

r: The Crouching 45:12
t: It is Allāh who subjected to you the sea so that ships may sail upon it by His command and that you may seek of His bounty; and perhaps you will be grateful.

r: The Crouching 45:13
t: And He has subjected to you whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth - all from Him. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought.

r: The Crouching 45:14
t: Say, [O Muḥammad], to those who have believed that they [should] forgive those who expect not the days of Allāh [i.e., of His retribution] so that He may recompense a people for what they used to earn.

r: The Crouching 45:15
t: Whoever does a good deed - it is for himself; and whoever does evil - it is against it [i.e., the self or soul]. Then to your Lord you will be returned.

r: The Crouching 45:16
t: And We did certainly give the Children of Israel the Scripture and judgement and prophethood, and We provided them with good things and preferred them over the worlds.

r: The Crouching 45:17
t: And We gave them clear proofs of the matter [of religion]. And they did not differ except after knowledge had come to them - out of jealous animosity between themselves. Indeed, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ.

r: The Crouching 45:18
t: Then We put you, [O Muḥammad], on an ordained way concerning the matter [of religion]; so follow it and do not follow the inclinations of those who do not know.

r: The Crouching 45:19
t: Indeed, they will never avail you against Allāh at all. And indeed, the wrongdoers are allies of one another; but Allāh is the protector of the righteous.

r: The Crouching 45:20
t: This [Qur’ān] is enlightenment for mankind and guidance and mercy for a people who are certain [in faith].

r: The Crouching 45:21
t: Or do those who commit evils think We will make them like those who have believed and done righteous deeds - [make them] equal in their life and their death? Evil is that which they judge [i.e., assume].

r: The Crouching 45:22
t: And Allāh created the heavens and earth in truth and so that every soul may be recompensed for what it has earned, and they will not be wronged.

r: The Crouching 45:23
t: Have you seen he who has taken as his god his [own] desire, and Allāh has sent him astray due to knowledge and has set a seal upon his hearing and his heart and put over his vision a veil? So who will guide him after Allāh? Then will you not be reminded?

r: The Crouching 45:24
t: And they say, "There is not but our worldly life; we die and live, and nothing destroys us except time." And they have of that no knowledge; they are only assuming.

r: The Crouching 45:25
t: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, their argument is only that they say, "Bring [back] our forefathers, if you should be truthful."

r: The Crouching 45:26
t: Say, "Allāh causes you to live, then causes you to die; then He will assemble you for the Day of Resurrection, about which there is no doubt, but most of the people do not know."

r: The Crouching 45:27
t: And to Allāh belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And the Day the Hour appears - that Day the falsifiers will lose.

r: The Crouching 45:28
t: And you will see every nation kneeling [from fear]. Every nation will be called to its record [and told], "Today you will be recompensed for what you used to do.

r: The Crouching 45:29
t: This, Our record, speaks about you in truth. Indeed, We were having transcribed whatever you used to do."

r: The Crouching 45:30
t: So as for those who believed and did righteous deeds, their Lord will admit them into His mercy. That is what is the clear attainment.

r: The Crouching 45:31
t: But as for those who disbelieved, [it will be said], "Were not Our verses recited to you, but you were arrogant and became a criminal people?

r: The Crouching 45:32
t: And when it was said, 'Indeed, the promise of Allāh is truth and the Hour [is coming] - no doubt about it,' you said, 'We know not what is the Hour. We assume only assumption, and we are not convinced.'"

r: The Crouching 45:33
t: And the evil consequences of what they did will appear to them, and they will be enveloped by what they used to ridicule.

r: The Crouching 45:34
t: And it will be said, "Today We will forget you as you forgot the meeting of this Day of yours, and your refuge is the Fire, and for you there are no helpers.

r: The Crouching 45:35
t: That is because you took the verses of Allāh in ridicule, and worldly life deluded you." So that Day they will not be removed from it, nor will they be asked to appease [Allāh].

r: The Crouching 45:36
t: Then, to Allāh belongs [all] praise - Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, Lord of the worlds.

r: The Crouching 45:37
t: And to Him belongs [all] grandeur within the heavens and the earth, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

r: The Wind-Curved Sandhills 46:1
t: Ḥā, Meem.

r: The Wind-Curved Sandhills 46:2
t: The revelation of the Book is from Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

r: The Wind-Curved Sandhills 46:3
t: We did not create the heavens and earth and what is between them except in truth and [for] a specified term. But those who disbelieve, from that of which they are warned, are turning away.

r: The Wind-Curved Sandhills 46:4
t: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Have you considered that which you invoke besides Allāh? Show me what they have created of the earth; or did they have partnership in [creation of] the heavens? Bring me a scripture [revealed] before this or a [remaining] trace of knowledge, if you should be truthful."

r: The Wind-Curved Sandhills 46:5
t: And who is more astray than he who invokes besides Allāh those who will not respond to him until the Day of Resurrection [i.e., never], and they, of their invocation, are unaware.

r: The Wind-Curved Sandhills 46:6
t: And when the people are gathered [that Day], they [who were invoked] will be enemies to them, and they will be deniers of their worship.

r: The Wind-Curved Sandhills 46:7
t: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, those who disbelieve say of the truth when it has come to them, "This is obvious magic."

r: The Wind-Curved Sandhills 46:8
t: Or do they say, "He has invented it"? Say, "If I have invented it, you will not possess for me [the power of protection] from Allāh at all. He is most knowing of that in which you are involved. Sufficient is He as Witness between me and you, and He is the Forgiving, the Merciful."

r: The Wind-Curved Sandhills 46:9
t: Say, "I am not something original among the messengers, nor do I know what will be done with me or with you. I only follow that which is revealed to me, and I am not but a clear warner."

r: The Wind-Curved Sandhills 46:10
t: Say, "Have you considered: if it [i.e., the Qur’ān] was from Allāh, and you disbelieved in it while a witness from the Children of Israel has testified to something similar and believed while you were arrogant...?" Indeed, Allāh does not guide the wrongdoing people.

r: The Wind-Curved Sandhills 46:11
t: And those who disbelieve say of those who believe, "If it had [truly] been good, they would not have preceded us to it." And when they are not guided by it, they will say, "This is an ancient falsehood."

r: The Wind-Curved Sandhills 46:12
t: And before it was the scripture of Moses to lead and as a mercy. And this is a confirming Book in an Arabic tongue to warn those who have wronged and as good tidings to the doers of good.

r: The Wind-Curved Sandhills 46:13
t: Indeed, those who have said, "Our Lord is Allāh," and then remained on a right course - there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve.

r: The Wind-Curved Sandhills 46:14
t: Those are the companions of Paradise, abiding eternally therein as reward for what they used to do.

r: The Wind-Curved Sandhills 46:15
t: And We have enjoined upon man, to his parents, good treatment. His mother carried him with hardship and gave birth to him with hardship, and his gestation and weaning [period] is thirty months. [He grows] until, when he reaches maturity and reaches [the age of] forty years, he says, "My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to work righteousness of which You will approve and make righteous for me my offspring. Indeed, I have repented to You, and indeed, I am of the Muslims."

r: The Wind-Curved Sandhills 46:16
t: Those are the ones from whom We will accept the best of what they did and overlook their misdeeds, [their being] among the companions of Paradise. [That is] the promise of truth which they had been promised.

r: The Wind-Curved Sandhills 46:17
t: But one who says to his parents, "Uff to you; do you promise me that I will be brought forth [from the earth] when generations before me have already passed on [into oblivion]?" while they call to Allāh for help [and to their son], "Woe to you! Believe! Indeed, the promise of Allāh is truth." But he says, "This is not but legends of the former peoples" -

r: The Wind-Curved Sandhills 46:18
t: Those are the ones upon whom the word [i.e., decree] has come into effect, [who will be] among nations which had passed on before them of jinn and men. Indeed, they [all] were losers.

r: The Wind-Curved Sandhills 46:19
t: And for all there are degrees [of reward and punishment] for what they have done, and [it is] so that He may fully compensate them for their deeds, and they will not be wronged.

r: The Wind-Curved Sandhills 46:20
t: And the Day those who disbelieved are exposed to the Fire [it will be said], "You exhausted your pleasures during your worldly life and enjoyed them, so this Day you will be awarded the punishment of [extreme] humiliation because you were arrogant upon the earth without right and because you were defiantly disobedient."

r: The Wind-Curved Sandhills 46:21
t: And mention, [O Muḥammad], the brother of ʿAad, when he warned his people in [the region of] al-Aḥqāf - and warners had already passed on before him and after him - [saying], "Do not worship except Allāh. Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a terrible day."

r: The Wind-Curved Sandhills 46:22
t: They said, "Have you come to delude us away from our gods? Then bring us what you promise us, if you should be of the truthful."

r: The Wind-Curved Sandhills 46:23
t: He said, "Knowledge [of its time] is only with Allāh, and I convey to you that with which I was sent; but I see you [to be] a people behaving ignorantly."

r: The Wind-Curved Sandhills 46:24
t: And when they saw it as a cloud approaching their valleys, they said, "This is a cloud bringing us rain!" Rather, it is that for which you were impatient: a wind, within it a painful punishment,

r: The Wind-Curved Sandhills 46:25
t: Destroying everything by command of its Lord. And they became so that nothing was seen [of them] except their dwellings. Thus do We recompense the criminal people.

r: The Wind-Curved Sandhills 46:26
t: And We had certainly established them in such as We have not established you, and We made for them hearing and vision and hearts [i.e., intellect]. But their hearing and vision and hearts availed them not from anything [of the punishment] when they were [continually] rejecting the signs of Allāh; and they were enveloped by what they used to ridicule.

r: The Wind-Curved Sandhills 46:27
t: And We have already destroyed what surrounds you of [those] cities, and We have diversified the signs [or verses] that perhaps they might return [from disbelief].

r: The Wind-Curved Sandhills 46:28
t: Then why did those they took besides Allāh as deities by which to approach [Him] not aid them? But they had strayed [i.e., departed] from them. And that was their falsehood and what they were inventing.

r: The Wind-Curved Sandhills 46:29
t: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when We directed to you a few of the jinn, listening to the Qur’ān. And when they attended it, they said, "Listen attentively." And when it was concluded, they went back to their people as warners.

r: The Wind-Curved Sandhills 46:30
t: They said, "O our people, indeed we have heard a [recited] Book revealed after Moses confirming what was before it which guides to the truth and to a straight path.

r: The Wind-Curved Sandhills 46:31
t: O our people, respond to the Caller [i.e., Messenger] of Allāh and believe in him; He [i.e., Allāh] will forgive for you your sins and protect you from a painful punishment.

r: The Wind-Curved Sandhills 46:32
t: But he who does not respond to the Caller of Allāh will not cause failure [to Him] upon earth, and he will not have besides Him any protectors. Those are in manifest error."

r: The Wind-Curved Sandhills 46:33
t: Do they not see that Allāh, who created the heavens and earth and did not fail in their creation, is able to give life to the dead? Yes. Indeed, He is over all things competent.

r: The Wind-Curved Sandhills 46:34
t: And the Day those who disbelieved are exposed to the Fire [it will be said], "Is this not the truth?" They will say, "Yes, by our Lord." He will say, "Then taste the punishment for what you used to deny."

r: The Wind-Curved Sandhills 46:35
t: So be patient, [O Muḥammad], as were those of determination among the messengers and do not be impatient for them. It will be - on the Day they see that which they are promised - as though they had not remained [in the world] except an hour of a day. [This is] notification. And will [any] be destroyed except the defiantly disobedient people?

r: Muhammad 47:1
t: Those who disbelieve and avert [people] from the way of Allāh - He will waste their deeds.

r: Muhammad 47:2
t: And those who believe and do righteous deeds and believe in what has been sent down upon Muḥammad - and it is the truth from their Lord - He will remove from them their misdeeds and amend their condition.

r: Muhammad 47:3
t: That is because those who disbelieve follow falsehood, and those who believe follow the truth from their Lord. Thus does Allāh present to the people their comparisons.

r: Muhammad 47:4
t: So when you meet those who disbelieve [in battle], strike [their] necks until, when you have inflicted slaughter upon them, then secure [their] bonds, and either [confer] favor afterwards or ransom [them] until the war lays down its burdens. That [is the command]. And if Allāh had willed, He could have taken vengeance upon them [Himself], but [He ordered armed struggle] to test some of you by means of others. And those who are killed in the cause of Allāh - never will He waste their deeds.

r: Muhammad 47:5
t: He will guide them and amend their condition

r: Muhammad 47:6
t: And admit them to Paradise, which He has made known to them.

r: Muhammad 47:7
t: O you who have believed, if you support Allāh, He will support you and plant firmly your feet.

r: Muhammad 47:8
t: But those who disbelieve - for them is misery, and He will waste their deeds.

r: Muhammad 47:9
t: That is because they disliked what Allāh revealed, so He rendered worthless their deeds.

r: Muhammad 47:10
t: Have they not traveled through the land and seen how was the end of those before them? Allāh destroyed [everything] over them, and for the disbelievers is something comparable.

r: Muhammad 47:11
t: That is because Allāh is the protector of those who have believed and because the disbelievers have no protector.

r: Muhammad 47:12
t: Indeed, Allāh will admit those who have believed and done righteous deeds to gardens beneath which rivers flow, but those who disbelieve enjoy themselves and eat as grazing livestock eat, and the Fire will be a residence for them.

r: Muhammad 47:13
t: And how many a city was stronger than your city [i.e., Makkah] which drove you out? We destroyed them; and there was no helper for them.

r: Muhammad 47:14
t: So is he who is on clear evidence from his Lord like him to whom the evil of his work has been made attractive and they follow their [own] desires?

r: Muhammad 47:15
t: Is the description of Paradise, which the righteous are promised, wherein are rivers of water unaltered, rivers of milk the taste of which never changes, rivers of wine delicious to those who drink, and rivers of purified honey, in which they will have from all [kinds of] fruits and forgiveness from their Lord... [Are its inhabitants] like those who abide eternally in the Fire and are given to drink scalding water that will sever their intestines?

r: Muhammad 47:16
t: And among them, [O Muḥammad], are those who listen to you, until when they depart from you, they say to those who were given knowledge, "What has he said just now?" Those are the ones of whom Allāh has sealed over their hearts and who have followed their [own] desires.

r: Muhammad 47:17
t: And those who are guided - He increases them in guidance and gives them their righteousness.

r: Muhammad 47:18
t: Then do they await except that the Hour should come upon them unexpectedly? But already there have come [some of] its indications. Then how [i.e., what good] to them, when it has come, will be their remembrance?

r: Muhammad 47:19
t: So know, [O Muḥammad], that there is no deity except Allāh and ask forgiveness for your sin and for the believing men and believing women. And Allāh knows of your movement and your resting place.

r: Muhammad 47:20
t: Those who believe say, "Why has a sūrah not been sent down?" But when a precise sūrah is revealed and battle is mentioned therein, you see those in whose hearts is disease [i.e., hypocrisy] looking at you with a look of one overcome by death. And more appropriate for them [would have been]

r: Muhammad 47:21
t: Obedience and good words. And when the matter [of fighting] was determined, if they had been true to Allāh, it would have been better for them.

r: Muhammad 47:22
t: So would you perhaps, if you turned away, cause corruption on earth and sever your [ties of] relationship?

r: Muhammad 47:23
t: Those [who do so] are the ones that Allāh has cursed, so He deafened them and blinded their vision.

r: Muhammad 47:24
t: Then do they not reflect upon the Qur’ān, or are there locks upon [their] hearts?

r: Muhammad 47:25
t: Indeed, those who reverted back [to disbelief] after guidance had become clear to them - Satan enticed them and prolonged hope for them.

r: Muhammad 47:26
t: That is because they said to those who disliked what Allāh sent down, "We will obey you in part of the matter." And Allāh knows what they conceal.

r: Muhammad 47:27
t: Then how [will it be] when the angels take them in death, striking their faces and their backs?

r: Muhammad 47:28
t: That is because they followed what angered Allāh and disliked [what earns] His pleasure, so He rendered worthless their deeds.

r: Muhammad 47:29
t: Or do those in whose hearts is disease think that Allāh would never expose their [feelings of] hatred?

r: Muhammad 47:30
t: And if We willed, We could show them to you, and you would know them by their mark; but you will surely know them by the tone of [their] speech. And Allāh knows your deeds.

r: Muhammad 47:31
t: And We will surely test you until We make evident those who strive among you [for the cause of Allāh] and the patient, and We will test your affairs.

r: Muhammad 47:32
t: Indeed, those who disbelieved and averted [people] from the path of Allāh and opposed the Messenger after guidance had become clear to them - never will they harm Allāh at all, and He will render worthless their deeds.

r: Muhammad 47:33
t: O you who have believed, obey Allāh and obey the Messenger and do not invalidate your deeds.

r: Muhammad 47:34
t: Indeed, those who disbelieved and averted [people] from the path of Allāh and then died while they were disbelievers - never will Allāh forgive them.

r: Muhammad 47:35
t: So do not weaken and call for peace while you are superior; and Allāh is with you and will never deprive you of [the reward of] your deeds.

r: Muhammad 47:36
t: [This] worldly life is only amusement and diversion. And if you believe and fear Allāh, He will give you your rewards and not ask you for your properties.

r: Muhammad 47:37
t: If He should ask you for them and press you, you would withhold, and He would expose your hatred [i.e., unwillingness].

r: Muhammad 47:38
t: Here you are - those invited to spend in the cause of Allāh - but among you are those who withhold [out of greed]. And whoever withholds only withholds [benefit] from himself; and Allāh is the Free of need, while you are the needy. And if you turn away [i.e., refuse], He will replace you with another people; then they will not be the likes of you.

r: The Victory 48:1
t: Indeed, We have given you, [O Muḥammad], a clear conquest

r: The Victory 48:2
t: That Allāh may forgive for you what preceded of your sin [i.e., errors] and what will follow and complete His favor upon you and guide you to a straight path

r: The Victory 48:3
t: And [that] Allāh may aid you with a mighty victory.

r: The Victory 48:4
t: It is He who sent down tranquility into the hearts of the believers that they would increase in faith along with their [present] faith. And to Allāh belong the soldiers of the heavens and the earth, and ever is Allāh Knowing and Wise.

r: The Victory 48:5
t: [And] that He may admit the believing men and the believing women to gardens beneath which rivers flow to abide therein eternally and remove from them their misdeeds - and ever is that, in the sight of Allāh, a great attainment

r: The Victory 48:6
t: And [that] He may punish the hypocrite men and hypocrite women, and the polytheist men and polytheist women - those who assume about Allāh an assumption of evil nature. Upon them is a misfortune of evil nature; and Allāh has become angry with them and has cursed them and prepared for them Hell, and evil it is as a destination.

r: The Victory 48:7
t: And to Allāh belong the soldiers of the heavens and the earth. And ever is Allāh Exalted in Might and Wise.

r: The Victory 48:8
t: Indeed, We have sent you as a witness and a bringer of good tidings and a warner

r: The Victory 48:9
t: That you [people] may believe in Allāh and His Messenger and honor him and respect him [i.e., the Prophet (ﷺ)] and exalt Him [i.e., Allāh] morning and afternoon.

r: The Victory 48:10
t: Indeed, those who pledge allegiance to you, [O Muḥammad] - they are actually pledging allegiance to Allāh. The hand of Allāh is over their hands. So he who breaks his word only breaks it to the detriment of himself. And he who fulfills that which he has promised Allāh - He will give him a great reward.

r: The Victory 48:11
t: Those who remained behind of the bedouins will say to you, "Our properties and our families occupied us, so ask forgiveness for us." They say with their tongues what is not within their hearts. Say, "Then who could prevent Allāh at all if He intended for you harm or intended for you benefit? Rather, ever is Allāh, of what you do, Aware.

r: The Victory 48:12
t: But you thought that the Messenger and the believers would never return to their families, ever, and that was made pleasing in your hearts. And you assumed an assumption of evil and became a people ruined."

r: The Victory 48:13
t: And whoever has not believed in Allāh and His Messenger - then indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers a Blaze.

r: The Victory 48:14
t: And to Allāh belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. He forgives whom He wills and punishes whom He wills. And ever is Allāh Forgiving and Merciful.

r: The Victory 48:15
t: Those who remained behind will say when you set out toward the war booty to take it, "Let us follow you." They wish to change the words of Allāh. Say, "Never will you follow us. Thus did Allāh say before." So they will say, "Rather, you envy us." But [in fact] they were not understanding except a little.

r: The Victory 48:16
t: Say to those who remained behind of the bedouins, "You will be called to [face] a people of great military might; you may fight them, or they will submit. So if you obey, Allāh will give you a good reward; but if you turn away as you turned away before, He will punish you with a painful punishment."

r: The Victory 48:17
t: There is not upon the blind any guilt or upon the lame any guilt or upon the ill any guilt [for remaining behind]. And whoever obeys Allāh and His Messenger - He will admit him to gardens beneath which rivers flow; but whoever turns away - He will punish him with a painful punishment.

r: The Victory 48:18
t: Certainly was Allāh pleased with the believers when they pledged allegiance to you, [O Muḥammad], under the tree, and He knew what was in their hearts, so He sent down tranquility upon them and rewarded them with an imminent conquest

r: The Victory 48:19
t: And much war booty which they will take. And ever is Allāh Exalted in Might and Wise.

r: The Victory 48:20
t: Allāh has promised you much booty that you will take [in the future] and has hastened for you this [victory] and withheld the hands of people from you - that it may be a sign for the believers and [that] He may guide you to a straight path.

r: The Victory 48:21
t: And [He promises] other [victories] that you were [so far] unable to [realize] which Allāh has already encompassed. And ever is Allāh, over all things, competent.

r: The Victory 48:22
t: And if those [Makkans] who disbelieve had fought you, they would have turned their backs [in flight]. Then they would not find a protector or a helper.

r: The Victory 48:23
t: [This is] the established way of Allāh which has occurred before. And never will you find in the way of Allāh any change.

r: The Victory 48:24
t: And it is He who withheld their hands from you and your hands from them within [the area of] Makkah after He caused you to overcome them. And ever is Allāh, of what you do, Seeing.

r: The Victory 48:25
t: They are the ones who disbelieved and obstructed you from al-Masjid al-Ḥarām while the offering was prevented from reaching its place of sacrifice. And if not for believing men and believing women whom you did not know - that you might trample [i.e., kill] them and there would befall you because of them dishonor without [your] knowledge - [you would have been permitted to enter Makkah]. [This was so] that Allāh might admit to His mercy whom He willed. If they had been apart [from them], We would have punished those who disbelieved among them with painful punishment

r: The Victory 48:26
t: When those who disbelieved had put into their hearts chauvinism - the chauvinism of the time of ignorance. But Allāh sent down His tranquility upon His Messenger and upon the believers and imposed upon them the word of righteousness, and they were more deserving of it and worthy of it. And ever is Allāh, of all things, Knowing.

r: The Victory 48:27
t: Certainly has Allāh showed to His Messenger the vision [i.e., dream] in truth. You will surely enter al-Masjid al-Ḥarām, if Allāh wills, in safety, with your heads shaved and [hair] shortened, not fearing [anyone]. He knew what you did not know and has arranged before that a conquest near [at hand].

r: The Victory 48:28
t: It is He who sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of truth to manifest it over all religion. And sufficient is Allāh as Witness.

r: The Victory 48:29
t: Muḥammad is the Messenger of Allāh; and those with him are forceful against the disbelievers, merciful among themselves. You see them bowing and prostrating [in prayer], seeking bounty from Allāh and [His] pleasure. Their sign is in their faces from the effect of prostration [i.e., prayer]. That is their description in the Torah. And their description in the Gospel is as a plant which produces its offshoots and strengthens them so they grow firm and stand upon their stalks, delighting the sowers - so that He [i.e., Allāh] may enrage by them the disbelievers. Allāh has promised those who believe and do righteous deeds among them forgiveness and a great reward.

r: The Rooms 49:1
t: O you who have believed, do not put [yourselves] before Allāh and His Messenger but fear Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Hearing and Knowing.

r: The Rooms 49:2
t: O you who have believed, do not raise your voices above the voice of the Prophet or be loud to him in speech like the loudness of some of you to others, lest your deeds become worthless while you perceive not.

r: The Rooms 49:3
t: Indeed, those who lower their voices before the Messenger of Allāh - they are the ones whose hearts Allāh has tested for righteousness. For them is forgiveness and great reward.

r: The Rooms 49:4
t: Indeed, those who call you, [O Muḥammad], from behind the chambers - most of them do not use reason.

r: The Rooms 49:5
t: And if they had been patient until you [could] come out to them, it would have been better for them. But Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

r: The Rooms 49:6
t: O you who have believed, if there comes to you a disobedient one with information, investigate, lest you harm a people out of ignorance and become, over what you have done, regretful.

r: The Rooms 49:7
t: And know that among you is the Messenger of Allāh. If he were to obey you in much of the matter, you would be in difficulty, but Allāh has endeared to you the faith and has made it pleasing in your hearts and has made hateful to you disbelief, defiance and disobedience. Those are the [rightly] guided.

r: The Rooms 49:8
t: [It is] as bounty from Allāh and favor. And Allāh is Knowing and Wise.

r: The Rooms 49:9
t: And if two factions among the believers should fight, then make settlement between the two. But if one of them oppresses the other, then fight against the one that oppresses until it returns to the ordinance of Allāh. And if it returns, then make settlement between them in justice and act justly. Indeed, Allāh loves those who act justly.

r: The Rooms 49:10
t: The believers are but brothers, so make settlement between your brothers. And fear Allāh that you may receive mercy.

r: The Rooms 49:11
t: O you who have believed, let not a people ridicule [another] people; perhaps they may be better than them; nor let women ridicule [other] women; perhaps they may be better than them. And do not insult one another and do not call each other by [offensive] nicknames. Wretched is the name [i.e., mention] of disobedience after [one's] faith. And whoever does not repent - then it is those who are the wrongdoers.

r: The Rooms 49:12
t: O you who have believed, avoid much [negative] assumption. Indeed, some assumption is sin. And do not spy or backbite each other. Would one of you like to eat the flesh of his brother when dead? You would detest it. And fear Allāh; indeed, Allāh is Accepting of Repentance and Merciful.

r: The Rooms 49:13
t: O mankind, indeed We have created you from male and female and made you peoples and tribes that you may know one another. Indeed, the most noble of you in the sight of Allāh is the most righteous of you. Indeed, Allāh is Knowing and Aware.

r: The Rooms 49:14
t: The bedouins say, "We have believed." Say, "You have not [yet] believed; but say [instead], 'We have submitted,' for faith has not yet entered your hearts. And if you obey Allāh and His Messenger, He will not deprive you from your deeds of anything. Indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful."

r: The Rooms 49:15
t: The believers are only the ones who have believed in Allāh and His Messenger and then doubt not but strive with their properties and their lives in the cause of Allāh. It is those who are the truthful.

r: The Rooms 49:16
t: Say, "Would you acquaint Allāh with your religion while Allāh knows whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth, and Allāh is Knowing of all things?"

r: The Rooms 49:17
t: They consider it a favor to you that they have accepted Islām. Say, "Do not consider your Islām a favor to me. Rather, Allāh has conferred favor upon you that He has guided you to the faith, if you should be truthful."

r: The Rooms 49:18
t: Indeed, Allāh knows the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth. And Allāh is Seeing of what you do.

r: Qaf 50:1
t: Qāf. By the honored Qur’ān...

r: Qaf 50:2
t: But they wonder that there has come to them a warner from among themselves, and the disbelievers say, "This is an amazing thing.

r: Qaf 50:3
t: When we have died and have become dust, [we will return to life]? That is a distant [i.e., unlikely] return."

r: Qaf 50:4
t: We know what the earth diminishes [i.e., consumes] of them, and with Us is a retaining record.

r: Qaf 50:5
t: But they denied the truth when it came to them, so they are in a confused condition.

r: Qaf 50:6
t: Have they not looked at the heaven above them - how We structured it and adorned it and [how] it has no rifts?

r: Qaf 50:7
t: And the earth - We spread it out and cast therein firmly set mountains and made grow therein [something] of every beautiful kind,

r: Qaf 50:8
t: Giving insight and a reminder for every servant who turns [to Allāh].

r: Qaf 50:9
t: And We have sent down blessed rain from the sky and made grow thereby gardens and grain from the harvest
And lofty palm trees having fruit arranged in layers -
As provision for the servants, and We have given life thereby to a dead land. Thus is the emergence [i.e., resurrection].
The people of Noah denied before them, and the companions of the well and Thamūd
And ʿAad and Pharaoh and the brothers [i.e., people] of Lot
And the companions of the thicket and the people of Tubbaʿ. All denied the messengers, so My threat was justly fulfilled.
Did We fail in the first creation? But they are in confusion over a new creation.
And We have already created man and know what his soul whispers to him, and We are closer to him than [his] jugular vein.
When the two receivers [i.e., recording angels] receive, seated on the right and on the left.
He [i.e., man] utters no word except that with him is an observer prepared [to record].
And the intoxication of death will bring the truth; that is what you were trying to avoid.
And the Horn will be blown. That is the Day of [carrying out] the threat.
And every soul will come, with it a driver and a witness.
[It will be said], "You were certainly in unmindfulness of this, and We have removed from you your cover, so your sight, this Day, is sharp."
And his companion, [the angel], will say, "This [record] is what is with me, prepared."
[Allāh will say], "Throw into Hell every obstinate disbeliever,
Preventer of good, aggressor, and doubter,
Who made [as equal] with Allāh another deity; then throw him into the severe punishment."
His [devil] companion will say, "Our Lord, I did not make him transgress, but he [himself] was in extreme error."
[Allāh] will say, "Do not dispute before Me, while I had already presented to you the threat [i.e., warning].
The word [i.e., decree] will not be changed with Me, and never will I be unjust to the servants."
On the Day We will say to Hell, "Have you been filled?" and it will say, "Are there some more,"
And Paradise will be brought near to the righteous, not far,
[It will be said], "This is what you were promised - for every returner [to Allāh] and keeper [of His covenant].
Who feared the Most Merciful in the unseen and came with a heart returning [in repentance].
Enter it in peace. This is the Day of Eternity."
They will have whatever they wish therein, and with Us is more.
And how many a generation before them did We destroy who were greater than them in [striking] power and had explored throughout the lands. Is there any place of escape?
Indeed in that is a reminder for whoever has a heart or who listens while he is present [in mind].
And We did certainly create the heavens and earth and what is between them in six days, and there touched Us no weariness.
So be patient, [O Muḥammad], over what they say and exalt [Allāh] with praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting,
And [in part] of the night exalt Him and after prostration [i.e., prayer].
And listen on the Day when the Caller will call out from a place that is near -
The Day they will hear the blast [of the Horn] in truth. That is the Day of Emergence [from the graves].
Indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and to Us is the destination
On the Day the earth breaks away from them [and they emerge] rapidly; that is a gathering easy for Us.
We are most knowing of what they say, and you are not over them a tyrant. But remind by the Qur’ān whoever fears My threat.

r: The Winnowing Winds 51:1
t: By the [winds] scattering [dust], dispersing [it]

r: The Winnowing Winds 51:2
t: And the [clouds] carrying a load [of water]

r: The Winnowing Winds 51:3
t: And the ships sailing with ease

r: The Winnowing Winds 51:4
t: And the [angels] apportioning [each] matter,

r: The Winnowing Winds 51:5
t: Indeed, what you are promised is true.

r: The Winnowing Winds 51:6
t: And indeed, the recompense is to occur.

r: The Winnowing Winds 51:7
t: By the heaven containing pathways,

r: The Winnowing Winds 51:8
t: Indeed, you are in differing speech.

r: The Winnowing Winds 51:9
t: Deluded away from it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is he who is deluded.

r: The Winnowing Winds 51:10
t: Destroyed are the misinformers

r: The Winnowing Winds 51:11
t: Who are within a flood [of confusion] and heedless.

r: The Winnowing Winds 51:12
t: They ask, "When is the Day of Recompense?"

r: The Winnowing Winds 51:13
t: [It is] the Day they will be tormented over the Fire.

r: The Winnowing Winds 51:14
t: [And will be told], "Taste your torment. This is that for which you were impatient."

r: The Winnowing Winds 51:15
t: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and springs,

r: The Winnowing Winds 51:16
t: Accepting what their Lord has given them. Indeed, they were before that doers of good.

r: The Winnowing Winds 51:17
t: They used to sleep but little of the night,

r: The Winnowing Winds 51:18
t: And in the hours before dawn they would ask forgiveness,

r: The Winnowing Winds 51:19
t: And from their properties was [given] the right of the [needy] petitioner and the deprived.

r: The Winnowing Winds 51:20
t: And on the earth are signs for the certain [in faith]

r: The Winnowing Winds 51:21
t: And in yourselves. Then will you not see?

r: The Winnowing Winds 51:22
t: And in the heaven is your provision and whatever you are promised.

r: The Winnowing Winds 51:23
t: Then by the Lord of the heaven and earth, indeed, it is truth - just as [sure as] it is that you are speaking.

r: The Winnowing Winds 51:24
t: Has there reached you the story of the honored guests of Abraham? -

r: The Winnowing Winds 51:25
t: When they entered upon him and said, "[We greet you with] peace." He answered, "[And upon you] peace; [you are] a people unknown."

r: The Winnowing Winds 51:26
t: Then he went to his family and came with a fat [roasted] calf.

r: The Winnowing Winds 51:27
t: And placed it near them; he said, "Will you not eat?"

r: The Winnowing Winds 51:28
t: And he felt from them apprehension. They said, "Fear not," and gave him good tidings of a learned boy.

r: The Winnowing Winds 51:29
t: And his wife approached with a cry [of alarm] and struck her face and said, "[I am] a barren old woman!"

r: The Winnowing Winds 51:30
t: They said, "Thus has said your Lord; indeed, He is the Wise, the Knowing."

r: The Winnowing Winds 51:31
t: [Abraham] said, "Then what is your business [here], O messengers?"

r: The Winnowing Winds 51:32
t: They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals

r: The Winnowing Winds 51:33
t: To send down upon them stones of clay,

r: The Winnowing Winds 51:34
t: Marked in the presence of your Lord for the transgressors."

r: The Winnowing Winds 51:35
t: So We brought out whoever was in them [i.e., the cities] of the believers.

r: The Winnowing Winds 51:36
t: And We found not within them other than a [single] house of Muslims.

r: The Winnowing Winds 51:37
t: And We left therein a sign for those who fear the painful punishment.

r: The Winnowing Winds 51:38
t: And in Moses [was a sign], when We sent him to Pharaoh with clear authority.

r: The Winnowing Winds 51:39
t: But he turned away with his supporters and said, "A magician or a madman."

r: The Winnowing Winds 51:40
t: So We took him and his soldiers and cast them into the sea, and he was blameworthy.

r: The Winnowing Winds 51:41
t: And in ʿAad [was a sign], when We sent against them the barren wind.

r: The Winnowing Winds 51:42
t: It left nothing of what it came upon but that it made it like disintegrated ruins.

r: The Winnowing Winds 51:43
t: And in Thamūd, when it was said to them, "Enjoy yourselves for a time."

r: The Winnowing Winds 51:44
t: But they were insolent toward the command of their Lord, so the thunderbolt seized them while they were looking on.

r: The Winnowing Winds 51:45
t: And they were unable to arise, nor could they defend themselves.

r: The Winnowing Winds 51:46
t: And [We destroyed] the people of Noah before; indeed, they were a people defiantly disobedient.

r: The Winnowing Winds 51:47
t: And the heaven We constructed with strength, and indeed, We are [its] expander.

r: The Winnowing Winds 51:48
t: And the earth We have spread out, and excellent is the preparer.

r: The Winnowing Winds 51:49
t: And of all things We created two mates [i.e., counterparts]; perhaps you will remember.

r: The Winnowing Winds 51:50
t: So flee to Allāh. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.

r: The Winnowing Winds 51:51
t: And do not make [as equal] with Allāh another deity. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.

r: The Winnowing Winds 51:52
t: Similarly, there came not to those before them any messenger except that they said, "A magician or a madman."

r: The Winnowing Winds 51:53
t: Did they suggest it to them? Rather, they [themselves] are a transgressing people.

r: The Winnowing Winds 51:54
t: So leave them, [O Muḥammad], for you are not to be blamed.

r: The Winnowing Winds 51:55
t: And remind, for indeed, the reminder benefits the believers.

r: The Winnowing Winds 51:56
t: And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me.

r: The Winnowing Winds 51:57
t: I do not want from them any provision, nor do I want them to feed Me.

r: The Winnowing Winds 51:58
t: Indeed, it is Allāh who is the [continual] Provider, the firm possessor of strength.

r: The Winnowing Winds 51:59
t: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a portion [of punishment] like the portion of their companions [i.e., predecessors], so let them not impatiently urge Me.

r: The Winnowing Winds 51:60
t: And woe to those who have disbelieved from their Day which they are promised.

r: The Mount 52:1
t: By the mount

r: The Mount 52:2
t: And [by] a Book inscribed

r: The Mount 52:3
t: In parchment spread open

r: The Mount 52:4
t: And [by] the frequented House

r: The Mount 52:5
t: And [by] the ceiling [i.e., heaven] raised high

r: The Mount 52:6
t: And [by] the sea set on fire,

r: The Mount 52:7
t: Indeed, the punishment of your Lord will occur.

r: The Mount 52:8
t: Of it there is no preventer.

r: The Mount 52:9
t: On the Day the heaven will sway with circular motion

r: The Mount 52:10
t: And the mountains will pass on, departing -

r: The Mount 52:11
t: Then woe, that Day, to the deniers,

r: The Mount 52:12
t: Who are in [empty] discourse amusing themselves.

r: The Mount 52:13
t: The Day they are thrust toward the fire of Hell with a [violent] thrust, [its angels will say],

r: The Mount 52:14
t: "This is the Fire which you used to deny.

r: The Mount 52:15
t: Then is this magic, or do you not see?

r: The Mount 52:16
t: [Enter to] burn therein; then be patient or impatient - it is all the same for you. You are only being recompensed [for] what you used to do."

r: The Mount 52:17
t: Indeed, the righteous will be in gardens and pleasure,

r: The Mount 52:18
t: Enjoying what their Lord has given them, and their Lord protected them from the punishment of Hellfire.

r: The Mount 52:19
t: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."

r: The Mount 52:20
t: They will be reclining on thrones lined up, and We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.

r: The Mount 52:21
t: And those who believed and whose descendants followed them in faith - We will join with them their descendants, and We will not deprive them of anything of their deeds. Every person, for what he earned, is retained.

r: The Mount 52:22
t: And We will provide them with fruit and meat from whatever they desire.

r: The Mount 52:23
t: They will exchange with one another a cup [of wine] wherein [results] no ill speech or commission of sin.

r: The Mount 52:24
t: There will circulate among them [servant] boys [especially] for them, as if they were pearls well-protected.

r: The Mount 52:25
t: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.

r: The Mount 52:26
t: They will say, "Indeed, we were previously among our people fearful [of displeasing Allāh].

r: The Mount 52:27
t: So Allāh conferred favor upon us and protected us from the punishment of the Scorching Fire.

r: The Mount 52:28
t: Indeed, we used to supplicate Him before. Indeed, it is He who is the Beneficent, the Merciful."

r: The Mount 52:29
t: So remind, [O Muḥammad], for you are not, by the favor of your Lord, a soothsayer or a madman.

r: The Mount 52:30
t: Or do they say [of you], "A poet for whom we await a misfortune of time"?

r: The Mount 52:31
t: Say, "Wait, for indeed I am, with you, among the waiters."

r: The Mount 52:32
t: Or do their minds command them to [say] this, or are they a transgressing people?

r: The Mount 52:33
t: Or do they say, "He has made it up"? Rather, they do not believe.

r: The Mount 52:34
t: Then let them produce a statement like it, if they should be truthful.

r: The Mount 52:35
t: Or were they created by nothing, or were they the creators [of themselves]?

r: The Mount 52:36
t: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Rather, they are not certain.

r: The Mount 52:37
t: Or have they the depositories [containing the provision] of your Lord? Or are they the controllers [of them]?

r: The Mount 52:38
t: Or have they a stairway [into the heaven] upon which they listen? Then let their listener produce a clear authority [i.e., proof].

r: The Mount 52:39
t: Or has He daughters while you have sons?

r: The Mount 52:40
t: Or do you, [O Muḥammad], ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down?

r: The Mount 52:41
t: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down?

r: The Mount 52:42
t: Or do they intend a plan? But those who disbelieve - they are the object of a plan.

r: The Mount 52:43
t: Or have they a deity other than Allāh? Exalted is Allāh above whatever they associate with Him.

r: The Mount 52:44
t: And if they were to see a fragment from the sky falling, they would say, "[It is merely] clouds heaped up."

r: The Mount 52:45
t: So leave them until they meet their Day in which they will be struck insensible -

r: The Mount 52:46
t: The Day their plan will not avail them at all, nor will they be helped.

r: The Mount 52:47
t: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a punishment before that, but most of them do not know.

r: The Mount 52:48
t: And be patient, [O Muḥammad], for the decision of your Lord, for indeed, you are in Our eyes [i.e., sight]. And exalt [Allāh] with praise of your Lord when you arise

r: The Mount 52:49
t: And in a part of the night exalt Him and after [the setting of] the stars.

r: The Star 53:1
t: By the star when it descends,

r: The Star 53:2
t: Your companion [i.e., Muḥammad] has not strayed, nor has he erred,

r: The Star 53:3
t: Nor does he speak from [his own] inclination.

r: The Star 53:4
t: It is not but a revelation revealed,

r: The Star 53:5
t: Taught to him by one intense in strength [i.e., Gabriel] -

r: The Star 53:6
t: One of soundness. And he rose to [his] true form

r: The Star 53:7
t: While he was in the higher [part of the] horizon.

r: The Star 53:8
t: Then he approached and descended

r: The Star 53:9
t: And was at a distance of two bow lengths or nearer.

r: The Star 53:10
t: And he revealed to His Servant what he revealed [i.e., conveyed].

r: The Star 53:11
t: The heart did not lie [about] what it saw.

r: The Star 53:12
t: So will you dispute with him over what he saw?

r: The Star 53:13
t: And he certainly saw him in another descent

r: The Star 53:14
t: At the Lote Tree of the Utmost Boundary -

r: The Star 53:15
t: Near it is the Garden of Refuge [i.e., Paradise] -

r: The Star 53:16
t: When there covered the Lote Tree that which covered [it].

r: The Star 53:17
t: The sight [of the Prophet (ﷺ)] did not swerve, nor did it transgress [its limit].

r: The Star 53:18
t: He certainly saw of the greatest signs of his Lord.

r: The Star 53:19
t: So have you considered al-Lāt and al-ʿUzzā?

r: The Star 53:20
t: And Manāt, the third - the other one?

r: The Star 53:21
t: Is the male for you and for Him the female?

r: The Star 53:22
t: That, then, is an unjust division.

r: The Star 53:23
t: They are not but [mere] names you have named them - you and your forefathers - for which Allāh has sent down no authority. They follow not except assumption and what [their] souls desire, and there has already come to them from their Lord guidance.

r: The Star 53:24
t: Or is there for man whatever he wishes?

r: The Star 53:25
t: Rather, to Allāh belongs the Hereafter and the first [life].

r: The Star 53:26
t: And how many angels there are in the heavens whose intercession will not avail at all except [only] after Allāh has permitted [it] to whom He wills and approves.

r: The Star 53:27
t: Indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter name the angels female names,

r: The Star 53:28
t: And they have thereof no knowledge. They follow not except assumption, and indeed, assumption avails not against the truth at all.

r: The Star 53:29
t: So turn away from whoever turns his back on Our message and desires not except the worldly life.

r: The Star 53:30
t: That is their sum of knowledge. Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who strays from His way, and He is most knowing of who is guided.

r: The Star 53:31
t: And to Allāh belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth - that He may recompense those who do evil with [the penalty of] what they have done and recompense those who do good with the best [reward] -

r: The Star 53:32
t: Those who avoid the major sins and immoralities, only [committing] slight ones. Indeed, your Lord is vast in forgiveness. He was most knowing of you when He produced you from the earth and when you were fetuses in the wombs of your mothers. So do not claim yourselves to be pure; He is most knowing of who fears Him.

r: The Star 53:33
t: Have you seen the one who turned away

r: The Star 53:34
t: And gave a little and [then] refrained?

r: The Star 53:35
t: Does he have knowledge of the unseen, so he sees?

r: The Star 53:36
t: Or has he not been informed of what was in the scriptures of Moses

r: The Star 53:37
t: And [of] Abraham, who fulfilled [his obligations] -

r: The Star 53:38
t: That no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another

r: The Star 53:39
t: And that there is not for man except that [good] for which he strives

r: The Star 53:40
t: And that his effort is going to be seen -

r: The Star 53:41
t: Then he will be recompensed for it with the fullest recompense -

r: The Star 53:42
t: And that to your Lord is the finality

r: The Star 53:43
t: And that it is He who makes [one] laugh and weep

r: The Star 53:44
t: And that it is He who causes death and gives life

r: The Star 53:45
t: And that He creates the two mates - the male and female -

r: The Star 53:46
t: From a sperm-drop when it is emitted

r: The Star 53:47
t: And that [incumbent] upon Him is the other [i.e., next] creation.

r: The Star 53:48
t: And that it is He who enriches and suffices

r: The Star 53:49
t: And that it is He who is the Lord of Sirius.

r: The Star 53:50
t: And that He destroyed the first [people of] ʿAad.

r: The Star 53:51
t: And Thamūd - and He did not spare [them] -

r: The Star 53:52
t: And the people of Noah before. Indeed, it was they who were [even] more unjust and oppressing.

r: The Star 53:53
t: And the overturned towns He hurled down.

r: The Star 53:54
t: And covered them by that which He covered.

r: The Star 53:55
t: Then which of the favors of your Lord do you doubt?

r: The Star 53:56
t: This [Prophet (ﷺ)] is a warner from [i.e., like] the former warners.

r: The Star 53:57
t: The Approaching Day has approached.

r: The Star 53:58
t: Of it, [from those] besides Allāh, there is no remover.

r: The Star 53:59
t: Then at this statement do you wonder?

r: The Star 53:60
t: And you laugh and do not weep

r: The Star 53:61
t: While you are proudly sporting?

r: The Star 53:62
t: So prostrate to Allāh and worship [Him].

r: The Moon 54:1
t: The Hour has come near, and the moon has split [in two].

r: The Moon 54:2
t: And if they see a sign [i.e., miracle], they turn away and say, "Passing magic."

r: The Moon 54:3
t: And they denied and followed their inclinations. But for every matter is a [time of] settlement.

r: The Moon 54:4
t: And there has already come to them of information that in which there is deterrence.

r: The Moon 54:5
t: Extensive wisdom - but warning does not avail [them].

r: The Moon 54:6
t: So leave them, [O Muḥammad]. The Day the Caller calls to something forbidding,

r: The Moon 54:7
t: Their eyes humbled, they will emerge from the graves as if they were locusts spreading,

r: The Moon 54:8
t: Racing ahead toward the Caller. The disbelievers will say, "This is a difficult Day."

r: The Moon 54:9
t: The people of Noah denied before them, and they denied Our servant and said, "A madman," and he was repelled.

r: The Moon 54:10
t: So he invoked his Lord, "Indeed, I am overpowered, so help."

r: The Moon 54:11
t: Then We opened the gates of the heaven with rain pouring down

r: The Moon 54:12
t: And caused the earth to burst with springs, and the waters met for a matter already predestined.

r: The Moon 54:13
t: And We carried him on a [construction of] planks and nails,

r: The Moon 54:14
t: Sailing under Our observation as reward for he who had been denied.

r: The Moon 54:15
t: And We left it as a sign, so is there any who will remember?

r: The Moon 54:16
t: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.

r: The Moon 54:17
t: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?

r: The Moon 54:18
t: ʿAad denied; and how [severe] were My punishment and warning.

r: The Moon 54:19
t: Indeed, We sent upon them a screaming wind on a day of continuous misfortune,

r: The Moon 54:20
t: Extracting the people as if they were trunks of palm trees uprooted.

r: The Moon 54:21
t: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.

r: The Moon 54:22
t: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?

r: The Moon 54:23
t: Thamūd denied the warning.

r: The Moon 54:24
t: And said, "Is it one human being among us that we should follow? Indeed, we would then be in error and madness.

r: The Moon 54:25
t: Has the message been sent down upon him from among us? Rather, he is an insolent liar."

r: The Moon 54:26
t: They will know tomorrow who is the insolent liar.

r: The Moon 54:27
t: Indeed, We are sending the she-camel as trial for them, so watch them and be patient.

r: The Moon 54:28
t: And inform them that the water is shared between them, each [day of] drink attended [by turn].

r: The Moon 54:29
t: But they called their companion, and he dared and hamstrung [her].

r: The Moon 54:30
t: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.

r: The Moon 54:31
t: Indeed, We sent upon them one shriek [i.e., blast from the sky], and they became like the dry twig fragments of an [animal] pen.

r: The Moon 54:32
t: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?

r: The Moon 54:33
t: The people of Lot denied the warning.

r: The Moon 54:34
t: Indeed, We sent upon them a storm of stones, except the family of Lot - We saved them before dawn.

r: The Moon 54:35
t: As favor from Us. Thus do We reward he who is grateful.

r: The Moon 54:36
t: And he had already warned them of Our assault, but they disputed the warning.

r: The Moon 54:37
t: And they had demanded from him his guests, but We obliterated their eyes, [saying], "Taste My punishment and warning."

r: The Moon 54:38
t: And there came upon them by morning an abiding punishment.

r: The Moon 54:39
t: So taste My punishment and warning.

r: The Moon 54:40
t: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?

r: The Moon 54:41
t: And there certainly came to the people of Pharaoh warning.

r: The Moon 54:42
t: They denied Our signs, all of them, so We seized them with a seizure of one Exalted in Might and Perfect in Ability.

r: The Moon 54:43
t: Are your disbelievers better than those [former ones], or have you immunity in the scriptures?

r: The Moon 54:44
t: Or do they say, "We are an assembly supporting [each other]"?

r: The Moon 54:45
t: [Their] assembly will be defeated, and they will turn their backs [in retreat].

r: The Moon 54:46
t: But the Hour is their appointment [for due punishment], and the Hour is more disastrous and more bitter.

r: The Moon 54:47
t: Indeed, the criminals are in error and madness..

r: The Moon 54:48
t: The Day they are dragged into the Fire on their faces [it will be said], "Taste the touch of Saqar."

r: The Moon 54:49
t: Indeed, all things We created with predestination.

r: The Moon 54:50
t: And Our command is but one, like a glance of the eye.

r: The Moon 54:51
t: And We have already destroyed your kinds, so is there any who will remember?

r: The Moon 54:52
t: And everything they did is in written records.

r: The Moon 54:53
t: And every small and great [thing] is inscribed.

r: The Moon 54:54
t: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and rivers,

r: The Moon 54:55
t: In a seat of honor near a Sovereign, Perfect in Ability.

r: The Most Merciful 55:1
t: The Most Merciful

r: The Most Merciful 55:2
t: Taught the Qur’ān,

r: The Most Merciful 55:3
t: Created man,

r: The Most Merciful 55:4
t: [And] taught him eloquence.

r: The Most Merciful 55:5
t: The sun and the moon [move] by precise calculation,

r: The Most Merciful 55:6
t: And the stars and trees prostrate.

r: The Most Merciful 55:7
t: And the heaven He raised and imposed the balance

r: The Most Merciful 55:8
t: That you not transgress within the balance.

r: The Most Merciful 55:9
t: And establish weight in justice and do not make deficient the balance.

r: The Most Merciful 55:10
t: And the earth He laid [out] for the creatures.

r: The Most Merciful 55:11
t: Therein is fruit and palm trees having sheaths [of dates]

r: The Most Merciful 55:12
t: And grain having husks and scented plants.

r: The Most Merciful 55:13
t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

r: The Most Merciful 55:14
t: He created man from clay like [that of] pottery.

r: The Most Merciful 55:15
t: And He created the jinn from a smokeless flame of fire.

r: The Most Merciful 55:16
t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

r: The Most Merciful 55:17
t: [He is] Lord of the two sunrises and Lord of the two sunsets.

r: The Most Merciful 55:18
t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

r: The Most Merciful 55:19
t: He released the two seas, meeting [one another];

r: The Most Merciful 55:20
t: Between them is a barrier so neither of them transgresses.

r: The Most Merciful 55:21
t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

r: The Most Merciful 55:22
t: From both of them emerge pearl and coral.

r: The Most Merciful 55:23
t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

r: The Most Merciful 55:24
t: And to Him belong the ships [with sails] elevated in the sea like mountains.

r: The Most Merciful 55:25
t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

r: The Most Merciful 55:26
t: Everyone upon it [i.e., the earth] will perish,

r: The Most Merciful 55:27
t: And there will remain the Face of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.

r: The Most Merciful 55:28
t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

r: The Most Merciful 55:29
t: Whoever is within the heavens and earth asks Him; every day He is in [i.e., bringing about] a matter.

r: The Most Merciful 55:30
t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

r: The Most Merciful 55:31
t: We will attend to you, O prominent beings.

r: The Most Merciful 55:32
t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

r: The Most Merciful 55:33
t: O company of jinn and mankind, if you are able to pass beyond the regions of the heavens and the earth, then pass. You will not pass except by authority [from Allāh].

r: The Most Merciful 55:34
t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

r: The Most Merciful 55:35
t: There will be sent upon you a flame of fire and smoke, and you will not defend yourselves.

r: The Most Merciful 55:36
t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

r: The Most Merciful 55:37
t: And when the heaven is split open and becomes rose-colored like oil -

r: The Most Merciful 55:38
t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

r: The Most Merciful 55:39
t: Then on that Day none will be asked about his sin among men or jinn.

r: The Most Merciful 55:40
t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

r: The Most Merciful 55:41
t: The criminals will be known by their marks, and they will be seized by the forelocks and the feet.

r: The Most Merciful 55:42
t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

r: The Most Merciful 55:43
t: This is Hell, which the criminals deny.

r: The Most Merciful 55:44
t: They will circulate between it and scalding water, heated [to the utmost degree].

r: The Most Merciful 55:45
t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

r: The Most Merciful 55:46
t: But for he who has feared the position of his Lord are two gardens -

r: The Most Merciful 55:47
t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

r: The Most Merciful 55:48
t: Having [spreading] branches.

r: The Most Merciful 55:49
t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

r: The Most Merciful 55:50
t: In both of them are two springs, flowing.

r: The Most Merciful 55:51
t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

r: The Most Merciful 55:52
t: In both of them are of every fruit, two kinds.

r: The Most Merciful 55:53
t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

r: The Most Merciful 55:54
t: [They are] reclining on beds whose linings are of silk brocade, and the fruit of the two gardens is hanging low.

r: The Most Merciful 55:55
t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

r: The Most Merciful 55:56
t: In them are women limiting [their] glances, untouched before them by man or jinnī -

r: The Most Merciful 55:57
t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

r: The Most Merciful 55:58
t: As if they were rubies and coral.

r: The Most Merciful 55:59
t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

r: The Most Merciful 55:60
t: Is the reward for good [anything] but good?

r: The Most Merciful 55:61
t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

r: The Most Merciful 55:62
t: And below them both [in excellence] are two [other] gardens -

r: The Most Merciful 55:63
t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

r: The Most Merciful 55:64
t: Dark green [in color].

r: The Most Merciful 55:65
t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

r: The Most Merciful 55:66
t: In both of them are two springs, spouting.

r: The Most Merciful 55:67
t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

r: The Most Merciful 55:68
t: In both of them are fruit and palm trees and pomegranates.

r: The Most Merciful 55:69
t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

r: The Most Merciful 55:70
t: In them are good and beautiful women -

r: The Most Merciful 55:71
t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

r: The Most Merciful 55:72
t: Fair ones reserved in pavilions -

r: The Most Merciful 55:73
t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

r: The Most Merciful 55:74
t: Untouched before them by man or jinnī -

r: The Most Merciful 55:75
t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

r: The Most Merciful 55:76
t: Reclining on green cushions and beautiful fine carpets.

r: The Most Merciful 55:77
t: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

r: The Most Merciful 55:78
t: Blessed is the name of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.

r: The Inevitable 56:1
t: When the Occurrence occurs,

r: The Inevitable 56:2
t: There is, at its occurrence, no denial.

r: The Inevitable 56:3
t: It will bring down [some] and raise up [others].

r: The Inevitable 56:4
t: When the earth is shaken with convulsion

r: The Inevitable 56:5
t: And the mountains are broken down, crumbling

r: The Inevitable 56:6
t: And become dust dispersing,

r: The Inevitable 56:7
t: And you become [of] three kinds:

r: The Inevitable 56:8
t: Then the companions of the right - what are the companions of the right?

r: The Inevitable 56:9
t: And the companions of the left - what are companions of the left?

r: The Inevitable 56:10
t: And the forerunners, the forerunners -

r: The Inevitable 56:11
t: Those are the ones brought near [to Allāh]

r: The Inevitable 56:12
t: In the Gardens of Pleasure,

r: The Inevitable 56:13
t: A [large] company of the former peoples

r: The Inevitable 56:14
t: And a few of the later peoples,

r: The Inevitable 56:15
t: On thrones woven [with ornament],

r: The Inevitable 56:16
t: Reclining on them, facing each other.

r: The Inevitable 56:17
t: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal.

r: The Inevitable 56:18
t: With vessels, pitchers and a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring -

r: The Inevitable 56:19
t: No headache will they have therefrom, nor will they be intoxicated -

r: The Inevitable 56:20
t: And fruit of what they select

r: The Inevitable 56:21
t: And the meat of fowl, from whatever they desire.

r: The Inevitable 56:22
t: And [for them are] fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes,

r: The Inevitable 56:23
t: The likenesses of pearls well-protected,

r: The Inevitable 56:24
t: As reward for what they used to do.

r: The Inevitable 56:25
t: They will not hear therein ill speech or commission of sin -

r: The Inevitable 56:26
t: Only a saying [of] peace, peace.

r: The Inevitable 56:27
t: The companions of the right - what are the companions of the right?

r: The Inevitable 56:28
t: [They will be] among lote trees with thorns removed.

r: The Inevitable 56:29
t: And [banana] trees layered [with fruit].

r: The Inevitable 56:30
t: And shade extended.

r: The Inevitable 56:31
t: And water poured out

r: The Inevitable 56:32
t: And fruit, abundant [and varied],

r: The Inevitable 56:33
t: Neither limited [to season] nor forbidden,

r: The Inevitable 56:34
t: And [upon] beds raised high.

r: The Inevitable 56:35
t: Indeed, We have produced them [i.e., the women of Paradise] in a [new] creation

r: The Inevitable 56:36
t: And made them virgins,

r: The Inevitable 56:37
t: Devoted [to their husbands] and of equal age,

r: The Inevitable 56:38
t: For the companions of the right [who are]

r: The Inevitable 56:39
t: A company of the former peoples

r: The Inevitable 56:40
t: And a company of the later peoples.

r: The Inevitable 56:41
t: And the companions of the left - what are the companions of the left?

r: The Inevitable 56:42
t: [They will be] in scorching fire and scalding water

r: The Inevitable 56:43
t: And a shade of black smoke,

r: The Inevitable 56:44
t: Neither cool nor beneficial.

r: The Inevitable 56:45
t: Indeed they were, before that, indulging in affluence,

r: The Inevitable 56:46
t: And they used to persist in the great violation,

r: The Inevitable 56:47
t: And they used to say, "When we die and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?

r: The Inevitable 56:48
t: And our forefathers [as well]?"

r: The Inevitable 56:49
t: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Indeed, the former and later peoples

r: The Inevitable 56:50
t: Are to be gathered together for the appointment of a known Day."

r: The Inevitable 56:51
t: Then indeed you, O those astray [who are] deniers,

r: The Inevitable 56:52
t: Will be eating from trees of zaqqūm

r: The Inevitable 56:53
t: And filling with it your bellies

r: The Inevitable 56:54
t: And drinking on top of it from scalding water.

r: The Inevitable 56:55
t: And will drink as the drinking of thirsty camels.

r: The Inevitable 56:56
t: That is their accommodation on the Day of Recompense.

r: The Inevitable 56:57
t: We have created you, so why do you not believe?

r: The Inevitable 56:58
t: Have you seen that which you emit?

r: The Inevitable 56:59
t: Is it you who creates it, or are We the Creator?

r: The Inevitable 56:60
t: We have decreed death among you, and We are not to be outdone

r: The Inevitable 56:61
t: In that We will change your likenesses and produce you in that [form] which you do not know.

r: The Inevitable 56:62
t: And you have already known the first creation, so will you not remember?

r: The Inevitable 56:63
t: And have you seen that [seed] which you sow?

r: The Inevitable 56:64
t: Is it you who makes it grow, or are We the grower?

r: The Inevitable 56:65
t: If We willed, We could make it [dry] debris, and you would remain in wonder,

r: The Inevitable 56:66
t: [Saying], "Indeed, we are [now] in debt;

r: The Inevitable 56:67
t: Rather, we have been deprived."

r: The Inevitable 56:68
t: And have you seen the water that you drink?

r: The Inevitable 56:69
t: Is it you who brought it down from the clouds, or is it We who bring it down?

r: The Inevitable 56:70
t: If We willed, We could make it bitter, so why are you not grateful?

r: The Inevitable 56:71
t: And have you seen the fire that you ignite?

r: The Inevitable 56:72
t: Is it you who produced its tree, or are We the producer?

r: The Inevitable 56:73
t: We have made it a reminder and provision for the travelers,

r: The Inevitable 56:74
t: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.

r: The Inevitable 56:75
t: Then I swear by the setting of the stars,

r: The Inevitable 56:76
t: And indeed, it is an oath - if you could know - [most] great.

r: The Inevitable 56:77
t: Indeed, it is a noble Qur’ān.

r: The Inevitable 56:78
t: In a Register well-protected;.

r: The Inevitable 56:79
t: None touch it except the purified [i.e., the angels].

r: The Inevitable 56:80
t: [It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.

r: The Inevitable 56:81
t: Then is it to this statement that you are indifferent

r: The Inevitable 56:82
t: And make [the thanks for] your provision that you deny [the Provider]?

r: The Inevitable 56:83
t: Then why, when it [i.e., the soul at death] reaches the throat

r: The Inevitable 56:84
t: And you are at that time looking on -

r: The Inevitable 56:85
t: And We [i.e., Our angels] are nearer to him than you, but you do not see -

r: The Inevitable 56:86
t: Then why do you not, if you are not to be recompensed,

r: The Inevitable 56:87
t: Bring it back, if you should be truthful?

r: The Inevitable 56:88
t: And if he [i.e., the deceased] was of those brought near [to Allāh],

r: The Inevitable 56:89
t: Then [for him is] rest and bounty and a garden of pleasure.

r: The Inevitable 56:90
t: And if he was of the companions of the right,

r: The Inevitable 56:91
t: Then [the angels will say], "Peace for you; [you are] from the companions of the right."

r: The Inevitable 56:92
t: But if he was of the deniers [who were] astray,

r: The Inevitable 56:93
t: Then [for him is] accommodation of scalding water

r: The Inevitable 56:94
t: And burning in Hellfire.

r: The Inevitable 56:95
t: Indeed, this is the true certainty,

r: The Inevitable 56:96
t: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.

r: The Iron 57:1
t: Whatever is in the heavens and earth exalts Allāh, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

r: The Iron 57:2
t: His is the dominion of the heavens and earth. He gives life and causes death, and He is over all things competent.

r: The Iron 57:3
t: He is the First and the Last, the Ascendant and the Intimate, and He is, of all things, Knowing.

r: The Iron 57:4
t: It is He who created the heavens and earth in six days and then established Himself above the Throne. He knows what penetrates into the earth and what emerges from it and what descends from the heaven and what ascends therein; and He is with you wherever you are. And Allāh, of what you do, is Seeing.

r: The Iron 57:5
t: His is the dominion of the heavens and earth. And to Allāh are returned [all] matters.

r: The Iron 57:6
t: He causes the night to enter the day and causes the day to enter the night, and He is Knowing of that within the breasts.

r: The Iron 57:7
t: Believe in Allāh and His Messenger and spend out of that in which He has made you successive inheritors. For those who have believed among you and spent, there will be a great reward.

r: The Iron 57:8
t: And why do you not believe in Allāh while the Messenger invites you to believe in your Lord and He has taken your covenant, if you should [truly] be believers?

r: The Iron 57:9
t: It is He who sends down upon His Servant [Muḥammad (ﷺ)] verses of clear evidence that He may bring you out from darknesses into the light. And indeed, Allāh is to you Kind and Merciful.

r: The Iron 57:10
t: And why do you not spend in the cause of Allāh while to Allāh belongs the heritage of the heavens and the earth? Not equal among you are those who spent before the conquest [of Makkah] and fought [and those who did so after it]. Those are greater in degree than they who spent afterwards and fought. But to all Allāh has promised the best [reward]. And Allāh, of what you do, is Aware.

r: The Iron 57:11
t: Who is it that would loan Allāh a goodly loan so He will multiply it for him and he will have a noble reward?

r: The Iron 57:12
t: On the Day you see the believing men and believing women, their light proceeding before them and on their right, [it will be said], "Your good tidings today are [of] gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein you will abide eternally." That is what is the great attainment.

r: The Iron 57:13
t: On the [same] Day the hypocrite men and hypocrite women will say to those who believed, "Wait for us that we may acquire some of your light." It will be said, "Go back behind you and seek light." And a wall will be placed between them with a door, its interior containing mercy, but on the outside of it is torment.

r: The Iron 57:14
t: They [i.e., the hypocrites] will call to them [i.e., the believers], "Were we not with you?" They will say, "Yes, but you afflicted yourselves and awaited [misfortune for us] and doubted, and wishful thinking deluded you until there came the command of Allāh. And the Deceiver [i.e., Satan] deceived you concerning Allāh.

r: The Iron 57:15
t: So today no ransom will be taken from you or from those who disbelieved. Your refuge is the Fire. It is most worthy of you, and wretched is the destination."

r: The Iron 57:16
t: Has the time not come for those who have believed that their hearts should become humbly submissive at the remembrance of Allāh and what has come down of the truth?
