And let them not be like those who were given the Scripture before, and a long period passed over them, so their hearts hardened; and many of them are defiantly disobedient.

r: The Iron 57:17
t: Know that Allāh gives life to the earth after its lifelessness. We have made clear to you the signs; perhaps you will understand.

r: The Iron 57:18
t: Indeed, the men who practice charity and the women who practice charity and [they who] have loaned Allāh a goodly loan - it will be multiplied for them, and they will have a noble reward.

r: The Iron 57:19
t: And those who have believed in Allāh and His messengers - those are [in the ranks of] the supporters of truth and the martyrs, with their Lord. For them is their reward and their light. But those who have disbelieved and denied Our verses - those are the companions of Hellfire.

r: The Iron 57:20
t: Know that the life of this world is but amusement and diversion and adornment and boasting to one another and competition in increase of wealth and children - like the example of a rain whose [resulting] plant growth pleases the tillers; then it dries and you see it turned yellow; then it becomes [scattered] debris. And in the Hereafter is severe punishment and forgiveness from Allāh and approval. And what is the worldly life except the enjoyment of delusion.

r: The Iron 57:21
t: Race [i.e., compete] toward forgiveness from your Lord and a Garden whose width is like the width of the heavens and earth, prepared for those who believed in Allāh and His messengers. That is the bounty of Allāh which He gives to whom He wills, and Allāh is the possessor of great bounty.

r: The Iron 57:22
t: No disaster strikes upon the earth or among yourselves except that it is in a register before We bring it into being - indeed that, for Allāh, is easy -

r: The Iron 57:23
t: In order that you not despair over what has eluded you and not exult [in pride] over what He has given you. And Allāh does not like everyone self-deluded and boastful -

r: The Iron 57:24
t: [Those] who are stingy and enjoin upon people stinginess. And whoever turns away - then indeed, Allāh is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy.

r: The Iron 57:25
t: We have already sent Our messengers with clear evidences and sent down with them the Scripture and the balance that the people may maintain [their affairs] in justice. And We sent down iron, wherein is great military might and benefits for the people, and so that Allāh may make evident those who support Him and His messengers unseen. Indeed, Allāh is Powerful and Exalted in Might.

r: The Iron 57:26
t: And We have already sent Noah and Abraham and placed in their descendants prophethood and scripture; and among them is he who is guided, but many of them are defiantly disobedient.

r: The Iron 57:27
t: Then We sent following their footsteps [i.e., traditions] Our messengers and followed [them] with Jesus, the son of Mary, and gave him the Gospel. And We placed in the hearts of those who followed him compassion and mercy and monasticism, which they innovated; We did not prescribe it for them except [that they did so] seeking the approval of Allāh. But they did not observe it with due observance. So We gave the ones who believed among them their reward, but many of them are defiantly disobedient.

r: The Iron 57:28
t: O you who have believed, fear Allāh and believe in His Messenger; He will [then] give you a double portion of His mercy and make for you a light by which you will walk and forgive you; and Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

r: The Iron 57:29
t: [This is] so that the People of the Scripture may know that they are not able [to obtain] anything from the bounty of Allāh and that [all] bounty is in the hand of Allāh; He gives it to whom He wills. And Allāh is the possessor of great bounty.

r: The Pleading Woman 58:1
t: Certainly has Allāh heard the speech of the one who argues [i.e., pleads] with you, [O Muḥammad], concerning her husband and directs her complaint to Allāh. And Allāh hears your dialogue; indeed, Allāh is Hearing and Seeing.

r: The Pleading Woman 58:2
t: Those who pronounce ẓihār among you [to separate] from their wives - they are not [consequently] their mothers. Their mothers are none but those who gave birth to them. And indeed, they are saying an objectionable statement and a falsehood. But indeed, Allāh is Pardoning and Forgiving.

r: The Pleading Woman 58:3
t: And those who pronounce ẓihār from their wives and then [wish to] go back on what they said - then [there must be] the freeing of a slave before they touch one another. That is what you are admonished thereby; and Allāh is Aware of what you do.

r: The Pleading Woman 58:4
t: And he who does not find [a slave] - then a fast for two months consecutively before they touch one another; and he who is unable - then the feeding of sixty poor persons. That is for you to believe [completely] in Allāh and His Messenger; and those are the limits [set by] Allāh. And for the disbelievers is a painful punishment.

r: The Pleading Woman 58:5
t: Indeed, those who oppose Allāh and His Messenger are abased as those before them were abased. And We have certainly sent down verses of clear evidence. And for the disbelievers is a humiliating punishment

r: The Pleading Woman 58:6
t: On the Day when Allāh will resurrect them all and inform them of what they did. Allāh had enumerated it, while they forgot it; and Allāh is, over all things, Witness.

r: The Pleading Woman 58:7
t: Have you not considered that Allāh knows what is in the heavens and what is on the earth? There are not three in a private conversation but that He is the fourth of them, nor are there five but that He is the sixth of them - and no less than that and no more except that He is with them [in knowledge] wherever they are. Then He will inform them of what they did, on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed Allāh is, of all things, Knowing.

r: The Pleading Woman 58:8
t: Have you not considered those who were forbidden from private conversation [i.e., ridicule and conspiracy] and then return to that which they were forbidden and converse among themselves about sin and aggression and disobedience to the Messenger? And when they come to you, they greet you with that [word] by which Allāh does not greet you and say among themselves, "Why does Allāh not punish us for what we say?" Sufficient for them is Hell, which they will [enter to] burn, and wretched is the destination.

r: The Pleading Woman 58:9
t: O you who have believed, when you converse privately, do not converse about sin and aggression and disobedience to the Messenger but converse about righteousness and piety. And fear Allāh, to whom you will be gathered.

r: The Pleading Woman 58:10
t: Private conversation is only from Satan that he may grieve those who have believed, but he will not harm them at all except by permission of Allāh. And upon Allāh let the believers rely.

r: The Pleading Woman 58:11
t: O you who have believed, when you are told, "Space yourselves" in assemblies, then make space; Allāh will make space for you. And when you are told, "Arise," then arise; Allāh will raise those who have believed among you and those who were given knowledge, by degrees. And Allāh is Aware of what you do.

r: The Pleading Woman 58:12
t: O you who have believed, when you [wish to] privately consult the Messenger, present before your consultation a charity. That is better for you and purer. But if you find not [the means] - then indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

r: The Pleading Woman 58:13
t: Have you feared to present before your consultation charities? Then when you do not and Allāh has forgiven you, then [at least] establish prayer and give zakāh and obey Allāh and His Messenger. And Allāh is Aware of what you do.

r: The Pleading Woman 58:14
t: Have you not considered those who make allies of a people with whom Allāh has become angry? They are neither of you nor of them, and they swear to untruth while they know [they are lying].

r: The Pleading Woman 58:15
t: Allāh has prepared for them a severe punishment. Indeed, it was evil that they were doing.

r: The Pleading Woman 58:16
t: They took their [false] oaths as a cover, so they averted [people] from the way of Allāh, and for them is a humiliating punishment.

r: The Pleading Woman 58:17
t: Never will their wealth or their children avail them against Allāh at all. Those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally

r: The Pleading Woman 58:18
t: On the Day Allāh will resurrect them all, and they will swear to Him as they swear to you and think that they are [standing] on something. Unquestionably, it is they who are the liars.

r: The Pleading Woman 58:19
t: Satan has overcome them and made them forget the remembrance of Allāh. Those are the party of Satan. Unquestionably, the party of Satan - they will be the losers.

r: The Pleading Woman 58:20
t: Indeed, the ones who oppose Allāh and His Messenger - those will be among the most humbled.

r: The Pleading Woman 58:21
t: Allāh has written [i.e., decreed], "I will surely overcome, I and My messengers." Indeed, Allāh is Powerful and Exalted in Might.

r: The Pleading Woman 58:22
t: You will not find a people who believe in Allāh and the Last Day having affection for those who oppose Allāh and His Messenger, even if they were their fathers or their sons or their brothers or their kindred. Those - He has decreed within their hearts faith and supported them with spirit from Him. And We will admit them to gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein they abide eternally. Allāh is pleased with them, and they are pleased with Him - those are the party of Allāh. Unquestionably, the party of Allāh - they are the successful.

r: The Exile 59:1
t: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth exalts Allāh, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

r: The Exile 59:2
t: It is He who expelled the ones who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture from their homes at the first gathering. You did not think they would leave, and they thought that their fortresses would protect them from Allāh; but [the decree of] Allāh came upon them from where they had not expected, and He cast terror into their hearts [so] they destroyed their houses by their [own] hands and the hands of the believers. So take warning, O people of vision.

r: The Exile 59:3
t: And if not that Allāh had decreed for them evacuation, He would have punished them in [this] world, and for them in the Hereafter is the punishment of the Fire.

r: The Exile 59:4
t: That is because they opposed Allāh and His Messenger. And whoever opposes Allāh - then indeed, Allāh is severe in penalty.

r: The Exile 59:5
t: Whatever you have cut down of [their] palm trees or left standing on their trunks - it was by permission of Allāh and so He would disgrace the defiantly disobedient.

r: The Exile 59:6
t: And what Allāh restored [of property] to His Messenger from them - you did not spur for it [in an expedition] any horses or camels, but Allāh gives His messengers power over whom He wills, and Allāh is over all things competent.

r: The Exile 59:7
t: And what Allāh restored to His Messenger from the people of the towns - it is for Allāh and for the Messenger and for [his] near relatives and orphans and the needy and the [stranded] traveler - so that it will not be a perpetual distribution among the rich from among you. And whatever the Messenger has given you - take; and what he has forbidden you - refrain from. And fear Allāh; indeed, Allāh is severe in penalty.

r: The Exile 59:8
t: For the poor emigrants who were expelled from their homes and their properties, seeking bounty from Allāh and [His] approval and supporting [the cause of] Allāh and His Messenger, [there is also a share]. Those are the truthful.

r: The Exile 59:9
t: And [also for] those who were settled in the Home [i.e.,al-Madīnah] and [adopted] the faith before them. They love those who emigrated to them and find not any want in their breasts of what they [i.e., the emigrants] were given but give [them] preference over themselves, even though they are in privation. And whoever is protected from the stinginess of his soul - it is those who will be the successful.

r: The Exile 59:10
t: And [there is a share for] those who come after them, saying, "Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith and put not in our hearts [any] resentment toward those who have believed. Our Lord, indeed You are Kind and Merciful."

r: The Exile 59:11
t: Have you not considered those who practice hypocrisy, saying to their brothers [i.e., associates] who have disbelieved among the People of the Scripture, "If you are expelled, we will surely leave with you, and we will not obey, in regard to you, anyone - ever; and if you are fought, we will surely aid you." But Allāh testifies that they are liars.

r: The Exile 59:12
t: If they are expelled, they will not leave with them, and if they are fought, they will not aid them. And [even] if they should aid them, they will surely turn their backs; then [thereafter] they will not be aided.

r: The Exile 59:13
t: You [believers] are more fearful within their breasts than Allāh. That is because they are a people who do not understand.

r: The Exile 59:14
t: They will not fight you all except within fortified cities or from behind walls. Their violence [i.e., enmity] among themselves is severe. You think they are together, but their hearts are diverse. That is because they are a people who do not reason.

r: The Exile 59:15
t: [Theirs is] like the example of those shortly before them: they tasted the bad consequence of their affair, and they will have a painful punishment.

r: The Exile 59:16
t: [The hypocrites are] like the example of Satan when he says to man, "Disbelieve." But when he disbelieves, he says, "Indeed, I am disassociated from you. Indeed, I fear Allāh, Lord of the worlds."

r: The Exile 59:17
t: So the outcome for both of them is that they will be in the Fire, abiding eternally therein. And that is the recompense of the wrongdoers.

r: The Exile 59:18
t: O you who have believed, fear Allāh. And let every soul look to what it has put forth for tomorrow - and fear Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Aware of what you do.

r: The Exile 59:19
t: And be not like those who forgot Allāh, so He made them forget themselves. Those are the defiantly disobedient.

r: The Exile 59:20
t: Not equal are the companions of the Fire and the companions of Paradise. The companions of Paradise - they are the attainers [of success].

r: The Exile 59:21
t: If We had sent down this Qur’ān upon a mountain, you would have seen it humbled and splitting from fear of Allāh. And these examples We present to the people that perhaps they will give thought.

r: The Exile 59:22
t: He is Allāh, other than whom there is no deity, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed. He is the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.

r: The Exile 59:23
t: He is Allāh, other than whom there is no deity, the Sovereign, the Pure, the Perfection, the Grantor of Security, the Overseer, the Exalted in Might, the Compeller, the Superior. Exalted is Allāh above whatever they associate with Him.

r: The Exile 59:24
t: He is Allāh, the Creator, the Producer, the Fashioner; to Him belong the best names. Whatever is in the heavens and earth is exalting Him. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

r: The Woman to be Examined 60:1
t: O you who have believed, do not take My enemies and your enemies as allies, extending to them affection while they have disbelieved in what came to you of the truth, having driven out the Prophet and yourselves [only] because you believe in Allāh, your Lord. If you have come out for jihād [i.e., fighting or striving] in My cause and seeking means to My approval, [take them not as friends]. You confide to them affection [i.e., instruction], but I am most knowing of what you have concealed and what you have declared. And whoever does it among you has certainly strayed from the soundness of the way.

r: The Woman to be Examined 60:2
t: If they gain dominance over you, they would be [i.e., behave] to you as enemies and extend against you their hands and their tongues with evil, and they wish you would disbelieve.

r: The Woman to be Examined 60:3
t: Never will your relatives or your children benefit you; the Day of Resurrection He will judge between you. And Allāh, of what you do, is Seeing.

r: The Woman to be Examined 60:4
t: There has already been for you an excellent pattern in Abraham and those with him, when they said to their people, "Indeed, we are disassociated from you and from whatever you worship other than Allāh. We have denied you, and there has appeared between us and you animosity and hatred forever until you believe in Allāh alone" - except for the saying of Abraham to his father, "I will surely ask forgiveness for you, but I have not [power to do] for you anything against Allāh. Our Lord, upon You we have relied, and to You we have returned, and to You is the destination.

r: The Woman to be Examined 60:5
t: Our Lord, make us not [objects of] torment for the disbelievers and forgive us, our Lord. Indeed, it is You who is the Exalted in Might, the Wise."

r: The Woman to be Examined 60:6
t: There has certainly been for you in them an excellent pattern for anyone whose hope is in Allāh and the Last Day. And whoever turns away - then indeed, Allāh is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy.

r: The Woman to be Examined 60:7
t: Perhaps Allāh will put, between you and those to whom you have been enemies among them, affection. And Allāh is competent, and Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

r: The Woman to be Examined 60:8
t: Allāh does not forbid you from those who do not fight you because of religion and do not expel you from your homes - from being righteous toward them and acting justly toward them. Indeed, Allāh loves those who act justly.

r: The Woman to be Examined 60:9
t: Allāh only forbids you from those who fight you because of religion and expel you from your homes and aid in your expulsion - [forbids] that you make allies of them. And whoever makes allies of them, then it is those who are the wrongdoers.

r: The Woman to be Examined 60:10
t: O you who have believed, when the believing women come to you as emigrants, examine [i.e., test] them. Allāh is most knowing as to their faith. And if you know them to be believers, then do not return them to the disbelievers; they are not lawful [wives] for them, nor are they lawful [husbands] for them. But give them [i.e., the disbelievers] what they have spent. And there is no blame upon you if you marry them when you have given them their due compensation [i.e., mahr]. And hold not to marriage bonds with disbelieving women, but ask for what you have spent and let them [i.e., the disbelievers] ask for what they have spent. That is the judgement of Allāh; He judges between you. And Allāh is Knowing and Wise.

r: The Woman to be Examined 60:11
t: And if you have lost any of your wives to the disbelievers and you subsequently obtain [something], then give those whose wives have gone the equivalent of what they had spent. And fear Allāh, in whom you are believers.

r: The Woman to be Examined 60:12
t: O Prophet, when the believing women come to you pledging to you that they will not associate anything with Allāh, nor will they steal, nor will they commit unlawful sexual intercourse, nor will they kill their children, nor will they bring forth a slander they have invented between their arms and legs, nor will they disobey you in what is right - then accept their pledge and ask forgiveness for them of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

r: The Woman to be Examined 60:13
t: O you who have believed, do not make allies of a people with whom Allāh has become angry. They have despaired of [reward in] the Hereafter just as the disbelievers have despaired of [meeting] the companions [i.e., inhabitants] of the graves.

r: The Ranks 61:1
t: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth exalts Allāh, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

r: The Ranks 61:2
t: O you who have believed, why do you say what you do not do?

r: The Ranks 61:3
t: Greatly hateful in the sight of Allāh is that you say what you do not do.

r: The Ranks 61:4
t: Indeed, Allāh loves those who fight in His cause in a row as though they are a [single] structure joined firmly.

r: The Ranks 61:5
t: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when Moses said to his people, "O my people, why do you harm me while you certainly know that I am the messenger of Allāh to you?" And when they deviated, Allāh caused their hearts to deviate. And Allāh does not guide the defiantly disobedient people.

r: The Ranks 61:6
t: And [mention] when Jesus, the son of Mary, said, "O Children of Israel, indeed I am the messenger of Allāh to you confirming what came before me of the Torah and bringing good tidings of a messenger to come after me, whose name is Aḥmad." But when he came to them with clear evidences, they said, "This is obvious magic."

r: The Ranks 61:7
t: And who is more unjust than one who invents about Allāh untruth while he is being invited to Islām. And Allāh does not guide the wrongdoing people.

r: The Ranks 61:8
t: They want to extinguish the light of Allāh with their mouths, but Allāh will perfect His light, although the disbelievers dislike it.

r: The Ranks 61:9
t: It is He who sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of truth to manifest it over all religion, although those who associate others with Allāh dislike it.

r: The Ranks 61:10
t: O you who have believed, shall I guide you to a transaction that will save you from a painful punishment?

r: The Ranks 61:11
t: [It is that] you believe in Allāh and His Messenger and strive in the cause of Allāh with your wealth and your lives. That is best for you, if you only knew.

r: The Ranks 61:12
t: He will forgive for you your sins and admit you to gardens beneath which rivers flow and pleasant dwellings in gardens of perpetual residence. That is the great attainment.

r: The Ranks 61:13
t: And [you will obtain] another [favor] that you love - victory from Allāh and an imminent conquest; and give good tidings to the believers.

r: The Ranks 61:14
t: O you who have believed, be supporters of Allāh, as when Jesus, the son of Mary, said to the disciples, "Who are my supporters for Allāh?" The disciples said, "We are supporters of Allāh." And a faction of the Children of Israel believed and a faction disbelieved. So We supported those who believed against their enemy, and they became dominant.

r: The Congregation 62:1
t: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth is exalting Allāh, the Sovereign, the Pure, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

r: The Congregation 62:2
t: It is He who has sent among the unlettered [Arabs] a Messenger from themselves reciting to them His verses and purifying them and teaching them the Book [i.e., the Qur’ān] and wisdom [i.e., the sunnah] - although they were before in clear error -

r: The Congregation 62:3
t: And [to] others of them who have not yet joined them. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

r: The Congregation 62:4
t: That is the bounty of Allāh, which He gives to whom He wills, and Allāh is the possessor of great bounty.

r: The Congregation 62:5
t: The example of those who were entrusted with the Torah and then did not take it on is like that of a donkey who carries volumes [of books]. Wretched is the example of the people who deny the signs of Allāh. And Allāh does not guide the wrongdoing people.

r: The Congregation 62:6
t: Say, "O you who are Jews, if you claim that you are allies of Allāh, excluding the [other] people, then wish for death, if you should be truthful."

r: The Congregation 62:7
t: But they will not wish for it, ever, because of what their hands have put forth. And Allāh is Knowing of the wrongdoers.

r: The Congregation 62:8
t: Say, "Indeed, the death from which you flee - indeed, it will meet you. Then you will be returned to the Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, and He will inform you about what you used to do."

r: The Congregation 62:9
t: O you who have believed, when [the adhān] is called for the prayer on the day of Jumuʿah [Friday], then proceed to the remembrance of Allāh and leave trade. That is better for you, if you only knew.

r: The Congregation 62:10
t: And when the prayer has been concluded, disperse within the land and seek from the bounty of Allāh, and remember Allāh often that you may succeed.

r: The Congregation 62:11
t: But [on one occasion] when they saw a transaction or a diversion, [O Muḥammad], they rushed to it and left you standing. Say, "What is with Allāh is better than diversion and than a transaction, and Allāh is the best of providers."

r: The Hypocrites 63:1
t: When the hypocrites come to you, [O Muḥammad], they say, "We testify that you are the Messenger of Allāh." And Allāh knows that you are His Messenger, and Allāh testifies that the hypocrites are liars.

r: The Hypocrites 63:2
t: They have taken their oaths as a cover, so they averted [people] from the way of Allāh. Indeed, it was evil that they were doing.

r: The Hypocrites 63:3
t: That is because they believed, and then they disbelieved; so their hearts were sealed over, and they do not understand.

r: The Hypocrites 63:4
t: And when you see them, their forms please you, and if they speak, you listen to their speech. [They are] as if they were pieces of wood propped up - they think that every shout is against them. They are the enemy, so beware of them. May Allāh destroy them; how are they deluded?

r: The Hypocrites 63:5
t: And when it is said to them, "Come, the Messenger of Allāh will ask forgiveness for you," they turn their heads aside and you see them evading while they are arrogant.

r: The Hypocrites 63:6
t: It is all the same for them whether you ask forgiveness for them or do not ask forgiveness for them; never will Allāh forgive them. Indeed, Allāh does not guide the defiantly disobedient people.

r: The Hypocrites 63:7
t: They are the ones who say, "Do not spend on those who are with the Messenger of Allāh until they disband." And to Allāh belong the depositories of the heavens and the earth, but the hypocrites do not understand.

r: The Hypocrites 63:8
t: They say, "If we return to al-Madīnah, the more honored [for power] will surely expel therefrom the more humble." And to Allāh belongs [all] honor, and to His Messenger, and to the believers, but the hypocrites do not know.

r: The Hypocrites 63:9
t: O you who have believed, let not your wealth and your children divert you from the remembrance of Allāh. And whoever does that - then those are the losers.

r: The Hypocrites 63:10
t: And spend [in the way of Allāh] from what We have provided you before death approaches one of you and he says, "My Lord, if only You would delay me for a brief term so I would give charity and be of the righteous."

r: The Hypocrites 63:11
t: But never will Allāh delay a soul when its time has come. And Allāh is Aware of what you do.

r: The Mutual Disillusion 64:1
t: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth is exalting Allāh. To Him belongs dominion, and to Him belongs [all] praise, and He is over all things competent.

r: The Mutual Disillusion 64:2
t: It is He who created you, and among you is the disbeliever, and among you is the believer. And Allāh, of what you do, is Seeing.

r: The Mutual Disillusion 64:3
t: He created the heavens and earth in truth and formed you and perfected your forms; and to Him is the [final] destination.

r: The Mutual Disillusion 64:4
t: He knows what is within the heavens and earth and knows what you conceal and what you declare. And Allāh is Knowing of that within the breasts.

r: The Mutual Disillusion 64:5
t: Has there not come to you the news of those who disbelieved before? So they tasted the bad consequence of their affair, and they will have a painful punishment.

r: The Mutual Disillusion 64:6
t: That is because their messengers used to come to them with clear evidences, but they said, "Shall human beings guide us?" and disbelieved and turned away. And Allāh dispensed [with them]; and Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy.

r: The Mutual Disillusion 64:7
t: Those who disbelieve have claimed that they will never be resurrected. Say, "Yes, by my Lord, you will surely be resurrected; then you will surely be informed of what you did. And that, for Allāh, is easy."

r: The Mutual Disillusion 64:8
t: So believe in Allāh and His Messenger and the light [i.e., the Qur’ān] which We have sent down. And Allāh is Aware of what you do.

r: The Mutual Disillusion 64:9
t: The Day He will assemble you for the Day of Assembly - that is the Day of Deprivation. And whoever believes in Allāh and does righteousness - He will remove from him his misdeeds and admit him to gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever. That is the great attainment.

r: The Mutual Disillusion 64:10
t: But the ones who disbelieved and denied Our verses - those are the companions of the Fire, abiding eternally therein; and wretched is the destination.

r: The Mutual Disillusion 64:11
t: No disaster strikes except by permission of Allāh. And whoever believes in Allāh - He will guide his heart. And Allāh is Knowing of all things.

r: The Mutual Disillusion 64:12
t: And obey Allāh and obey the Messenger; but if you turn away - then upon Our Messenger is only [the duty of] clear notification.

r: The Mutual Disillusion 64:13
t: Allāh - there is no deity except Him. And upon Allāh let the believers rely.

r: The Mutual Disillusion 64:14
t: O you who have believed, indeed, among your spouses and your children are enemies to you, so beware of them. But if you pardon and overlook and forgive - then indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

r: The Mutual Disillusion 64:15
t: Your wealth and your children are but a trial, and Allāh has with Him a great reward.

r: The Mutual Disillusion 64:16
t: So fear Allāh as much as you are able and listen and obey and spend [in the way of Allāh]; it is better for your selves. And whoever is protected from the stinginess of his soul - it is those who will be the successful.

r: The Mutual Disillusion 64:17
t: If you loan Allāh a goodly loan, He will multiply it for you and forgive you. And Allāh is [most] Appreciative and Forbearing,

r: The Mutual Disillusion 64:18
t: Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

r: The Divorce 65:1
t: O Prophet, when you [Muslims] divorce women, divorce them for [the commencement of] their waiting period and keep count of the waiting period, and fear Allāh, your Lord. Do not turn them out of their [husbands'] houses, nor should they [themselves] leave [during that period] unless they are committing a clear immorality. And those are the limits [set by] Allāh. And whoever transgresses the limits of Allāh has certainly wronged himself. You know not; perhaps Allāh will bring about after that a [different] matter.

r: The Divorce 65:2
t: And when they have [nearly] fulfilled their term, either retain them according to acceptable terms or part with them according to acceptable terms. And bring to witness two just men from among you and establish the testimony for [the acceptance of] Allāh. That is instructed to whoever should believe in Allāh and the Last Day. And whoever fears Allāh - He will make for him a way out

r: The Divorce 65:3
t: And will provide for him from where he does not expect. And whoever relies upon Allāh - then He is sufficient for him. Indeed, Allāh will accomplish His purpose. Allāh has already set for everything a [decreed] extent.

r: The Divorce 65:4
t: And those who no longer expect menstruation among your women - if you doubt, then their period is three months, and [also for] those who have not menstruated. And for those who are pregnant, their term is until they give birth. And whoever fears Allāh - He will make for him of his matter ease.

r: The Divorce 65:5
t: That is the command of Allāh, which He has sent down to you; and whoever fears Allāh - He will remove for him his misdeeds and make great for him his reward.

r: The Divorce 65:6
t: Lodge them [in a section] of where you dwell out of your means and do not harm them in order to oppress them. And if they should be pregnant, then spend on them until they give birth. And if they breastfeed for you, then give them their payment and confer among yourselves in the acceptable way; but if you are in discord, then there may breastfeed for him [i.e., the father] another woman.

r: The Divorce 65:7
t: Let a man of wealth spend from his wealth, and he whose provision is restricted - let him spend from what Allāh has given him. Allāh does not charge a soul except [according to] what He has given it. Allāh will bring about, after hardship, ease [i.e., relief].

r: The Divorce 65:8
t: And how many a city was insolent toward the command of its Lord and His messengers, so We took it to severe account and punished it with a terrible punishment.

r: The Divorce 65:9
t: And it tasted the bad consequence of its affair [i.e., rebellion], and the outcome of its affair was loss.

r: The Divorce 65:10
t: Allāh has prepared for them a severe punishment; so fear Allāh, O you of understanding who have believed. Allāh has sent down to you a message [i.e., the Qur’ān].

r: The Divorce 65:11
t: [He sent] a Messenger [i.e., Muḥammad (ﷺ)] reciting to you the distinct verses of Allāh that He may bring out those who believe and do righteous deeds from darknesses into the light. And whoever believes in Allāh and does righteousness - He will admit him into gardens beneath which rivers flow to abide therein forever. Allāh will have perfected for him a provision.

r: The Divorce 65:12
t: It is Allāh who has created seven heavens and of the earth, the like of them. [His] command descends among them so you may know that Allāh is over all things competent and that Allāh has encompassed all things in knowledge.

r: The Prohibition 66:1
t: O Prophet, why do you prohibit [yourself from] what Allāh has made lawful for you, seeking the approval of your wives? And Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

r: The Prohibition 66:2
t: Allāh has already ordained for you [Muslims] the dissolution of your oaths. And Allāh is your protector, and He is the Knowing, the Wise.

r: The Prohibition 66:3
t: And [remember] when the Prophet confided to one of his wives a statement; and when she informed [another] of it and Allāh showed it to him, he made known part of it and ignored a part. And when he informed her about it, she said, "Who told you this?" He said, "I was informed by the Knowing, the Aware."

r: The Prohibition 66:4
t: If you two [wives] repent to Allāh, [it is best], for your hearts have deviated. But if you cooperate against him - then indeed Allāh is his protector, and Gabriel and the righteous of the believers and the angels, moreover, are [his] assistants.

r: The Prohibition 66:5
t: Perhaps his Lord, if he divorced you [all], would substitute for him wives better than you - submitting [to Allāh], believing, devoutly obedient, repentant, worshipping, and traveling - [ones] previously married and virgins.

r: The Prohibition 66:6
t: O you who have believed, protect yourselves and your families from a Fire whose fuel is people and stones, over which are [appointed] angels, harsh and severe; they do not disobey Allāh in what He commands them but do what they are commanded.

r: The Prohibition 66:7
t: O you who have disbelieved, make no excuses that Day. You will only be recompensed for what you used to do.

r: The Prohibition 66:8
t: O you who have believed, repent to Allāh with sincere repentance. Perhaps your Lord will remove from you your misdeeds and admit you into gardens beneath which rivers flow [on] the Day when Allāh will not disgrace the Prophet and those who believed with him. Their light will proceed before them and on their right; they will say, "Our Lord, perfect for us our light and forgive us. Indeed, You are over all things competent."

r: The Prohibition 66:9
t: O Prophet, strive against the disbelievers and the hypocrites and be harsh upon them. And their refuge is Hell, and wretched is the destination.

r: The Prohibition 66:10
t: Allāh presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so they [i.e., those prophets] did not avail them from Allāh at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter."

r: The Prohibition 66:11
t: And Allāh presents an example of those who believed: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, "My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people."

r: The Prohibition 66:12
t: And [the example of] Mary, the daughter of ʿImrān, who guarded her chastity, so We blew into [her garment] through Our angel [i.e., Gabriel], and she believed in the words of her Lord and His scriptures and was of the devoutly obedient.

r: The Dominion 67:1
t: Blessed is He in whose hand is dominion, and He is over all things competent -

r: The Dominion 67:2
t: [He] who created death and life to test you [as to] which of you is best in deed - and He is the Exalted in Might, the Forgiving -

r: The Dominion 67:3
t: [And] who created seven heavens in layers. You do not see in the creation of the Most Merciful any inconsistency. So return [your] vision [to the sky]; do you see any breaks?

r: The Dominion 67:4
t: Then return [your] vision twice again. [Your] vision will return to you humbled while it is fatigued.

r: The Dominion 67:5
t: And We have certainly beautified the nearest heaven with lamps [i.e., stars] and have made [from] them what is thrown at the devils and have prepared for them the punishment of the Blaze.

r: The Dominion 67:6
t: And for those who disbelieved in their Lord is the punishment of Hell, and wretched is the destination.

r: The Dominion 67:7
t: When they are thrown into it, they hear from it a [dreadful] inhaling while it boils up.

r: The Dominion 67:8
t: It almost bursts with rage. Every time a company is thrown into it, its keepers ask them, "Did there not come to you a warner?"

r: The Dominion 67:9
t: They will say, "Yes, a warner had come to us, but we denied and said, 'Allāh has not sent down anything. You are not but in great error.'"

r: The Dominion 67:10
t: And they will say, "If only we had been listening or reasoning, we would not be among the companions of the Blaze."

r: The Dominion 67:11
t: And they will admit their sin, so [it is] alienation for the companions of the Blaze.

r: The Dominion 67:12
t: Indeed, those who fear their Lord unseen will have forgiveness and great reward.

r: The Dominion 67:13
t: And conceal your speech or publicize it; indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.

r: The Dominion 67:14
t: Does He who created not know, while He is the Subtle, the Aware?

r: The Dominion 67:15
t: It is He who made the earth tame for you - so walk among its slopes and eat of His provision - and to Him is the resurrection.

r: The Dominion 67:16
t: Do you feel secure that He who is above would not cause the earth to swallow you and suddenly it would sway?

r: The Dominion 67:17
t: Or do you feel secure that He who is above would not send against you a storm of stones? Then you would know how [severe] was My warning.

r: The Dominion 67:18
t: And already had those before them denied, and how [terrible] was My reproach.

r: The Dominion 67:19
t: Do they not see the birds above them with wings outspread and [sometimes] folded in? None holds them [aloft] except the Most Merciful. Indeed He is, of all things, Seeing.

r: The Dominion 67:20
t: Or who is it that could be an army for you to aid you other than the Most Merciful? The disbelievers are not but in delusion.

r: The Dominion 67:21
t: Or who is it that could provide for you if He withheld His provision? But they have persisted in insolence and aversion.

r: The Dominion 67:22
t: Then is one who walks fallen on his face better guided or one who walks erect on a straight path?

r: The Dominion 67:23
t: Say, "It is He who has produced you and made for you hearing and vision and hearts [i.e., intellect]; little are you grateful."

r: The Dominion 67:24
t: Say, "It is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered."

r: The Dominion 67:25
t: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"

r: The Dominion 67:26
t: Say, "The knowledge is only with Allāh, and I am only a clear warner."

r: The Dominion 67:27
t: But when they see it approaching, the faces of those who disbelieve will be distressed, and it will be said, "This is that for which you used to call."

r: The Dominion 67:28
t: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Have you considered: whether Allāh should cause my death and those with me or have mercy upon us, who can protect the disbelievers from a painful punishment?"

r: The Dominion 67:29
t: Say, "He is the Most Merciful; we have believed in Him, and upon Him we have relied. And you will [come to] know who it is that is in clear error."

r: The Dominion 67:30
t: Say, "Have you considered: if your water was to become sunken [into the earth], then who could bring you flowing water?"

r: The Pen 68:1
t: Nūn. By the pen and what they inscribe,

r: The Pen 68:2
t: You are not, [O Muḥammad], by the favor of your Lord, a madman.

r: The Pen 68:3
t: And indeed, for you is a reward uninterrupted.

r: The Pen 68:4
t: And indeed, you are of a great moral character.

r: The Pen 68:5
t: So you will see and they will see.

r: The Pen 68:6
t: Which of you is the afflicted [by a devil].

r: The Pen 68:7
t: Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who has gone astray from His way, and He is most knowing of the [rightly] guided.

r: The Pen 68:8
t: Then do not obey the deniers.

r: The Pen 68:9
t: They wish that you would soften [in your position], so they would soften [toward you].

r: The Pen 68:10
t: And do not obey every worthless habitual swearer

r: The Pen 68:11
t: [And] scorner, going about with malicious gossip -

r: The Pen 68:12
t: A preventer of good, transgressing and sinful,

r: The Pen 68:13
t: Cruel, moreover, and an illegitimate pretender.

r: The Pen 68:14
t: Because he is a possessor of wealth and children,

r: The Pen 68:15
t: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples."

r: The Pen 68:16
t: We will brand him upon the snout.

r: The Pen 68:17
t: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning

r: The Pen 68:18
t: Without making exception.

r: The Pen 68:19
t: So there came upon it [i.e., the garden] an affliction from your Lord while they were asleep.

r: The Pen 68:20
t: And it became as though reaped.

r: The Pen 68:21
t: And they called one another at morning,

r: The Pen 68:22
t: [Saying], "Go early to your crop if you would cut the fruit."

r: The Pen 68:23
t: So they set out, while lowering their voices,

r: The Pen 68:24
t: [Saying], "There will surely not enter it today upon you [any] poor person."

r: The Pen 68:25
t: And they went early in determination, [assuming themselves] able.

r: The Pen 68:26
t: But when they saw it, they said, "Indeed, we are lost;

r: The Pen 68:27
t: Rather, we have been deprived."

r: The Pen 68:28
t: The most moderate of them said, "Did I not say to you, 'Why do you not exalt [Allāh]?'"

r: The Pen 68:29
t: They said, "Exalted is our Lord! Indeed, we were wrongdoers."

r: The Pen 68:30
t: Then they approached one another, blaming each other.

r: The Pen 68:31
t: They said, "O woe to us; indeed we were transgressors.

r: The Pen 68:32
t: Perhaps our Lord will substitute for us [one] better than it. Indeed, we are toward our Lord desirous."

r: The Pen 68:33
t: Such is the punishment [of this world]. And the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew.

r: The Pen 68:34
t: Indeed, for the righteous with their Lord are the Gardens of Pleasure.

r: The Pen 68:35
t: Then will We treat the Muslims like the criminals?

r: The Pen 68:36
t: What is [the matter] with you? How do you judge?

r: The Pen 68:37
t: Or do you have a scripture in which you learn

r: The Pen 68:38
t: That indeed for you is whatever you choose?

r: The Pen 68:39
t: Or do you have oaths [binding] upon Us, extending until the Day of Resurrection, that indeed for you is whatever you judge?

r: The Pen 68:40
t: Ask them which of them, for that [claim], is responsible.

r: The Pen 68:41
t: Or do they have partners? Then let them bring their partners, if they should be truthful.

r: The Pen 68:42
t: The Day the shin will be uncovered and they are invited to prostration but they [i.e., the disbelievers] will not be able,

r: The Pen 68:43
t: Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. And they used to be invited to prostration while they were sound.

r: The Pen 68:44
t: So leave Me, [O Muḥammad], with [the matter of] whoever denies this statement [i.e., the Qur’ān]. We will progressively lead them [to punishment] from where they do not know.

r: The Pen 68:45
t: And I will give them time. Indeed, My plan is firm.

r: The Pen 68:46
t: Or do you ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down?

r: The Pen 68:47
t: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down?

r: The Pen 68:48
t: Then be patient for the decision of your Lord, [O Muḥammad], and be not like the companion of the fish [i.e., Jonah] when he called out while he was distressed.

r: The Pen 68:49
t: If not that a favor [i.e., mercy] from his Lord overtook him, he would have been thrown onto the naked shore while he was censured.

r: The Pen 68:50
t: And his Lord chose him and made him of the righteous.

r: The Pen 68:51
t: And indeed, those who disbelieve would almost make you slip with their eyes [i.e., looks] when they hear the message, and they say, "Indeed, he is mad."

r: The Pen 68:52
t: But it is not except a reminder to the worlds.

r: The Reality 69:1
t: The Inevitable Reality -

r: The Reality 69:2
t: What is the Inevitable Reality?

r: The Reality 69:3
t: And what can make you know what is the Inevitable Reality?

r: The Reality 69:4
t: Thamūd and ʿAad denied the Striking Calamity [i.e., the Resurrection].

r: The Reality 69:5
t: So as for Thamūd, they were destroyed by the overpowering [blast].

r: The Reality 69:6
t: And as for ʿAad, they were destroyed by a screaming, violent wind

r: The Reality 69:7
t: Which He [i.e., Allāh] imposed upon them for seven nights and eight days in succession, so you would see the people therein fallen as if they were hollow trunks of palm trees.

r: The Reality 69:8
t: Then do you see of them any remains?

r: The Reality 69:9
t: And there came Pharaoh and those before him and the overturned cities with sin.

r: The Reality 69:10
t: And they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with a seizure exceeding [in severity].

r: The Reality 69:11
t: Indeed, when the water overflowed, We carried you [i.e., your ancestors] in the sailing ship

r: The Reality 69:12
t: That We might make it for you a reminder and [that] a conscious ear would be conscious of it.

r: The Reality 69:13
t: Then when the Horn is blown with one blast

r: The Reality 69:14
t: And the earth and the mountains are lifted and leveled with one blow [i.e., stroke] -

r: The Reality 69:15
t: Then on that Day, the Occurrence [i.e., Resurrection] will occur,

r: The Reality 69:16
t: And the heaven will split [open], for that Day it is infirm.

r: The Reality 69:17
t: And the angels are at its edges. And there will bear the Throne of your Lord above them, that Day, eight [of them].

r: The Reality 69:18
t: That Day, you will be exhibited [for judgement]; not hidden among you is anything concealed.

r: The Reality 69:19
t: So as for he who is given his record in his right hand, he will say, "Here, read my record!

r: The Reality 69:20
t: Indeed, I was certain that I would be meeting my account."

r: The Reality 69:21
t: So he will be in a pleasant life -

r: The Reality 69:22
t: In an elevated garden,

r: The Reality 69:23
t: Its [fruit] to be picked hanging near.

r: The Reality 69:24
t: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you put forth in the days past."

r: The Reality 69:25
t: But as for he who is given his record in his left hand, he will say, "Oh, I wish I had not been given my record

r: The Reality 69:26
t: And had not known what is my account.

r: The Reality 69:27
t: I wish it [i.e., my death] had been the decisive one.

r: The Reality 69:28
t: My wealth has not availed me.

r: The Reality 69:29
t: Gone from me is my authority."

r: The Reality 69:30
t: [Allāh will say], "Seize him and shackle him.

r: The Reality 69:31
t: Then into Hellfire drive him.

r: The Reality 69:32
t: Then into a chain whose length is seventy cubits insert him."

r: The Reality 69:33
t: Indeed, he did not used to believe in Allāh, the Most Great,

r: The Reality 69:34
t: Nor did he encourage the feeding of the poor.

r: The Reality 69:35
t: So there is not for him here this Day any devoted friend

r: The Reality 69:36
t: Nor any food except from the discharge of wounds;

r: The Reality 69:37
t: None will eat it except the sinners.

r: The Reality 69:38
t: So I swear by what you see

r: The Reality 69:39
t: And what you do not see

r: The Reality 69:40
t: [That] indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is the word of a noble Messenger.

r: The Reality 69:41
t: And it is not the word of a poet; little do you believe.

r: The Reality 69:42
t: Nor the word of a soothsayer; little do you remember.

r: The Reality 69:43
t: [It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.

r: The Reality 69:44
t: And if he [i.e., Muḥammad] had made up about Us some [false] sayings,

r: The Reality 69:45
t: We would have seized him by the right hand;

r: The Reality 69:46
t: Then We would have cut from him the aorta.

r: The Reality 69:47
t: And there is no one of you who could prevent [Us] from him.

r: The Reality 69:48
t: And indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a reminder for the righteous.

r: The Reality 69:49
t: And indeed, We know that among you are deniers.

r: The Reality 69:50
t: And indeed, it will be [a cause of] regret upon the disbelievers.

r: The Reality 69:51
t: And indeed, it is the truth of certainty.

r: The Reality 69:52
t: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.

r: The Ascending Stairways 70:1
t: A supplicant asked for a punishment bound to happen

r: The Ascending Stairways 70:2
t: To the disbelievers; of it there is no preventer.

r: The Ascending Stairways 70:3
t: [It is] from Allāh, owner of the ways of ascent.

r: The Ascending Stairways 70:4
t: The angels and the Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] will ascend to Him during a Day the extent of which is fifty thousand years.

r: The Ascending Stairways 70:5
t: So be patient with gracious patience.

r: The Ascending Stairways 70:6
t: Indeed, they see it [as] distant,

r: The Ascending Stairways 70:7
t: But We see it [as] near.

r: The Ascending Stairways 70:8
t: On the Day the sky will be like murky oil,

r: The Ascending Stairways 70:9
t: And the mountains will be like wool,

r: The Ascending Stairways 70:10
t: And no friend will ask [anything of] a friend,

r: The Ascending Stairways 70:11
t: They will be shown each other. The criminal will wish that he could be ransomed from the punishment of that Day by his children.

r: The Ascending Stairways 70:12
t: And his wife and his brother

r: The Ascending Stairways 70:13
t: And his nearest kindred who shelter him.

r: The Ascending Stairways 70:14
t: And whoever is on earth entirely [so] then it could save him.

r: The Ascending Stairways 70:15
t: No! Indeed, it is the Flame [of Hell],

r: The Ascending Stairways 70:16
t: A remover of exteriors.

r: The Ascending Stairways 70:17
t: It invites he who turned his back [on truth] and went away [from obedience]

r: The Ascending Stairways 70:18
t: And collected [wealth] and hoarded.

r: The Ascending Stairways 70:19
t: Indeed, mankind was created anxious:

r: The Ascending Stairways 70:20
t: When evil touches him, impatient,

r: The Ascending Stairways 70:21
t: And when good touches him, withholding [of it],

r: The Ascending Stairways 70:22
t: Except the observers of prayer -

r: The Ascending Stairways 70:23
t: Those who are constant in their prayer

r: The Ascending Stairways 70:24
t: And those within whose wealth is a known right

r: The Ascending Stairways 70:25
t: For the petitioner and the deprived -

r: The Ascending Stairways 70:26
t: And those who believe in the Day of Recompense

r: The Ascending Stairways 70:27
t: And those who are fearful of the punishment of their Lord -

r: The Ascending Stairways 70:28
t: Indeed, the punishment of their Lord is not that from which one is safe -

r: The Ascending Stairways 70:29
t: And those who guard their private parts

r: The Ascending Stairways 70:30
t: Except from their wives or those their right hands possess, for indeed, they are not to be blamed -

r: The Ascending Stairways 70:31
t: But whoever seeks beyond that, then they are the transgressors -

r: The Ascending Stairways 70:32
t: And those who are to their trusts and promises attentive.

r: The Ascending Stairways 70:33
t: And those who are in their testimonies upright

r: The Ascending Stairways 70:34
t: And those who [carefully] maintain their prayer:

r: The Ascending Stairways 70:35
t: They will be in gardens, honored.

r: The Ascending Stairways 70:36
t: So what is [the matter] with those who disbelieve, hastening [from] before you, [O Muḥammad],

r: The Ascending Stairways 70:37
t: [To sit] on [your] right and [your] left in separate groups?

r: The Ascending Stairways 70:38
t: Does every person among them aspire to enter a garden of pleasure?

r: The Ascending Stairways 70:39
t: No! Indeed, We have created them from that which they know.

r: The Ascending Stairways 70:40
t: So I swear by the Lord of [all] risings and settings that indeed We are able

r: The Ascending Stairways 70:41
t: To replace them with better than them; and We are not to be outdone.

r: The Ascending Stairways 70:42
t: So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised -

r: The Ascending Stairways 70:43
t: The Day they will emerge from the graves rapidly as if they were, toward an erected idol, hastening.

r: The Ascending Stairways 70:44
t: Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. That is the Day which they had been promised.

r: Noah 71:1
t: Indeed, We sent Noah to his people, [saying], "Warn your people before there comes to them a painful punishment."

r: Noah 71:2
t: He said, "O my people, indeed I am to you a clear warner -

r: Noah 71:3
t: To worship Allāh, fear Him and obey me.

r: Noah 71:4
t: He [i.e., Allāh] will forgive you of your sins and delay you for a specified term. Indeed, the time [set by] Allāh, when it comes, will not be delayed, if you only knew."

r: Noah 71:5
t: He said, "My Lord, indeed I invited my people [to truth] night and day.

r: Noah 71:6
t: But my invitation increased them not except in flight [i.e., aversion].

r: Noah 71:7
t: And indeed, every time I invited them that You may forgive them, they put their fingers in their ears, covered themselves with their garments, persisted, and were arrogant with [great] arrogance.

r: Noah 71:8
t: Then I invited them publicly.

r: Noah 71:9
t: Then I announced to them and [also] confided to them secretly

r: Noah 71:10
t: And said, 'Ask forgiveness of your Lord. Indeed, He is ever a Perpetual Forgiver.

r: Noah 71:11
t: He will send [rain from] the sky upon you in [continuing] showers

r: Noah 71:12
t: And give you increase in wealth and children and provide for you gardens and provide for you rivers.

r: Noah 71:13
t: What is [the matter] with you that you do not attribute to Allāh [due] grandeur

r: Noah 71:14
t: While He has created you in stages?

r: Noah 71:15
t: Do you not consider how Allāh has created seven heavens in layers

r: Noah 71:16
t: And made the moon therein a [reflected] light and made the sun a burning lamp?

r: Noah 71:17
t: And Allāh has caused you to grow from the earth a [progressive] growth.

r: Noah 71:18
t: Then He will return you into it and extract you [another] extraction.

r: Noah 71:19
t: And Allāh has made for you the earth an expanse

r: Noah 71:20
t: That you may follow therein roads of passage.'"

r: Noah 71:21
t: Noah said, "My Lord, indeed they have disobeyed me and followed him whose wealth and children will not increase him except in loss.

r: Noah 71:22
t: And they conspired an immense conspiracy

r: Noah 71:23
t: And said, 'Never leave your gods and never leave Wadd or Suwāʿ or Yaghūth and Yaʿūq and Nasr.'

r: Noah 71:24
t: And already they have misled many. And, [my Lord], do not increase the wrongdoers except in error."

r: Noah 71:25
t: Because of their sins they were drowned and put into the Fire, and they found not for themselves besides Allāh [any] helpers.

r: Noah 71:26
t: And Noah said, "My Lord, do not leave upon the earth from among the disbelievers an inhabitant.

r: Noah 71:27
t: Indeed, if You leave them, they will mislead Your servants and not beget except [every] wicked one and [confirmed] disbeliever.

r: Noah 71:28
t: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house a believer and the believing men and believing women. And do not increase the wrongdoers except in destruction."

r: The Jinn 72:1
t: Say, [O Muḥammad], "It has been revealed to me that a group of the jinn listened and said, 'Indeed, we have heard an amazing Qur’ān [i.e., recitation].

r: The Jinn 72:2
t: It guides to the right course, and we have believed in it. And we will never associate with our Lord anyone.

r: The Jinn 72:3
t: And [it teaches] that exalted is the nobleness of our Lord; He has not taken a wife or a son

r: The Jinn 72:4
t: And that our foolish one [i.e., Iblees] has been saying about Allāh an excessive transgression.

r: The Jinn 72:5
t: And we had thought that mankind and the jinn would never speak about Allāh a lie.

r: The Jinn 72:6
t: And there were men from mankind who sought refuge in men from the jinn, so they [only] increased them in burden [i.e., sin].

r: The Jinn 72:7
t: And they had thought, as you thought, that Allāh would never send anyone [as a messenger].

r: The Jinn 72:8
t: And we have sought [to reach] the heaven but found it filled with powerful guards and burning flames.

r: The Jinn 72:9
t: And we used to sit therein in positions for hearing, but whoever listens now will find a burning flame lying in wait for him.

r: The Jinn 72:10
t: And we do not know [therefore] whether evil is intended for those on earth or whether their Lord intends for them a right course.

r: The Jinn 72:11
t: And among us are the righteous, and among us are [others] not so; we were [of] divided ways.

r: The Jinn 72:12
t: And we have become certain that we will never cause failure to Allāh upon earth, nor can we escape Him by flight.

r: The Jinn 72:13
t: And when we heard the guidance [i.e., the Qur’ān], we believed in it. And whoever believes in his Lord will not fear deprivation or burden.

r: The Jinn 72:14
t: And among us are Muslims [in submission to Allāh], and among us are the unjust. And whoever has become Muslim - those have sought out the right course.

r: The Jinn 72:15
t: But as for the unjust, they will be, for Hell, firewood.'

r: The Jinn 72:16
t: And [Allāh revealed] that if they had remained straight on the way, We would have given them abundant rain [i.e., provision].

r: The Jinn 72:17
t: So We might test them therein. And whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord He will put into arduous punishment.

r: The Jinn 72:18
t: And [He revealed] that the masjids are for Allāh, so do not invoke with Allāh anyone.

r: The Jinn 72:19
t: And that when the Servant [i.e., Prophet] of Allāh stood up supplicating Him, they almost became about him a compacted mass."

r: The Jinn 72:20
t: Say, [O Muḥammad], "I only invoke my Lord and do not associate with Him anyone."

r: The Jinn 72:21
t: Say, "Indeed, I do not possess for you [the power of] harm or right direction."

r: The Jinn 72:22
t: Say, "Indeed, there will never protect me from Allāh anyone [if I should disobey], nor will I find in other than Him a refuge.

r: The Jinn 72:23
t: But [I have for you] only notification from Allāh, and His messages." And whoever disobeys Allāh and His Messenger - then indeed, for him is the fire of Hell; they will abide therein forever.

r: The Jinn 72:24
t: [The disbelievers continue] until, when they see that which they are promised, then they will know who is weaker in helpers and less in number.

r: The Jinn 72:25
t: Say, "I do not know if what you are promised is near or if my Lord will grant for it a [long] period."

r: The Jinn 72:26
t: [He is] Knower of the unseen, and He does not disclose His [knowledge of the] unseen to anyone

r: The Jinn 72:27
t: Except whom He has approved of messengers, and indeed, He sends before him [i.e., each messenger] and behind him observers

r: The Jinn 72:28
t: That he [i.e., Muḥammad (ﷺ)] may know that they have conveyed the messages of their Lord; and He has encompassed whatever is with them and has enumerated all things in number.

r: The Enshrouded One 73:1
t: O you who wraps himself [in clothing]

r: The Enshrouded One 73:2
t: Arise [to pray] the night, except for a little -

r: The Enshrouded One 73:3
t: Half of it - or subtract from it a little

r: The Enshrouded One 73:4
t: Or add to it, and recite the Qur’ān with measured recitation.

r: The Enshrouded One 73:5
t: Indeed, We will cast upon you a heavy word.

r: The Enshrouded One 73:6
t: Indeed, the hours of the night are more effective for concurrence [of heart and tongue] and more suitable for words.

r: The Enshrouded One 73:7
t: Indeed, for you by day is prolonged occupation.

r: The Enshrouded One 73:8
t: And remember the name of your Lord and devote yourself to Him with [complete] devotion.

r: The Enshrouded One 73:9
t: [He is] the Lord of the East and the West; there is no deity except Him, so take Him as Disposer of [your] affairs.

r: The Enshrouded One 73:10
t: And be patient over what they say and avoid them with gracious avoidance.

r: The Enshrouded One 73:11
t: And leave Me with [the matter of] the deniers, those of ease [in life], and allow them respite a little.

r: The Enshrouded One 73:12
t: Indeed, with Us [for them] are shackles and burning fire.

r: The Enshrouded One 73:13
t: And food that chokes and a painful punishment -

r: The Enshrouded One 73:14
t: On the Day the earth and the mountains will convulse and the mountains will become a heap of sand pouring down.

r: The Enshrouded One 73:15
t: Indeed, We have sent to you a Messenger as a witness upon you just as We sent to Pharaoh a messenger.

r: The Enshrouded One 73:16
t: But Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger, so We seized him with a ruinous seizure.

r: The Enshrouded One 73:17
t: Then how can you fear, if you disbelieve, a Day that will make the children white-haired?

r: The Enshrouded One 73:18
t: The heaven will break apart therefrom; ever is His promise fulfilled.

r: The Enshrouded One 73:19
t: Indeed, this is a reminder, so whoever wills may take to his Lord a way.

r: The Enshrouded One 73:20
t: Indeed, your Lord knows, [O Muḥammad], that you stand [in prayer] almost two thirds of the night or half of it or a third of it, and [so do] a group of those with you. And Allāh determines [the extent of] the night and the day. He has known that you [Muslims] will not be able to do it and has turned to you in forgiveness, so recite what is easy [for you] of the Qur’ān. He has known that there will be among you those who are ill and others traveling throughout the land seeking [something] of the bounty of Allāh and others fighting for the cause of Allāh. So recite what is easy from it and establish prayer and give zakāh and loan Allāh a goodly loan. And whatever good you put forward for yourselves - you will find it with Allāh. It is better and greater in reward. And seek forgiveness of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

r: The Cloaked One 74:1
t: O you who covers himself [with a garment],

r: The Cloaked One 74:2
t: Arise and warn.

r: The Cloaked One 74:3
t: And your Lord glorify.

r: The Cloaked One 74:4
t: And your clothing purify.

r: The Cloaked One 74:5
t: And uncleanliness avoid.

r: The Cloaked One 74:6
t: And do not confer favor to acquire more.

r: The Cloaked One 74:7
t: But for your Lord be patient.

r: The Cloaked One 74:8
t: And when the trumpet is blown,

r: The Cloaked One 74:9
t: That Day will be a difficult day

r: The Cloaked One 74:10
t: For the disbelievers - not easy.

r: The Cloaked One 74:11
t: Leave Me with the one I created alone

r: The Cloaked One 74:12
t: And to whom I granted extensive wealth

r: The Cloaked One 74:13
t: And children present [with him]

r: The Cloaked One 74:14
t: And spread [everything] before him, easing [his life].

r: The Cloaked One 74:15
t: Then he desires that I should add more.

r: The Cloaked One 74:16
t: No! Indeed, he has been toward Our verses obstinate.

r: The Cloaked One 74:17
t: I will cover him with arduous torment.

r: The Cloaked One 74:18
t: Indeed, he thought and deliberated.

r: The Cloaked One 74:19
t: So may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated.

r: The Cloaked One 74:20
t: Then may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated.

r: The Cloaked One 74:21
t: Then he considered [again];

r: The Cloaked One 74:22
t: Then he frowned and scowled;

r: The Cloaked One 74:23
t: Then he turned back and was arrogant

r: The Cloaked One 74:24
t: And said, "This is not but magic imitated [from others].

r: The Cloaked One 74:25
t: This is not but the word of a human being."

r: The Cloaked One 74:26
t: I will drive him into Saqar.

r: The Cloaked One 74:27
t: And what can make you know what is Saqar?

r: The Cloaked One 74:28
t: It lets nothing remain and leaves nothing [unburned],

r: The Cloaked One 74:29
t: Altering [i.e., blackening] the skins.

r: The Cloaked One 74:30
t: Over it are nineteen [angels].

r: The Cloaked One 74:31
t: And We have not made the keepers of the Fire except angels. And We have not made their number except as a trial for those who disbelieve - that those who were given the Scripture will be convinced and those who have believed will increase in faith and those who were given the Scripture and the believers will not doubt and that those in whose hearts is disease [i.e., hypocrisy] and the disbelievers will say, "What does Allāh intend by this as an example?" Thus does Allāh send astray whom He wills and guide whom He wills. And none knows the soldiers of your Lord except Him. And it [i.e., mention of the Fire] is not but a reminder to humanity.

r: The Cloaked One 74:32
t: No! By the moon.

r: The Cloaked One 74:33
t: And [by] the night when it departs.

r: The Cloaked One 74:34
t: And [by] the morning when it brightens,

r: The Cloaked One 74:35
t: Indeed, it [i.e., the Fire] is of the greatest [afflictions].

r: The Cloaked One 74:36
t: As a warning to humanity -

r: The Cloaked One 74:37
t: To whoever wills among you to proceed or stay behind.

r: The Cloaked One 74:38
t: Every soul, for what it has earned, will be retained.

r: The Cloaked One 74:39
t: Except the companions of the right,.

r: The Cloaked One 74:40
t: [Who will be] in gardens, questioning each other

r: The Cloaked One 74:41
t: About the criminals,

r: The Cloaked One 74:42
t: [And asking them], "What put you into Saqar?"

r: The Cloaked One 74:43
t: They will say, "We were not of those who prayed,

r: The Cloaked One 74:44
t: Nor did we used to feed the poor.

r: The Cloaked One 74:45
t: And we used to enter into vain discourse with those who engaged [in it],

r: The Cloaked One 74:46
t: And we used to deny the Day of Recompense

r: The Cloaked One 74:47
t: Until there came to us the certainty [i.e., death]."

r: The Cloaked One 74:48
t: So there will not benefit them the intercession of [any] intercessors.

r: The Cloaked One 74:49
t: Then what is [the matter] with them that they are, from the reminder, turning away.

r: The Cloaked One 74:50
t: As if they were alarmed donkeys.

r: The Cloaked One 74:51
t: Fleeing from a lion?

r: The Cloaked One 74:52
t: Rather, every person among them desires that he would be given scriptures spread about.

r: The Cloaked One 74:53
t: No! But they do not fear the Hereafter.

r: The Cloaked One 74:54
t: No! Indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a reminder.

r: The Cloaked One 74:55
t: Then whoever wills will remember it.

r: The Cloaked One 74:56
t: And they will not remember except that Allāh wills. He is worthy of fear and adequate for [granting] forgiveness.

r: The Resurrection 75:1
t: I swear by the Day of Resurrection

r: The Resurrection 75:2
t: And I swear by the reproaching soul [to the certainty of resurrection].

r: The Resurrection 75:3
t: Does man think that We will not assemble his bones?

r: The Resurrection 75:4
t: Yes. [We are] Able [even] to proportion his fingertips.

r: The Resurrection 75:5
t: But man desires to continue in sin.

r: The Resurrection 75:6
t: He asks, "When is the Day of Resurrection?"

r: The Resurrection 75:7
t: So when vision is dazzled.

r: The Resurrection 75:8
t: And the moon darkens.

r: The Resurrection 75:9
t: And the sun and the moon are joined,

r: The Resurrection 75:10
t: Man will say on that Day, "Where is the [place of] escape?"

r: The Resurrection 75:11
t: No! There is no refuge.

r: The Resurrection 75:12
t: To your Lord, that Day, is the [place of] permanence.

r: The Resurrection 75:13
t: Man will be informed that Day of what he sent ahead and kept back.

r: The Resurrection 75:14
t: Rather, man, against himself, will be a witness,

r: The Resurrection 75:15
t: Even if he presents his excuses.

r: The Resurrection 75:16
t: Move not your tongue with it, [O Muḥammad], to hasten with it [i.e., recitation of the Qur’ān].

r: The Resurrection 75:17
t: Indeed, upon Us is its collection [in your heart] and [to make possible] its recitation.

r: The Resurrection 75:18
t: So when We have recited it [through Gabriel], then follow its recitation.

r: The Resurrection 75:19
t: Then upon Us is its clarification [to you].

r: The Resurrection 75:20
t: No! But you [i.e., mankind] love the immediate

r: The Resurrection 75:21
t: And leave [i.e., neglect] the Hereafter.

r: The Resurrection 75:22
t: [Some] faces, that Day, will be radiant,

r: The Resurrection 75:23
t: Looking at their Lord.

r: The Resurrection 75:24
t: And [some] faces, that Day, will be contorted,

r: The Resurrection 75:25
t: Expecting that there will be done to them [something] backbreaking.

r: The Resurrection 75:26
t: No! When it [i.e., the soul] has reached the collar bones

r: The Resurrection 75:27
t: And it is said, "Who will cure [him]?"

r: The Resurrection 75:28
t: And he [i.e., the dying one] is certain that it is the [time of] separation

r: The Resurrection 75:29
t: And the leg is wound about the leg,

r: The Resurrection 75:30
t: To your Lord, that Day, will be the procession.

r: The Resurrection 75:31
t: And he [i.e., the disbeliever] had not believed, nor had he prayed.

r: The Resurrection 75:32
t: But [instead], he denied and turned away.

r: The Resurrection 75:33
t: And then he went to his people, swaggering [in pride].

r: The Resurrection 75:34
t: Woe to you, and woe!

r: The Resurrection 75:35
t: Then woe to you, and woe!

r: The Resurrection 75:36
t: Does man think that he will be left neglected?

r: The Resurrection 75:37
t: Had he not been a sperm from semen emitted?

r: The Resurrection 75:38
t: Then he was a clinging clot, and [Allāh] created [his form] and proportioned [him]

r: The Resurrection 75:39
t: And made of him two mates, the male and the female.

r: The Resurrection 75:40
t: Is not that [Creator] Able to give life to the dead?

r: The Man 76:1
t: Has there [not] come upon man a period of time when he was not a thing [even] mentioned?

r: The Man 76:2
t: Indeed, We created man from a sperm-drop mixture that We may try him; and We made him hearing and seeing.

r: The Man 76:3
t: Indeed, We guided him to the way, be he grateful or be he ungrateful.

r: The Man 76:4
t: Indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers chains and shackles and a blaze.

r: The Man 76:5
t: Indeed, the righteous will drink from a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of Kāfūr,

r: The Man 76:6
t: A spring of which the [righteous] servants of Allāh will drink; they will make it gush forth in force [and abundance].

r: The Man 76:7
t: They [are those who] fulfill [their] vows and fear a Day whose evil will be widespread.

r: The Man 76:8
t: And they give food in spite of love for it to the needy, the orphan, and the captive,

r: The Man 76:9
t: [Saying], "We feed you only for the face [i.e., approval] of Allāh. We wish not from you reward or gratitude.

r: The Man 76:10
t: Indeed, We fear from our Lord a Day austere and distressful."

r: The Man 76:11
t: So Allāh will protect them from the evil of that Day and give them radiance and happiness

r: The Man 76:12
t: And will reward them for what they patiently endured [with] a garden [in Paradise] and silk [garments].

r: The Man 76:13
t: [They will be] reclining therein on adorned couches. They will not see therein any [burning] sun or [freezing] cold.

r: The Man 76:14
t: And near above them are its shades, and its [fruit] to be picked will be lowered in compliance.

r: The Man 76:15
t: And there will be circulated among them vessels of silver and cups having been [created] clear [as glass],

r: The Man 76:16
t: Clear glasses [made] from silver of which they have determined the measure.

r: The Man 76:17
t: And they will be given to drink a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of ginger

r: The Man 76:18
t: [From] a fountain within it [i.e., Paradise] named Salsabeel.

r: The Man 76:19
t: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal. When you see them, you would think them [as beautiful as] scattered pearls.

r: The Man 76:20
t: And when you look there [in Paradise], you will see pleasure and great dominion.

r: The Man 76:21
t: Upon them [i.e., the inhabitants] will be green garments of fine silk and brocade. And they will be adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a purifying drink.

r: The Man 76:22
t: [And it will be said], "Indeed, this is for you a reward, and your effort has been appreciated."

r: The Man 76:23
t: Indeed, it is We who have sent down to you, [O Muḥammad], the Qur’ān progressively.

r: The Man 76:24
t: So be patient for the decision of your Lord and do not obey from among them a sinner or ungrateful [disbeliever].

r: The Man 76:25
t: And mention the name of your Lord [in prayer] morning and evening

r: The Man 76:26
t: And during the night prostrate to Him and exalt [i.e., praise] Him a long [part of the] night.

r: The Man 76:27
t: Indeed, these [disbelievers] love the immediate and leave behind them a grave Day.

r: The Man 76:28
t: We have created them and strengthened their forms, and when We will, We can change their likenesses with [complete] alteration.

r: The Man 76:29
t: Indeed, this is a reminder, so he who wills may take to his Lord a way.

r: The Man 76:30
t: And you do not will except that Allāh wills. Indeed, Allāh is ever Knowing and Wise.

r: The Man 76:31
t: He admits whom He wills into His mercy; but the wrongdoers - He has prepared for them a painful punishment.

r: The Emissaries 77:1
t: By those [winds] sent forth in gusts

r: The Emissaries 77:2
t: And the winds that blow violently

r: The Emissaries 77:3
t: And [by] the winds that spread [clouds]

r: The Emissaries 77:4
t: And those [angels] who bring criterion

r: The Emissaries 77:5
t: And those [angels] who deliver a message.

r: The Emissaries 77:6
t: As justification or warning,

r: The Emissaries 77:7
t: Indeed, what you are promised is to occur.

r: The Emissaries 77:8
t: So when the stars are obliterated

r: The Emissaries 77:9
t: And when the heaven is opened

r: The Emissaries 77:10
t: And when the mountains are blown away

r: The Emissaries 77:11
t: And when the messengers' time has come...

r: The Emissaries 77:12
t: For what Day was it postponed?

r: The Emissaries 77:13
t: For the Day of Judgement.

r: The Emissaries 77:14
t: And what can make you know what is the Day of Judgement?

r: The Emissaries 77:15
t: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

r: The Emissaries 77:16
t: Did We not destroy the former peoples?

r: The Emissaries 77:17
t: Then We will follow them with the later ones.

r: The Emissaries 77:18
t: Thus do We deal with the criminals.

r: The Emissaries 77:19
t: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

r: The Emissaries 77:20
t: Did We not create you from a liquid disdained?

r: The Emissaries 77:21
t: And We placed it in a firm lodging [i.e., the womb]

r: The Emissaries 77:22
t: For a known extent.

r: The Emissaries 77:23
t: And We determined [it], and excellent [are We] to determine.

r: The Emissaries 77:24
t: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

r: The Emissaries 77:25
t: Have We not made the earth a container

r: The Emissaries 77:26
t: Of the living and the dead?

r: The Emissaries 77:27
t: And We placed therein lofty, firmly set mountains and have given you to drink sweet water.

r: The Emissaries 77:28
t: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

r: The Emissaries 77:29
t: [They will be told], "Proceed to that which you used to deny.

r: The Emissaries 77:30
t: Proceed to a shadow [of smoke] having three columns.

r: The Emissaries 77:31
t: [But having] no cool shade and availing not against the flame."

r: The Emissaries 77:32
t: Indeed, it throws sparks [as huge] as a fortress,

r: The Emissaries 77:33
t: As if they were yellowish [black] camels.

r: The Emissaries 77:34
t: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

r: The Emissaries 77:35
t: This is a Day they will not speak,

r: The Emissaries 77:36
t: Nor will it be permitted for them to make an excuse.

r: The Emissaries 77:37
t: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

r: The Emissaries 77:38
t: This is the Day of Judgement; We will have assembled you and the former peoples.

r: The Emissaries 77:39
t: So if you have a plan, then plan against Me.

r: The Emissaries 77:40
t: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

r: The Emissaries 77:41
t: Indeed, the righteous will be among shades and springs

r: The Emissaries 77:42
t: And fruits from whatever they desire,

r: The Emissaries 77:43
t: [Being told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."

r: The Emissaries 77:44
t: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

r: The Emissaries 77:45
t: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

r: The Emissaries 77:46
t: [O disbelievers], eat and enjoy yourselves a little; indeed, you are criminals.

r: The Emissaries 77:47
t: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

r: The Emissaries 77:48
t: And when it is said to them, "Bow [in prayer]," they do not bow.

r: The Emissaries 77:49
t: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

r: The Emissaries 77:50
t: Then in what statement after it [i.e., the Qur’ān] will they believe?

r: The Great News 78:1
t: About what are they asking one another?

r: The Great News 78:2
t: About the great news -

r: The Great News 78:3
t: That over which they are in disagreement.

r: The Great News 78:4
t: No! They are going to know.

r: The Great News 78:5
t: Then, no! They are going to know.

r: The Great News 78:6
t: Have We not made the earth a resting place?

r: The Great News 78:7
t: And the mountains as stakes?

r: The Great News 78:8
t: And We created you in pairs.

r: The Great News 78:9
