t: And made your sleep [a means for] rest

r: The Great News 78:10
t: And made the night as clothing.

r: The Great News 78:11
t: And made the day for livelihood.

r: The Great News 78:12
t: And constructed above you seven strong [heavens].

r: The Great News 78:13
t: And made [therein] a burning lamp

r: The Great News 78:14
t: And sent down, from the rain clouds, pouring water.

r: The Great News 78:15
t: That We may bring forth thereby grain and vegetation.

r: The Great News 78:16
t: And gardens of entwined growth.

r: The Great News 78:17
t: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is an appointed time -

r: The Great News 78:18
t: The Day the Horn is blown and you will come forth in multitudes

r: The Great News 78:19
t: And the heaven is opened and will become gateways.

r: The Great News 78:20
t: And the mountains are removed and will be [but] a mirage.

r: The Great News 78:21
t: Indeed, Hell has been lying in wait

r: The Great News 78:22
t: For the transgressors, a place of return,

r: The Great News 78:23
t: In which they will remain for ages [unending].

r: The Great News 78:24
t: They will not taste therein [any] coolness or drink.

r: The Great News 78:25
t: Except scalding water and [foul] purulence -

r: The Great News 78:26
t: An appropriate recompense.

r: The Great News 78:27
t: Indeed, they were not expecting an account

r: The Great News 78:28
t: And denied Our verses with [emphatic] denial.

r: The Great News 78:29
t: But all things We have enumerated in writing.

r: The Great News 78:30
t: "So taste [the penalty], and never will We increase you except in torment."

r: The Great News 78:31
t: Indeed, for the righteous is attainment -

r: The Great News 78:32
t: Gardens and grapevines.

r: The Great News 78:33
t: And full-breasted [companions] of equal age.

r: The Great News 78:34
t: And a full cup.

r: The Great News 78:35
t: No ill speech will they hear therein or any falsehood -

r: The Great News 78:36
t: [As] reward from your Lord, [a generous] gift [made due by] account,

r: The Great News 78:37
t: [From] the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Most Merciful. They possess not from Him [authority for] speech.

r: The Great News 78:38
t: The Day that the Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] and the angels will stand in rows, they will not speak except for one whom the Most Merciful permits, and he will say what is correct.

r: The Great News 78:39
t: That is the True [i.e., certain] Day; so he who wills may take to his Lord a [way of] return.

r: The Great News 78:40
t: Indeed, We have warned you of an impending punishment on the Day when a man will observe what his hands have put forth and the disbeliever will say, "Oh, I wish that I were dust!"

r: The Snatchers 79:1
t: By those [angels] who extract with violence

r: The Snatchers 79:2
t: And [by] those who remove with ease

r: The Snatchers 79:3
t: And [by] those who glide [as if] swimming

r: The Snatchers 79:4
t: And those who race each other in a race

r: The Snatchers 79:5
t: And those who arrange [each] matter,

r: The Snatchers 79:6
t: On the Day the blast [of the Horn] will convulse [creation],

r: The Snatchers 79:7
t: There will follow it the subsequent [one].

r: The Snatchers 79:8
t: Hearts, that Day, will tremble,

r: The Snatchers 79:9
t: Their eyes humbled.

r: The Snatchers 79:10
t: They are [presently] saying, "Will we indeed be returned to [our] former state [of life]?

r: The Snatchers 79:11
t: Even if we should be decayed bones?"

r: The Snatchers 79:12
t: They say, "That, then, would be a losing return."

r: The Snatchers 79:13
t: Indeed, it will be but one shout,

r: The Snatchers 79:14
t: And suddenly they will be [alert] upon the earth's surface.

r: The Snatchers 79:15
t: Has there reached you the story of Moses? -

r: The Snatchers 79:16
t: When his Lord called to him in the sacred valley of Ṭuwā,

r: The Snatchers 79:17
t: "Go to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed.

r: The Snatchers 79:18
t: And say to him, 'Would you [be willing to] purify yourself

r: The Snatchers 79:19
t: And let me guide you to your Lord so you would fear [Him]?'"

r: The Snatchers 79:20
t: And he showed him the greatest sign,

r: The Snatchers 79:21
t: But he [i.e., Pharaoh] denied and disobeyed.

r: The Snatchers 79:22
t: Then he turned his back, striving [i.e., plotting].

r: The Snatchers 79:23
t: And he gathered [his people] and called out.

r: The Snatchers 79:24
t: And said, "I am your most exalted lord."

r: The Snatchers 79:25
t: So Allāh seized him in exemplary punishment for the last and the first [transgression]..

r: The Snatchers 79:26
t: Indeed in that is a lesson [i.e., warning] for whoever would fear [Allāh].

r: The Snatchers 79:27
t: Are you a more difficult creation or is the heaven? He [i.e., Allāh] constructed it.

r: The Snatchers 79:28
t: He raised its ceiling and proportioned it.

r: The Snatchers 79:29
t: And He darkened its night and extracted its brightness.

r: The Snatchers 79:30
t: And after that He spread the earth.

r: The Snatchers 79:31
t: He extracted from it its water and its pasture,

r: The Snatchers 79:32
t: And the mountains He set firmly

r: The Snatchers 79:33
t: As enjoyment [i.e., provision] for you and your grazing livestock.

r: The Snatchers 79:34
t: But when there comes the greatest Overwhelming Calamity -

r: The Snatchers 79:35
t: The Day when man will remember that for which he strove,

r: The Snatchers 79:36
t: And Hellfire will be exposed for [all] those who see -

r: The Snatchers 79:37
t: So as for he who transgressed

r: The Snatchers 79:38
t: And preferred the life of the world,

r: The Snatchers 79:39
t: Then indeed, Hellfire will be [his] refuge.

r: The Snatchers 79:40
t: But as for he who feared the position of his Lord and prevented the soul from [unlawful] inclination,

r: The Snatchers 79:41
t: Then indeed, Paradise will be [his] refuge.

r: The Snatchers 79:42
t: They ask you, [O Muḥammad], about the Hour: when is its arrival?

r: The Snatchers 79:43
t: In what [position] are you that you should mention it?

r: The Snatchers 79:44
t: To your Lord is its finality.

r: The Snatchers 79:45
t: You are only a warner for those who fear it.

r: The Snatchers 79:46
t: It will be, on the Day they see it, as though they had not remained [in the world] except for an afternoon or a morning thereof.

r: He Frowned 80:1
t: He [i.e., the Prophet (ﷺ) ] frowned and turned away

r: He Frowned 80:2
t: Because there came to him the blind man, [interrupting].

r: He Frowned 80:3
t: But what would make you perceive, [O Muḥammad], that perhaps he might be purified

r: He Frowned 80:4
t: Or be reminded and the remembrance would benefit him?

r: He Frowned 80:5
t: As for he who thinks himself without need,

r: He Frowned 80:6
t: To him you give attention.

r: He Frowned 80:7
t: And not upon you [is any blame] if he will not be purified.

r: He Frowned 80:8
t: But as for he who came to you striving [for knowledge]

r: He Frowned 80:9
t: While he fears [Allāh],

r: He Frowned 80:10
t: From him you are distracted.

r: He Frowned 80:11
t: No! Indeed, they [i.e., these verses] are a reminder;

r: He Frowned 80:12
t: So whoever wills may remember it.

r: He Frowned 80:13
t: [It is recorded] in honored sheets,

r: He Frowned 80:14
t: Exalted and purified,

r: He Frowned 80:15
t: [Carried] by the hands of messenger-angels,

r: He Frowned 80:16
t: Noble and dutiful.

r: He Frowned 80:17
t: Destroyed [i.e., cursed] is man; how disbelieving is he.

r: He Frowned 80:18
t: From what thing [i.e., substance] did He create him?

r: He Frowned 80:19
t: From a sperm-drop He created him and destined for him;

r: He Frowned 80:20
t: Then He eased the way for him;

r: He Frowned 80:21
t: Then He causes his death and provides a grave for him.

r: He Frowned 80:22
t: Then when He wills, He will resurrect him.

r: He Frowned 80:23
t: No! He [i.e., man] has not yet accomplished what He commanded him.

r: He Frowned 80:24
t: Then let mankind look at his food -

r: He Frowned 80:25
t: How We poured down water in torrents,

r: He Frowned 80:26
t: Then We broke open the earth, splitting [it with sprouts],

r: He Frowned 80:27
t: And caused to grow within it grain

r: He Frowned 80:28
t: And grapes and herbage

r: He Frowned 80:29
t: And olive and palm trees

r: He Frowned 80:30
t: And gardens of dense shrubbery

r: He Frowned 80:31
t: And fruit and grass -

r: He Frowned 80:32
t: [As] enjoyment [i.e., provision] for you and your grazing livestock.

r: He Frowned 80:33
t: But when there comes the Deafening Blast

r: He Frowned 80:34
t: On the Day a man will flee from his brother

r: He Frowned 80:35
t: And his mother and his father

r: He Frowned 80:36
t: And his wife and his children,

r: He Frowned 80:37
t: For every man, that Day, will be a matter adequate for him.

r: He Frowned 80:38
t: [Some] faces, that Day, will be bright -

r: He Frowned 80:39
t: Laughing, rejoicing at good news.

r: He Frowned 80:40
t: And [other] faces, that Day, will have upon them dust.

r: He Frowned 80:41
t: Blackness will cover them.

r: He Frowned 80:42
t: Those are the disbelievers, the wicked ones.

r: The Overthrowing 81:1
t: When the sun is wrapped up [in darkness]

r: The Overthrowing 81:2
t: And when the stars fall, dispersing,

r: The Overthrowing 81:3
t: And when the mountains are removed

r: The Overthrowing 81:4
t: And when full-term she-camels are neglected

r: The Overthrowing 81:5
t: And when the wild beasts are gathered

r: The Overthrowing 81:6
t: And when the seas are filled with flame

r: The Overthrowing 81:7
t: And when the souls are paired

r: The Overthrowing 81:8
t: And when the girl [who was] buried alive is asked

r: The Overthrowing 81:9
t: For what sin she was killed

r: The Overthrowing 81:10
t: And when the pages are spread [i.e., made public]

r: The Overthrowing 81:11
t: And when the sky is stripped away

r: The Overthrowing 81:12
t: And when Hellfire is set ablaze

r: The Overthrowing 81:13
t: And when Paradise is brought near,

r: The Overthrowing 81:14
t: A soul will [then] know what it has brought [with it].

r: The Overthrowing 81:15
t: So I swear by the retreating stars -

r: The Overthrowing 81:16
t: Those that run [their courses] and disappear [i.e., set]

r: The Overthrowing 81:17
t: And by the night as it closes in

r: The Overthrowing 81:18
t: And by the dawn when it breathes [i.e., stirs]

r: The Overthrowing 81:19
t: [That] indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a word [conveyed by] a noble messenger [i.e., Gabriel]

r: The Overthrowing 81:20
t: [Who is] possessed of power and with the Owner of the Throne, secure [in position],

r: The Overthrowing 81:21
t: Obeyed there [in the heavens] and trustworthy.

r: The Overthrowing 81:22
t: And your companion [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ) ] is not [at all] mad.

r: The Overthrowing 81:23
t: And he has already seen him [i.e., Gabriel] in the clear horizon.

r: The Overthrowing 81:24
t: And he [i.e., Muḥammad (ﷺ)] is not a withholder of [knowledge of] the unseen.

r: The Overthrowing 81:25
t: And it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is not the word of a devil, expelled [from the heavens].

r: The Overthrowing 81:26
t: So where are you going?

r: The Overthrowing 81:27
t: It is not except a reminder to the worlds

r: The Overthrowing 81:28
t: For whoever wills among you to take a right course.

r: The Overthrowing 81:29
t: And you do not will except that Allāh wills - Lord of the worlds.

r: The Cleaving 82:1
t: When the sky breaks apart

r: The Cleaving 82:2
t: And when the stars fall, scattering,

r: The Cleaving 82:3
t: And when the seas are erupted

r: The Cleaving 82:4
t: And when the [contents of] graves are scattered [i.e., exposed],

r: The Cleaving 82:5
t: A soul will [then] know what it has put forth and kept back.

r: The Cleaving 82:6
t: O mankind, what has deceived you concerning your Lord, the Generous,

r: The Cleaving 82:7
t: Who created you, proportioned you, and balanced you?

r: The Cleaving 82:8
t: In whatever form He willed has He assembled you.

r: The Cleaving 82:9
t: No! But you deny the Recompense.

r: The Cleaving 82:10
t: And indeed, [appointed] over you are keepers,

r: The Cleaving 82:11
t: Noble and recording;

r: The Cleaving 82:12
t: They know whatever you do.

r: The Cleaving 82:13
t: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure,

r: The Cleaving 82:14
t: And indeed, the wicked will be in Hellfire.

r: The Cleaving 82:15
t: They will [enter to] burn therein on the Day of Recompense,

r: The Cleaving 82:16
t: And never therefrom will they be absent.

r: The Cleaving 82:17
t: And what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?

r: The Cleaving 82:18
t: Then, what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?

r: The Cleaving 82:19
t: It is the Day when a soul will not possess for another soul [power to do] a thing; and the command, that Day, is [entirely] with Allāh.

r: The Defrauders 83:1
t: Woe to those who give less [than due],

r: The Defrauders 83:2
t: Who, when they take a measure from people, take in full.

r: The Defrauders 83:3
t: But if they give by measure or by weight to them, they cause loss.

r: The Defrauders 83:4
t: Do they not think that they will be resurrected

r: The Defrauders 83:5
t: For a tremendous Day -

r: The Defrauders 83:6
t: The Day when mankind will stand before the Lord of the worlds?

r: The Defrauders 83:7
t: No! Indeed, the record of the wicked is in sijjeen.

r: The Defrauders 83:8
t: And what can make you know what is sijjeen?

r: The Defrauders 83:9
t: It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed.

r: The Defrauders 83:10
t: Woe, that Day, to the deniers,

r: The Defrauders 83:11
t: Who deny the Day of Recompense.

r: The Defrauders 83:12
t: And none deny it except every sinful transgressor.

r: The Defrauders 83:13
t: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples."

r: The Defrauders 83:14
t: No! Rather, the stain has covered their hearts of that which they were earning.

r: The Defrauders 83:15
t: No! Indeed, from their Lord, that Day, they will be partitioned.

r: The Defrauders 83:16
t: Then indeed, they will [enter and] burn in Hellfire.

r: The Defrauders 83:17
t: Then it will be said [to them], "This is what you used to deny."

r: The Defrauders 83:18
t: No! Indeed, the record of the righteous is in ʿilliyyūn.

r: The Defrauders 83:19
t: And what can make you know what is ʿilliyyūn?

r: The Defrauders 83:20
t: It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed

r: The Defrauders 83:21
t: Which is witnessed by those brought near [to Allāh].

r: The Defrauders 83:22
t: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure

r: The Defrauders 83:23
t: On adorned couches, observing.

r: The Defrauders 83:24
t: You will recognize in their faces the radiance of pleasure.

r: The Defrauders 83:25
t: They will be given to drink [pure] wine [which was] sealed.

r: The Defrauders 83:26
t: The last of it is musk. So for this let the competitors compete.

r: The Defrauders 83:27
t: And its mixture is of Tasneem,

r: The Defrauders 83:28
t: A spring from which those near [to Allāh] drink.

r: The Defrauders 83:29
t: Indeed, those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed.

r: The Defrauders 83:30
t: And when they passed by them, they would exchange derisive glances.

r: The Defrauders 83:31
t: And when they returned to their people, they would return jesting.

r: The Defrauders 83:32
t: And when they saw them, they would say, "Indeed, those are truly lost."

r: The Defrauders 83:33
t: But they had not been sent as guardians over them.

r: The Defrauders 83:34
t: So Today those who believed are laughing at the disbelievers,

r: The Defrauders 83:35
t: On adorned couches, observing.

r: The Defrauders 83:36
t: Have the disbelievers [not] been rewarded [this Day] for what they used to do?

r: The Sundering 84:1
t: When the sky has split [open]

r: The Sundering 84:2
t: And has listened [i.e., responded] to its Lord and was obligated [to do so]

r: The Sundering 84:3
t: And when the earth has been extended

r: The Sundering 84:4
t: And has cast out that within it and relinquished [it].

r: The Sundering 84:5
t: And has listened [i.e., responded] to its Lord and was obligated [to do so] -

r: The Sundering 84:6
t: O mankind, indeed you are laboring toward your Lord with [great] exertion and will meet it.

r: The Sundering 84:7
t: Then as for he who is given his record in his right hand,

r: The Sundering 84:8
t: He will be judged with an easy account

r: The Sundering 84:9
t: And return to his people in happiness.

r: The Sundering 84:10
t: But as for he who is given his record behind his back,

r: The Sundering 84:11
t: He will cry out for destruction

r: The Sundering 84:12
t: And [enter to] burn in a Blaze.

r: The Sundering 84:13
t: Indeed, he had [once] been among his people in happiness;

r: The Sundering 84:14
t: Indeed, he had thought he would never return [to Allāh].

r: The Sundering 84:15
t: But yes! Indeed, his Lord was ever, of him, Seeing.

r: The Sundering 84:16
t: So I swear by the twilight glow

r: The Sundering 84:17
t: And [by] the night and what it envelops

r: The Sundering 84:18
t: And [by] the moon when it becomes full

r: The Sundering 84:19
t: [That] you will surely embark upon [i.e., experience] state after state.

r: The Sundering 84:20
t: So what is [the matter] with them [that] they do not believe,

r: The Sundering 84:21
t: And when the Qur’ān is recited to them, they do not prostrate [to Allāh]?

r: The Sundering 84:22
t: But those who have disbelieved deny,

r: The Sundering 84:23
t: And Allāh is most knowing of what they keep within themselves.

r: The Sundering 84:24
t: So give them tidings of a painful punishment,

r: The Sundering 84:25
t: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds. For them is a reward uninterrupted.

r: The Mansions of the Stars 85:1
t: By the sky containing great stars

r: The Mansions of the Stars 85:2
t: And [by] the promised Day

r: The Mansions of the Stars 85:3
t: And [by] the witness and what is witnessed,

r: The Mansions of the Stars 85:4
t: Destroyed [i.e., cursed] were the companions of the trench

r: The Mansions of the Stars 85:5
t: [Containing] the fire full of fuel,

r: The Mansions of the Stars 85:6
t: When they were sitting near it.

r: The Mansions of the Stars 85:7
t: And they, to what they were doing against the believers, were witnesses.

r: The Mansions of the Stars 85:8
t: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy,

r: The Mansions of the Stars 85:9
t: To whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And Allāh, over all things, is Witness.

r: The Mansions of the Stars 85:10
t: Indeed, those who have tortured the believing men and believing women and then have not repented will have the punishment of Hell, and they will have the punishment of the Burning Fire.

r: The Mansions of the Stars 85:11
t: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds will have gardens beneath which rivers flow. That is the great attainment.

r: The Mansions of the Stars 85:12
t: Indeed, the assault [i.e., vengeance] of your Lord is severe.

r: The Mansions of the Stars 85:13
t: Indeed, it is He who originates [creation] and repeats.

r: The Mansions of the Stars 85:14
t: And He is the Forgiving, the Affectionate,

r: The Mansions of the Stars 85:15
t: Honorable Owner of the Throne,

r: The Mansions of the Stars 85:16
t: Effecter of what He intends.

r: The Mansions of the Stars 85:17
t: Has there reached you the story of the soldiers -

r: The Mansions of the Stars 85:18
t: [Those of] Pharaoh and Thamūd?

r: The Mansions of the Stars 85:19
t: But they who disbelieve are in [persistent] denial,

r: The Mansions of the Stars 85:20
t: While Allāh encompasses them from behind.

r: The Mansions of the Stars 85:21
t: But this is an honored Qur’ān

r: The Mansions of the Stars 85:22
t: [Inscribed] in a Preserved Slate.

r: The Nightcomer 86:1
t: By the sky and the night comer

r: The Nightcomer 86:2
t: And what can make you know what is the night comer?

r: The Nightcomer 86:3
t: It is the piercing star

r: The Nightcomer 86:4
t: There is no soul but that it has over it a protector.

r: The Nightcomer 86:5
t: So let man observe from what he was created.

r: The Nightcomer 86:6
t: He was created from a fluid, ejected,

r: The Nightcomer 86:7
t: Emerging from between the backbone and the ribs.

r: The Nightcomer 86:8
t: Indeed, He [i.e., Allāh], to return him [to life], is Able.

r: The Nightcomer 86:9
t: The Day when secrets will be put on trial,

r: The Nightcomer 86:10
t: Then he [i.e., man] will have no power or any helper.

r: The Nightcomer 86:11
t: By the sky which sends back

r: The Nightcomer 86:12
t: And [by] the earth which splits,

r: The Nightcomer 86:13
t: Indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a decisive statement,

r: The Nightcomer 86:14
t: And it is not amusement.

r: The Nightcomer 86:15
t: Indeed, they are planning a plan,

r: The Nightcomer 86:16
t: But I am planning a plan.

r: The Nightcomer 86:17
t: So allow time for the disbelievers. Leave them awhile.

r: The Most High 87:1
t: Exalt the name of your Lord, the Most High,

r: The Most High 87:2
t: Who created and proportioned

r: The Most High 87:3
t: And who destined and [then] guided

r: The Most High 87:4
t: And who brings out the pasture

r: The Most High 87:5
t: And [then] makes it black stubble.

r: The Most High 87:6
t: We will make you recite, [O Muḥammad], and you will not forget,

r: The Most High 87:7
t: Except what Allāh should will. Indeed, He knows what is declared and what is hidden.

r: The Most High 87:8
t: And We will ease you toward ease.

r: The Most High 87:9
t: So remind, if the reminder should benefit;

r: The Most High 87:10
t: He who fears [Allāh] will be reminded.

r: The Most High 87:11
t: But the wretched one will avoid it

r: The Most High 87:12
t: [He] who will [enter and] burn in the greatest Fire,

r: The Most High 87:13
t: Neither dying therein nor living.

r: The Most High 87:14
t: He has certainly succeeded who purifies himself

r: The Most High 87:15
t: And mentions the name of his Lord and prays.

r: The Most High 87:16
t: But you prefer the worldly life,

r: The Most High 87:17
t: While the Hereafter is better and more enduring.

r: The Most High 87:18
t: Indeed, this is in the former scriptures,

r: The Most High 87:19
t: The scriptures of Abraham and Moses.

r: The Overwhelming 88:1
t: Has there reached you the report of the Overwhelming [event]?

r: The Overwhelming 88:2
t: [Some] faces, that Day, will be humbled,

r: The Overwhelming 88:3
t: Working [hard] and exhausted.

r: The Overwhelming 88:4
t: They will [enter to] burn in an intensely hot Fire.

r: The Overwhelming 88:5
t: They will be given drink from a boiling spring.

r: The Overwhelming 88:6
t: For them there will be no food except from a poisonous, thorny plant

r: The Overwhelming 88:7
t: Which neither nourishes nor avails against hunger.

r: The Overwhelming 88:8
t: [Other] faces, that Day, will show pleasure.

r: The Overwhelming 88:9
t: With their effort [they are] satisfied

r: The Overwhelming 88:10
t: In an elevated garden,

r: The Overwhelming 88:11
t: Wherein they will hear no unsuitable speech.

r: The Overwhelming 88:12
t: Within it is a flowing spring.

r: The Overwhelming 88:13
t: Within it are couches raised high

r: The Overwhelming 88:14
t: And cups put in place

r: The Overwhelming 88:15
t: And cushions lined up

r: The Overwhelming 88:16
t: And carpets spread around.

r: The Overwhelming 88:17
t: Then do they not look at the camels - how they are created?

r: The Overwhelming 88:18
t: And at the sky - how it is raised?

r: The Overwhelming 88:19
t: And at the mountains - how they are erected?

r: The Overwhelming 88:20
t: And at the earth - how it is spread out?

r: The Overwhelming 88:21
t: So remind, [O Muḥammad]; you are only a reminder.

r: The Overwhelming 88:22
t: You are not over them a controller.

r: The Overwhelming 88:23
t: However, he who turns away and disbelieves

r: The Overwhelming 88:24
t: Then Allāh will punish him with the greatest punishment.

r: The Overwhelming 88:25
t: Indeed, to Us is their return.

r: The Overwhelming 88:26
t: Then indeed, upon Us is their account.

r: The Dawn 89:1
t: By the dawn

r: The Dawn 89:2
t: And [by] ten nights

r: The Dawn 89:3
t: And [by] the even [number] and the odd

r: The Dawn 89:4
t: And [by] the night when it passes,

r: The Dawn 89:5
t: Is there [not] in [all] that an oath [sufficient] for one of perception?

r: The Dawn 89:6
t: Have you not considered how your Lord dealt with ʿAad -

r: The Dawn 89:7
t: [With] Iram - who had lofty pillars,

r: The Dawn 89:8
t: The likes of whom had never been created in the land?

r: The Dawn 89:9
t: And [with] Thamūd, who carved out the rocks in the valley?

r: The Dawn 89:10
t: And [with] Pharaoh, owner of the stakes?

r: The Dawn 89:11
t: [All of] whom oppressed within the lands

r: The Dawn 89:12
t: And increased therein the corruption.

r: The Dawn 89:13
t: So your Lord poured upon them a scourge of punishment.

r: The Dawn 89:14
t: Indeed, your Lord is in observation.

r: The Dawn 89:15
t: And as for man, when his Lord tries him and [thus] is generous to him and favors him, he says, "My Lord has honored me."

r: The Dawn 89:16
t: But when He tries him and restricts his provision, he says, "My Lord has humiliated me."

r: The Dawn 89:17
t: No! But you do not honor the orphan

r: The Dawn 89:18
t: And you do not encourage one another to feed the poor.

r: The Dawn 89:19
t: And you consume inheritance, devouring [it] altogether,

r: The Dawn 89:20
t: And you love wealth with immense love.

r: The Dawn 89:21
t: No! When the earth has been leveled - pounded and crushed

r: The Dawn 89:22
t: And your Lord has come and the angels, rank upon rank,

r: The Dawn 89:23
t: And brought [within view], that Day, is Hell - that Day, man will remember, but how [i.e., what good] to him will be the remembrance?

r: The Dawn 89:24
t: He will say, "Oh, I wish I had sent ahead [some good] for my life."

r: The Dawn 89:25
t: So on that Day, none will punish [as severely] as His punishment,

r: The Dawn 89:26
t: And none will bind [as severely] as His binding [of the evildoers].

r: The Dawn 89:27
t: [To the righteous it will be said], "O reassured soul,

r: The Dawn 89:28
t: Return to your Lord, well-pleased and pleasing [to Him],

r: The Dawn 89:29
t: And enter among My [righteous] servants

r: The Dawn 89:30
t: And enter My Paradise."

r: The City 90:1
t: I swear by this city [i.e., Makkah]

r: The City 90:2
t: And you, [O Muḥammad], are free of restriction in this city

r: The City 90:3
t: And [by] the father and that which was born [of him],

r: The City 90:4
t: We have certainly created man into hardship.

r: The City 90:5
t: Does he think that never will anyone overcome him?

r: The City 90:6
t: He says, "I have spent wealth in abundance."

r: The City 90:7
t: Does he think that no one has seen him?

r: The City 90:8
t: Have We not made for him two eyes?

r: The City 90:9
t: And a tongue and two lips?

r: The City 90:10
t: And have shown him the two ways?

r: The City 90:11
t: But he has not broken through the difficult pass.

r: The City 90:12
t: And what can make you know what is [breaking through] the difficult pass?

r: The City 90:13
t: It is the freeing of a slave

r: The City 90:14
t: Or feeding on a day of severe hunger

r: The City 90:15
t: An orphan of near relationship

r: The City 90:16
t: Or a needy person in misery

r: The City 90:17
t: And then being among those who believed and advised one another to patience and advised one another to compassion.

r: The City 90:18
t: Those are the companions of the right.

r: The City 90:19
t: But they who disbelieved in Our signs - those are the companions of the left.

r: The City 90:20
t: Over them will be fire closed in.

r: The Sun 91:1
t: By the sun and its brightness

r: The Sun 91:2
t: And [by] the moon when it follows it

r: The Sun 91:3
t: And [by] the day when it displays it

r: The Sun 91:4
t: And [by] the night when it covers [i.e., conceals] it

r: The Sun 91:5
t: And [by] the sky and He who constructed it

r: The Sun 91:6
t: And [by] the earth and He who spread it

r: The Sun 91:7
t: And [by] the soul and He who proportioned it

r: The Sun 91:8
t: And inspired it [with discernment of] its wickedness and its righteousness,

r: The Sun 91:9
t: He has succeeded who purifies it,

r: The Sun 91:10
t: And he has failed who instills it [with corruption].

r: The Sun 91:11
t: Thamūd denied [their prophet] by reason of their transgression,

r: The Sun 91:12
t: When the most wretched of them was sent forth.

r: The Sun 91:13
t: And the messenger of Allāh [i.e., Ṣāliḥ] said to them, "[Do not harm] the she-camel of Allāh or [prevent her from] her drink."

r: The Sun 91:14
t: But they denied him and hamstrung her. So their Lord brought down upon them destruction for their sin and made it equal [upon all of them].

r: The Sun 91:15
t: And He does not fear the consequence thereof.

r: The Night 92:1
t: By the night when it covers

r: The Night 92:2
t: And [by] the day when it appears

r: The Night 92:3
t: And [by] He who created the male and female,

r: The Night 92:4
t: Indeed, your efforts are diverse.

r: The Night 92:5
t: As for he who gives and fears Allāh

r: The Night 92:6
t: And believes in the best [reward],

r: The Night 92:7
t: We will ease him toward ease.

r: The Night 92:8
t: But as for he who withholds and considers himself free of need

r: The Night 92:9
t: And denies the best [reward],

r: The Night 92:10
t: We will ease him toward difficulty.

r: The Night 92:11
t: And what will his wealth avail him when he falls?

r: The Night 92:12
t: Indeed, [incumbent] upon Us is guidance.

r: The Night 92:13
t: And indeed, to us belongs the Hereafter and the first [life].

r: The Night 92:14
t: So I have warned you of a Fire which is blazing.

r: The Night 92:15
t: None will [enter to] burn therein except the most wretched one

r: The Night 92:16
t: Who had denied and turned away.

r: The Night 92:17
t: But the righteous one will avoid it

r: The Night 92:18
t: [He] who gives [from] his wealth to purify himself

r: The Night 92:19
t: And not [giving] for anyone who has [done him] a favor to be rewarded

r: The Night 92:20
t: But only seeking the face [i.e., acceptance] of his Lord, Most High.

r: The Night 92:21
t: And he is going to be satisfied.

r: The Morning Hours 93:1
t: By the morning brightness

r: The Morning Hours 93:2
t: And [by] the night when it covers with darkness,

r: The Morning Hours 93:3
t: Your Lord has not taken leave of you, [O Muḥammad], nor has He detested [you].

r: The Morning Hours 93:4
t: And the Hereafter is better for you than the first [life].

r: The Morning Hours 93:5
t: And your Lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied.

r: The Morning Hours 93:6
t: Did He not find you an orphan and give [you] refuge?

r: The Morning Hours 93:7
t: And He found you lost and guided [you],

r: The Morning Hours 93:8
t: And He found you poor and made [you] self-sufficient.

r: The Morning Hours 93:9
t: So as for the orphan, do not oppress [him].

r: The Morning Hours 93:10
t: And as for the petitioner, do not repel [him].

r: The Morning Hours 93:11
t: But as for the favor of your Lord, report [it].

r: The Relief 94:1
t: Did We not expand for you, [O Muḥammad], your breast?

r: The Relief 94:2
t: And We removed from you your burden

r: The Relief 94:3
t: Which had weighed upon your back

r: The Relief 94:4
t: And raised high for you your repute.

r: The Relief 94:5
t: For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease [i.e., relief].

r: The Relief 94:6
t: Indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.

r: The Relief 94:7
t: So when you have finished [your duties], then stand up [for worship].

r: The Relief 94:8
t: And to your Lord direct [your] longing.

r: The Fig 95:1
t: By the fig and the olive

r: The Fig 95:2
t: And [by] Mount Sinai

r: The Fig 95:3
t: And [by] this secure city [i.e., Makkah],

r: The Fig 95:4
t: We have certainly created man in the best of stature;

r: The Fig 95:5
t: Then We return him to the lowest of the low,

r: The Fig 95:6
t: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds, for they will have a reward uninterrupted.

r: The Fig 95:7
t: So what yet causes you to deny the Recompense?

r: The Fig 95:8
t: Is not Allāh the most just of judges?

r: The Clot 96:1
t: Recite in the name of your Lord who created

r: The Clot 96:2
t: Created man from a clinging substance.

r: The Clot 96:3
t: Recite, and your Lord is the most Generous -

r: The Clot 96:4
t: Who taught by the pen

r: The Clot 96:5
t: Taught man that which he knew not.

r: The Clot 96:6
t: No! [But] indeed, man transgresses

r: The Clot 96:7
t: Because he sees himself self-sufficient.

r: The Clot 96:8
t: Indeed, to your Lord is the return.

r: The Clot 96:9
t: Have you seen the one who forbids

r: The Clot 96:10
t: A servant when he prays?

r: The Clot 96:11
t: Have you seen if he is upon guidance

r: The Clot 96:12
t: Or enjoins righteousness?

r: The Clot 96:13
t: Have you seen if he denies and turns away -

r: The Clot 96:14
t: Does he not know that Allāh sees?

r: The Clot 96:15
t: No! If he does not desist, We will surely drag him by the forelock

r: The Clot 96:16
t: A lying, sinning forelock.

r: The Clot 96:17
t: Then let him call his associates;

r: The Clot 96:18
t: We will call the angels of Hell.

r: The Clot 96:19
t: No! Do not obey him. But prostrate and draw near [to Allāh].

r: The Power 97:1
t: Indeed, We sent it [i.e., the Qur’ān] down during the Night of Decree.

r: The Power 97:2
t: And what can make you know what is the Night of Decree?

r: The Power 97:3
t: The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months.

r: The Power 97:4
t: The angels and the Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] descend therein by permission of their Lord for every matter.

r: The Power 97:5
t: Peace it is until the emergence of dawn.

r: The Clear Proof 98:1
t: Those who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists were not to be parted [from misbelief] until there came to them clear evidence

r: The Clear Proof 98:2
t: A Messenger from Allāh, reciting purified scriptures

r: The Clear Proof 98:3
t: Within which are correct writings [i.e., rulings and laws].

r: The Clear Proof 98:4
t: Nor did those who were given the Scripture become divided until after there had come to them clear evidence.

r: The Clear Proof 98:5
t: And they were not commanded except to worship Allāh, [being] sincere to Him in religion, inclining to truth, and to establish prayer and to give zakāh. And that is the correct religion.

r: The Clear Proof 98:6
t: Indeed, they who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists will be in the fire of Hell, abiding eternally therein. Those are the worst of creatures.

r: The Clear Proof 98:7
t: Indeed, they who have believed and done righteous deeds - those are the best of creatures.

r: The Clear Proof 98:8
t: Their reward with their Lord will be gardens of perpetual residence beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever, Allāh being pleased with them and they with Him. That is for whoever has feared his Lord.

r: The Earthquake 99:1
t: When the earth is shaken with its [final] earthquake

r: The Earthquake 99:2
t: And the earth discharges its burdens

r: The Earthquake 99:3
t: And man says, "What is [wrong] with it?" -

r: The Earthquake 99:4
t: That Day, it will report its news

r: The Earthquake 99:5
t: Because your Lord has inspired [i.e., commanded] it.

r: The Earthquake 99:6
t: That Day, the people will depart separated [into categories] to be shown [the result of] their deeds.

r: The Earthquake 99:7
t: So whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it,

r: The Earthquake 99:8
t: And whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it.

r: The Chargers 100:1
t: By the racers, panting,

r: The Chargers 100:2
t: And the producers of sparks [when] striking

r: The Chargers 100:3
t: And the chargers at dawn,

r: The Chargers 100:4
t: Stirring up thereby [clouds of] dust,

r: The Chargers 100:5
t: Arriving thereby in the center collectively,

r: The Chargers 100:6
t: Indeed mankind, to his Lord, is ungrateful.

r: The Chargers 100:7
t: And indeed, he is to that a witness.

r: The Chargers 100:8
t: And indeed he is, in love of wealth, intense.

r: The Chargers 100:9
t: But does he not know that when the contents of the graves are scattered

r: The Chargers 100:10
t: And that within the breasts is obtained,

r: The Chargers 100:11
t: Indeed, their Lord with them, that Day, is [fully] Aware.

r: The Calamity 101:1
t: The Striking Calamity -

r: The Calamity 101:2
t: What is the Striking Calamity?

r: The Calamity 101:3
t: And what can make you know what is the Striking Calamity?

r: The Calamity 101:4
t: It is the Day when people will be like moths, dispersed,

r: The Calamity 101:5
t: And the mountains will be like wool, fluffed up.

r: The Calamity 101:6
t: Then as for one whose scales are heavy [with good deeds],

r: The Calamity 101:7
t: He will be in a pleasant life.

r: The Calamity 101:8
t: But as for one whose scales are light,

r: The Calamity 101:9
t: His refuge will be an abyss.

r: The Calamity 101:10
t: And what can make you know what that is?

r: The Calamity 101:11
t: It is a Fire, intensely hot.

r: The Rivalry in World Increase 102:1
t: Competition in [worldly] increase diverts you

r: The Rivalry in World Increase 102:2
t: Until you visit the graveyards.

r: The Rivalry in World Increase 102:3
t: No! You are going to know.

r: The Rivalry in World Increase 102:4
t: Then, no! You are going to know.

r: The Rivalry in World Increase 102:5
t: No! If you only knew with knowledge of certainty...

r: The Rivalry in World Increase 102:6
t: You will surely see the Hellfire.

r: The Rivalry in World Increase 102:7
t: Then you will surely see it with the eye of certainty.

r: The Rivalry in World Increase 102:8
t: Then you will surely be asked that Day about pleasure.

r: The Declining Day 103:1
t: By time,

r: The Declining Day 103:2
t: Indeed, mankind is in loss,

r: The Declining Day 103:3
t: Except for those who have believed and done righteous deeds and advised each other to truth and advised each other to patience.

r: The Traducer 104:1
t: Woe to every scorner and mocker

r: The Traducer 104:2
t: Who collects wealth and [continuously] counts it.

r: The Traducer 104:3
t: He thinks that his wealth will make him immortal.

r: The Traducer 104:4
t: No! He will surely be thrown into the Crusher.

r: The Traducer 104:5
t: And what can make you know what is the Crusher?

r: The Traducer 104:6
t: It is the fire of Allāh, [eternally] fueled,

r: The Traducer 104:7
t: Which mounts directed at the hearts.

r: The Traducer 104:8
t: Indeed, it [i.e., Hellfire] will be closed down upon them

r: The Traducer 104:9
t: In extended columns.

r: The Elephant 105:1
t: Have you not considered, [O Muḥammad], how your Lord dealt with the companions of the elephant?

r: The Elephant 105:2
t: Did He not make their plan into misguidance?

r: The Elephant 105:3
t: And He sent against them birds in flocks,

r: The Elephant 105:4
t: Striking them with stones of hard clay,

r: The Elephant 105:5
t: And He made them like eaten straw.

r: Quraysh 106:1
t: For the accustomed security of the Quraysh -

r: Quraysh 106:2
t: Their accustomed security [in] the caravan of winter and summer -

r: Quraysh 106:3
t: Let them worship the Lord of this House,

r: Quraysh 106:4
t: Who has fed them, [saving them] from hunger and made them safe, [saving them] from fear.

r: The Small Kindnesses 107:1
t: Have you seen the one who denies the Recompense?

r: The Small Kindnesses 107:2
t: For that is the one who drives away the orphan

r: The Small Kindnesses 107:3
t: And does not encourage the feeding of the poor.

r: The Small Kindnesses 107:4
t: So woe to those who pray

r: The Small Kindnesses 107:5
t: [But] who are heedless of their prayer -

r: The Small Kindnesses 107:6
t: Those who make show [of their deeds]

r: The Small Kindnesses 107:7
t: And withhold [simple] assistance.

r: The Abundance 108:1
t: Indeed, We have granted you, [O Muḥammad], al-Kawthar.

r: The Abundance 108:2
t: So pray to your Lord and offer sacrifice [to Him alone].

r: The Abundance 108:3
t: Indeed, your enemy is the one cut off.

r: The Disbelievers 109:1
t: Say, "O disbelievers,

r: The Disbelievers 109:2
t: I do not worship what you worship.

r: The Disbelievers 109:3
t: Nor are you worshippers of what I worship.

r: The Disbelievers 109:4
t: Nor will I be a worshipper of what you worship.

r: The Disbelievers 109:5
t: Nor will you be worshippers of what I worship.

r: The Disbelievers 109:6
t: For you is your religion, and for me is my religion."

r: The Divine Support 110:1
t: When the victory of Allāh has come and the conquest,

r: The Divine Support 110:2
t: And you see the people entering into the religion of Allāh in multitudes,

r: The Divine Support 110:3
t: Then exalt [Him] with praise of your Lord and ask forgiveness of Him. Indeed, He is ever Accepting of Repentance.

r: The Palm Fiber 111:1
t: May the hands of Abū Lahab be ruined, and ruined is he.

r: The Palm Fiber 111:2
t: His wealth will not avail him or that which he gained.

r: The Palm Fiber 111:3
t: He will [enter to] burn in a Fire of [blazing] flame

r: The Palm Fiber 111:4
t: And his wife [as well] - the carrier of firewood.

r: The Palm Fiber 111:5
t: Around her neck is a rope of [twisted] fiber.

r: The Sincerity 112:1
t: Say, "He is Allāh, [who is] One,

r: The Sincerity 112:2
t: Allāh, the Eternal Refuge.

r: The Sincerity 112:3
t: He neither begets nor is born,

r: The Sincerity 112:4
t: Nor is there to Him any equivalent."

r: The Daybreak 113:1
t: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak

r: The Daybreak 113:2
t: From the evil of that which He created

r: The Daybreak 113:3
t: And from the evil of darkness when it settles

r: The Daybreak 113:4
t: And from the evil of the blowers in knots

r: The Daybreak 113:5
t: And from the evil of an envier when he envies."

r: Mankind 114:1
t: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind,

r: Mankind 114:2
t: The Sovereign of mankind,

r: Mankind 114:3
t: The God of mankind,

r: Mankind 114:4
t: From the evil of the retreating whisperer -

r: Mankind 114:5
t: Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind -

r: Mankind 114:6
t: From among the jinn and mankind".

r: Sahih / Muslim / Characteristics of The Hypocrites And Rulings Concerning Them #2772
t: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ مُعَاوِيَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ زَيْدَ بْنَ أَرْقَمَ، يَقُولُ خَرَجْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي سَفَرٍ أَصَابَ النَّاسَ فِيهِ شِدَّةٌ فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أُبَىٍّ لأَصْحَابِهِ لاَ تُنْفِقُوا عَلَى مَنْ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى يَنْفَضُّوا مِنْ حَوْلِهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ زُهَيْرٌ وَهِيَ قِرَاءَةُ مَنْ خَفَضَ حَوْلَهُ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ لَئِنْ رَجَعْنَا إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ لَيُخْرِجَنَّ الأَعَزُّ مِنْهَا الأَذَلَّ - قَالَ - فَأَتَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ بِذَلِكَ فَأَرْسَلَ إِلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أُبَىٍّ فَسَأَلَهُ فَاجْتَهَدَ يَمِينَهُ مَا فَعَلَ فَقَالَ كَذَبَ زَيْدٌ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم - قَالَ - فَوَقَعَ فِي نَفْسِي مِمَّا قَالُوهُ شِدَّةٌ حَتَّى أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَصْدِيقِي ‏{‏ إِذَا جَاءَكَ الْمُنَافِقُونَ‏}‏ قَالَ ثُمَّ دَعَاهُمُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِيَسْتَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ - قَالَ - فَلَوَّوْا رُءُوسَهُمْ ‏.‏ وَقَوْلُهُ ‏{‏ كَأَنَّهُمْ خُشُبٌ مُسَنَّدَةٌ‏}‏ وَقَالَ كَانُوا رِجَالاً أَجْمَلَ شَىْءٍ ‏.‏

r: Sahih / Muslim / Characteristics of The Hypocrites And Rulings Concerning Them #2773
t: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَأَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدَةَ الضَّبِّيُّ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ - قَالَ ابْنُ عَبْدَةَ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرًا، يَقُولُ أَتَى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَبْرَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أُبَىٍّ فَأَخْرَجَهُ مِنْ قَبْرِهِ فَوَضَعَهُ عَلَى رُكْبَتَيْهِ وَنَفَثَ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ رِيقِهِ وَأَلْبَسَهُ قَمِيصَهُ فَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ ‏.‏

r: Sahih / Muslim / Characteristics of The Hypocrites And Rulings Concerning Them #2773a
t: حَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ الأَزْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ دِينَارٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ جَاءَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أُبَىٍّ بَعْدَ مَا أُدْخِلَ حُفْرَتَهُ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ سُفْيَانَ ‏.‏

r: Sahih / Muslim / Characteristics of The Hypocrites And Rulings Concerning Them #2774
t: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ لَمَّا تُوُفِّيَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أُبَىٍّ ابْنُ سَلُولَ جَاءَ ابْنُهُ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَسَأَلَهُ أَنْ يُعْطِيَهُ قَمِيصَهُ يُكَفِّنُ فِيهِ أَبَاهُ فَأَعْطَاهُ ثُمَّ سَأَلَهُ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ فَقَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِيُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ فَقَامَ عُمَرُ فَأَخَذَ بِثَوْبِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَتُصَلِّي عَلَيْهِ وَقَدْ نَهَاكَ اللَّهُ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّمَا خَيَّرَنِي اللَّهُ فَقَالَ اسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ أَوْ لاَ تَسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ إِنْ تَسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ سَبْعِينَ مَرَّةً وَسَأَزِيدُهُ عَلَى سَبْعِينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ إِنَّهُ مُنَافِقٌ ‏.‏ فَصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏{‏ وَلاَ تُصَلِّ عَلَى أَحَدٍ مِنْهُمْ مَاتَ أَبَدًا وَلاَ تَقُمْ عَلَى قَبْرِهِ‏}‏

r: Sahih / Muslim / Characteristics of The Hypocrites And Rulings Concerning Them #2774a
t: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَعُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، - وَهُوَ الْقَطَّانُ - عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ وَزَادَ قَالَ فَتَرَكَ الصَّلاَةَ عَلَيْهِمْ ‏.‏

r: Sahih / Muslim / Characteristics of The Hypocrites And Rulings Concerning Them #2775
t: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ الْمَكِّيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي، مَعْمَرٍ عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، قَالَ اجْتَمَعَ عِنْدَ الْبَيْتِ ثَلاَثَةُ نَفَرٍ قُرَشِيَّانِ وَثَقَفِيٌّ أَوْ ثَقَفِيَّانِ وَقُرَشِيٌّ قَلِيلٌ فِقْهُ قُلُوبِهِمْ كَثِيرٌ شَحْمُ بُطُونِهِمْ فَقَالَ أَحَدُهُمْ أَتَرَوْنَ اللَّهَ يَسْمَعُ مَا نَقُولُ وَقَالَ الآخَرُ يَسْمَعُ إِنْ جَهَرْنَا وَلاَ يَسْمَعُ إِنْ أَخْفَيْنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرُ إِنْ كَانَ يَسْمَعُ إِذَا جَهَرْنَا فَهُوَ يَسْمَعُ إِذَا أَخْفَيْنَا ‏.‏ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏{‏ وَمَا كُنْتُمْ تَسْتَتِرُونَ أَنْ يَشْهَدَ عَلَيْكُمْ سَمْعُكُمْ وَلاَ أَبْصَارُكُمْ وَلاَ جُلُودُكُمْ‏}‏ الآيَةَ ‏.‏

r: Sahih / Muslim / Characteristics of The Hypocrites And Rulings Concerning Them #2775a
t: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ خَلاَّدٍ الْبَاهِلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ سَعِيدٍ - حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ وَهْبِ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، ح وَقَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنِي مَنْصُورٌ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، بِنَحْوِهِ ‏.‏

r: Sahih / Muslim / Characteristics of The Hypocrites And Rulings Concerning Them #2776
t: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَدِيٍّ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ ثَابِتٍ - قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ يَزِيدَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَرَجَ إِلَى أُحُدٍ فَرَجَعَ نَاسٌ مِمَّنْ كَانَ مَعَهُ فَكَانَ أَصْحَابُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِيهِمْ فِرْقَتَيْنِ قَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ نَقْتُلُهُمْ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ لاَ ‏.‏ فَنَزَلَتْ ‏{‏ فَمَا لَكُمْ فِي الْمُنَافِقِينَ فِئَتَيْنِ‏}‏

r: Sahih / Muslim / Characteristics of The Hypocrites And Rulings Concerning Them #2776a
t: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ نَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏

r: Sahih / Muslim / Characteristics of The Hypocrites And Rulings Concerning Them #2777
t: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَهْلٍ التَّمِيمِيُّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي، مَرْيَمَ أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي زَيْدُ بْنُ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، الْخُدْرِيِّ أَنَّ رِجَالاً، مِنَ الْمُنَافِقِينَ فِي عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانُوا إِذَا خَرَجَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى الْغَزْوِ تَخَلَّفُوا عَنْهُ وَفَرِحُوا بِمَقْعَدِهِمْ خِلاَفَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَإِذَا قَدِمَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم اعْتَذَرُوا إِلَيْهِ وَحَلَفُوا وَأَحَبُّوا أَنْ يُحْمَدُوا بِمَا لَمْ يَفْعَلُوا فَنَزَلَتْ ‏{‏ لاَ تَحْسَبَنَّ الَّذِينَ يَفْرَحُونَ بِمَا أَتَوْا وَيُحِبُّونَ أَنْ يُحْمَدُوا بِمَا لَمْ يَفْعَلُوا فَلاَ تَحْسَبَنَّهُمْ بِمَفَازَةٍ مِنَ الْعَذَابِ‏}‏

r: Sahih / Muslim / Characteristics of The Hypocrites And Rulings Concerning Them #2778
t: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَهَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِزُهَيْرٍ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ، بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، أَنَّ حُمَيْدَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ مَرْوَانَ قَالَ اذْهَبْ يَا رَافِعُ - لِبَوَّابِهِ - إِلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ فَقُلْ لَئِنْ كَانَ كُلُّ امْرِئٍ مِنَّا فَرِحَ بِمَا أَتَى وَأَحَبَّ أَنْ يُحْمَدَ بِمَا لَمْ يَفْعَلْ مُعَذَّبًا لَنُعَذَّبَنَّ أَجْمَعُونَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ مَا لَكُمْ وَلِهَذِهِ الآيَةِ إِنَّمَا أُنْزِلَتْ هَذِهِ الآيَةُ فِي أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ تَلاَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ ‏{‏ وَإِذْ أَخَذَ اللَّهُ مِيثَاقَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْكِتَابَ لَتُبَيِّنُنَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ وَلاَ تَكْتُمُونَهُ‏}‏ هَذِهِ الآيَةَ وَتَلاَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ ‏{‏ لاَ تَحْسَبَنَّ الَّذِينَ يَفْرَحُونَ بِمَا أَتَوْا وَيُحِبُّونَ أَنْ يُحْمَدُوا بِمَا لَمْ يَفْعَلُوا‏}‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ سَأَلَهُمُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ شَىْءٍ فَكَتَمُوهُ إِيَّاهُ وَأَخْبَرُوهُ بِغَيْرِهِ فَخَرَجُوا قَدْ أَرَوْهُ أَنْ قَدْ أَخْبَرُوهُ بِمَا سَأَلَهُمْ عَنْهُ وَاسْتَحْمَدُوا بِذَلِكَ إِلَيْهِ وَفَرِحُوا بِمَا أَتَوْا مِنْ كِتْمَانِهِمْ إِيَّاهُ مَا سَأَلَهُمْ عَنْهُ ‏.‏

r: Sahih / Muslim / Characteristics of The Hypocrites And Rulings Concerning Them #2779
t: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَسْوَدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ بْنُ الْحَجَّاجِ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ، عَنْ قَيْسٍ، قَالَ قُلْتُ لِعَمَّارٍ أَرَأَيْتُمْ صَنِيعَكُمْ هَذَا الَّذِي صَنَعْتُمْ فِي أَمْرِ عَلِيٍّ أَرَأْيًا رَأَيْتُمُوهُ أَوْ شَيْئًا عَهِدَهُ إِلَيْكُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ مَا عَهِدَ إِلَيْنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم شَيْئًا لَمْ يَعْهَدْهُ إِلَى النَّاسِ كَافَّةً وَلَكِنْ حُذَيْفَةُ أَخْبَرَنِي عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ فِي أَصْحَابِي اثْنَا عَشَرَ مُنَافِقًا فِيهِمْ ثَمَانِيَةٌ لاَ يَدْخُلُونَ الْجَنَّةَ حَتَّى يَلِجَ الْجَمَلُ فِي سَمِّ الْخِيَاطِ ثَمَانِيَةٌ مِنْهُمْ تَكْفِيكَهُمُ الدُّبَيْلَةُ وَأَرْبَعَةٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ لَمْ أَحْفَظْ مَا قَالَ شُعْبَةُ فِيهِمْ ‏.‏

r: Sahih / Muslim / Characteristics of The Hypocrites And Rulings Concerning Them #2779a
t: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ الْمُثَنَّى - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ، عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ عُبَادٍ، قَالَ قُلْنَا لِعَمَّارٍ أَرَأَيْتَ قِتَالَكُمْ أَرَأْيًا رَأَيْتُمُوهُ فَإِنَّ الرَّأْىَ يُخْطِئُ وَيُصِيبُ أَوْ عَهْدًا عَهِدَهُ إِلَيْكُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ مَا عَهِدَ إِلَيْنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم شَيْئًا لَمْ يَعْهَدْهُ إِلَى النَّاسِ كَافَّةً ‏.‏ وَقَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ فِي أُمَّتِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ شُعْبَةُ وَأَحْسِبُهُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي حُذَيْفَةُ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ غُنْدَرٌ أُرَاهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ فِي أُمَّتِي اثْنَا عَشَرَ مُنَافِقًا لاَ يَدْخُلُونَ الْجَنَّةَ وَلاَ يَجِدُونَ رِيحَهَا حَتَّى يَلِجَ الْجَمَلُ فِي سَمِّ الْخِيَاطِ ثَمَانِيَةٌ مِنْهُمْ تَكْفِيكَهُمُ الدُّبَيْلَةُ سِرَاجٌ مِنَ النَّارِ يَظْهَرُ فِي أَكْتَافِهِمْ حَتَّى يَنْجُمَ مِنْ صُدُورِهِمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏

r: Sahih / Muslim / Characteristics of The Hypocrites And Rulings Concerning Them #2779b
t: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أَحْمَدَ الْكُوفِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ جُمَيْعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الطُّفَيْلِ، قَالَ كَانَ بَيْنَ رَجُلٍ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْعَقَبَةِ وَبَيْنَ حُذَيْفَةَ بَعْضُ مَا يَكُونُ بَيْنَ النَّاسِ فَقَالَ أَنْشُدُكَ بِاللَّهِ كَمْ كَانَ أَصْحَابُ الْعَقَبَةِ قَالَ فَقَالَ لَهُ الْقَوْمُ أَخْبِرْهُ إِذْ سَأَلَكَ قَالَ كُنَّا نُخْبَرُ أَنَّهُمْ أَرْبَعَةَ عَشَرَ فَإِنْ كُنْتَ مِنْهُمْ فَقَدْ كَانَ الْقَوْمُ خَمْسَةَ عَشَرَ وَأَشْهَدُ بِاللَّهِ أَنَّ اثْنَىْ عَشَرَ مِنْهُمْ حَرْبٌ لِلَّهِ وَلِرَسُولِهِ فِي الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا وَيَوْمَ يَقُومُ الأَشْهَادُ وَعَذَرَ ثَلاَثَةً قَالُوا مَا سَمِعْنَا مُنَادِيَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَلاَ عَلِمْنَا بِمَا أَرَادَ الْقَوْمُ ‏.‏ وَقَدْ كَانَ فِي حَرَّةٍ فَمَشَى فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ الْمَاءَ قَلِيلٌ فَلاَ يَسْبِقُنِي إِلَيْهِ أَحَدٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَوَجَدَ قَوْمًا قَدْ سَبَقُوهُ فَلَعَنَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ ‏.‏

r: Sahih / Muslim / Characteristics of The Hypocrites And Rulings Concerning Them #2780
t: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا قُرَّةُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَنْ يَصْعَدُ الثَّنِيَّةَ ثَنِيَّةَ الْمُرَارِ فَإِنَّهُ يُحَطُّ عَنْهُ مَا حُطَّ عَنْ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَكَانَ أَوَّلَ مَنْ صَعِدَهَا خَيْلُنَا خَيْلُ بَنِي الْخَزْرَجِ ثُمَّ تَتَامَّ النَّاسُ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ وَكُلُّكُمْ مَغْفُورٌ لَهُ إِلاَّ صَاحِبَ الْجَمَلِ الأَحْمَرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَأَتَيْنَاهُ فَقُلْنَا لَهُ تَعَالَ يَسْتَغْفِرْ لَكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ وَاللَّهِ لأَنْ أَجِدَ ضَالَّتِي أَحَبُّ إِلَىَّ مِنْ أَنْ يَسْتَغْفِرَ لِي صَاحِبُكُمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَكَانَ رَجُلٌ يَنْشُدُ ضَالَّةً لَهُ ‏.‏

r: Sahih / Muslim / Characteristics of The Hypocrites And Rulings Concerning Them #2780a
t: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ الْحَارِثِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، حَدَّثَنَا قُرَّةُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ يَصْعَدُ ثَنِيَّةَ الْمُرَارِ أَوِ الْمَرَارِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ مُعَاذٍ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ وَإِذَا هُوَ أَعْرَابِيٌّ جَاءَ يَنْشُدُ ضَالَّةً لَهُ ‏.‏

r: Sahih / Muslim / Characteristics of The Hypocrites And Rulings Concerning Them #2781
t: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النَّضْرِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ - عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ كَانَ مِنَّا رَجُلٌ مِنْ بَنِي النَّجَّارِ قَدْ قَرَأَ الْبَقَرَةَ وَآلَ عِمْرَانَ وَكَانَ يَكْتُبُ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَانْطَلَقَ هَارِبًا حَتَّى لَحِقَ بِأَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ - قَالَ - فَرَفَعُوهُ قَالُوا هَذَا قَدْ كَانَ يَكْتُبُ لِمُحَمَّدٍ فَأُعْجِبُوا بِهِ فَمَا لَبِثَ أَنْ قَصَمَ اللَّهُ عُنُقَهُ فِيهِمْ فَحَفَرُوا لَهُ فَوَارَوْهُ فَأَصْبَحَتِ الأَرْضُ قَدْ نَبَذَتْهُ عَلَى وَجْهِهَا ثُمَّ عَادُوا فَحَفَرُوا لَهُ فَوَارَوْهُ فَأَصْبَحَتِ الأَرْضُ قَدْ نَبَذَتْهُ عَلَى وَجْهِهَا ثُمَّ عَادُوا فَحَفَرُوا لَهُ فَوَارَوْهُ فَأَصْبَحَتِ الأَرْضُ قَدْ نَبَذَتْهُ عَلَى وَجْهِهَا فَتَرَكُوهُ مَنْبُوذًا ‏.‏

r: Sahih / Muslim / Characteristics of The Hypocrites And Rulings Concerning Them #2782
t: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ غِيَاثٍ - عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَدِمَ مِنْ سَفَرٍ فَلَمَّا كَانَ قُرْبَ الْمَدِينَةِ هَاجَتْ رِيحٌ شَدِيدَةٌ تَكَادُ أَنْ تَدْفِنَ الرَّاكِبَ فَزَعَمَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ بُعِثَتْ هَذِهِ الرِّيحُ لِمَوْتِ مُنَافِقٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا قَدِمَ الْمَدِينَةَ فَإِذَا مُنَافِقٌ عَظِيمٌ مِنَ الْمُنَافِقِينَ قَدْ مَاتَ ‏.‏

r: Sahih / Muslim / Characteristics of The Hypocrites And Rulings Concerning Them #2783
t: حَدَّثَنِي عَبَّاسُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَظِيمِ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ النَّضْرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ، مُوسَى الْيَمَامِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا عِكْرِمَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا إِيَاسٌ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي قَالَ، عُدْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَجُلاً مَوْعُوكًا - قَالَ - فَوَضَعْتُ يَدِي عَلَيْهِ فَقُلْتُ وَاللَّهِ مَا رَأَيْتُ كَالْيَوْمِ رَجُلاً أَشَدَّ حَرًّا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَلاَ أُخْبِرُكُمْ بِأَشَدَّ حَرًّا مِنْهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ هَذَيْنِكَ الرَّجُلَيْنِ الرَّاكِبَيْنِ الْمُقَفِّيَيْنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ لِرَجُلَيْنِ حِينَئِذٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ ‏.‏

r: Sahih / Muslim / Characteristics of The Hypocrites And Rulings Concerning Them #2784
t: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي ح، وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، - يَعْنِي الثَّقَفِيَّ - حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَثَلُ الْمُنَافِقِ كَمَثَلِ الشَّاةِ الْعَائِرَةِ بَيْنَ الْغَنَمَيْنِ تَعِيرُ إِلَى هَذِهِ مَرَّةً وَإِلَى هَذِهِ مَرَّةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏

r: Sahih / Muslim / Characteristics of The Hypocrites And Rulings Concerning Them #2784a
t: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْقَارِيَّ - عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ تَكِرُّ فِي هَذِهِ مَرَّةً وَفِي هَذِهِ مَرَّةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏

r: Sahih / Muslim / Characteristics of the Day of Judgment Paradise and Hell #2785
t: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنِي الْمُغِيرَةُ، - يَعْنِي الْحِزَامِيَّ - عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّهُ لَيَأْتِي الرَّجُلُ الْعَظِيمُ السَّمِينُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ لاَ يَزِنُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ جَنَاحَ بَعُوضَةٍ اقْرَءُوا ‏{‏ فَلاَ نُقِيمُ لَهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَزْنًا‏}‏ ‏"‏ ‏.‏

r: Sahih / Muslim / Characteristics of the Day of Judgment Paradise and Hell #2786
t: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا فُضَيْلٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عِيَاضٍ - عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَبِيدَةَ السَّلْمَانِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، قَالَ جَاءَ حَبْرٌ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا مُحَمَّدُ أَوْ يَا أَبَا الْقَاسِمِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ تَعَالَى يُمْسِكُ السَّمَوَاتِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ عَلَى إِصْبَعٍ وَالأَرَضِينَ عَلَى إِصْبَعٍ وَالْجِبَالَ وَالشَّجَرَ عَلَى إِصْبَعٍ وَالْمَاءَ وَالثَّرَى عَلَى إِصْبَعٍ وَسَائِرَ الْخَلْقِ عَلَى إِصْبَعٍ ثُمَّ يَهُزُّهُنَّ فَيَقُولُ أَنَا الْمَلِكُ أَنَا الْمَلِكُ ‏.‏ فَضَحِكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم تَعَجُّبًا مِمَّا قَالَ الْحَبْرُ تَصْدِيقًا لَهُ ثُمَّ قَرَأَ ‏{‏ وَمَا قَدَرُوا اللَّهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهِ وَالأَرْضُ جَمِيعًا قَبْضَتُهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَالسَّمَوَاتُ مَطْوِيَّاتٌ بِيَمِينِهِ سُبْحَانَهُ وَتَعَالَى عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ‏}‏

r: Sahih / Muslim / Characteristics of the Day of Judgment Paradise and Hell #2786a
t: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ جَرِيرٍ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ قَالَ جَاءَ حَبْرٌ مِنَ الْيَهُودِ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ فُضَيْلٍ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ ثُمَّ يَهُزُّهُنَّ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ فَلَقَدْ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ضَحِكَ حَتَّى بَدَتْ نَوَاجِذُهُ تَعَجُّبًا لِمَا قَالَ تَصْدِيقًا لَهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ ‏{‏ وَمَا قَدَرُوا اللَّهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهِ‏}‏ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَتَلاَ الآيَةَ ‏.‏

r: Sahih / Muslim / Characteristics of the Day of Judgment Paradise and Hell #2786b
t: حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ حَفْصِ بْنِ غِيَاثٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ عَلْقَمَةَ، يَقُولُ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا أَبَا الْقَاسِمِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُمْسِكُ السَّمَوَاتِ عَلَى إِصْبَعٍ وَالأَرَضِينَ عَلَى إِصْبَعٍ وَالشَّجَرَ وَالثَّرَى عَلَى إِصْبَعٍ وَالْخَلاَئِقَ عَلَى إِصْبَعٍ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ أَنَا الْمَلِكُ أَنَا الْمَلِكُ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَرَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ضَحِكَ حَتَّى بَدَتْ نَوَاجِذُهُ ثُمَّ قَرَأَ ‏{‏ وَمَا قَدَرُوا اللَّهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهِ‏}‏

r: Sahih / Muslim / Characteristics of the Day of Judgment Paradise and Hell #2786c
t: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ، بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ خَشْرَمٍ قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي، شَيْبَةَ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ غَيْرَ أَنَّ فِي، حَدِيثِهِمْ جَمِيعًا وَالشَّجَرَ عَلَى إِصْبَعٍ وَالثَّرَى عَلَى إِصْبَعٍ وَلَيْسَ فِي حَدِيثِ جَرِيرٍ وَالْخَلاَئِقَ عَلَى إِصْبَعٍ ‏.‏ وَلَكِنْ فِي حَدِيثِهِ وَالْجِبَالَ عَلَى إِصْبَعٍ ‏.‏ وَزَادَ فِي حَدِيثِ جَرِيرٍ تَصْدِيقًا لَهُ تَعَجُّبًا لِمَا قَالَ ‏.‏

r: Sahih / Muslim / Characteristics of the Day of Judgment Paradise and Hell #2787
t: حَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، كَانَ يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ يَقْبِضُ اللَّهُ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى الأَرْضَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَيَطْوِي السَّمَاءَ بِيَمِينِهِ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ أَنَا الْمَلِكُ أَيْنَ مُلُوكُ الأَرْضِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏

r: Sahih / Muslim / Characteristics of the Day of Judgment Paradise and Hell #2788
t: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ حَمْزَةَ، عَنْ سَالِمِ، بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ يَطْوِي اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ السَّمَوَاتِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ثُمَّ يَأْخُذُهُنَّ بِيَدِهِ الْيُمْنَى ثُمَّ يَقُولُ أَنَا الْمَلِكُ أَيْنَ الْجَبَّارُونَ أَيْنَ الْمُتَكَبِّرُونَ ثُمَّ يَطْوِي الأَرَضِينَ بِشِمَالِهِ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ أَنَا الْمَلِكُ أَيْنَ الْجَبَّارُونَ أَيْنَ الْمُتَكَبِّرُونَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏

r: Sahih / Muslim / Characteristics of the Day of Judgment Paradise and Hell #2788a
t: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ - حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو حَازِمٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مِقْسَمٍ، أَنَّهُ نَظَرَ إِلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ كَيْفَ يَحْكِي رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ يَأْخُذُ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ سَمَوَاتِهِ وَأَرَضِيهِ بِيَدَيْهِ فَيَقُولُ أَنَا اللَّهُ - وَيَقْبِضُ أَصَابِعَهُ وَيَبْسُطُهَا - أَنَا الْمَلِكُ ‏"‏ حَتَّى نَظَرْتُ إِلَى الْمِنْبَرِ يَتَحَرَّكُ مِنْ أَسْفَلِ شَىْءٍ مِنْهُ حَتَّى إِنِّي لأَقُولُ أَسَاقِطٌ هُوَ بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم

r: Sahih / Muslim / Characteristics of the Day of Judgment Paradise and Hell #2788b
t: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ، اللَّهِ بْنِ مِقْسَمٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ وَهُوَ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ يَأْخُذُ الْجَبَّارُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ سَمَوَاتِهِ وَأَرَضِيهِ بِيَدَيْهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ يَعْقُوبَ ‏.‏

r: Sahih / Muslim / Characteristics of the Day of Judgment Paradise and Hell #2789
t: حَدَّثَنِي سُرَيْجُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، وَهَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ قَالَ ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ أَخْبَرَنِي إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أُمَيَّةَ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ بْنِ خَالِدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ رَافِعٍ، مَوْلَى أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ أَخَذَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِيَدِي فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ خَلَقَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ التُّرْبَةَ يَوْمَ السَّبْتِ وَخَلَقَ فِيهَا الْجِبَالَ يَوْمَ الأَحَدِ وَخَلَقَ الشَّجَرَ يَوْمَ الاِثْنَيْنِ وَخَلَقَ الْمَكْرُوهَ يَوْمَ الثُّلاَثَاءِ وَخَلَقَ النُّورَ يَوْمَ الأَرْبِعَاءِ وَبَثَّ فِيهَا الدَّوَابَّ يَوْمَ الْخَمِيسِ وَخَلَقَ آدَمَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ مِنْ يَوْمِ الْجُمُعَةِ فِي آخِرِ الْخَلْقِ وَفِي آخِرِ سَاعَةٍ مِنْ سَاعَاتِ الْجُمُعَةِ فِيمَا بَيْنَ الْعَصْرِ إِلَى اللَّيْلِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ حَدَّثَنَا الْبِسْطَامِيُّ، - وَهُوَ الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ عِيسَى - وَسَهْلُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ وَإِبْرَاهِيمُ ابْنُ بِنْتِ حَفْصٍ وَغَيْرُهُمْ عَنْ حَجَّاجٍ، بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ ‏.‏

r: Sahih / Muslim / Characteristics of the Day of Judgment Paradise and Hell #2790
t: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ أَبِي، كَثِيرٍ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو حَازِمِ بْنُ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ يُحْشَرُ النَّاسُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ عَلَى أَرْضٍ بَيْضَاءَ عَفْرَاءَ كَقُرْصَةِ النَّقِيِّ لَيْسَ فِيهَا عَلَمٌ لأَحَدٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏

r: Sahih / Muslim / Characteristics of the Day of Judgment Paradise and Hell #2791
t: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ قَوْلِهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏{‏ يَوْمَ تُبَدَّلُ الأَرْضُ غَيْرَ الأَرْضِ وَالسَّمَوَاتُ‏}‏ فَأَيْنَ يَكُونُ النَّاسُ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ عَلَى الصِّرَاطِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏

r: Sahih / Muslim / Characteristics of the Day of Judgment Paradise and Hell #2792
t: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ اللَّيْثِ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ جَدِّي، حَدَّثَنِي خَالِدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي هِلاَلٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ تَكُونُ الأَرْضُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ خُبْزَةً وَاحِدَةً يَكْفَؤُهَا الْجَبَّارُ بِيَدِهِ كَمَا يَكْفَأُ أَحَدُكُمْ خُبْزَتَهُ فِي السَّفَرِ نُزُلاً لأَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَتَى رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْيَهُودِ فَقَالَ بَارَكَ الرَّحْمَنُ عَلَيْكَ أَبَا الْقَاسِمِ أَلاَ أُخْبِرُكَ بِنُزُلِ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ قَالَ ‏"‏ بَلَى ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ تَكُونُ الأَرْضُ خُبْزَةً وَاحِدَةً - كَمَا قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم - قَالَ فَنَظَرَ إِلَيْنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ ضَحِكَ حَتَّى بَدَتْ نَوَاجِذُهُ قَالَ أَلاَ أُخْبِرُكَ بِإِدَامِهِمْ قَالَ ‏"‏ بَلَى ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ إِدَامُهُمْ بَالاَمُ وَنُونٌ ‏.‏ قَالُوا وَمَا هَذَا قَالَ ثَوْرٌ وَنُونٌ يَأْكُلُ مِنْ زَائِدَةِ كَبِدِهِمَا سَبْعُونَ أَلْفًا ‏.‏

r: Sahih / Muslim / Characteristics of the Day of Judgment Paradise and Hell #2793
t: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ الْحَارِثِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، حَدَّثَنَا قُرَّةُ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لَوْ تَابَعَنِي عَشْرَةٌ مِنَ الْيَهُودِ لَمْ يَبْقَ عَلَى ظَهْرِهَا يَهُودِيٌّ إِلاَّ أَسْلَمَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏

r: Sahih / Muslim / Characteristics of the Day of Judgment Paradise and Hell #2794
t: حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ حَفْصِ بْنِ غِيَاثٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ بَيْنَمَا أَنَا أَمْشِي، مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي حَرْثٍ وَهُوَ مُتَّكِئٌ عَلَى عَسِيبٍ إِذْ مَرَّ بِنَفَرٍ مِنَ الْيَهُودِ فَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ سَلُوهُ عَنِ الرُّوحِ فَقَالُوا مَا رَابَكُمْ إِلَيْهِ لاَ يَسْتَقْبِلُكُمْ بِشَىْءٍ تَكْرَهُونَهُ ‏.‏ فَقَالُوا سَلُوهُ فَقَامَ إِلَيْهِ بَعْضُهُمْ فَسَأَلَهُ عَنِ الرُّوحِ - قَالَ - فَأَسْكَتَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمْ يَرُدَّ عَلَيْهِ شَيْئًا فَعَلِمْتُ أَنَّهُ يُوحَى إِلَيْهِ - قَالَ - فَقُمْتُ مَكَانِي فَلَمَّا نَزَلَ الْوَحْىُ قَالَ ‏{‏ وَيَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ الرُّوحِ قُلِ الرُّوحُ مِنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّي وَمَا أُوتِيتُمْ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ إِلاَّ قَلِيلاً‏}‏

r: Sahih / Muslim / Characteristics of the Day of Judgment Paradise and Hell #2794a
t: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو سَعِيدٍ الأَشَجُّ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْحَنْظَلِيُّ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ خَشْرَمٍ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ كُنْتُ أَمْشِي مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي حَرْثٍ بِالْمَدِينَةِ ‏.‏ بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِ حَفْصٍ غَيْرَ أَنَّ فِي حَدِيثِ وَكِيعٍ وَمَا أُوتِيتُمْ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ إِلاَّ قَلِيلاً ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ عِيسَى بْنِ يُونُسَ وَمَا أُوتُوا ‏.‏ مِنْ رِوَايَةِ ابْنِ خَشْرَمٍ ‏.‏

r: Sahih / Muslim / Characteristics of the Day of Judgment Paradise and Hell #2794b
t: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو سَعِيدٍ الأَشَجُّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ إِدْرِيسَ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ الأَعْمَشَ، يَرْوِيهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي نَخْلٍ يَتَوَكَّأُ عَلَى عَسِيبٍ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِهِمْ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ وَقَالَ فِي رِوَايَتِهِ وَمَا أُوتِيتُمْ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ إِلاَّ قَلِيلاً ‏.‏

r: Sahih / Muslim / Characteristics of the Day of Judgment Paradise and Hell #2795
t: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَشَجُّ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ أَبِي الضُّحَى، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ خَبَّابٍ، قَالَ كَانَ لِي عَلَى الْعَاصِ بْنِ وَائِلٍ دَيْنٌ فَأَتَيْتُهُ أَتَقَاضَاهُ فَقَالَ لِي لَنْ أَقْضِيَكَ حَتَّى تَكْفُرَ بِمُحَمَّدٍ - قَالَ - فَقُلْتُ لَهُ إِنِّي لَنْ أَكْفُرَ بِمُحَمَّدٍ حَتَّى تَمُوتَ ثُمَّ تُبْعَثَ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَإِنِّي لَمَبْعُوثٌ مِنْ بَعْدِ الْمَوْتِ فَسَوْفَ أَقْضِيكَ إِذَا رَجَعْتُ إِلَى مَالٍ وَوَلَدٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَكِيعٌ كَذَا قَالَ الأَعْمَشُ قَالَ فَنَزَلَتْ هَذِهِ الآيَةُ ‏{‏ أَفَرَأَيْتَ الَّذِي كَفَرَ بِآيَاتِنَا وَقَالَ لأُوتَيَنَّ مَالاً وَوَلَدًا‏}‏ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ ‏{‏ وَيَأْتِينَا فَرْدًا‏}‏

r: Sahih / Muslim / Characteristics of the Day of Judgment Paradise and Hell #2795a
t: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي ح، وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ وَكِيعٍ وَفِي حَدِيثِ جَرِيرٍ قَالَ كُنْتُ قَيْنًا فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ فَعَمِلْتُ لِلْعَاصِ بْنِ وَائِلٍ عَمَلاً فَأَتَيْتُهُ أَتَقَاضَاهُ ‏.‏

r: Sahih / Muslim / Characteristics of the Day of Judgment Paradise and Hell #2796
t: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ الزِّيَادِيِّ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، يَقُولُ قَالَ أَبُو جَهْلٍ اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كَانَ هَذَا هُوَ الْحَقَّ مِنْ عِنْدِكَ فَأَمْطِرْ عَلَيْنَا حِجَارَةً مِنَ السَّمَاءِ أَوِ ائْتِنَا بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ ‏.‏ فَنَزَلَتْ ‏{‏ وَمَا كَانَ اللَّهُ لِيُعَذِّبَهُمْ وَأَنْتَ فِيهِمْ وَمَا كَانَ اللَّهُ مُعَذِّبَهُمْ وَهُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ * وَمَا لَهُمْ أَلاَّ يُعَذِّبَهُمُ اللَّهُ وَهُمْ يَصُدُّونَ عَنِ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ‏}‏ إِلَى آخِرِ الآيَةِ ‏.‏

r: Sahih / Muslim / Characteristics of the Day of Judgment Paradise and Hell #2797
t: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى الْقَيْسِيُّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعْتَمِرُ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، حَدَّثَنِي نُعَيْمُ بْنُ أَبِي هِنْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو جَهْلٍ هَلْ يُعَفِّرُ مُحَمَّدٌ وَجْهَهُ بَيْنَ أَظْهُرِكُمْ قَالَ فَقِيلَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ وَاللاَّتِ وَالْعُزَّى لَئِنْ رَأَيْتُهُ يَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ لأَطَأَنَّ عَلَى رَقَبَتِهِ أَوْ لأُعَفِّرَنَّ وَجْهَهُ فِي التُّرَابِ - قَالَ - فَأَتَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ يُصَلِّي زَعَمَ لِيَطَأَ عَلَى رَقَبَتِهِ - قَالَ - فَمَا فَجِئَهُمْ مِنْهُ إِلاَّ وَهُوَ يَنْكِصُ عَلَى عَقِبَيْهِ وَيَتَّقِي بِيَدَيْهِ - قَالَ - فَقِيلَ لَهُ مَا لَكَ فَقَالَ إِنَّ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُ لَخَنْدَقًا مِنْ نَارٍ وَهَوْلاً وَأَجْنِحَةً ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لَوْ دَنَا مِنِّي لاَخْتَطَفَتْهُ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ عُضْوًا عُضْوًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ لاَ نَدْرِي فِي حَدِيثِ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ أَوْ شَىْءٌ بَلَغَهُ ‏{‏ كَلاَّ إِنَّ الإِنْسَانَ لَيَطْغَى * أَنْ رَآهُ اسْتَغْنَى * إِنَّ إِلَى رَبِّكَ الرُّجْعَى * أَرَأَيْتَ الَّذِي يَنْهَى * عَبْدًا إِذَا صَلَّى * أَرَأَيْتَ إِنْ كَانَ عَلَى الْهُدَى * أَوْ أَمَرَ بِالتَّقْوَى * أَرَأَيْتَ إِنْ كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّى‏}‏ - يَعْنِي أَبَا جَهْلٍ - ‏{‏ أَلَمْ يَعْلَمْ بِأَنَّ اللَّهَ يَرَى * كَلاَّ لَئِنْ لَمْ يَنْتَهِ لَنَسْفَعًا بِالنَّاصِيَةِ * نَاصِيَةٍ كَاذِبَةٍ خَاطِئَةٍ * فَلْيَدْعُ نَادِيَهُ * سَنَدْعُ الزَّبَانِيَةَ * كَلاَّ لاَ تُطِعْهُ‏}‏ زَادَ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ فِي حَدِيثِهِ قَالَ وَأَمَرَهُ بِمَا أَمَرَهُ بِهِ ‏.‏ وَزَادَ ابْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى فَلْيَدْعُ نَادِيَهُ يَعْنِي قَوْمَهُ ‏.‏

r: Sahih / Muslim / Characteristics of the Day of Judgment Paradise and Hell #2798
t: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الضُّحَى، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، قَالَ كُنَّا عِنْدَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ جُلُوسًا وَهُوَ مُضْطَجِعٌ بَيْنَنَا فَأَتَاهُ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ إِنَّ قَاصًّا عِنْدَ أَبْوَابِ كِنْدَةَ يَقُصُّ وَيَزْعُمُ أَنَّ آيَةَ الدُّخَانِ تَجِيءُ فَتَأْخُذُ بِأَنْفَاسِ الْكُفَّارِ وَيَأْخُذُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ مِنْهُ كَهَيْئَةِ الزُّكَامِ فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ وَجَلَسَ وَهُوَ غَضْبَانُ يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ مَنْ عَلِمَ مِنْكُمْ شَيْئًا فَلْيَقُلْ بِمَا يَعْلَمُ وَمَنْ لَمْ يَعْلَمْ فَلْيَقُلِ اللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ فَإِنَّهُ أَعْلَمُ لأَحَدِكُمْ أَنْ يَقُولَ لِمَا لاَ يَعْلَمُ اللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ قَالَ لِنَبِيِّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏{‏ قُلْ مَا أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ وَمَا أَنَا مِنَ الْمُتَكَلِّفِينَ‏}‏ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَمَّا رَأَى مِنَ النَّاسِ إِدْبَارًا فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ سَبْعٌ كَسَبْعِ يُوسُفَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَخَذَتْهُمْ سَنَةٌ حَصَّتْ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ حَتَّى أَكَلُوا الْجُلُودَ وَالْمَيْتَةَ مِنَ الْجُوعِ وَيَنْظُرُ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ أَحَدُهُمْ فَيَرَى كَهَيْئَةِ الدُّخَانِ فَأَتَاهُ أَبُو سُفْيَانَ فَقَالَ يَا مُحَمَّدُ إِنَّكَ جِئْتَ تَأْمُرُ بِطَاعَةِ اللَّهِ وَبِصِلَةِ الرَّحِمِ وَإِنَّ قَوْمَكَ قَدْ هَلَكُوا فَادْعُ اللَّهَ لَهُمْ - قَالَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏{‏ فَارْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَأْتِي السَّمَاءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُبِينٍ * يَغْشَى النَّاسَ هَذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ‏}‏ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ ‏{‏ إِنَّكُمْ عَائِدُونَ‏}‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَفَيُكْشَفُ عَذَابُ الآخِرَةِ ‏{‏ يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ الْبَطْشَةَ الْكُبْرَى إِنَّا مُنْتَقِمُونَ‏}‏ فَالْبَطْشَةُ يَوْمَ بَدْرٍ وَقَدْ مَضَتْ آيَةُ الدُّخَانِ وَالْبَطْشَةُ وَاللِّزَامُ وَآيَةُ الرُّومِ ‏.‏

r: Sahih / Muslim / Characteristics of the Day of Judgment Paradise and Hell #2798a
t: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، وَوَكِيعٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَعِيدٍ، الأَشَجُّ أَخْبَرَنَا وَكِيعٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لِيَحْيَى - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ مُسْلِمِ بْنِ صُبَيْحٍ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، قَالَ جَاءَ إِلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ تَرَكْتُ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ رَجُلاً يُفَسِّرُ الْقُرْآنَ بِرَأْيِهِ يُفَسِّرُ هَذِهِ الآيَةَ ‏{‏ يَوْمَ تَأْتِي السَّمَاءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُبِينٍ‏}‏ قَالَ يَأْتِي النَّاسَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ دُخَانٌ فَيَأْخُذُ بِأَنْفَاسِهِمْ حَتَّى يَأْخُذَهُمْ مِنْهُ كَهَيْئَةِ الزُّكَامِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ مَنْ عَلِمَ عِلْمًا فَلْيَقُلْ بِهِ وَمَنْ لَمْ يَعْلَمْ فَلْيَقُلِ اللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ فَإِنَّ مِنْ فِقْهِ الرَّجُلِ أَنْ يَقُولَ لِمَا لاَ عِلْمَ لَهُ بِهِ اللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ ‏.‏ إِنَّمَا كَانَ هَذَا أَنَّ قُرَيْشًا لَمَّا اسْتَعْصَتْ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم دَعَا عَلَيْهِمْ بِسِنِينَ كَسِنِي يُوسُفَ فَأَصَابَهُمْ قَحْطٌ وَجَهْدٌ حَتَّى جَعَلَ الرَّجُلُ يَنْظُرُ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ فَيَرَى بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَهَا كَهَيْئَةِ الدُّخَانِ مِنَ الْجَهْدِ وَحَتَّى أَكَلُوا الْعِظَامَ فَأَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ اسْتَغْفِرِ اللَّهَ لِمُضَرَ فَإِنَّهُمْ قَدْ هَلَكُوا فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لِمُضَرَ إِنَّكَ لَجَرِيءٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَدَعَا اللَّهَ لَهُمْ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏{‏ إِنَّا كَاشِفُو الْعَذَابِ قَلِيلاً إِنَّكُمْ عَائِدُونَ‏}‏ قَالَ فَمُطِرُوا فَلَمَّا أَصَابَتْهُمُ الرَّفَاهِيَةُ - قَالَ - عَادُوا إِلَى مَا كَانُوا عَلَيْهِ - قَالَ - فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏{‏ فَارْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَأْتِي السَّمَاءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُبِينٍ * يَغْشَى النَّاسَ هَذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ‏}‏ ‏{‏ يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ الْبَطْشَةَ الْكُبْرَى إِنَّا مُنْتَقِمُونَ‏}‏ قَالَ يَعْنِي يَوْمَ بَدْرٍ ‏.‏

r: Sahih / Muslim / Characteristics of the Day of Judgment Paradise and Hell #2798b
t: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي الضُّحَى، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ خَمْسٌ قَدْ مَضَيْنَ الدُّخَانُ وَاللِّزَامُ وَالرُّومُ وَالْبَطْشَةُ وَالْقَمَرُ ‏.‏

r: Sahih / Muslim / Characteristics of the Day of Judgment Paradise and Hell #2798c
t: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو سَعِيدٍ الأَشَجُّ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏

r: Sahih / Muslim / Characteristics of the Day of Judgment Paradise and Hell #2799
t: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ عَزْرَةَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ الْعُرَنِيِّ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ الْجَزَّارِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنْ أُبَىِّ، بْنِ كَعْبٍ فِي قَوْلِهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏{‏ وَلَنُذِيقَنَّهُمْ مِنَ الْعَذَابِ الأَدْنَى دُونَ الْعَذَابِ الأَكْبَرِ‏}‏ قَالَ مَصَائِبُ الدُّنْيَا وَالرُّومُ وَالْبَطْشَةُ أَوِ الدُّخَانُ ‏.‏ شُعْبَةُ الشَّاكُّ فِي الْبَطْشَةِ أَوِ الدُّخَانِ ‏.‏

r: Sahih / Muslim / Characteristics of the Day of Judgment Paradise and Hell #2800
t: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي، نَجِيحٍ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ انْشَقَّ الْقَمَرُ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِشِقَّتَيْنِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ اشْهَدُوا ‏"‏ ‏.‏

r: Sahih / Muslim / Characteristics of the Day of Judgment Paradise and Hell #2800a
t: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ جَمِيعًا عَنْ أَبِي، مُعَاوِيَةَ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ حَفْصِ بْنِ غِيَاثٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي كِلاَهُمَا، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مِنْجَابُ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ التَّمِيمِيُّ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ أَبِي مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، قَالَ بَيْنَمَا نَحْنُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِنًى إِذَا انْفَلَقَ الْقَمَرُ فِلْقَتَيْنِ فَكَانَتْ فِلْقَةٌ وَرَاءَ الْجَبَلِ وَفِلْقَةٌ دُونَهُ فَقَالَ لَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ اشْهَدُوا ‏"‏ ‏.‏

r: Sahih / Muslim / Characteristics of the Day of Judgment Paradise and Hell #2800b
t: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ أَبِي مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، قَالَ انْشَقَّ الْقَمَرُ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِلْقَتَيْنِ فَسَتَرَ الْجَبَلُ فِلْقَةً وَكَانَتْ فِلْقَةٌ فَوْقَ الْجَبَلِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ اشْهَدْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏

r: Sahih / Muslim / Characteristics of the Day of Judgment Paradise and Hell #2801
